source_doc: Some are good, some STANK. I'm a flower person, I love all things floral scents and I came at this knowing what I want. What I don't understand is why the seller doesn't group up the flower scents and the musky [really, musty] scents in one pack? I bought the green variety pack after returning the pink one and I'm still not 100% satisfied since I can't just choose a set with only floral scents.The Jasmine is great, skydive too, but the open and Darbar stink to high heaven! source_doc: Brings sound down a notch and are super comfy. I work from home and have a couple of dogs a toddler and various other distractions around the house, usually when I want to tune them out I throw on some headphones but sometimes I just want quiet so I got these to help with that.  It came packaged well and I didn't see any defects in them.  In the box you get a case, two rings to put the ear tips on, and 6 different ear tips to use.  I chose the large double-flanged and got to it. Getting the stock tips off was fairly easy and putting the new ones on was too after that I stuck them in.  It isn't complete noise cancelation I can still hear most things fine but it's like the volume got turned down a bit which I love.  Also when Im wearing them I can barely feel them so I might actually try sleeping in them.  All in all, these are fantastic 5 starts not notes.

source_doc: Great console organizer! Even better with a few modifications! I got the one without the coin holder and USB ports! I did this for several reasons:1. I want to use a rapid charger for my phone2. I've read reviews about the coin holder being a knuckle buster when putting the car in park3. The USB ports could break later on meaning you'd need to replace the entire unit4. Better utilization of space to not have the USB ports taking up space in an already small compartment.So i made a few modifications to an already great console organizer. I used my dremel to cut a square in the top to allow the console light to enter the top compartment. I also cut 2 holes in the back of the organizer to allow me to run my apple charger through any compartment that I wanted. I chose the small upper right corner for my ear pod charger. Check out the photos.The unit fits tight and snug like a glove. I really don't have any complaints about this unit although it would have been better if it already came with the modifications that I did. Overall I'll give it 5 stars and I would highly recommend it!

source_doc: Might work for others, but not for me. I am an older lady.  I have a small, older car.  It will probably be the last car I own, too.  So I wanted to try to protect the seats.  The problem is, I didn't think about how I get into my car.  Because it is a small car and I am older, I open the driver's door, turn away from the driver's seat and then lower myself onto the seat.  THEN I both turn and pull my legs into the car.  Because of how I pivot by turning and pulling my legs in, these lay-on-top covers just get all twisted beneath me!  You really think I want to try to lean up in the seat and fiddle with this tangled/twisted seat cover beneath me???  SMH...for this price these should be way better than they are.

source_doc: great stabilizers and super pretty!!! OMG! I LOVE these rings! I purchased a set of 6"-12" crystal bowls from Amazon. I really enjoy them, as does my kitty Olivia who regularly totally blisses out listening to them! (The root chakra bowl is her favorite, in case your interested!) The only problem was that the tiniest bowl, the crown chakra bowl, was seriously unstable. I found it super difficult and frustrating to play. The problem may well have been that I have the bowls on carpet. I don't know, although I did try setting it on a stone coaster. (Desperate, I know!)  But it got frustrating enough that I eventually replaced it with an 8" bowl. I needn't have bothered! The new ring perfectly, absolutely, 100% stablizes the bowl, perhaps because it raises it above the caarpet. I don't know! I DO know that these rings are much thicker and actually  hug the bowl. Also, unlike the rubber rings which seem to come in only 2 sizes,  these are individually sized to fit each bowl. The bowls aslo seem to sound better. The carpet issue again?? They are also color coordinated to each bowl and are readily visible, so they are super pretty, I mean, really pretty! I am thrilled with this purchase.
hypos: Skvělé stabilizátory a super hezké!!! OMG! Miluji tyto prsteny! Koupil/a jsem sadu krystalových misek o velikosti 6"-12" z Amazonu. Opravdu si je užívám, stejně jako moje kočka Olivia, která pravidelně úplně vychutnává, když je poslouchá! (Miska pro kořenovou čakru je její oblíbená, pokud máte zájem!) Jediný problém byl, že nejmenší miska, miska pro korunní čakru, byla vážně nestabilní. Přišlo mi velmi obtížné a frustrující na ni hrát. Problém mohl být v tom, že mám misky na koberci. Nevím, i když jsem se pokusil/a postavit ji na kamenou podložku. (Bezradný/á, to vím!) Ale bylo to dost frustrující, takže jsem ji nakonec vyměnil/a za 8" misku. Nemusel/a jsem se obtěžovat! Nový prsten perfektně, naprosto, 100% stabilizuje misku, možná protože ji zvedá nad koberec. Nevím! Vím však, že tyto prsteny jsou mnohem silnější a skutečně objímají misku. Také, na rozdíl od gumových prstenů, které se zdají být jen ve 2 velikostech, jsou tyto individuálně přizpůsobené pro každou misku. Misky také vypadají, že lépe zní. Zase ten koberec?? Jsou také barevně sladěné s každou miskou a jsou snadno viditelné, takže jsou super hezké, myslím, opravdu hezké! Jsem nadšen/á z tohoto nákupu.

source_doc: Great rower. Pros:  I have been using this rower for a few months now.  This is a great, sturdy, affordable rower! I do not personally have any trouble with the foot straps.  They are velco and very strong.  I love the whole body workout that I get from this rower.  I filled the water to maximum strength and after 10 minutes, my heart is pumping!  The seat is more comfortable than other rowers I have used, and seems to be a little cushioned as opposed to hard plastic which was one of the main reason why I purchased this one.  Having a comfy seat, will allow me to work out longer!Cons: I wish it came with a few water purification tablets.  I don't understand the electronic board and I threw away the manual.  I wish the timer would stay put instead of going back and forth to some other number.

source_doc: I can't deny, I love these bare limbed lighted trees. I have one the same height as this one but it is all white lights.  I still love it - it puts off more light that you would think and it's just really pretty when lit up at night.  This one, having colorful lights is just as pretty, but I do love that this one has several colors.  The only thing I might wish for is that this had a remote so that I could change the colors to a solid color, have it fade or pulse, or even have all the colors race.  See, I don't put up a Christmas tree and this would be sort of a substitute.  Other than that, I love this tree.  It was easy to put together and I used a smart plug so that I could turn it on with voice control through Alexa.  Love this tree!

source_doc: Made me break out, scent is a bit strong for me. This has a sticky texture and doesn't quite absorb into the skin, but rather, sits on top of it. I personally didn't love the scent and found it to be a bit strong. I put this on my body and immediately started itching and developed hives. As soon as that happened, I went to wash it off my body and then came to read the reviews, where I learned from another review that this is meant to be WASHED OFF after applying, though it isn't included in the package instructions. I must say that, after rinsing, I did feel a bit of relief from the pain I was experiencing and it did help me feel sleepy.I would use it again, but this needs clearer instructions.Also, about the pack@ging: Personally, I feel it's a bit wasteful to pack the plastic-wrapped bottle in a heavy b0x, use something to fill the empty space. And the note from the family is sweet, but I don't know them and it's printed on heavy cardstock. I'm not hanging it in my house anywhere, and I'd rather none of this was included, it just gave me more to discard (I recycled the b0x, its filling and the note). But even if I were giving this as a gift (which I wouldn't), it felt a bit overdone and wasteful.

source_doc: Sleek flosser. I love this flosser.  Opening it up, it looks and feels like a quality piece.  What I love most about it, is its sleek and minimalist design. I'm a sucker for a good design, and It doesn't look like every other flosser you see out there.  It's well designed, and easy to hold and use.After I charged it up and cleaned all the necessary pieces, I tried it out for the first time.  Filling it is quick, with the reservoir at the top.  It's very easy to use, you can change the levels simply by pressing the power button. Mine was set at the strongest setting, and I quickly adjusted it to a lower setting.  Even at the lowest setting, It does a fantastic job at getting all the dirty bits out of my teeth, leaving my mouth feeling extra clean.  I've only felt the need to use the standard nozzle so far, but the others are there for when I need them.Verdict:  I'm so glad I got this. It's worth it's price in my opinion.  I love the design of it, I don't mind if it's sitting outside on the counter, and not put away. I would absolutely purchase this again if I ever needed to replace this one in a few years.

source_doc: I thought it had an on off button. I have a few Snarks  and the pivoting features  have broken..  I had tried to duct tape them, but  ultimately they were finished... Since I have several guitars, my theory is to have a tuner with each guitar... everything in it's place. to replace the Snarks, I ordered 2 FENDER  tuners, wanting to try something different.I  was pleasantly pleased! Fender's oval hinge feature makes me believe that I will not have any breakage issues. The tuner's panel is very easy to read and shuts off in 5 minutes. I've had these tuners  for 2 days now, and so far they are pretty nice. Of course i will come back and update later on in the year, but for now i give it 4 stars until I witness the Fender's durability.One thing I didn't count on, was the lack of an on/off switch. I almost sent the tuners back, but tried it out for the hell of it. The on/off is automatic and shuts itself off in 5 minutes, which is more than enough time to tune up.  If you are jamming and want to tune later in your session, all you have to do is unclip from guitar re-clip to the head stock. I'm guessing the on/off switch is paired up with the tuner's clip on screw. It's not that bad of a feature.Good Job, Fender!

source_doc: My cat love this water fountain! I used to buy my cat bottled water for her water dish (yes, I know I am a little over the top, but everyone's pipes are gross). When I work sometimes I would forget to check my cats water bowl. I always knew my cat was out of water because she would follow me and my boyfriend to the bathroom to drink from the faucet. Ever since I got this fountain my cat has totally stopped trying to drink out of the faucet, and I have saved money on buying bottled water. The first day I think my cat was a little apprehensive, but she soon grew comfortable with the fountain! I have had it now for three weeks and it hasn't ran out of charge. You can run a 10 min cycle that will purify all the water. I have not found a water filter that this company makes, but I have found others that I cut in half. They work great. I will never go back to a plain water dish because I love this water fountain asich as I am sure my cat does!!! If you love your animals like I do than buy this fountain. The first picture shows you all the parts that come with this fountain. The only thing you will need to start is a charging block, and eventually you will need to buy more filters.

source_doc: Nice. I have lots of long thick hair.  I am particular about how I wash and dry it.  I didn't realize this was rectangular when I got it so when I opened it I was a little disappointed.  I've been using those ergonomic head-shaped twist ones for so long I was skeptical (you know, like turbie-twist).  So when I tried this I was really surprised.  It's really big and fluffy but it actually stays better up on my head than the contoured ones.  It isn't as heavy as it seems and it doesn't pull on my hair as tightly as the ones I was using before.  I actually get more volume in my hair with this because y hair isn't compacted down as tightly and it doesn't pull my hair backwards into a tight little towel.  It's a single piece of fabric with very tough elastic sewn onto it for your tuck.And as I discovered just the other day, if your kids spill a jug on the floor then use every bathroom towel to clean up their mess right before your shower, this towel wrap is big enough to dry your whole body, cover you as you duck down the hall and still dry enough to use on your hair afterwards.

source_doc: Love the color and brightness, but they do not last. I purchased 2 boxes of these lights 2 years ago (march of 2021) to replace old can lighting in our basement and kitchen. Out of the 24 lights I installed probably 17 of them. I love the color of the light and how bright they are. HOWEVER.... I am giving these lights 1 start because over the last year one by one they have been dying and need to be replaced. I am at the point where I have had to use the 7 extras that I had to replace ones that died. Since using the last spare I had which was maybe 2 weeks ago,  I now am sitting in my basement with 2 dead lights and one dead one in my kitchen. Very disappointed how they did not last at all. Total waste of money as I am going to have to buy all new lights knowing that the ones I have left are going to die soon.

source_doc: Versatile cat shelter. I helped a young feral cat all fall. I bought this shelter for him.  I was impressed with it's sturdiness, and how rain rolled right off.  I stuffed it with straw and he used it regularly.  Recently I found a barn home for him. I have 2 other feral shelters in the back yard so I wondered if I should leave this one out too.  I cleaned out the straw and put a soft rug in it. I put it back in one closet.  I was not sure if my inside cats would take to it, but they did. Now there's a race to see who gets it first. No need to hang a no vacancy sign on it.  One cat is always in it.
hypos: Univerzální kočičí útulek. Pomohl/a jsem mladé divoké kočce celé podzim. Koupil/a jsem tento útulek pro něj/ni. Byl/a jsem ohromen/a jeho pevností a tím, jak voda přímo stékala dolů. Naplnil/a jsem ho slámou a on/ona ho pravidelně používal/a. Nedávno jsem našel/a pro něj/ni stáji domov. Mám 2 další divoké útulky na zahradě, tak jsem se divil/a, jestli bych neměl/a nechat tento také venku. Vyčistil/a jsem slámu a dal/a do něj měkký koberec. Vrátil/a jsem ho zpět do jedné skříně. Nebyl/a jsem si jistý/á, jestli si ho moji domácí kočky oblíbi/í, ale oblíbil/a. Teď je závod, kdo to dostane první. Není potřeba viset na něj ceduli "není volno". Jedna kočka je v něm vždy.

source_doc: Helps for arthritis-type pain. Many reviewers say the capsules are big. I agree. I take with a cupful of water and thoroughly wet it before swallowing but it still sticks in my throat for a few minutes. I don’t know why.That said, this supplement is amazing. Another reviewer mentioned it helped with her arthritis. I don’t know if what I have is arthritis, but for nearly a year I have had pain in my left hand and have not been able to close my fingers completely into a fist. Not even halfway. I tried creams, ibuprofen, Tylenol, and even dmso, and nothing helped the pain or changed how my fingers closed. It got to the point I became used to the pain and basically accepted it as my new normal until I got around to seeing a doctor—not easy to do in the rural area I live in. So when I read the review that mentioned how it helped with the person’s arthritis, I looked at my hand. I had only been taking it for 2 or 3 days, but the pain was gone, and I could close my hand almost completely. I hadn’t even noticed! I take only one capsule a day now (half the daily dosage), and take it with liposomal vitamin c for better absorption, and my hand is doing great. I’m sure it must be helping me in other ways I don’t recognize. Great product!
hypos: Pomáhá při bolesti typu artritidy. Mnoho recenzentů říká, že kapsle jsou velké. Souhlasím. Beru je s hrnkem vody a důkladně je navlhčím před polknutím, ale stejně se mi na pár minut uvíznou v krku. Nevím proč. To ale neznamená, že tento doplněk je úžasný. Další recenzentka uvedla, že jí pomohl s artritidou. Nevím, zda to, co mám, je artritida, ale téměř rok mě bolí levá ruka a nedokážu úplně sevřít prsty do pěsti. Ani napůl. Zkoušela jsem krémy, ibuprofen, Tylenol a dokonce dmso, a nic mi nepomohlo na bolest ani nezměnilo, jak se mi prsty zavíraly. Dospěla jsem do bodu, kdy jsem si na bolest zvykla a vlastně ji přijala jako svoji novou normu, až jsem se dostala k tomu, abych šla k lékaři—v oblasti, kde bydlím, není snadné to udělat. Když jsem tedy četla recenzi, která zmiňovala, jak to pomohlo s artritidou dotyčné osoby, podívala jsem se na svou ruku. Brala jsem to jen 2 nebo 3 dny, ale bolest byla pryč, a mohla jsem ruku skoro úplně zavřít. Ani jsem si toho nevšimla! Teď beru jen jednu kapsli denně (polovinu denní dávky) a beru ji s liposomálním vitamínem C pro lepší vstřebávání, a moje ruka je na tom skvěle. Jsem si jistá, že mi to musí pomáhat i jiným způsobem, který nepoznávám. Skvělý produkt!

source_doc: Bright is a Under Statement. I have been wanting to switch over to LED's for awhile now, but I have held off because the colors of LED's were more pastel and didn't look good to me. So I can honestly say these do look great and remind me of my classic C9's. I still have over 20 strands of C9 Christmas Lights from the 70's that are still going strong with GE light blubs. More than half are still original and look great, but as you can guess my light bill for Nov. - Jan. shoots up a lot when using.So when I saw these lights I decided to try one box. When they came and I first tried out I was blown away how good they looked.  They look so good. I will be definitely getting more.  Well let me redo that last statement. If these hold up this season, and make it through the cold weather, rain, snow, ice. Then I will be getting more. I will update later if they don't, but for now all is good.
hypos: Jasné je podhodnocení. Už nějakou dobu chci přejít na LED, ale odkládal/a jsem to, protože barvy LED byly spíše pastelové a nepřipadaly mi hezké. Takže mohu upřímně říct, že tyto vypadají skvěle a připomínají mi moje klasické C9. Stále mám přes 20 řetězů vánočních světel C9 z 70. let, které stále mají sílu s žárovkami GE. Více než polovina je ještě originální a vypadají skvěle, ale jak si můžete domyslet, moje účty za elektřinu na listopad - leden stoupají hodně při používání. Když jsem tedy viděl/a tato světla, rozhodl/a jsem se vyzkoušet jednu krabici. Když dorazila a poprvé jsem je vyzkoušel/a, byl/a jsem ohromen/a, jak dobře vypadají. Vypadají tak dobře. Určitě si jich pořídím víc. No, dovolte mi to poslední tvrzení přeformulovat. Pokud tyto vydrží tuto sezónu a přežijí chladné počasí, déšť, sníh, led. Pak si jich pořídím víc. Později dám vědět, pokud ne, ale prozatím je vše v pořádku.

source_doc: Excellent feed. I bought this for my green winged macaw because her other food went up $20 and I wanted something a little less expensive. Despite what some people said about their birds rejecting it I decided to try it anyways. It had a good pellet size, smelled good and had a nice crumble factor to it. My bird usually dives into her other food but only ate a little bit of it when I put it in her dish. Usually she eats all her food by 5 pm which is her second feeding time. There were pellets left over. I waited a few days for her to get used to it but she never did. I did not want her to go to many more days without eating so I broke down and despite the cost  bought her, her old food which is what I will keep her on from now on. I have nothing negative to say about this product except you have a 50/50 chance of your bird liking it. I didnt want this to go to waste so I gave it to my friend who owns a bunch of parrots.

source_doc: I was unsure at first BUT... I was unsure when I first took this out of it's box. I needed a carrier because I realized I really can't carry my newborn and do other things around the house at the same time. I forgot how useful carriers were with my first son. It's intimidating at first to see all the straps, but once you get this adjusted for your body and baby it's a breeze to snap it right on you. My 6 week old currently loves being close to me and sleeping on my chest. In fact this is his favorite place to take naps in during the day. It gets him settled down real quick when he gets a little fussy. It's so durable and sturdy I don't worry about baby in here when doing anything around the house. I even take this with me at the office, fortunately I own my own business so I can take baby with me to work. For the price it's great, it's worth every penny and more. I plan to use this the whole time baby can stay in a carrier. I love this better Tham the bjorn, which I had with my first son. This is so much more versatile and transforms as the baby grows.
hypos: Na začátku jsem si nebyl/a jistý/á, ALE... Když jsem to poprvé vyndal/a z krabice, byl/a jsem si nejistý/á. Potřeboval/a jsem nosič, protože jsem si uvědomil/a, že opravdu nemůžu nosit své novorozené dítě a zároveň dělat další věci kolem domu. Zapomněl/a jsem, jak užitečné nosiče byly s mým prvním synem. Na začátku je zastrašující vidět všechny popruhy, ale jakmile si to přizpůsobíte pro své tělo a dítě, je to hračka, jak to na sebe připnout. Mému 6týdnu starému dítěti se momentálně líbí být blízko mě a spát na mém hrudníku. Ve skutečnosti je to jeho oblíbené místo na odpočinek během dne. Když se trochu zlobí, rychle ho uklidní. Je to tak odolné a pevné, že se nebojím o dítě, když dělám něco kolem domu. Dokonce to nosím i do kanceláře, naštěstí mám vlastní podnikání, takže si mohu vzít dítě s sebou do práce. Za tu cenu je to skvělé, stojí to každou korunu a ještě víc. Plánuji to používat po celou dobu, kdy dítě může být v nosiči. Mám to raději než bjorn, který jsem měl/a s mým prvním synem. To je mnohem univerzálnější a mění se, jak dítě roste.

source_doc: beachy aroma lingers like cologne, good coverage, even spray, pretty good overall. Pleasant aroma, sprays well, no irritation.I use sunscreen all year round. I am fair and have sun sensitivities. Add in that I take a couple of meds that exacerbate this, and I just cover up. Currently dark and snowy in NY with no real use for body sunscreen, but I gave this a cursory try. It should be good for body use when the time comes. I buy the sprays for the ability to cover my back to reach places that a lotion cannot.Since I use sunscreen copiously, and spend a lot of time outside which warrants it, I tend to prefer a higher SPF (I dont down rate for this because I can clearly see what I am ordering; no suprises), and I also prefer healthy sunscreens that are good for body and environment. I can get giant bottles of cheap stuff which is fine in a pinch, but for every day use, multiple times a day.. I choose wisely.Keep in mind that this is aromatic. This comes with an air freshener of this aroma. It is beachy and pleasant, but also a tad perfumy. If you like colognes and such then you will likely enjoy this. I dont mind it but it is something I am aware of when I have it on.

source_doc: Handy multi-device car charger with useful voltmeter. I don't currently have any auto devices that need their own power port so the best thing about this charger for me currently is the voltmeter so I can always know the condition of my battery. I am hoping to get a dash cam soon though so perhaps that will need the extra power port. I like this charger a lot but it fits a bit too snugly in my van's power port, when putting it in and removing it I worry I could damage my van's power port. My first generation Toyota Sienna may have a slightly smaller power port than usual because I had that problem with another charger, I also read about another Toyota RAV4 owner with the same problem. If it weren't for the tight fit I would probably use this as my main charger so I could always know the condition of my battery. Another odd thing, but not a big issue is that since my port is low, when I insert the charger so that I read the port labels right side up, I am forced to see the fine print on what I consider the bottom of the charger, maybe that's a good thing in some situations. I like the soft touch on off switch.

V současnosti nemám žádná auto zařízení, která by potřebovala vlastní napájecí port, takže nejlepší věc na této nabíječce pro mě v tuto chvíli je voltmetr, abych vždy věděl/a stav své baterie. Doufám, že brzy pořídím kameru do auta, takže možná bude potřebovat extra napájecí port. Tuto nabíječku mám moc rád/a, ale do mého napájecího portu ve dodávce sedí trochu příliš těsně; při vkládání a vyndávání se obávám, že bych mohl/a poškodit napájecí port mé dodávky. Moje první generace Toyota Sienna může mít o něco menší napájecí port než obvykle, protože jsem měl/a tento problém s jinou nabíječkou, také jsem četl/a o dalším majiteli Toyoty RAV4 se stejným problémem. Kdyby nebylo těsného uchycení, pravděpodobně bych tuto nabíječku používal/a jako svou hlavní, abych vždy věděl/a stav své baterie. Další zvláštní věc, ale ne velký problém, je, že protože je můj port nízko, když vložím nabíječku tak, abych viděl/a štítky portu správně jako nahoru, jsem nucen/a vidět drobný tisk na tom, co považuji za spodní část nabíječky, možná je to v některých situacích dobrá věc. Líbí se mi jemný dotykový vypínač.

source_doc: Smells really good. I didn’t have the main product for which this is a refill, but I do have the Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa ‘62 perfume, which I Love… so I went ahead and ordered this. The smell of this is really So good. I think the only thing is that I’m not used to that much smell coming from my armpits, even when it’s a really delicious smell. The armpits are really warm, so they release fragrance more intensely than other parts of the body. I found that I couldn’t really get used to that much smell wafting up to me from that area, for some reason. So I may have to find another way to use this, other than on my armpits. Because I really do love the smell. But I think I need for my armpits to not have much smell to them, good or bad.

source_doc: perfect for daily powder supplements on vacation. These helped me bring 15 days' worth of powder supplements to make my morning smoothies while on vacation; I poured the powder from these directly into my wide-mouth "ShakeSphere" bottle and added drinking water to shake it up. My powders filled each container right to the brim (approximately 70cc I think, if I did my math correctly from all the various scoop sizes). I didn't like being forced to use the funnel top as the lid on the topmost container; I don't have a baby and I didn't need to use a funnel, so it was wasted space in my already tight luggage - I would have preferred a flat top lid. When closing be sure the pieces are securely tightened with each other, and strangely, when you use too much force, the pieces don't twist apart nicely; after I loosened my grip, then the pieces came apart smoothly. I used these for a 1 week trip to San Diego and now I'm packing them up for a 2-wk trip to Hawaii. I use these weekly at home too, because I love the time savings in the mornings of not needing to measure all the powders out each day (now I do that only once per week).
hypos: Perfektní pro denní práškové doplňky na dovolené. Tyto mi pomohly vzít 15 dní práškových doplňků na přípravu mých ranních smoothie během dovolené; nalil/a jsem prášek z těchto přímo do své láhve "ShakeSphere" s širokým hrdlem a přidal/a jsem pitnou vodu, abych to protřepal/a. Moje prášky naplnily každý kontejner až po okraj (přibližně 70cc, myslím, pokud jsem správně spočítal/a všechny různé velikosti odměrek). Nechci/a být nucen/a používat trychtýřový víko jako víko na nejhornějším kontejneru; nemám dítě a nepotřeboval/a jsem používat trychtýř, takže to byl zbytečný prostor v mém již tak těsném zavazadle - raději/a bych zvolil/a ploché víko. Při zavírání se ujistěte, že jsou díly bezpečně utaženy k sobě, a podivně, když použijete příliš velkou sílu, díly se hezky neodkroutí; po uvolnění mého úchopu se pak díly oddělily hladce. Použil/a jsem to na týdenní cestu do San Diega a teď je balím na dvoutýdenní cestu na Havaj. Používám to také týdně doma, protože miluji časovou úsporu ráno, kdy nemusím každý den měřit všechny prášky (nyní to dělám jen jednou týdně).

source_doc: I'm REALLY Impressed. At the beginning of pandemic, I was constantly on video calls/doing virtual presentations etc. I heard a lot of  other people in meetings where you could barely understand them, and decided that I didn't want that to be me. I decided to buy a Blue Yeti because I figured it's probably important that other people can hear you speaking.After a few months, I upgraded to the Shure SM7B. It was an incredible upgrade and I was very happy with it. If you can, start with the Shure as opposed to a USB mic.Fast forward a few years, and I'm doing meetings and hosting webinars at least once a day. I heard the Neumann U87 is what NPR uses and I wanted to up the professionalism. I couldn't stomach paying $3500 for a U87, so I decided to compromise and get the TLM 103. It's a huge step up from the Shure.Both are great, but the 103 is way less fuzzy and sounds a lot more like my actual voice. A bonus, is that now I don't have to use a $150 cloud lifter to get decent sound out of the Shure. I highly recommend this product. The price is still a kick in the teeth, but it's noticeably better than anything I'd tried previously.
hypos: Opravdu mě to ohromilo. Na začátku pandemie jsem byl/a neustále na videohovorech/dělal/a virtuální prezentace atd. Slyšel/a jsem spoustu jiných lidí na schůzkách, kde je téměř nebylo rozumět, a rozhodl/a jsem se, že to nechci, aby se mě týkalo. Rozhodl/a jsem se koupit Blue Yeti, protože jsem si uvědomil/a, že je pravděpodobně důležité, aby vás ostatní slyšeli mluvit. Po několika měsících jsem přešel/přešla na Shure SM7B. Bylo to neuvěřitelné zlepšení a byl/a jsem s tím velmi spokojen/a. Pokud můžete, začněte se Shure místo USB mikrofonu. Pokročili jsme o několik let vpřed a nyní dělám schůzky a hostím webináře alespoň jednou denně. Slyšel/a jsem, že Neumann U87 používá NPR a chtěl/a jsem zvýšit profesionalitu. Nemohl/a jsem si dovolit zaplatit 3500 dolarů za U87, tak jsem se rozhodl/a pro kompromis a vzal/a jsem TLM 103. Je to obrovský krok vpřed od Shure. Oba jsou skvělé, ale 103 je mnohem méně rozmazaný/á a zní mnohem více jako můj skutečný hlas. Bonus je, že nyní nemusím používat 150 dolarový cloud lifter, abych získal/a slušný zvuk z Shure. Tento produkt vřele doporučuji. Cena je stále k zubům, ale je to výrazně lepší než cokoliv, co jsem zkoušel/a předtím.

source_doc: If you put together many items, this is a great addition to your toolbox. I have a couple of wrenches - ratcheting ones - that I have used to hold nuts in place while screwing bolts down tight.  I mean, if you have ever bought "easy to assemble" furniture, you have probably cursed halfway through and wanted to throw the mess in the dumpster, right?  They give you this cheap-o "wrench" to hold the nut while you wrestle with a single "stick" Allen wrench to tighten the bolt.  That is WHY I have this set!  I throw out the "helpful" tools the manufacturer sends with their chair/table (whatever).  I have a drill with hex bits and this ratcheting wrench set - it shaves about half the time to put the item together, for real!  The last set I put together was a gliding outdoor chair that I love, but had I used the included items, I know putting the glider chair together would have taken me at least 4 hours to complete.  I believe it took me just under 2 hours (reading, checking, then doing) to complete the chair and with this wrench set holding the nuts while the drill tightened the hex-head bolts, I finished with no cursing at all!  Woo-hoo!  Thank you drill and ratcheting wrenches for that!  The heads included should help with most of the items you will encounter in household item builds and for me, that's enough!
hypos: Pokud dáte dohromady mnoho položek, je to skvělý přídavek do vaší toolboxu. Mám pár klíčů - ráčnových - které jsem používal/a k držení matic na místě, když jsem pevně zašroubovával/a šrouby. Myslím, že pokud jste někdy koupil/a "snadno sestavitelné" nábytek, pravděpodobně jste proklínal/a v polovině a chtěl/a hodit ten nepořádek do kontejneru, že? Dají vám tento levný "klíč", abyste drželi matičku, zatímco se snažíte s jedním "tyčovým" imbusovým klíčem utáhnout šroub. To je DŮVOD, proč mám tuto sadu! Vyhazuji "užitečné" nástroje, které výrobce posílá se svým křeslem/stolem (cokoli). Mám vrtačku s hexovými bity a tuto ráčnovou soupravu klíčů - značně to zkracuje dobu potřebnou k sestavení položky, opravdu! Poslední sada, kterou jsem sestavil/a, bylo klouzavé venkovní křeslo, které miluji, ale kdybych použil/a zahrnuté položky, vím, že by mi sestavení křesla klouzavého trvalo alespoň 4 hodiny. Věřím, že jsem to stihl/a za necelé 2 hodiny (čtení, kontrolování, pak dělání) a s touto sadou klíčů držícími matice, zatímco vrtačka utahovala šrouby s hexovými hlavami, jsem dokončil/a bez proklínání! Hurá! Děkuji vrtačce a ráčnovým klíčům za to! Hlavy, které jsou zahrnuty, by měly pomoci se většinou položek, se kterými se setkáte při sestavování domácích předmětů, a pro mě je to dost!

source_doc: Well worth the price! I love everything about this slim eyeliner by Eco Soul! Since I have aged, eyeliner has become more difficult to apply. It is either too thick or too thin going across my eyelids as they seem to have become “bumpy” as I have gotten older. I also tend to have watery eyes for no apparent reason and my eyeliner will run. None of these prior problems with eyeliner has occurred with the new Eco Soul Super Slim Eyeliner.  The eyeliner applies very smoothly without tugging and I can have a very thin line, or bolder if I choose without any struggle. I love being able to just twist the tube just a little to get the point come out further when needed. I have not noticed any loss of my eyeliner when my eyes water as it stays put all day until I remove it at night. I especially appreciate the brown color of the eyeliner as it is more subtle than a harsh black. I am really enjoying using this new powerproof slim eyeliner and I would definitely recommend this to any age, but especially to older women who struggle with eyeliner.

source_doc: Cute Starburst Lights. I have wanted some of these starburst lights to add to my holiday decor.  I ordered these because they can be used outdoors and could be used for different holidays like Christmas and the 4th of July etc.  I haven’t quite managed to get them shaped like the picture but will do a better job when I am ready to hang them.  I like that they are battery operated because that will mean I can hang them just about anywhere.  My plan was to hang them in the large tree in my front yard. source_doc: Fantastic beginners microphone. I purchase this microphone to make videos for my YouTube channel. The reason I went with the ATR is because it is a dynamic microphone. Apparently, this type of microphone is very good at isolating only your voice, and not picking up background noises. Since I am making these videos in a non-soundproofed room, it only made sense to get this microphone. There are newer, looking and cooler looking microphones if you’re a neophyte like me and it would’ve been easy to choose them however, I am very happy with the choice I made.I wish I purchased the boom package as well as I now recognize that the boom makes it so that there are no extraneous sounds making it into the recording. Tapping noises, if close enough to the microphone will unfortunately make it into the recording. So now, I am looking for a boom.Are use this microphone with my iPad Pro 2021 and also with an OWC thunderbolt hub. It works well. I did not choose to go down the XLR option but instead I am using the USB-C option. I highly recommend this microphone.I also purchased a wind blocking cover for the microphone head it seems to be helping.

Zřejmě je tento typ mikrofonu velmi dobrý v izolaci pouze vašeho hlasu a nezachycuje okolní hluky. source_doc: Great for reptile enclosure!! I got this lock for a 4x2x2 Dubia reptile enclosure for my Uromastyx. She does a lot of window surfing and I wanted to be sure she couldn't slide it open and get out. I also wanted peace of mind to prevent me from leaving the enclosure open. It was very simple to install. My husband screwed it on for me while I held it in place. Probably don't even need two people to do it. I just wanted to make sure it was exactly where I wanted it placed. It comes when two keys. We just leave the keys in it at all times. We don't have children in the home so don't need to worry about that. The price is great. I had seen some locks that were cheaper, but went with this one because I read a review stating it was longer. I keep it all the way to the last locking point. So even if the enclosure gets opened, my Uro can't get out. I have made a routine so that once I finish spot cleaning or feeding, I put the lock back on ASAP. So no more being at work suddenly wondering did I close it all the way. I would get this again. If I get another Uromastyx I will get this lock.

source_doc: Needed a mouse that has the buttons that remind me of a controller so I can switch over to mnk. First Logitech product I've purchased and I can say that it works wonders.  I was a controller player for years and when I switched to pc I continued to play controller for fps games.  I was looking for a mouse that had multiple buttons that I can use as I would on a controller and this was it.  I've changed my keybinds for all of the buttons on the side of the mouse because I was used to using my thumbs for multiple buttons anyways.  This worked out perfectly and now I can game comfortably and stick to mouse and keyboard.  This mouse was so great I bought another one for my pc while is use the first one for my laptop. Easy to setup just plug and play.

source_doc: I use this for my dog's toys. My dog, Hank, is overly spoiled and has a ridiculous amount of toys. The bin I used to have for the toys is no longer big enough, so I needed something bigger. This basket is quite large, and is the perfect size for his toys. It's pretty deep, so I don't think it would be great for a small dog. Hank is really tall (I'm 5'7" and he is almost as tall as me when he is on his hind legs), so it's easy for him to reach into the deep basket and get his toys. The material seems sturdy, so I think it will last a while. But, even using a hair dryer like they suggest, it's not really keeping its shape. Since I ordered this for my dog's toys, that's not a deal breaker for me. For what I wanted to use it for, it's perfect. It's also more of a dark grayish/black, but again, that doesn't bother me for what I wanted it for. It may be important for someone who is using it more as a nice, decorative way to store blankets, etc. though. I also may have done something wrong when I tried to form it. Despite those tiny quirks I love the basket and am really happy I ordered it.

source_doc: Pet gate. I purchased the gate to keep my 13 week old goldendoodle from accessing parts of the house. She has managed to climb over other play pens I recently purchased . I opened the box and noticed one of the free stands were broke. I reached out to the seller and within 2 to 3 days they had sent a replacement . I love this gate!!! I can even make a kennel using the wall with this thing and she has not been able to climb over it either . We have always had gates up that was you had to open and close the gate and it was aggravating when moving furniture because we would have to take those gates down .  This one I just slid around to wherever and it’s much better !! I give this. 11 star out of 10!! I will be getting another one so I can block off my dining room on both sides .  This is just one of the many ways I am using it .

source_doc: Great game. I see a lot of game reviews that really really going to a lot of detail about the game. I’m not going to do that lol. I will say that I am in my mid 40s and although I did just got a PlayStation five recently I have very much enjoyed playing PlayStation 3 games. This game was very very addictive and I enjoyed it immensely. So much so that when it was actually over, I was very disappointed. Not disappointed about the ending but just thought it was over and I couldn’t play anymore. I liked it so much that I began looking into other resident evil games as this was the first one that I had played.  I don’t really have other games to compare it to but if you are looking for a good game, Joe, Marsha self into your attention that moderately challenging I would say this is definitely the game for you

source_doc: Gear for Motorcycle front sprocket. I used this sprocket JT1264.17 17-tooth to swap out the front sprocket gearing of my Lifan Xpect 200cc motorcycle.  There are videos on how to do it on youtube. It's a very well-made sprocket and heavy-duty. After removing the sprocket cover and loosening the back wheel and chain I was able to take the stock 15-tooth sprocket (JT1264.15) out and install this 17-tooth with little issue.  The sprocket cover needed a little wiggling to get back on over the larger sprocket, but it worked. The result: This was a test I conducted as my own gear ratio experiment. Please consult for advice, from a mechanic professional, the manual, and the service dealer before doing this experiment. What did I gain? I was able to extend lower gears out longer and gained a comfortable (less RPM) 5th-gear speed riding the paved highway.  What did I lose by doing this swap?  I lost lower gear torque to the rear wheel.  I don't want to lose lower-gear torque. I am going to ride the bike on dirt roads and ATV trails where I need lower-gear torque for many purposes.  I won't keep the 17-tooth front sprocket in the motorcycle.  The 17-tooth sprocket looks very well made.  No manufacturing imperfections.  If you have a purpose for this front sprocket this looks like a good one to buy.  I am a DIYer.  Please consult your dealer service department for professional advice.

source_doc: Nice trimmer and accessories. I am normally a clean-shaven guy I like keeping my sideburns clean and sometimes I get a bit of a scruff that I need to keep clean.  I didn't have any clippers that I could use to keep the scruff from looking too bad so I decided to get this.  The clipper itself is nice and heavy and made up of almost all metal so it feels like it could take a beating if needed, I also nerd that I am like the design of it.  It comes with a bunch of normal clipper accessories such as guards, nose trimmer, etc, all of these were fine and fit and cut as expected.  Using the clippers was easy and charging it took almost no time at all.  It was able to at least make this mess on my face look presentable and not like I was homeless.  All said in done I like these the thing that stood out the most was the all-metal heavy design of them.

source_doc: Beautiful and soft. I bought the turquoise color. I read some reviews that the duvet was too small for some people, so I bought the king size for my queen size bed. It fits perfectly. I wanted the duvet to come down the sides and foot of the bed some. It does have ties in all 4 corners of the duvet to tie down the insert. I was happy about that. This duvet is very soft and beautiful. The only problem is I was given 2 king shams because I ordered the king, but I have a queen bed, so I need queen shams. I have asked the seller if I could buy the queen shams separately. So far I've gotten no response. Eventually I'll have to get the shams taken in by a seamstress. Other than that everything is perfect!

source_doc: Wanted to like these but it doesnt work for my Jeep. I was so excited when I saw these because I was very ready for a different look for my TJ's tail lights and I liked the sort of modern look these gave. Unfortunately these don't work with my TJ because I have Rugged Ridge's heavy duty hinge kit for my tailgate and the tail lights are shorter in depth than the stock lights. I thought about cutting a 1/2 inch thick rubber sheet to shape but that also didnt work because the bolts didnt end up being long enough to also reach through the body with it. When I did test fit them though, they were bright and worked like they should so that's why I gave them 3 stars. I really liked them but I just wish they were similar to stock in depth so I could have used them.

source_doc: Needed it to sleep outside. I’m not one to rough it in the outdoors.  And I don’t function well without sleep.  So, when I decided I’d like to try testing in preparation for camping again.  I knew I’d need something like this, and I was right.I picked about the coldest night to test this out.  I first laid out my bag and crawled my over six foot self in without this mattress.  I could feel every lump under my nearly 200 pound body.  I know that if I raked up the earth under me it would’ve been better but that’s not something I was prepared to do.So, I then unscrewed the valve cap to the mattress and it inflated very quickly.  I set my bag on top and got in it again.  It was quite a difference.  But, after 10 minutes or so, the mattress had settled some.  So got out and opened the  valve again.  It sucked in more air.  That held for the rest of the night.  And I needed this comfort to feel relaxed enough to sleep.It was easy enough to deflate, just open the valve and roll it up.  The strap works great to store it.For anybody who is thinking about camping in the woods after having not done it, I think you’ll want this.

source_doc: Nice! Recommended. This product was not the brand I thought I ordered but it is the same style and string number and I like it very well. Looks like the above picture of Byla 27-string lyre harp with accessories. I could not tune the strings as noted above the tuning pegs because they got too tight toward the high end, but I added an F# after every F and that has worked out very nicely for me. I play hymns and have used the F# strings for several hymns that I would not otherwise be able to play. With the F#s added, it has been very easy to tune. It is a lovely instrument and has good sound. I used sharpie markers to color code my tuning pegs and strings. I tried several other lyre harps before this one, but this is the one I really like. Glad I bought it. Shipping took a bit longer, but the seller contacted me about that through Amazon and I was willing to wait for it.

source_doc: 1mg time release lasts WAY too long, 13+ hrs after taking pill. I've done a lot of experimenting with different timing/dosage of melatonin, so I have a pretty good sense for how any given pill is affecting me. In theory, a 1mg time-release pill should be exactly what I need (more on this below). However, for me, this pill takes too long to kick in, and then induces drowsiness WAY too long. I don't feel much affect until 1-2 hours after taking it, and then it gets most intense right when I need to be waking up (about 8 hours in), and then it continues to make me sleepy for 4+ hours after that. I can definitely feel the affects lasting more than 12 hours.Before trying this tablet, I had been taking a regular melatonin pill divided into 0.5mg pieces twice per night---0.5mg before bed, and 0.5mg between sleep cycles (about 4 hours later). I had been doing this because I need help both falling asleep and staying asleep, and I only need a little melatonin to notice the affects. Taking 0.5mg twice worked well for me. Then I discovered this time-release 1mg tablet, which sounded ideal since I wouldn't have to take a second dose halfway through the night. However, this pill takes too long to kick in, and then lasts WAY too long after that (as described above).

source_doc: I think my brother and I had an allergic reaction or poor quality. I bought ClearFormulas SAM-e 500mg 90 Capsules (S-Adenosyl Methionine) for my brother and I since we were having similar depressive thoughts.  They worked pretty well but I noticed I started to get a real bad sore throat and cough.  I thought I was just getting sick, but when my brother who doesn't live anywhere near me, had the same symptoms, but worse;  I thought maybe it was from these suppleents.  So I quit taking them for awhile, and when I started back; I got sick again.  My brother went to the hospital, and was put on 6 different medications.  I feel terrible.  Maybe we had an allergic reaction or maybe it's poor quality.  I can not recommend them.  I will not buy again.  We through them out.

source_doc: i love these diapers but they’re not perfect. i love these diapers but i can’t give them 5 stars. my baby turned 4 months old today and i just finished my first box of 68 size 3 diapers… they fit her but they’re on the verge of being to small, to the point of me being unsure wether or not i should order a size up on our next box. I had to buy a pack of pampers in the mean time and noticed a significant size difference between pampers size 3 and these size 3s, i think it’s safe to say these run small. These are also the first diapers my baby has managed to pee through and have a “blow out” with but it may just be because they’re on the smaller size. i’ll have to see how the size 4 does for her. i will continue to buy these diapers though bc they’re so stinkin cute, after 2 boys, i ended up having a surprise pregnancy that has given me a baby girl & im fully enjoying all things girly.. including these slightly overpriced, not the best functioning, but ridiculously cute diapers! i love the girly bright prints, they’re so much prettier than any of the others i’ve come across! I did try Hello Bello diapers and they’re a definite no, they’re cute but way worse on the absorbency, her skin would be visibly wet when i’d change her diaper with those!
hypos: Tyto pleny miluji, ale nejsou dokonalé. Tyto pleny miluji, ale nemohu jim dát 5 hvězdiček. Moje miminko dnes oslavilo 4 měsíce a právě jsem došla k první krabici 68 velikosti 3 plen… padnou jí, ale jsou na hranici toho, že jsou příliš malé, takže si nejsem jistý/á, jestli bych měla objednat větší velikost na naši další krabici. Mezitím jsem musela koupit balení pampers a všimla jsem si významného rozdílu ve velikosti mezi pampers velikosti 3 a těmito velikostmi 3, myslím, že je bezpečné říct, že tyto jsou malé. Jsou to také první pleny, kterými moje miminko dokázalo prosáknout a mít „výbuch“, ale to může být jen tím, že jsou na menší velikost. Budu muset zjistit, jak si povede velikost 4. I nadále budu tyto pleny kupovat, protože jsou tak roztomilé, po dvou chlapcích jsem měla nečekané těhotenství, které mi dalo holčičku a plně si užívám všechny věci spojené s děvčaty... včetně těchto lehce předražených, ne zcela funkčních, ale směšně roztomilých plen! Miluji dívčí jasné vzory, jsou mnohem krásnější než jakékoli jiné, na které jsem narazila! source_doc: Works well for me. I am liking these MicroVision Optical Futura Blue Light Shiny Tortoise glasses. There are 3 in a pack but so far, I've only been using one pair. I selected the 2.0 strength, and I was a bit worried that it would be right for me, but it has been great. I love the size of the lens. I feel like I don't have keep adjusting as it covers my habitual sight range. It doesn't quite work when I need to read a book, but it is perfect for use on my computer and phone as well as tv watching. I can also wear it when I am out and about, and it is comfortable to keep. My only concern is that the frame is a bit light which I think is fine for the price point, but I do wonder how long it will last.

source_doc: Meh. I was really excited to get this car charger adapter for my spectra. Well, my excitement was short lived once I started using it. Once I plugged it in and turner my pump on, I could clearly hear the motor of the pump struggling. This adapter doesn't provide enough power to give my pump what it needs to function properly. As a result I need to pump longer, on higher settings/vaccum and my output is less than half of what I usually can get. I use this once I day while at work on my lunch break and as soon as I get home I have to pump again because I still have milk left that needs to be extracted. Is this adapter great for relieving pressure- yes. Would I recommend it for a reliable addition to your pump for every day use- that would be a no. Other than that, it's a sturdy item that came shortly after it was ordered and packaging was nice and cute.

source_doc: Refreshing. Here I thought we have a really nice shower head until I came across this. How silly of me that I did not know a dual shower head/spray exists. It's not complicated to install, I actually thought I had to wait for the hubby to do it but I managed to do it myself. I love, love that it has 2 places where water comes out of so that I can shower more fully and quickly. Our current shower head has only 3 settings and with the highest pressure turned on, you don't get to cover lots of areas because the spray coverage is narrow. I love that I don't have to sacrifice the water pressure to get the most body parts washed. I also love that there are 9 different settings so even the pickiest person should be able to find the most suitable setting for their liking. Usually I'd have to take off the handheld to rinse properly but with the dual feature on this shower, I don't need to do any unnecessary work. I actually feel like I'm staying in some fancy hotel, it's really nice and refreshing.

source_doc: Not the Quality I Was Expecting. Typically I love JRPG's. The ones published by Square Enix have often become some of my favorite games so I was surprised to find myself having trouble getting into this one. First off, I felt the player movement was too slow and to me it seemed pretty laggy on my PS4. I didn't feel any sense of flow in the movement or the battles and found this to be one of the few non first person games to give me motion sickness which greatly influenced my negative opinion of the game. The battles weren't anything super complicated which usually I would enjoy as I like to just enjoy the story on my first playthrough of a game. Unfortunately there was keeping me hooked on the story so I didn't feel the need to continue forcing myself to play hoping at least that would be worth it in the end. I also found the world itself didn't feel worth exploring as I wasn't finding anything notable in the treasure chests or making interesting discoveries along the way so I will admit I have not finished the game. If it were to get updated at some point I would consider trying to play again, but as of right now I don't feel it's worth playing.

source_doc: Buy a concert instead. I bought an Enya Nova plus concert uke and liked it so much I decided to get the tenor also because of the metal frets. I sent it back the day after I got it. I did like the looks of it and the fret board with those rounded frets really looked nice but the action was so high I felt like I was having to chase the strings around. I think the price is high and I didn't want to have to pay to get it set up by someone else. It's also really heavy and the neck is thinner than most of my other ukes ( I have 14). And it feels kind of slippery. It just didn't feel comfortable to play. Maybe the non electric would be better, but I didn't care for the titanium strings either so all in all I think the concert is a better deal.

source_doc: This does not do as it is advertised. I don't understand what people are raving about. I tried this and it did nothing. I tried this on my carpet, on my stairs, on my rugs and I didn't get any hair pulled up.  I have 2 100 pd dogs that shed profusely. I vacuum every 2 days to keep the hair up.  I know there is hair on my floors even after I vacuum because it comes up on my pants an d socks.  So this should be picking stuff up.Anyways, I am unhappy about the shipping. What happened to the shipping box?  I got my box today and it was crushed. I got several boxes today at the same time and THIS was the only box that was crushed. Like it had to be deliberately chosen to be crushed.  This is not the first time my deliveries have been crushed, ripped open, etc by Amazon or UPS. In fact, I had over $1000 in tile crushed on my last UPS order over the holiday. Which I watched UPS from my window as they threw each box of tile out of their truck and onto my pavement. So no wonder my tile was crushed. But what happened here?

source_doc: Very easy install. I purchased this timer from a local store, just because I was afraid it wouldn't work and could take back. With that being said, this 62 year old female who is not an electrician had no trouble installing this switch. It helped that whoever did the original wiring had the box nice and neat. The only thing I had to figure out was which black wire was the load wire that you connect to the red on switch. Planned on using my tester, but it no longer worked. So I did the next thing I saw when googled. It was the wire that came in from top of box. Wasn't sure I was right, but figured if I was wrong all I had to do was change around. Turned power back on and it worked!!! The worse part was connecting the white to my whites, there were a lot wrapped up together, but I managed. Now for the operation of switch. The buttons are really tiny so not the easiest to push, but I use 40 minutes most of the time for after showering. Have it set so just push the big rocker switch and it starts on 40. You can easily override by pushing any other button. So didn't get 5 stars because of the button size, but I am otherwise very happy with this switch, better than leaving fan on all day cause forgot to shut off.

source_doc: Worth every penny. I was skeptical that this would work as well as people have said but we had a small grease fire and I decided to give it a try since entering else had cleaned the stove very well. I had read it is best to smear it on and let it sit for a few minutes before scrubbing so I smeared it all over the stove and under the lid making it really thick in the bad areas. Almost everything wiped clean and I only needed a little elbow grease in a couple spots. Even the spots I had to scrub didn't need much effort. As you can see in the pictures that the stove is spotless! Next came the metal drip pan under the burner that caught fire. Included is a before and after picture. I did two rounds of smearing it on, letting it sit for about 5 minutes and scrubbing. As you can see it cleaned most of the burn off! I am amazed. Im sure if I continued a couple more times it would have removed the remainder (but honestly this was good enough for me as im going to cover it with foil anyway). I am amazed and highly recommend this for the tough jobs! Oh also, I didn't notice a strong offensive scent and I was elbows deep in this stuff.

source_doc: Great for Gross Garden Feet! I take baths instead of showers, and I just never cared for bath mats. But when I saw this one is machine washable and has the foot massage nubs and rectangular soft nubby foot-cleaning area, I decided to get it. I work out in the garden a lot, sometimes in clogs that get red-clay muddy (along with my feet!) and sometimes barefooted (even worse), and I can't believe how easy it is to just run a little water into the tub, sit on the side, and scrub/clean/massage my feet. I don't even have to take my clothes off. Easy to drain and rinse off with a sprayer, and then I can fill the tub with water and epsom salts for a nice soothing soak. I even enjoy the feel of the nubs on my butt! LOL! It remains to be seen if this will stain from red clay over time and not come clean, but I don't care about that. I'm the only one who has to look at it.Be sure to follow the directions for flattening it and sticking it down. I put mine on the bathroom floor with a bottle of vinegar on top of the most-curled end for a day or so before using. If you have a smooth floor, you could even use it as a floor mat in front of your toilet so you can massage your feet every time you have to go.

source_doc: SHARP. I ordered these scissors because the reviews were good and said they were sharp. They are very sharp I ordered the lefty.  Just a heads up to anyone who is just getting started in grooming your dog with little or no experience take extra care in using these it is extremely easy to cut yourself which I did, the dog wasn't the most cooperative and I got my finger.  I couldn't believe I did that, I thought I cut the dog but luckily I got myself.  Amateur mistake I know but I am an amateur.  My hats off to the professionals out there that do this everyday you surely earn your money!  To all my fellow amateurs good luck and be careful.

source_doc: Pumps well and came with 21 mm as well. I really enjoy using this hands free pump in addition to my other pumps I have from last couple of years. I just had my 3rd baby and hands free is the way to go if you have little ones. It's easy to use and cleaning is not hard, basically same as other pumps with cups. I got this because I wanted to have other options when pumping middle of the night. Also, I didn't see it mention in the listing but 21mm came with it as well.As for the cons, I noticed the actual pumps on top falls off and is not as secure as I would have liked. I wished it had a bit of a screw on so it would remain in place. Sometimes when I angle it to put them on my breasts, the pump (top) parts comes off. Also, I am not sure if they sell the actual cup for this pump but it would be a good idea since there are special and spectra cups would not fit here. The noise level seems a bit louder than my willow 3.0 but  since they work fine, I am pretty much used to it now.

source_doc: Amazing customer service. I bought this headset for my new remote job. The first headset I received, I had trouble with the microphone not working. I did all of the troubleshooting my computer told me. Then I contacted the seller directly. They also had me do some troubleshooting. Next, they asked me to send them pictures of the model number and serial number off of the box. Once sent, they asked me to try some more troubleshooting. Finally, they said they would send me a replacement and there was no need to send back the faulty headset. I was totally shocked. I had already packed the faulty headset to ship it back. They were very quick with their responses. There was no delay in responding. Then I received my replacement headset in two days after shipping. The new headset works wonderfully. They are so comfortable and I love the sound quality. Tonight I will be using them for the first time for class. So I will be able to find out the quality of the microphone. I highly recommend this product and this company.

source_doc: Don’t last long. So I bought my second pair of these led lights and they failed once again. I love how good they are but not very impressed how long they don’t last . I bought in dec 2021 and same thing happen right side went out again. Contact the company is pretty easy but when trying to get a new pair is a pain do that they say u must send your photos thru your computer not your smartphone or they will not even honor it . I don’t have a computer to upload pictures so I just bought another pair thinking that batch was bad but I was wrong. I would love to give them another chance but I don’t know if I want to spend another 100 dollars on this brand. If u get these lights I must say they are awesome but don’t last at least these models don’t! Maybe they newer ones that work way better but I guess I will have to do some research before I again!

source_doc: Glittery. I’m not using this product again because it is glittery. I don’t think i saw glitter in the description, so I was not pleased to put this on my skin and find I look like a preteen. Luckily I tested on an arm before putting it on my face - I’d hate to go into work all glittery. Just for kicks, I did try it on my face on a day when I knew I wasn’t going out, and indeed I did look like I was getting ready for a glamour shots session.That said, it is a nice skin oil, if you don’t mind the glitter. I could definitely feel a difference in softness in the patch of skin I tested and my skin felt nice when I did put it on my face. So it works, for what it is, I just wouldn’t use it.

source_doc: Battery life has room to improve. I use a Glorious gaming mouse as my primary mouse. My only complaint is that I don't own the wireless version. I tried out this pwnage mouse in hopes that it would be everything I like plus the wireless aspect. In terms of customization, weight, accuracy, and feel, everything is very similar to my glorious mouse. I love it. It has a nice grip, it's very lightweight, and I can make the rgb pink. I fully charged the mouse and was gaming away until I hit about day 3 and the battery had to be recharged. Asking around my gaming group and reading online, 3 days is not very long for a wireless mouse at all. I really wish that the battery lasted longer on this mouse, but as it is I would rather deal with a cord and not have to worry about charging my mouse every 3 days. I am back to using my glorious mouse.

source_doc: I don't game, but this is a great mouse for CAD and every day use. I switch between my Chromebook, MacBook Pro, and Windows desktop consistently, but I carry this one mouse around with me everywhere. Switching between bluetooth and the WiFi dongle is a blessing. I can switch the mouse to control different machines easily and on the go ;)When it comes to like buttons and comfort and clickyness and DPI and other miscellaneous gamery super-into-it mouse nerd kinda stuff, I have no idea. I like it. I CAD and do, like, normal computer stuff for work and personal stuff. Cool mouse. For CAD I map the two side buttons to whichever button is the orbit/pan modifier key, which has been pretty useful for switching between CAD programs. The other button I use as the esc key.I only wish I could pair it with more than one dongle so I can use the mouse on my desktop at home AND at work with wifi instead of bluetooth.

source_doc: Works great, so far. It’s very sturdy and seems well-made but I can’t speak to the adhesion, yet.  I bought this during the winter and I prefer to wait until it’s warmer so I can clean the garage floor and use the adhesive stickers for exactly where I want it.Currently I have it on an old area rug so it doesn’t slide around.  I really like how I can feel the slight elevation in the front so I know it’s close then I feel the higher back which signals me to stop.  I don’t have to guess at all; it’s like my tire fits into a perfect little trough.  I have about 3 inches between the front of my vehicle and the garage wall and maybe another 3 inches of space in the back so my garage door will close.  This device works great and saves me from guessing or getting out of my vehicle and checking clearance.  If I had one suggestion it would be that it should be a little wider but I’ve gotten use to it

source_doc: Easy to set up, a bit complicated to get full measurements. Since I am spending more time in my basement, I decided I wanted to know more about the radon level there. Several years ago, when the house was rented, a one month radon test was done that indicated above standards radon level, so a radon mitigation system was put in. Lately I have been spending more time in the basement, so I decided I wanted more info on the radon levels. There are less expensive radon monitors, but because of the reputation and history of this company, it is the one I chose. Setup is simple, though you don't get immediate readings for radon (though you do for temperature and humidity. You have to wait 3 days to get radon values. When they started showing up on the monitor, the levels increased over the next few days, but were in the safe range. Since I have a science background, I also wanted to see the detailed maeasurements. Airthings has both an app and a web site (called the Airthings Dashboard). Both are needed to get all the information from the meter. The app gives 1, 7 and 30 day average values, the Dashboard gives graphs over various periods. Since I don't have any other monitors to compare with I can't say how this compares in accuracy or ease of use to other systems, but this seems to be working well and indicates my radon mitigation system is working.

Před několika lety, když byl dům pronajat, byl proveden měsíční test na radon, který ukázal úroveň radonu nad normou, takže byl nainstalován systém na snížení radonu. V poslední době jsem trávil/a více času v suterénu, a tak jsem se rozhodl/a, že chci více informací o úrovních radonu. Nastavení je jednoduché, i když okamžité hodnoty pro radon nedostanete (ale pro teplotu a vlhkost ano). Musíte počkat 3 dny, abyste získali hodnoty radonu. Když se začali objevovat na monitoru, úrovně se během několika následujících dní zvýšily, ale byly v bezpečném rozmezí. Protože mám vědecké pozadí, také jsem chtěl/a vidět podrobné měření. Airthings má jak aplikaci, tak webovou stránku (nazvanou Airthings Dashboard). Obě jsou potřebné, abyste získali všechny informace z měřiče. source_doc: Made a believer out of me! I've been dealing with dry feet, cracked heels since I was a teenager. Pedicurists would make comments, get me to go for the premium service every time. I got this product to try but honestly with very low expectations. Nothing else did any good.With book in hand, I sat on the edge of the tub with my feet in the pouches filled with the solution for a good hour.  I took care to follow the instructions carefully. Over the next few days, I soaked my feet daily in warm/hot water for 10 minutes each night.Since it's winter, I have my feet in socks most of the time.Photos are unaltered and with no filters.My feet because even drier and cracked looking. I never had big pieces falling off or peeling off.  I just kept my feet in socks most of the time since I didn't want skin flakes all over the place.Two week after the fact, I went to get a pedicure and the pedicurist DID NOT comment about how dry my feet were nor did she ask about an upgrade from the basic service. She used a pumice stone to de-skin as usual. These "after" photos were taken after the pedicure and a warm bath.AMAZING!!!Still have another set that I can use later.

source_doc: Amazing mouse! I bought second hand and after a reset it works great! I own 4 mice, 2 cheapos a Corsair harpoon and this dark core. Only going to compare the corsair mice. The harpoon is light and easy to use. The the scroll wheel is very easy to use. I would rate this mouse excellent if I had never used the dark core RGB. The dark core is heavier which I actually like. And it FEELS so smooth I’m guessing that’s due to the 18,000 dpi optical sensor. The RGB IMO is awesome. I have it set to match my monitor or whatever is on display. The scroll wheel on the other hand is stiff. I find my finger sliding on it constantly. source_doc: MICROPHONE COMPLETELY UNDETECTABLE. Microphone is completely undetectable out the box! headset itself is perfectly fine, audio sounds real good but the microphone won’t work at all. I was enjoying the headset for a like 30 mins until I joined a party and I was wondering why the mic wasn’t working at all no matter what I tried on my xbox so I plugged it into my ps4 controller but same problem, but the ps4 lets u switch your mic input and output and for output device it shows the headset but for device input the headset wouldn’t pop up that’s when I figured the microphone was undetectable. So I plugged it into my pc and open microphones in control panel and it would pop up either.. I ended up watching videos for 2 hours until I gave up then contacted Amazon support but they count find a solution so now I’m returning this. I feel like it was just the one I got cause no one else in the reviews had my same problem that I know of, I would order it again but Its Saturday and it comes on Tuesday, If I do end up getting it again I’ll update this depending on I get a headset that works this time (her son).

source_doc: Cute🤩🤩 This Headset replaced an old Logitech USB wired headset that I had for a few years.  I'm not a gamer so I can't speak on how it works in that aspect.  I use these for my work from job, I was skeptical if they would work at first but I decided to purchase Anyway because Amazon has a great return policy.  Soon as I plug these into the USB port on my work computer it immediately recognized them.  I noticed the ears lit up, and  so did the mic, but I didn't hear any sound at First but then I realized I had to turn the volume up 😂 Lol, I love the sound quality more clearer than the Logitech one I had.  This headset works great with the VOIP software used by my employer my customers can hear me I can hear them.  I love that mic light turns off when I put the headset in mute.  And the background noise cancelation feature is a awesome plus!  This headset works great with Teams when we have our bi-weekly Team meetings but it also works with Zoom when we use Zoom for any uptrainings, Since we're on camera for meetings and Zoom I've gotten lots of compliments from friends and co-workers.  I highly recommend you won't be disappointed!

source_doc: Well made pullover for someone with an athletic build. I ordered this pullover because I was intrigued by Tom Brady's name attached to the item. I didn't know he was endorsing a line of athletic wear. I figured if Brady was willing to add his name to the product, it must be high quality. The pullover is indeed well made with quality materials. It is extremely lightweight, and great for moderate temperatures around 50 degrees. I am in my mid-50s, 5'9" and about 170. I run outside about 4 times a week and do strength training 2 times a week. I am certainly not an elite athlete, and I find myself walking up steep hills these days when out on a run. Usually a large is about the right size or just a little big on me. The large Brady pullover I ordered was definitely meant for someone with Brady's athletic build rather than my middle-aged build. There isn't any give when getting the item pulled over my head, so it isn't the easiest pullover to put on. However, while the fit is snug, once on it worked great for a warmer than usual January run. It kept the wind away and was surprisingly flexible for as difficult as it was to pull on. I would order again, but I would order a larger size.

source_doc: Reliable, versatile and an extra 9 string... Decades ago I had to re-learn a new playing style due to a slight HAND-icap. I have found that hybrid sets work best for me. In this time, I have tried many brands, materials and gauges, and still, I keep falling back to Rotosound Nickel Hybrid Electric Guitar String sets (9 11 16 26 36 46). I have a couple fallback brands that are very good...but this is where I land these days. As long as I keep them Clean, they're bright, they maintain their tone over time, and stay in tune. (and you get an extra high E string)To clarify, I'm not a guitar or string snob and I'm not rich, but maybe I may have experience that might be useful to others. That said, my baseline for strings is that <I use the strings I can afford and that get the job done.>I don't have expensive guitars but I have had several for 20 years or longer...and I know how to adjust the neck, string height, properly install the strings on the posts and make sure there's no hang-ups in the nut, yatta yatta. In short, with as much bending and hammering strings I do they, for the most part, stay in tune.
hypos: Spolehlivý/á, všestranný/á a s navíc 9 strunami... Před desítkami let jsem se musel/a naučit nový styl hry kvůli drobnému HAND-icapu. Zjistil/a jsem, že hybridní sady mi vyhovují nejlépe. Během této doby jsem vyzkoušel/a mnoho značek, materiálů a sil, a přesto se stále vracím k sadám strun Rotosound Nickel Hybrid Electric Guitar Strings (9 11 16 26 36 46). Mám pár alternativních značek, které jsou velmi dobré...ale tady jsem teď. Dokud je udržuju čisté, zní jasně, udržují si tón v průběhu času a zůstávají v ladění. (a dostanete navíc jednu extra vysokou E strunu) Abych to upřesnil/a, nejsem snob/ka na kytary nebo struny a nejsem bohatý/á, ale možná mám zkušenosti, které by mohly být užitečné pro ostatní. Řekněme, že můj základní požadavek na struny je, že <používám struny, které si mohu dovolit a které splní úkol.> Nemám drahé kytary, ale měl/a jsem několik více než 20 let... a vím, jak upravit krk, výšku strun, správně nainstalovat struny na kolíčky a ujistit se, že nedochází k žádným problémům v nultém pražci, a tak dále. Stručně řečeno, při tom, kolik struny ohýbám a bouchám, většinou zůstávají v ladění.

source_doc: Secure and comfortable. I like these better than my name-brand ones I use for my cable machine at home and the ones available at the box gym I used to go to. The reason I like them better is because they are way more secure. The ones I have are all velcro and if you are hooked onto a heavy cable then the velcro has come off before. These ones do not entirely depend on the velcro because they are made with the two metal rings that close and then you clip to the machine with those. Much better and safer. They are padded so they are comfortable. The only thing I don't like is that I can't get the circumference small enough to tightly wrap my ankle so they are loose (I have small ankles). However, that's not too big a deal I still prefer these over the other ones. Additionally, they did come with a chemical smell which I do not like but I will leave them out in the open to air out. If it doesn't dissipate I will report back, but I anticipate that the smell will dissipate.

Důvod, proč se mi líbí více, je ten, že jsou mnohem bezpečnější. Ty, které mám, jsou všechny na suchý zip a pokud jste připojení k těžkému kabelu, tak se suchý zip už odlepil. Tyto neodvisí zcela od suchého zipu, protože jsou vyrobeny s dvěma kovovými kroužky, které se zavřou a pak je pomocí nich přichytíte ke stroji. Mnohem lepší a bezpečnější. Jsou polstrované, takže jsou pohodlné. Jediná věc, která se mi nelíbí, je, že nemohu udělat obvod dostatečně malý, abych si je pevně omotal/a kolem kotníku, takže jsou volné (mám malé kotníky).
