source_doc: Excellent guitar for beginner intermediate, minimal setup was required. The guitars fit and finish was perfect.  The fret ends were polished and smooth, the action was fine, there were no blemishes.  Upon tuning the guitar, I noticed the intonation was slightly off. Upon further examination, I found the one “holiday” , the setup man went on.  The bridge was pulling up, when the guitar was tuned.  I took off the back plate, the tension screws were tensioned too loosely and unevenly.  Two minutes I had it sorted, and this fixed the intonation.  I have included a picture of my practice setup. It included a Pock Rock, headphone amp, and effects processor(approx 40 bucks on Amazon), an old Fire tablet I had lying around, hooked into the line in, on the Pock Rock, and a pair of Vintage Sansui head phones.  I have a behringer ppa200(also available on Amazon approx 350 on Amazon), that I also use for my karaoke/movie night, senior charity,when I want to Amp the setup(also through the Pock Rock).  I know quite a few chords, but haven’t played in years.  Even though my next door neighbor says I’m not loud, and don’t bother her, the majority of time, I play with the headphones.  This little setup, is loads of fun, and I’m really enjoying it.

source_doc: Refused to connect. I had a lamp I wanted to use Alexa with and I have other older Kasa smart plugs that work fine.  My other bulbs were Lumiman and I thought I would try to make everything just Kasa.  So I ordered a Kasa smart bulb but it refused to connect.  I thought that maybe it was because the lamp was one of those metal swing-arm things, so I thought, well, I'll just get another Kasa plug instead and ordered a used set of 2.  They both refused to connect.  Thinking it was because they were used, I ordered 2 more new ones.  And, guess what, they refused to connect, too.  I tried everything with all of them.  Multiple tries and resets, moving the lamp all over the house and even right next to the router.  None of them would connect.  So I ordered another Lumiman bulb and, lo and behold, it connected right away with absolutely no issues.  2 stars is for the old plugs that actually worked.

source_doc: Bought for dog chew toy. I have a Australian Cattle Dog AKA "Blue Healer" puppy we got a couple months ago. He will shred through any dollar store toy you give him in a matter of days and I had read another person's review with the same kind of dog that he gave his dog a broken Diaphragm and the dog has been chewing it for over 10 years so for $8 bucks I think it was when I bought it, I said what the heck.Got the thing in the mail and the first thing I noticed was that it gets stuck because of the shape of it if lands with the round part up instead of landing like a dish shape with the edge accessible so I cut it in half and gave half of it to my Father In Law for his dog. So far they both love them and even after ripping and shredding at it, my healer hasn't even scratched it now after weeks of use and seems to really like it I assume because it's similar feeling to flesh. Anyway for the price and what I bought it for it's a great deal. Not sure how it'd be for it's designated use since I have nothing to test it for in that regard but it is heavy duty so I would imagine it would work well for that as well.

source_doc: CRUSHED green fuzz algae! For months I tried everything. Everything in my low-tech freshwater tank seemed right. I had my light down to 3 hours a day. I stopped feeding for periods.  I even blocked out the sides of the tank to prevent ambient light from getting in.  Nothing worked.  The green fuzz algae was all over my plants and surfaces.  I cleaned, I did water changes, got an algae eater & snails. This was trial and error over months and nothing I tried showed any result. The green fuzz got so bad I had to cut down all my plants. Wish I had tried this product sooner.  I dosed just as the directions stated and within 1 week the green fuzz algae had been noticeably diminished.  It went from being bright green to a dull brown color.  Hoping this restores balance so I can begin fertilizing again so my plants will regrow. Amazing product!

source_doc: Great bulbs! I had a lamp I wanted to use Alexa with and I have other older Kasa smart plugs that work fine.  My other bulbs were Lumiman and I was thinking I'd switch to all Kasa so I'd have just the one app on my phone.  So I ordered a Kasa smart bulb but it refused to connect.  I thought that maybe it was because the lamp was one of those metal swing-arm things, so I decided I'd just get another Kasa plug instead and ordered a used set of 2 minis.  They both refused to connect.  Thinking it was because they were used, I ordered 2 more new ones.  And guess what, they refused to connect, too.  I tried everything with all of them.  Multiple tries and resets, moving the lamp all over the house and even right next to the router.  None of them would connect.  I thought it was me.  I decided last resort to try a Lumiman bulb just to eliminate a Kasa hardware factor and maybe my WiFi was an issue and, lo and behold, it connected right away with absolutely no issues.  Plus, these have no color which I rarely use on any of my smart bulbs.  So win win.  Too bad it seems there are no Lumiman plugs.  I used the second bulb in a lamp where I was using a Kasa plug.  Anyone have any recommendations to replace my other Kasa plugs?
hypos: Skvělé žárovky! Měl/a jsem lampu, kterou jsem chtěl/a používat s Alexou, a mám další starší chytré zásuvky Kasa, které fungují dobře. Myslel/a jsem, že to možná bylo tím, že lampa byla jednou z těch kovových kyvných ramen, tak jsem se rozhodl/a, že místo toho vezmu další zásuvku Kasa a objednal/a jsem použitou sadu 2 mini. Obě odmítly se připojit. Myslel/a jsem, že je to proto, že byly použité, tak jsem objednal/a 2 nové. A hádejte co, také odmítly se připojit. Zkusil/a jsem všechno se všemi. source_doc: Just what I was looking for just in case. I was looking for a tire jack for when I travel in my 15,000 lbs fifth wheel but didn’t want a bottle jack due to weight and the possibility of damage to axle if placed wrong. Then I found the Rapid Jack!  It’s light weight, looks like it is easy to use, withstands up to 30,000 lbs, everything I wanted. I haven’t had to use it yet but will make sure I’ve tried it  before my next trip. It looks pretty straight forward though. I think this was an excellent buy and an excellent price. When I had first started to look for one around Christmas time the cost was doubled than what it currently is so I think this was a heck of a deal and I’m glad I waited to purchase this. I highly recommend this item to anyone that travels with a multiple axle trailer.

source_doc: Always Have Loved Maple Necks/Fingerboards. I dont "get" alot of these reviews.  I've been playing forty years and have had at least five dozen guitars running the gamut of pricing.  You never know with a guitar, they all are different.  Personally, i have always liked maple necks and fretboards.  It has a soft, easy to play feel.  If it doesn't feel right, NOTHING else matters.  This guitar feels good and makes it easy and fun again, the same can't be said of plenty of guitars I've owned over the years.  I've had cheaper guitars feel great and really expensive guitars feel like crap.  As long as it feels good, i can get a good sound by using pedals.  I was very pleasantly surprised.  The tuning is a slight issue but stretch them good and/or put a new set on it.  The finish I think is great, too.  I like it so much i am going to get another.  That'll be a fun comparison.  Like i said, you never know.  I think it's a crapshoot.  I don't trust so-called luthiers, either.  I've had plenty of guitars come back less-playable.  These were well-respected people.  It's either playable or not.  I like this little thing.

source_doc: Not at all happy with this drum set After a Year! I got this to practice at home so I would not bother anyone in the house a year ago. At first it was great, but as the year went on, it was not so much a great experience. After the first month, the Hi Hat doesn't sense every strike. After about a month of waiting on the warranty, I get the new cymbal. Works alright again for about 3 months. Then the pad of the bass drum tears. So I go through warranty again, still about a month of waiting. I get the new skin for the bass pad, but I realize now I have a sensitivity problem that I had with the hi hat, is the same with the bass drum. So I have to contact again. After waiting again for the Kid Pad. I'm happy to play for about 1 month before the snare issues arrive. Now the warranty coverage is over and the snare is sounding like I'm hitting the rim the whole time. I am not happy with how many issues I've had with this electric drum set. It's too bad because Alesis is a strong brand, sadly, this drum set just had too many issues to praise. I could be mean and just give it 1 star, but I want to give my honest opinion on what I experienced and how I feel it should be rated.

source_doc: These are great! I got this set so that I could have the white and purple one because I got myself a white controller and some cute purple buttons and so now everything matches 💜 And the other headset I had just kept in the top of my closet as an extra for when my son's ended up breaking because we all know that headphones usually only last a few years. And yeah so I pulled out the black and red ones within a few months. And I've had my headphones for I think 2 years now and they're still holding up. My son already went through his, but he actually uses his everyday and I only really get a few hours here and there every month. But idk overall I love them, they fit great and the sound is awesome and I actually love that they are wired because I don't have to worry about them dying on me lol. But anyways I hope this helps. Oh and back when I got these I think it was like maybe $50 for the set, so idk how much they are now but if it's too much more than maybe just get one if you don't actually need both of them.

source_doc: Great for the price. I found myself DIYing a new stereo install in a 2015 Miata.  The Mazda engineers seem to have intentionally made everything difficult to get to, or super tight to work around for anyone with big hands.  I ordered this because I don't forsee myself doing much of this sort of thing, so I didn't want to invest in a "I do this for a living" quality product.The plastic is kind of soft, so I don't imagine these would manage to survive much more than a dozen or so cars worth of stereo installs, but for the money it sure as heck beats the more durable options.I didn't even realize it comes with valve stem caps when I ordered it.  That seems like an odd inclusion, but I suppose if I ever need to fill up with air at the gas station and manage to forget to put the cap back on, at least I have spares (enough to derp every wheel twice!)If you're looking for something quick and dirty to accomplish a task, and not looking for something to earn a living with, these are just fine (and heck, for all I know the more expensive ones are just as durable, and I owe these guys an apology)

source_doc: Beautiful. I love this little bowl and lid!  Two things I wish the makers could change, though.  One is that there is a little crease around the lid underneath.  I wish that was not there due to the difficulty to clean it.  Second, I wish the knob was easier to grasp and hold on the lid.  When this bowl is hot, you have to use a potholder to remove the lid.  That lid knob is too small.  I dropped it once because it slipped out of my potholders.  It could have broken, and my heart would be broken too.  I have tried to figure out how I can get the bowl out of the microwave, burning hot, rather than using potholders on each side.  I love it for its looks, but I want to use it, too.OK, sad news.  I could not find any way to remove the lid when it was very hot.  I tried gloves, mit's, and little pinchers.  Nothing worked.  I sadly sent it back.

source_doc: The best thing I’ve ever spent money on! First off I’m 31 next week so I’m not a kid but at heart I am. This thing came fully charged and after the simple setting up stuff I had to ride this thing around the block and I cried coz of how happy I was. Haven’t felt this happy since I was a kid when I was 13 my mom bought me a $200 electric scooter and I drive it to school. My school was just down the street from my home. This H5 is way better than the one I owned as a kid but wow! This thing GOES!! work your way up with the speed and make sure every nut and bolt is tight before riding it. YouTube videos helped me a lot. The seat is wobbly a bit but I tightened a bolt and it’s better now. Honestly, I have no complaints. This never happens. This thing is amazing! I’ll give updates over time of course. But this far I love it and I love everything about it!! Highly recommended to any adult or anyone any age.

source_doc: A lifesaver. I suffer from migraines quite often and I don't know how I would survive without this. There are days where I literally can't open my eyes until I put this on and then I can actually be productive. It is a bit tight for my head, but while I have a migraine, that is actually very helpful. Sometimes I don't pull it down over my eyes and it is still quite helpful. Personally, I need to let it warm up for a minute before I put it over my eyes anyways because if I put it over my eyes immediately, it can make me feel like I have brain freeze. If I were you, I would consider buying two of them, so that when one of them warms up and is no longer helpful, you can just replace it with the one thats still in your freezer.

source_doc: Please save yourself the trouble and just skip this one! I can't make this up, I had to buy this headset 4 times before it actually shipped. Not just Amazon, I tried GameStop as well, twice. It didn't ship out until about 2 weeks and when I FINALLY got it I find out all these headsets are BROKEN! Always check Reddit first!!! You can't trust ppl on Amazon or YouTube because they're paid to LIE! I use a stealth 700 and it's not perfect but atleast it WORKS. Not only was the mic completely trash out the box, and I mean like did not work, constant buzz, voice going in and out. I tried messing with settings, restarting it, using the app on PC, Mobile, and Xbox. None fixed the issue. But also I must mention the awful sound connectivity as well. When you speak into the headset the audio starts going in and out and sometimes completely out, you cant hear your game, your music, or your party. The colors are pretty but not at the cost of being able to actually USE the damn thing! What a joke, I really did expect better of Razor. If you like razor I suggest you bite the bullet and use a wired headset. The Kaira Pro is completely unusable and a huge waste of money, will be returning it shortly.

source_doc: Is not anti-scratch. I don't like anything about this set. There weren't any instructions and I thought it was pretty difficult to put on because of how solid it is. source_doc: sprays evenly, beachy aroma that lingers like cologne, light coverage, pretty good overall. Pleasant aroma, sprays well, no irritation.I use sunscreen all year round. I am fair and have sun sensitivities. Add in that I take a couple of meds that exacerbate this, and I just cover up. Currently dark and snowy in NY with no real use for body sunscreen, but I gave this a cursory try. It should be good for body use when the time comes. I buy the sprays for the ability to cover my back to reach places that a lotion cannot.Since I use sunscreen copiously, and spend a lot of time outside which warrants it, I tend to prefer a higher SPF (I dont down rate for this because I can clearly see what I am ordering; no suprises), and I also prefer healthy sunscreens that are good for body and environment. I can get giant bottles of cheap stuff which is fine in a pinch, but for every day use, multiple times a day.. I choose wisely.Keep in mind that this is aromatic. The other set I ordered came with an air freshener of this aroma. It is beachy and pleasant, but also a tad perfumy. If you like colognes and such then you will likely enjoy this. I dont mind it but it is something I am aware of when I have it on.

source_doc: I don’t think this product was tested. My Indie is drinking gallons of water in her old age so I ordered the 4 gallon size to keep up. Chewy had one cheaper but I liked the idea of filtered water for my dog. At first fill I did notice the water bowl wasn’t really filling with water well. My dog would drink and it would not refill the bowl. So I took the filter out which helped…. But wait I paid more for this bc I wanted the filter! I had accidentally ordered two of these so I had given one to a friend for his houseful of furry paw friends so I called him to see if he had the same issue. He said he did until he modified the holes to be larger so the water could flow better. So, as suggested I drilled more holes to increase the water flow. It worked, I guess. But the water never fills past about 1/2 inch and my indie prefers a deeper bowl. I don’t think this product was tested before production. I might return it but unlikely they’ll give me a refund since I’ve now added 5 more holes to it!

source_doc: Wish I got this fan sooner! This fan was a little bit larger than I had expected. It is still a small handheld fan but definitely bigger than the ones we used to take to theme parks when we were younger.The battery life seems pretty decent. As I was trying it out I kept it running in my kitchen while I was cooking and it ran until I turned it off with no decrease in the air flow.I love the fact that you can bend the legs to wrap around and hook onto things so it’s pretty versatile where you can use it. When I first turned it on, I thought the power was pretty low, but there are actually three settings, and the speed does turn up.I wish I would’ve had this last summer for my newborn son at the time when we went to a theme park! This truly works great and I am excited to hook it onto the stroller this summer for walks, or even set it up outside while the kids play. Not only was a well packaged, but I love the fact that it is rechargeable and it really does seem like it’s of decent quality.

source_doc: Nope. I've never used a product like this before, so for all I know they're all like this, but my overall experience was not a positive one.  I tried the Lavender first, which is a hot pink disk, and as soon as I turned the shower on what i got was hot pink coloring all over the shower floor, soaking into the tile grout.  (As instructed, I had placed it out of the way of the main shower flow.)  I was hoping it would all rinse away, but it didn't so I ended up having to scrub the floor.  Not exactly the relaxing spa-type experience I was hoping for.  On top of that, there was  virtually no aroma to the aromatherapy.  The scents of my shampoo, conditioner, and body wash were all stronger, though none of them are that strong themselves.  I was really surprised.  When I was all done--hair dried, etc.--I did notice a hint of lavender in the shower, but nothing while I was actually showering.  All in all it was definitely not worth the magenta mess.

source_doc: Good Keyboard for a Beginner or Novice. this is a nice keyboard for beginner.  It's not quite the full piano keyboard size but better than a 66 key offered on some.  I am an adult beginner, and this works fine.  There are way more bells and whistles then I need and the manual that comes with it is thick, I hope to get to it someday.  I have noticed that the keyboards and the song playback option are just a bit off.  One or the other is sharp or flat by just a little so it is a bit annoying.  I went with Yamaha because of the name and the PSR-EW310 is near the bottom of their price range, and I am glad I bought it.  It does not include a stand or a bench but the small table I have it on works fine for now, no sustain peddle either.  I did buy some headphones because I live in an apartment and so glad I did because it helps shut out other noises and I can concentrate better.  Yes, I'm a little ADD.

source_doc: Put the lotion in the (Amazon) basket. So what I didn’t think about was that my dogs really don’t like having their paws touched.  I swear I feel like Buffalo Bill in Silence of the Lambs every time I pull out the lotion.  But Reverend has very sensitive skin and his paws get dry and chapped in the winter so I’m willing to give off a few serial killer vibes to keep him healthy.My biggest concern though is that they both are obsessed with licking me when I put lotion on my own skin so I was pretty sure they were going to go to town on their feet after getting lubed up.  I wasn’t wrong.  Luckily this balm is made of food grade ingredients so while I won’t let Kudzu eat it straight from the jar - which he really wants to do- I don’t worry so much about them ingesting it.  As a bonus, it is virtually odor free so I don’t mind getting in a little extra moisturizing on my own paws while I’m massaging theirs. I am hopeful that with repeated exposure, they will learn to love their doggie spa treatments. And I will enjoy not being stepped on with paws that are rougher than a junk yard dog's.

source_doc: It seems to do the job well... I have an existing pedal board powered by Zuma Strymon; I am using this Strich to power the pedals I have in my studio (that are not on the pedal board.)  I am not an electrical engineer, yet I do know the differences between 110v and 220v - how can this pedal supply automatically differentiate the two?  There are no switches to for this setting.  Additionally, I do have one 24v pedal for this power supplier; I must plug in the 24v's transformer into the polarized outlets on the top of this unit.  So far, so good, but...This unit is very light in weight, yet every output had an independent kill-switch to prevent overload.  The outlets on top can power up to a 600v demand. How???As I ease into using this, I am acutely aware - sniffing the air for that burning electrical appliance smell, keeping a headphone partially on one ear so I can hear transformer buzzing (within the unit or through the monitors), and even touching it every so often to feel if it is overheating.  Again, so far, so good, for about 30 hours of use.Regardless of the mysteries, I am impressed thus far.  If it blows up, I will let you know!

source_doc: Very messy.  Needs a better applicator. This mascara went on really wet and clumpy.  I had to grab a cotton swab and use it multiple times to clean up around my lashes.  I feel like the applicator was partly to blame.  I couldn’t get good separation with this style of applicator.  The bristles weren’t very deep or thick.  Luckily, I had a spare applicator that I pulled out and used to clean up and separate my lashes.  Once I cleaned up the mess, my lashes were still a bit clumpy, but looked okay.  This mascara does add length to my lashes.Typically I need to reapply mascara at the end of my work day - and it smudges below my eyes.  With this mascara (if I applied it heavily), I had no smudging and I still had good coverage up to 12 hours after applying it.  If I apply the mascara lightly (in order to control the wet and clumping), it doesn’t make it through the day.  Heavier coverage lasts longer.  I did have flaking towards the end of the day.  It cleans up with soap and water well.

source_doc: Great Faucet - everything else?  Meh. I wanted a Heavy Duty utility sink for the basement.  I liked the look of this. The only positive I can come up with is - the faucet is great - I hope it lasts.  The tub comes with clear and urgent directions on how to assemble it without breaking the tub.  I followed those instructions to the T and the tub broke in three of the four leg attachment locations.  Clearly a bad design.  It's ok though - the faucet seems great so I went ahead and continued the install with the broken - yet still functional - tub.  The p-trap and drain plumbing supplied is hard and brittle.  I needed to cut the drain pipe down about two inches to fit the existing drain - drain pipe shattered not once but twice while cutting it.  Thankfully I was replacing a utility sink so I could use the old plumbing pieces.  There is almost no backsplash on this unit  - so I'm still trying to figure out how I will secure it to the wall - as securing the legs won't help because of the broken tub.  I'm wishing I kept my old tub and just replaced the faucet.  Still looking for a better solution.

Postupoval/a jsem podle těchto pokynů naprosto přesně a dřez se rozbil/a na třech ze čtyř míst připojení nohou. Jasně špatný/á design. source_doc: Expensive Diapers...Better Quality! I use them ALL THE TIME not just OVERNIGHT. I never knew little boys urinate much more than girls until I had my only son. I always brought Huggies Brand, but it seemed like the quality was starting to lack. Then I saw the OVERNIGHT Huggies! I realized the quality used in these pampers were BETTER & different than the Little Movers & Snug/Dry.My son can wear them all night until mid-morning! NO LEAKS! The pampers are thicker and softer. It holds wetness very well. My complaint that they are super expensive. I got 44 Overnight diapers for $25. I got just a huge discount the first shipment since I am on the program, so I only paid $16. But since then, its $24 per box. But compared getting a bunch of leaky cheap diapers, I rather pay the price. He wears them all the time.  I recommend the OVERNIGHT HUGGIES diapers.

source_doc: Brilliant self tightening design. I bought these chains to "keep in the truck" so I would be legal. Didn't think I would need them with 4x4 and snow tires. Sure enough, ended up in a blizzard leaving Yosemite national park while towing a trailer. Roads got really bad, really quick.  I pulled these out and was pleased with how easily they went on. Basically there's a notch for where your tire meets the ground, so you just slip it around. No pulling forward or backwards.  The chains weren't perfectly centered when I put them on, so I just drove 100 yards down the road and rechecked them. Sure enough, they have self centered and the tightening mechanism had taken up the slack on its own.  They stayed nice and tight and didn't slap around as we drove. Removal was ALMOST as easy as installing.  I was genuinely impressed.  I will be more likely to slap these on early when conditions deteriorate now that I know how easy they are. I will be buying a set for any car I own in the future.
hypos: Brilliantní design se samo utahováním. Koupil/a jsem tyto řetězy, abych je "měl/a v dodávce", abych byl/a legální/legální. Nemyslel/a jsem si, že je budu potřebovat s 4x4 a sněhovými pneumatikami. Až na to, že jsem skončil/a v bouři při odjezdu z národního parku Yosemite, zatímco jsem táhl/a přívěs. Silnice se opravdu rychle zhoršily. Vybral/a jsem je ven a byl/a jsem potěšen/a, jak snadno se nasazují. V podstatě je tam zářez, kde se vaše pneumatika dotýká země, takže je jen omotáte kolem. Žádné tahání dopředu nebo dozadu. Řetězy nebyly při nasazování dokonale vycentrované, takže jsem jen jel/a 100 yardů po silnici a zkontroloval/a je. source_doc: Not a lot of head pressure. I use this to pump diesel out of canisters into my car. I was hoping that I would be able to place the canisters on the ground and simply pump into the car, which is not very far up. I have been using a siphon, and I wanted a setup that was a little cleaner. To make sure that I had maximum power coming from D cell batteries, I also ordered a set of rechargeable lithium d cells to go with this. The pump does work, but don't have any high expectations for flow rates. If I have the container on the ground and I am filling to a fuel cap near my waist, the flow rate at max is barely more than a trickle. However, lifting the source canister up two or three feet brought the flow to a satisfactory level. Ultimately, I decided to place the canisters on the roof of the car, as I had done with the siphon. That works very well but if the pump falls out of the canister, it can be a bit messy, which is what I was trying to avoid. It is a very slick product, but needs a larger pump or more power.

source_doc: Not good on my thick, curly hair. This hair mask didn’t work for me. I followed the instructions, first washing my hair then coating with mask and letting sit for ten minutes. Already when applying, I thought it felt like it wasn’t going to provide enough conditioning to my hair. When I rinsed, I was certain. When I tried to comb my hair, it was as if I hadn’t conditioned my hair at all.To be fair, I have thick, curly, shoulder-length hair that requires a lot of conditioner every time I shampoo, but I thought that’s what this product was supposed to be. Instead, I had to put leave-in conditioner on my hair just to be able to comfortably comb thru it.Maybe if you have drastically different hair than I do, this will work for you, but for me, it just didn’t provide much noticeable benefit.
hypos: Na moje husté, kudrnaté vlasy to není dobré. Tato vlasová maska ​​mi nefungovala. Řídila/řídil/a jsem se pokyny, nejprve jsem si umyla/umyl vlasy, pak je pokryla/pokryl maskou a nechala/nechal působit deset minut. Už při aplikaci jsem myslela/myslel, že to nebude poskytovat dostatečnou péči mým vlasům. Když jsem opláchla/opláchnul, byla/jsem si jistá/jistý. source_doc: Good Coverage Tricky Folding. Update: I bought this again after returning the first one. This time I paid close attention to the way it was folded out of the package. I understand it better now. Also, it feels like the material is better and softer this time. I wonder if i got an older model before. Either way, I’m glad I bought it again.Original Review: I like this for the rain coverage. I wore it in light rain but the back of my coat and backpack remained dry after a 2 mile walk.I do not like the folding mechanism. The bag it comes with is useless to me. I cannot get this to fold properly despite watching the video tutorial. O tried several times.I ended up folding it as best I could and stuffing it into the back shown in my pic. Otherwise, it will pop open as it did on NY’s disgusting sidewalks when I stored it in the carrier that it comes with.If there was a simpler storing/folding solution, I’d rate this higher. Also mine came with a plastic part peeled off. I returned that but oddly want to re-order because it serves as a rain shelter at bus stops where there’s none.

source_doc: Comfortable. I am not a woman of color and have very fine hair, but I do have issues with keeping my hair out of the way at night. I usually put it in a topknot when I go to sleep so I don't roll over and pull it. That has a couple issues - the hair band slipping and sleeping with a hard bump under my head, and putting ponytail ridges in my hair. I also thought I'd get this for my daughter who has long, curly, thick, red hair that is often dry and frizzy. I had heard that bonnets help keep your hair moisturized so I thought between us we'd give it a try.The bonnet is comfortable and the band is not constricting. It is easy to put on. Maybe because my hair is so fine it didn't stay on all night, but it seems that it was on most of the night. (when I woke up in the middle of the night it was still on). My hair feels soft and not dry, so I'll try it again. I couldn't get my teen daughter to try it, though I think it would be helpful for her hair and I'll keep trying. My other daughter tried it and she recommends it highly for keeping the cat from chewing on her hair every night!
hypos: Pohodlné. Nejsem žena barvy pleti a mám velmi jemné vlasy, ale mám problémy s tím, jak si vlasy v noci udržet mimo cestu. Obvykle si je při spaní dávám do drdolu, abych se neotočila a netahala je. To má několik problémů - gumička sklouzává a spím s tvrdou bump pod hlavou a dělám si rýhy od culíku ve vlasech. Také jsem si myslela, že to pořídím pro svou dceru, která má dlouhé, kudrnaté, silné, rudé vlasy, které jsou často suché a krepaté. Slyšela jsem, že čepice pomáhají udržet vlasy hydratované, takže jsem si myslela, že to vyzkoušíme. Čepice je pohodlná a gumička není příliš těsná. Snad protože mám vlasy tak jemné, nevydržela mi celou noc, ale zdálo se, že mi byla většinu noci. (když jsem se probudila uprostřed noci, stále byla na hlavě). Mé vlasy jsou hebké a ne suché, tak to vyzkouším znovu. Nemohla jsem přimět svou dospívající dceru, aby to zkusila, i když si myslím, že by to bylo užitečné pro její vlasy, a budu zkoušet dál. Moje druhá dcera to vyzkoušela a velmi doporučuje, aby to udrželo kočku od okusování jejích vlasů každou noc!

source_doc: Was really hopeful but my hope burnt out. I bought these for my truck cargo lights as well as my door lights.  When I first put them in I was amazed at how bright they were.  It was amazing and I was excited.  Then about 2 weeks after having them in I noticed one of the cargo lights started blinking.  I thought it might be the wiring in the truck but then shortly after I noticed the other light started doing the same thing.  I had my little daughter push on the brake to see about the brake light and it seemed to still be okay.  So I took 2 of the bulbs out of the doors and put it back in the cargo lights.  It was about 2 days later that both of those started to struggle as well.  Then I noticed the one in the brake light started to flicker as well.  I was so hopeful for these bulbs and am quite saddened that they stopped working so quickly.  I would understand it if was 1 bulb then it could be a fluke but I now have 6 bulbs total that aren't working any longer or flickering really bad.  Thankfully they weren't too expensive so it didn't hurt too bad when I threw them away.

source_doc: Compact, easy to use and nice carrying case. The BOOKOO jump starter is great to have in case of you need to give yourself a boost or help someone else out with dead battery. It’s easy to use. I have not had to use this particular one yet I do keep it in my boat in case my cranking battery dies or one goes bad. I feel confident this will boost when I need it to!I have multiple BOOKOO boosters and used one with less mah to completely jump my truck. I wanted to test it out so I unhooked my battery completely from my truck so it would be as if my battery were COMPLETELY dead and I hooked up the BOOKOO booster and it successfully started my 5.4 l pickup multiple times! I didn’t test how many times it could jump without having original battery even hooked up but I did at least three times and I know it had mor juice left. I was just happy with those results so I unhooked it and recharged it and put in in vehicle for use when needed. I now keep one in every vehicle we own.I’ve also jumped a 4 wheeler with the BOOKOO booster no problem.

source_doc: I have owned this now for just over 3 years. So, I kind of forgot where I bought this. I was going through my "buy it again" list to try to remember what something I bought was called, and discovered I bought this on February 23rd 2020.Now, due to the pandemic, I actually spent a lot of time both on the road in both truck and motorcycle. In that time I've used this countless times for both air variation at elevation and temperature due to changing of seasons as well as being high in the mountains. I also use it nearly 3 times a week simply to check my motorcycle tire pressure.I've also used this for various reasons like getting myself or others off the highway, mounting new tires on any of the 3 motorcycles I use and even for limping 200 miles down the highway on my Africa Twin until I got to a shop with the correct sized tire for my bike.Shockingly, this cheap feeling and clunky mess of a product never once let me down, nor did it ever give an inaccurate reading on the pressure I have selected.Honestly, I've recommended this to multiple other riders as well as bought them for several friends and family members, all who have had zero problems with them.10/10 would spend $60 again.

source_doc: Like my 100W so much I might be upgrading my main tank. I actually got this to warm water change water, but I love the features so much I might get a 300W for my main tank.  Mostly I liked that they external reader tells the temperature of the tank which I wanted so I could tell when my water was ready for changing into the tank.  Now I wish I had that feature in my main tank.  I also like the peace of mind that there is an automatic shut off.  My son lost his whole tank to a shorted heater that cooked his fish.  I hope this will prevent that from happening to me.And the kicker is that I paid about the same for my heater without the temp readout.

source_doc: Great for any wide mouth water storage jug. Since we had my daughter and the ridiculous amount of distilled water we used for her I bought a home water distiller so I didn't have to go to the store all the time to get distilled water.  The only problem was I was only able to do a gallon every three hours and when I was just using it for the kid that was fine but since we have hard water I've started using it for my humidifiers, coffee, tea, basically anything that water quality matters on so I needed to find a way to store it.  I got a couple of empty jugs and an electric pump to get the water out with, the only problem is sometimes I need to charge the pump and I don't want to leave the water open to our air which is why I got these.  They fit on both of my 5-gallon and 3-gallon just fine and keep the air out while I do whatever I need to do.  I don't have any gripes about these and they work as expected.

source_doc: I’m not positive if this product is the real deal. I usually buy this product from smartpak, but I didn’t realize how low I was and decided to buy from Amazon. My guy has been on this for over a year, so I know what it is suppose to smell and look like. It’s usually an extremely fine white powder, but the tub I got from this seller was slightly off colored and had a slightly different texture. I called the manufacturer to verify lot numbers and they told me “it was a valid lot number, but the Amazon shop was not a verified distributor.” I am little crazy about my animals so I tasted the product from smartpak and I tasted this one just to see if anything was off. It wasn’t exactly the same which made me nervous. To conclude, I have been using it and there have been no bad impacts, but I just don’t know about the validity of the product. I would definitely suggest getting it from a feed store or smartpak over this seller just ensure the safety of your horse.

source_doc: Good but misses keys. I have had this keyboard for a while. About 2-3 months after I got it, I started having issues with the buttons on the far right not working (the enter button, the 9, 6, 3 keys. I have to try to hit them multiple times for them to register. Sometimes my 2 key sticks and does the number twice when only hit it once. And the D key doesn’t always register. It started off mild at first and kept getting worse. It’s now at the point that I can’t deal with the issues anymore. I deal with a lot of numbers on a daily basis and this keeps slowing me down. I need to get a new keyboard. I want to try this one again, but am worried about the same issue happening again. I love the colors and the quickness of the buttons (as long as they work) I would give it 5 stars if I wasn’t having issues with the keys reacting. This keyboard was exactly what I was looking for with speed, sound, touch and responsiveness. Hopefully won’t have issues on next keyboard

source_doc: It turns off, Glitchy, connection keeps cutting off... Bought it about a year and 6 months ago. I first started noticing that the headset would randomly lose connection and or it would turn off. Usually I would turn it back on and that would solve the problem. This usually happened when I would try to connect to my xbox. I also noticed that in the middle of a game it would drop connection even though it was on and I had not moved anywhere. This started to happen more and more frequently about 3 moths ago. Now as of yesterday it kept turning off over and over again and or dropping connection. At first i thought it was because it might be low on battery. I plugged it in for about 1-2 hours. That did not solve the issue. So i thought maybe the cable does not work right. I checked the cable it was good. but just in case i used another cable as well. It still did not work. When i plug the cables in it shows a green light meaning it is fully charged or close to fully charged. Well it is still turning off randomly at intervals of about 1-2 mins. Yes I even tried keeping the cable on (charging) while the headset was on. It would still turn off. I am no longer within warranty. I guess I will go back to my other headset from  2013 lol. Do not buy they are glitchy!!!

source_doc: Better than what I was expecting. I get home late at night from work and I don't want to wake the family so I decided to buy a headset.I watched reviews on the PS5 Pulse 3D Headset which most people gave it an average rating. And from my own experience third party headsets are not always good. So I decided to get the Playstation brand headset. I heard it wasn't that comfortable for extended periods of gaming this I discovered wasn't the case for me as comfort is often is a preference made by different people. It felt comfortable to me. But I have to say the 3D sound is better than what I expected. I was figuring it would sound okay but I wasn't expecting surround sound like using my ouw home theater system. It was a good buy for the price.

source_doc: Works great. I have several remote control switches and bulbs around the house.  I got this one for its small size.  I use it for my cordless phone.  I got this thing about rechargeable batteries.  I believe if you keep them on the charger they don't last long.  I have experienced this myself with power tools.  I want the batteries to last as long as possible so I charge them and then let them discharge to a point then recharge.  I am told this is not necessary but again, I have seen several devices die early on constant charge.  So I have this cordless phone on my landline and it is in a cradle and constantly charging.  I got this device and plugged the cradle into it.  When the phone  is charged, I turn off the device till it needs charging again and turn it on.  Very convenient.

source_doc: Very Good Quality! One of my cats has always had a problem with leaving a yucky surprise on the floor after she eats.  I have tried so many different foods and it is always the same result.  After doing a bit of research, I learned that using an elevated bowl that is tilted can help cats that vomit after eating.  When I saw this one, I ordered it because it looks really nice.  I love that it is ceramic so that clean up is easier.  I also prefer to not feed my cats from any type of plastic.  The quality of this bowl is excellent.  The height is perfect and it is tilted.  After using this for a few days, I wish I had discovered it much sooner.  Since I have been feeding my fur baby from this bowl, she has not vomited once!!!  The price is good so I will be ordering a second one.  I cannot even tell you how happy I am that this bowl has helped her.

source_doc: Not the best for spices. I bought these to store some of my dry spices however I noticed that the jars had a strong chemical smell when opening them. I did not want these chemicals to seep into my spices. After a bit of tinkering with the jars I realized that the chemical smell was coming from the white styrofoam seals in the lids—once I took them out the jars smelled fine. I choose these jars specifically because they screw shut unlike some others jars that just have a cork/plunger type lid. For my purposes since I use my spices frequently and I don’t live in a very humid climate I don’t need the airtight seals which I took out. With that in mind this was a good purchase for me however it may not be for others who are looking to store spices.Edit————After removing the chemical smelling seals that came with these jars I decided to buy rubber gasket seals online to replace them. Cheap and very effective and now my jars are air and water tight. Unfortunate that I had to go to this extra step but these jars are nice enough for me to go the extra mile.

source_doc: Overly sensitive - may need therapy! I love the individually programmable key light colors! Granted, the color/brightness varies a little across the keyboard, but most people would not likely notice. I like the volume control, contrary to other reviews. The keyboard is full-size but compact - like a Tardis! With light use, the battery has lasted well. The only thing I don't care for is that the keys are very sensitive - it is easy to mistype with a very light touch. I find myself making corrections or opening windows that I didn't intend. I could use the power cable to keep the backlight from sleeping, but that's not why I bought a wireless model. I wish I could extend the sleep timer. I don't think there is a competitive model with similar features for this price and I highly recommend this Red Dragon keyboard if you can train yourself to use the very sensitive keys.

source_doc: Excellent to aid in learning. After many years away from the piano I am now retiring and attempting to teach myself how to play once again. I purchased a self-taught program which is very effective and came with an 8 1/2" x 11" picture of the keyboard showing the keys. As I am just starting out once again I found myself frequently referring to the "cheat sheet". I'm sure glad I found these keyboard notes which make it much easier to read music. I expected them to be thin but they are much thicker than I expected. I laid them across the keyboard and like the fact that they are slightly angled up as they rest on the keyboard but far enough to the top so as not to interfere with playing music. They cover the entire keyboard from left to right with letters that are large enough to see quite easily and a photo of the location of the note on a music sheet that is smaller and slightly less visible but that's ok the goal is to help me get started but I don't want to rely on them. These are quite durable, I expect them to last a long time and when not needed can easily be stored in the locking plastic box which they arrived in. I hightly recommend these for anyone learning how to play the piano
hypos: Výborné k pomoci při učení. Po mnoha letech od klavíru se nyní chystám na odchod do důchodu a pokouším se znovu naučit, jak hrát. Koupil/a jsem si samoučící program, který je velmi účinný, a přišel/a s obrázkem klávesnice o rozměrech 8 1/2" x 11", který ukazuje klávesy. Jak teď znovu začínám, často se odvolávám na "mimořádný list". Jsem rád/a, že jsem našel/a tyto poznámky na klávesnici, které činí čtení not mnohem snazším. Očekával/a jsem, že budou tenké, ale jsou mnohem silnější, než jsem očekával/a. Položil/a jsem je přes klávesnici a líbí se mi, že jsou mírně nakloněné vzhůru, když spočívají na klávesnici, ale dostatečně nahoře, aby nebránily hraní hudby. Pokrývají celou klávesnici zleva doprava s písmeny, která jsou dostatečně velká, aby byla snadno viditelná, a fotografií umístění noty na notovém archu, která je menší a mírně hůře viditelná, ale to nevadí, cílem je pomoci mi začít, ale nechci se na ně spoléhat. Tyto jsou dost odolné, očekávám, že vydrží dlouho, a když je nebudu potřebovat, mohou být snadno uschovány v uzamykatelné plastové krabici, v které přišly. Rozhodně doporučuji tyto pro každého, kdo se učí hrát na klavír.

Tyto poznámky jsou velmi odolné, očekávám, že vydrží dlouho, a když je nebudu potřebovat, snadno je mohu uložit do uzamykatelné plastové krabice, ve které přišly. Vřele doporučuji tyto poznámky každému, kdo se učí hrát na klavír.

source_doc: Awful smart switch. We got 3 of these. They were so easy to install, we are not able to add o e of them  to the app because I get the error that I need to be close to the switch( sitting next to it) . I have good wifi reception on my phone,  there’s no wall that interferes with switch. But still no getting a wifi signal So it’s useless!!!! The other 2, work ok. I set up routines, they never work! The lights stay on all day and sometimes they are not even on at night, I have to go to the app and doing it manually on the app which it’s a pain becasue there’s a reason I bought the smart one so I don’t have to be checking the lights becasue I always forget! I thought Maybe I installed the wrong but it’s the same situation with the plugs! The routines do not work! When I tried telling google to turn them on/ off . Google can never connect to the app! All the other smart switches/lights/plugs work just not these ones… You better save your money and get a wemo or another brand! Because this is a waste of money and time!

source_doc: Had for 10 months, ghosting bad. I've never experienced ghosting keys, but I bought two of these as I have 2 computers in my office that I use often. These are not cheap keyboards so I expected it to be better but the touch sensitivity of the keys is too much, multiple rr's (see what I did there? :D)  show up as well as other letters. I type a lot of for both of my jobs that I use these computers for. I previously had mechanical keyboards but they wore out some keys so rather than buy another one I tried this because I wanted something wireless for keeping a tidier desk so I felt like this was a good balance of wireless with responsive keys but am starting to consider what my next option will be.

source_doc: Loud!!!!! Perfect! I bought these for my cat my precious kitty cat, who transforms into a stealthy savage when she is outside! I couldn’t stand the carnage anymore! Although my husband is the one who dealt with that lol. It got to the point where I didn’t wanna let her out anymore. I didn’t think it was fair to the wildlife. but with these bells and the perfect to the safety collar changed everything! And I can hear her coming through the fields because of these awesome bells! source_doc: Great Product For Automobiles Or Any Filling Need! I used this product to repair a hole in the front bumper of my wife's car after an accident! I had a hole about 3 inches by 4 inches that was in need of repair. What I liked about this product was that I did not have to put a bunch of materials together or make a big batch for such a small job.I packed the hole with some newspaper; then I left about a half inch depth from the front of the bumper to fill. I took out about a cup of putty from the can with a plastic putty knife and then  added about a half inch line of hardener from the package.I then stirred the material until the colors blended well and applied it to the bumper. I did read where other users added too much hardener and it hardened on them rapidly; but I did not experience that problem with my batch. As a matter of fact, it took around an hour to dry completely which led me to believe I was a little too lenient on the hardener. It worked well though and I sanded it down within three hours and painted it the next day.You really can't tell that the hole was there at all; with the exception of paint difference. I strongly recommend this product for any of your patching needs!

source_doc: A great dissapointment. The characters are one demensional tropes that I couldn't care less about, the story is bland and predictable and the dialouge is pointless. I feel like I know as much about all of my companions 11 chapters in as I did when I first picked them up and I am A ranked with most of them.The world seems shallow and uninteresting. I have no drive to play the game because I have no feeling of imersion and connection (both important in a story driven RPG) to keep me invested and wanting to fight on.The combat system seems dumbed down and boring. And since, as I said above, the characters are just tropes that I don't care about I don't care when they die beyond losing a unit for battle.Even the character and world design seems lacking.I REALLY wanted to like this game. Three Houses is one of my favorite games of all time, but this just seems like a poorly done nostalgia cash grab.

source_doc: Bright Lights. Short Length. I ordered these to add some lights under my cabinets. I am currently using battery operated puck lights… which need battery replacement often. I don’t want to keep replacing the batteries or forgetting… and then they corrode. ANYWAY, these were my solution. However, I am not handy, and I have zero clue how to install these. You would think it’s as easy as sticking them up and boom you’re done. But I’m afraid to cut the wire and then they don’t work. My boyfriend is an electrician, and I am hoping he can help ease this process and make it worry free for me… but for now, I’m not so sure what to do. There are detailed instructions, but I am scared to do something wrong… and how do they connect between cabinet spaces? However, I am happy this came with all the pieces necessary for the job. And as you can see the lights actually work and are pretty bright. I can’t blame the lights that I don’t know how to install… but to me, personally, it’s not very user friendly. I “pretend” hung them in my kitchen, and they weren’t long enough any way. I would consider hanging them in my closet, where no cutting would be involved, but I don’t have an outlet in there. Hopefully one day I will be able to provide an update with a more positive review.

source_doc: This little tool is fantastic! True confession: I have horrible calluses and cracked heels. They don't bother me during the summer but as soon as winter hints, I start hobbling around, wondering why I never deal with it. The reason that I haven't dealt with them is that using a pumice stone has always made it worse.I got this kit because I thought it might help. I was so afraid that it would do more harm than good, that I avoided even hoping the box. I just found my courage.It's a wonder tool! First of all, it weighs next to nothing. There are two separate roller heads. I think that the rougher one would be too much for my feet in the current state but the smoothe one is perfect. I used it gently and felt the skin before and after and it was so much smoother. I think that if I don't over do it but use it consistently, I might be able to get my feet in summer shape. I'll consider it my New Years' Resolution.

source_doc: Finally I can see the road. After driving around at night with old foggy zero visibility headlamps for the last ten years, I came across these. Wasn't really interested in high-tech LED lights as they are not in character with my truck. I found the only hard part about installing these was the lower screw positioning which is right behind the bumper, a real pain to get to...  So I improvised I drilled a one-inch hole into the bumper as you can see in the picture, a service hatch, to get to the screw which I will stick a plug into later.  Maybe I got lucky they seem to be in the exact spot, light-wise, so I have not needed to adjust them.  The only issue with them is because they are not two-part lenses like the stock type if you have to remove the indicator bulb you will have to basically remove the headlamp screws and pull the headlamp forward, which I discovered when I noticed the indicator bulb was out. It is also a bit of a tight squeeze to get the headlamps in. Overall for the money, you cannot beat them. And I would buy it again if needed.

source_doc: Cleans well, no water splashes. This mop cleans well. I wasn't sure if water would be splashing all over with the spinning of the mop head but it doesn't, it is contained in the bucket. I like that this comes with so many microfiber mop heads so I can keep some in rotation until I wash the used ones. It is fairly simple to use once assembled, you just have to flip the lever one way when you are mopping and the opposite way when you are spinning the mop. There is no foot pedal like on the original spin mop, this one works by pushing on the metal pole after you flip the lever to rotate the head that you put in place in the metal basket. The basket, mop head and handle spin and the water splashes out of the holes in the basket into the pail. The only thing I don't like is that as I was mopping I kept scraping the floor with the mop as the microfiber yarns moved to the side, I think they need to be a little shorter and fuller because I don't like the feel or sound of that. It also comes with a scrubber brush that you can attach, instead of the microfiber head, which I have not tried yet.This mop cleans well and I like the color too.

Je to poměrně jednoduché na používání, jakmile je sestaveno, stačí otočit páku jedním směrem, když mopujete, a opačným způsobem, když otáčíte mopem. source_doc: Works great for me! As I have gotten older and I suppose less active, I seem to have more trouble going and staying asleep. I did not want to take a prescription sleep aid, so I tried the Dream Flo sleep aid without melatonin supplement, and I am glad that I did. I have tried other natural sleep supplements but really did not have good results. This product not only helped me get to sleep faster, but I stayed asleep most of the night with the exception of having to get up to go to the bathroom as usual. I also suffer from restless leg syndrome and even that is better when I take this supplement. I like the taste of the powder and I don’t have any trouble getting it to dissolve.  I think the price of this supplement might be a little high, but with the quality ingredients used in this product and how well it works, I think it’s worth it. I am very impressed with the results I am getting from this sleep aid, and I highly recommend it.

source_doc: This really works! I have suffered from neck, shoulder and upper back pain for years now. I get massages and use massage guns to get relief, but it still exists. When I saw this device I was a little skeptical, but I started using it nightly while watching television. I set it up behind me and let the infrared lights do their work. After using this for about a month now, I can say I feel a difference. The warmth, heat has made the pain minimize and I feel great after using it for about 15-20 minutes. Afterwards, I use it on my face to help activate collagen (my spa uses a similar light on my face as well and my skin looks great). I highly recommend this device for anyone with pain (especially).

source_doc: Awesome with a Catch... I really hate breaking the wood hotrods and then buying them again, only to break them again. The Kuppmen carbon fiber rods seem to be the answer to this issue. I love the way they feel, and they sound just great on my hi hats when I need less attack but still want to play pretty hard. Rebound from the snare is awesome, and all around they're just a pleasure to play with.BUT... the center rod will eventually fly out! This usually happens mid song, and I usually realize it when I go to hit the snare and I get the crash (12 inches behind the snare) instead. Then I have to use a drumstick to smash the rod back into place and hope it doesn't come out again. I've considered pulling the center rod and putting a dab of superglue on the very bottom of it, but I kind of wish I didn't have to do that, considering how expensive these rods are. I don't mind paying the price, but I expect durability, you know?Otherwise, I love them!
hypos: Skvělé s háčkem... Opravu nenávidím, když lámu dřevěné paličky a pak je znovu kupuji, abych je zase zlomil/a. Karpitové tyče Kuppmen se zdají být odpovědí na tento problém. Miluji, jak se cítí, a na mých hi-hatech zní skvěle, když potřebuji méně útoku, ale stále chci hrát docela tvrdě. Odezva ze snare je úžasná a celkově je s nimi jen radost hrát. ALE... centrální tyč nakonec vyskočí! To se obvykle stává uprostřed písně a většinou si toho všimnu, když se chystám udeřit do snare a místo toho dostanu náraz (12 palců za snare). Pak musím použít paličku, abych tyč vrazil/a zpátky na místo a doufat, že znovu nevypadne. source_doc: I bought this months ago and I still use it every week. After I bought one of these egg cookers, I saw one show up at work. That was kind of funny. I've bought other things and only used them a couple of times. When I still use something regularly after having it for months, I know I found something good.

source_doc: More feel and stability. I took the JumboMax challenge, ordering a full set of grips, re-gripping one club and going to play.  I changed out my 8 iron because I use it a lot, plenty of opportunities for bump and run where I play.Came home, had lunch and re-gripped the whole set.  I find that I was too tight, tense, whatever you call it with the old skinny grips.  With these I was able to swing without clamping down on the club and without having to think about it much.  This lead to much increased feel and more clubhead speed.Around the greens my wedge play  is much improved.  I let one of my regular partners try out a wedge and he showed up the next week with HIS set changed out to these grips too.  So he still scores better than me, not that I mind.I love these grips.  Picking up a regular grip club now feels very strange.  I now understand why I never really had the degree of control I wanted before, even though I used oversize grips.  Oversize does not come even close to the feel of the JumboMax.

source_doc: It did help! I've recently recovered from a respiratory infection. I've had a strong cough, runny nose and was sneezing all the time. At one point, my whole nose was congested and I couldn't feel any smells. I am happy I saw this tea and ordered it. It came super fast so I could start drinking it right away. I couldn't feel the taste or smell of it when was sick but on a third day after drinking this tea I felt such a great relief. I have to say I was getting some medicine and other stuff like garlic, ginger and lemon too but I have a feeling that the tea helped too! Now when I'm fully recovered I can feel taste and smell of the tea. Smells like herbal tea, tastes a little weird to me, but as long as it helps - I am okay with it.

source_doc: Screw holes not machined well and doesn't fit handlebars or steer tube perfectly. I bought two of these. The first one broke as I was installing it. One of the handlebar screws popped out as I was screwing it in and the threads in the hole completely just stripped out. So I got a refund and wanted to give the benefit doubt to the product so I ordered another. It lasted me roughly 9 months and as I was removing the stem to take my fork off, the bolt hole snapped and stripped out again. For the price it isn't bad. If you don't intend on ever taking the stem off and you carefully install it, I think it could be good. But I travel with my bike and this happened as I was traveling so it nearly ruined my trip. Luckily it was just one hole so I was able to make due with it temporarily but I will not be buying this stem again. Another weird thing about this stem is that it didn't fit my handlebars perfectly and there was a gap between the front plate and the stem. It also didn't fit onto my steer tube very well and it  took a lot of effort to remove/install.

source_doc: It’s all about THAT Bass. I recently purchased a Fender Aerodyne Jazz bass.  This particular bass has no fret markers on the fingerboard, which makes for a nice, clean look.  I normally don’t pay any attention to the markers on the fingerboard, so no problem.  Here’s the problem.  I’m visually impaired and I DO rely on the markers that are in the neck of the bass.  The Aerodyne came with tiny , white dots that I couldn’t see while playing.I tried 1/8” inch dots, but they were too small.  I then ordered these 1/4” dots and they are perfect.  They were easy to apply, and seem to stay adheres pretty well to the neck.  Even if I have to replace them regularly, it’s worth it.  I was about ready to return the bass, not because I didn’t like it, but because it was too difficult to play well.  These simple dots saved the day for me as I love this bass!  See picture for details.  No jokes about them not being straight cuz I already told you I can’t see lol.

source_doc: In The Stars. Sometimes it is hard to know what the reviews are referring to if there are multiple items to purchase. I bought In The Stars which has quickly become a huge favorite of mine. I bought it without smelling it first based on the description. This is not something I normally do but I’m so glad I did. The scent is clean but also sexy. It is light and not overpowering like some can be. I have the lotion so before bed I slather that on and follow with this spray. I feel wonderful and pretty wearing this and I also recommend the lotion that makes my skin feel like velvet. I took one star off because when I spay it on I can smell alcohol but I’m not  really mad about it. After a moment it smells sweet and wonderful. This scent would be good for anyone. It doesn’t smell like old lady or children at all. It blends with my body chemistry and smells natural on me like it was designed just for me! It is a unique and complex fragrance. I’m used to spending 10 times as much for products and honestly I’m throwing a bunch of them out. This is in my top 3 BBW scents and I highly recommend it!

source_doc: SMELLS SO BAD, that’s the only flaw. I bought this car seat because after getting in an accident, I realized I wanted the most safe infant car seat I could find, rather than my previous cheap one with very little padding, that easily pops out of the base. So I got this MaxiCosi after talking with several friends about their favorite brands, and I love everything about it EXCEPT the smell, oh my gosh it is so strong smelling of chemicals, almost a burning plastic type smell, and it makes my baby and her clothes stink so much I bathe her and wash the clothes first thing when we get home. I’m grateful for the extra padding, and that it’s still in a great price range (on the higher end though), but please be aware even after washing & then soaking the car seat fabric parts in borax, it will still be overwhelmingly strong. I also used my Bissell fabric cleaning machine and it still smells… just an FYI, maybe not all of them are like that and I got a defective one, I’m not sure, but if I didn’t absolutely need to have a good car seat in my car right now, I would return it.

source_doc: Good moisturizer, fragrance free. I have been using oil vs lotion on my body for years. Usually almond or grape, but thought I would give this a try. I have heard good things about jojoba. It has no fragrance, which I prefer. It is a little thicker, but absorbs nicely on wet skin. I like oil better as I have dry skin & lotion tends to coat skin on me, instead of feeling like it’s actually getting into my skin. I can keep my dry skin in check, if I use it daily. The Jojoba oil seems to leave a bit of a layer, but only cause it  takes a little longer to absorb completely. My skin definitely feels moisturized & looks healthier. I like it. Other than the thicker texture of the oil, it isn’t much different than what I have used before. No negatives that I notice. Competitively price for the large size. Worth a try.

source_doc: Works The Best Of Anything I've Ever Used. I have very calloused feet from wearing flipflops all the time.  My heels are always pretty rough. I have tried lots of methods to get my feet smooth, and I have to say, this glass foot file is amazing!  I used it at the end of my shower, when my skin had softened up.  I soaped up my foot, used the coarse side first, then finished up with the smoother side.  It made my feet really smooth, really quickly.  It works much better than my rechargeable rotary foot file.  I like that you don't have to charge it.  The one I had that you had to charge always seemed to be not sitting just right on the charger and then it wouldn't work when you went to use it.  It is a little big and bulky, but I just put it in the cabinet when I'm not planning on using it.  When I plan on using it, I put the stand right next to the tub on the floor.  The stand seems a little rickety, and I don't want it to tip over and scratch my tub.  The file is quite coarse on one side, and I'm afraid it would leave scratches.  This works the best of anything I have ever used to smooth my feet.  I highly recommend it.  It seems like it will last for a long time too.

source_doc: Solid basic arm. Honest review! Bought this because i wanted a basic simple arm for my mic. Easy to install and works as advertised. It is a little clunky and the motion is very meh. But for what i paid for it… Come on. I don’t get any metal ringing through recordings if i hit the stand slightly like in some others i’ve had. The medium sized one was perfect for what i needed. The large would have probably been returned. If i had to pick out one thing i love and hate? I LOVE the base that goes to the desk. Very solid and makes me feel confident in it. The thing i HATE? This arm would be 10/10 if they made a simple design change on the mic holder. I want it to be able to turn full radius. Up, down, left, right, ect. It’s a little limited. Up and down only. Now I KNOW i can buy a separate piece to make that happen and it is probably designed for that. But it would be a game changer if it just DID THIS TO BEGIN WITH. 4/5 stars good

source_doc: Don't let first impressions fool you! I love to karaoke. I don't sing well, but I still love trying. I was so excited when the machine arrived! I tore open the box and my excitement turned immediately into disappointment! I actually laughed when I saw this little box that was supposed to be my new karaoke machine! I thought I'd been had! Still, I had to see how bad it was going to be. Guess what? It actually works pretty darn good! The sound is really good, and gets plenty loud. We just connected my cell phone with blue tooth, loaded the playlist and I was singing my little heart out! Just like that! I still haven't experimented with all the features, but we did try out the voice changing one and it's hilarious! We had a blast on New Years Eve with this machine! The microphones held their charge all the way to midnight! Well, I guess big things do come in small packages after all! Two thumbs up!

source_doc: I should have bought this years ago. I love this thing.  I love hard boiled eggs but often don't eat them because of the hassle of making them.  When I do make them, I tend to not eat all of them, or by the time I do, they have lost their flavor.  With this egg cooker I can make them on demand with pretty much zero effort.  I also love fried eggs over medium but it's such a pain to always get out the frying pan etc... I just make medium boiled eggs with this and it's pretty much the same!  I tried doing the poached eggs, but could not find the best amount of water/time to get them cooked right.  I could get the yolk perfect, but the underside of the egg white was still runny.  Added more water and the yolk was almost completely cooked and the underside egg white was till runny.  Not a big deal because again, I get exactly the cook I want with the medium boil and can do more eggs at a time.I would have paid triple for this item it's that good.  I don't really understand the negative reviews about the timer.  It is loud, but not obnoxious and I can hear it anywhere in the house.  The melody is fine, it took me a few times to realize it was the egg timer and not my phone ringing.
hypos: Měl/a jsem to koupit už před lety. Miluji tuto věc. Miluji vařená vejce, ale často je nejím kvůli námaze s jejich přípravou. Když je už dělám, obvykle je všechny nesním, nebo když už je sním, ztratí svou chuť. S tímto vařičem na vejce je mohu připravit na požádání téměř s nulovým úsilím. Také miluji smažená vejce na středně, ale je to taková otrava vždy vytahovat pánev atd... Jen dělám středně vařená vejce s tímto a je to téměř stejné! Zkoušel/a jsem dělat vejce benedikt, ale nemohl/a jsem najít nejlepší množství vody/času, abych je správně uvařil/a. Žloutek jsem měl/a perfektní, ale spodní strana bílku byla stále řídká. Přidal/a jsem více vody a žloutek byl téměř úplně uvařený, ale spodní strana bílku byla stále řídká. Není to velký problém, protože znovu dostávám přesně to, jak chci s vařením na středně a mohu udělat více vajec najednou. Zaplatil/a bych za tuto věc trojnásobek, je to až tak dobré. Opravdu nerozumím negativním recenzím ohledně časovače. Je hlasitý, ale ne obtěžující a slyším ho kdekoli v domě. Melodie je v pořádku, trvalo mi párkrát, než jsem si uvědomil/a, že to je časovač na vejce a ne, že mi zvoní telefon.

source_doc: Really hoped to love it. Install slightly difficult. I have a 2014 Nissan Sentra SR and this is not my first time replacing a cabin air filter. I was really hoping to love this product due to the longer life and activated carbon, but I'm hesitant to purchase another one.I may have received a defective filter, but the filter I received was not easy to install. I had to really force and maneuver it in the filter compartment. I struggled with it so much that I accidentally ripped the little tag that is supposed to help pull the filter back out later. Hopefully I won't have too much trouble taking it out when it's time to replace it again. I haven't decided if I plan to purchase this again when it is time for another replacement. If I do I will update my review on whether or not the 2nd one was just as difficult. For time comparison.... It took me half the time, if not less, to replace my engine air filter and air intake hose than the cabin air filter.

source_doc: Painful, but maybe it's me. I don't have plantar fasciitis or any particular foot issues, but I could use indoor sandals and thought the massage aspect might be fun. I thought I got the wrong item at first because the (unsealed) box pictures a teapot and herbs, but I guess that's supposed to reference natural healing; the box is actually pictured in the listing. The slippers run about a size small. I would've ordered a size 5 if they had it, but 6 was the smallest and it turns out they are just right. I don't know why the smaller sizes have a rocker bottom while the larger sizes have a flat bottom or why stone is listed as a material. The spikes on the slippers hurt even with socks. It's very hard to endure walking in them. The listing does suggest wearing socks and gradually increasing wear time to ease the pain, so I guess it was to be expected? This kind of thing is new to me and maybe if I had foot issues, I would feel a different kind of relief. The seller did personally reach out and respectfully reiterate that the pain is said to subside by some. That's possible and since I'm not the target audience, I reconsidered that I should remain neutral in rating these. I'll continue trying to get used to these, but if you just need ordinary slippers, don't put yourself through this. They're priced okay at $29.99 plus $5 off.

source_doc: It IS lower tracking and lower dust than the other bags, but I'm not sure I'll continue buying it. The litter is made into much larger granules; this is why it tracks less and has less dust. At first, I was not impressed. I was not expecting this kind of dramatic change, so it threw me off guard. However, I gave it a chance, and I like it okay. My cats are fine with it, and it does do what it says it will do. I like that it tracks less; however, I still need to sweep every day because I like my floors litter-free. And I like that it has less dust, but it still has some dust.The only problems with this litter are:- I can imagine it might hurt my cats feet a little more, kind of like walking on gravel instead of sand, but maybe that's not the case (I haven't asked my cats how it feels).- The litter scoops I have don't sift it very well because the slots are a little too small for these large particles.- The clumping ability is still pretty great, but I think it clumps just a little bit less well than the other bags.This is still a 5-star cat litter, but, for me, I think I'm going to switch back to the other bags. It's worth trying, for sure, and it may be better for you depending on your situation.
hypos: Je to nižší sledování a méně prachu než u ostatních pytlů, ale nejsem si jistý/jistá, že ho budu nadále kupovat. Podestýlka je vyrobena z mnohem větších granulí; to je důvod, proč se méně sleduje a má méně prachu. Zpočátku jsem nebyl/byla jsem ohromený/á. Nepředpokládal/předpokládala jsem tento typ dramatické změny, takže mě to zaskočilo. Nicméně, dala/dal jsem tomu šanci a vypadá to v pořádku. Moje kočky jsou s tím v pořádku a dělá to, co říká, že udělá. Líbí se mi, že se méně sleduje; nicméně, stále musím zametat každý den, protože mám ráda/mám rád své podlahy bez podestýlky. A líbí se mi, že má méně prachu, ale stále má nějaký prach. Jedinými problémy s touto podestýlkou jsou: - Mohu si představit, že by to mohlo mojim kočkám trochu více ubližovat na nožkách, jako kdyby chodily po kamení místo po písku, ale možná to tak není (neptala/ptal jsem se svých koček, jak to cítí). - Lopatky na podestýlku, které mám, ji neprosévají moc dobře, protože otvory jsou trochu příliš malé pro tyto velké částice. - Skládací schopnost je stále docela skvělá, ale myslím, že se shlukuje jen o něco méně dobře než u ostatních pytlů. To je stále podestýlka pro kočky s 5 hvězdičkami, ale pro mě, myslím, že se vrátím k ostatním pytlům. Určitě to stojí za zkoušku a může být lepší pro vás v závislosti na vaší situaci.

source_doc: So disappointed. I am really disappointed. I contacted customer service because the vegan leather on my bag is pealing after just a few months of use. The best they can do is nothing? They said I must be rubbing it on rough surfaces. I am not rubbing or bumping it on rough surfaces. I have had another Itzy Ritzy bag and used it the exact same way and it has very little wear and tear on it after years of use. It was also vegan leather. The surface of the vegan leather is just peeling in places where there is not much friction. I am careful to take good care of my bags. I have really enjoyed being an Itzy Ritzy customer. As a mom of 7, I have carried their bags for years as well as used many other products including toys and pacifiers. I also recommend the brand because of the quality, however I have sadly learned that the customer care is lacking. For an item to peel like this is unacceptable and not normal wear and tear. I guess their quality standards have lowered as well, previous bags did not do this. If they will only stand by products purchased directly from their website and not other merchants such as Amazon, what is the point of selling there? I will no longer purchase or recommend Itzy Ritzy.

source_doc: Great option for a wireless lav mic without breaking the bank! I had middle of the road expectations for this wireless last mic, compared to some other brands that I am more familiar with. But I saw that there was an excellent Black Friday sale, and I was desperately in need of a new wireless microphone like this, And it was recommended on one tech YouTube channel I saw, so I decided to give it a shot. I’m really glad that I did! A lot of times I am filming in an area where I am away from my phone, and the way this plugs into the charging port on the bottom is super convenient. The sound quality is also very good for what it is, and is  impressive to me more than I thought it would be. I would definitely buy this again, and I would recommend it to others.
