source_doc: It works great for holding towels. I don't have a large linen closet so I've been keeping hand towels and other extras on a shelf here or a drawer there... When I saw these storage baskets I thought they may be a solution and, as it turns out, they are! I was able to hang the baskets on a over-the-door hook on my bathroom door - it can easily hold the weight of the baskets and towels.I have to say that I expected the baskets to look a bit more "straw-like" - more like real woven basket texture... I know they are described as cotton rope, but the word "jute" was also in the description so I guess that's why I expected it to look more like straw. They are still attractive - just not exactly what I expected. Also, the 3rd/bottom basket hangs at a weird angle - it tilts forward (see photo). I tried to adjust it but nothing I did made it straighten up. It's not a dramatic tilt or dip, so I don't think anything would fall out of it, but just something I observed. I removed a star for those two small things (jute in the description is misleading and the bottom basket tilts forward). But those are tiny things I can certainly overlook and I like the baskets a lot - they are a nice looking solution for my lack of linen closet storage.

source_doc: Stays in place all night! I ordered this sleep cap to try to keep my long hair from frizzing since I toss and turn all night. I adjusted the cap to be tighter with the adjustable strap inside. I honestly thought the cap would fall off during the night, but every time I woke up, it was still on my head. I sleep with a pillow over my eyes, so I’m used to something being on my head while I sleep, but having this cap on was still a little different for me. I think I will get used to it quickly. When I woke up in the morning and took off the cap, my hair was still smooth from the night before, so I believe this product works as intended. The cap material itself is really soft and smooth, so I can see why this is gentler on hair than a pillow case. Bonus, if you don’t wash your hair every day, this cap will keep your hair products from rubbing on your face and causing a breakout. I am excited to see if putting this cap on will preserve my curls to where I don’t have to completely recurl my hair the next morning.

source_doc: Excellent USB Hub. I work in IT and needed to get rid of all the USB adapters I carry for one dependable/portable hub. I think I found that hub. This hub is made of metal is looks very durable. Looks to have good ventilation but it is a little on the big size for me. I guess it has to be with everything it does. I connected it to my Surface Pro 7 and away I went. No drivers needed which is very important to me. I tested the VGA port, Micro SD port, USB 3.0 ports, and the ethernet port and all worked flawlessly. I tried to connect my USC-C thunderbolt docking station to the 100w PD port, but power didn’t pass through. I’m not saying it didn’t work, it just didn’t work with what I had. I could buy a 100w USB-C charger if needed but this hub passed my tests for the ports I really needed. Now, I would be willing to trade the VGA port for a serial port. I guess I have to keep carrying my USB to Serial adapter. All in all, this hub rocks.

source_doc: Game changer for keeping the kitties hydrated! I was a bit leery about purchasing this, but boy-oh-boy am I glad that I went for it! It is better than I even imagined. We have a bit tight living space and I needed something that could fit in a small space. I was tired of carrying a full water bowl over to the cat’s “dining area” to then have one of them nudge my hand and then spilling the entire bowl of water on the floor! Plus I could never seem to be able to tell when their water bowl was empty. This unit has been a blessing. It didn’t take them any time at all to use it—they weren’t intimidated by the new look at all. I also discovered that the lid will screw onto a soda bottle also, so if there is a time when we need to leave more water out for them, I feel confident that I could use a larger size bottle if we will be gone for an extended amount of time. It will also be useful if for some reason the original bottle cracks (which I’m hoping it won’t). I would love to find another stainless food bowl for this unit so that I can have a clean one on standby when I want to wash the included bowl in the dishwasher. The extra ones I have are either too large or too small. This was a great buy!!

source_doc: Weak Sandalwood - Not For My Sensitive Skin. I shave my beard but leave my mustache alone.  I have never used beard oil before.  I just apply whatever facial cream is left on my hand to my mustache.  So decided to try this.The bottles are small and as per the label, each one contains 20ml of various oils.  I uncap each one and use my sensitive nose to check the fragrance.  I love sandalwood soap so the first one I checked was the one in the middle - Sandalwood.  The fragrance of this is disappointing.  I can smell a slight presence of sandalwood but there is also something added that turned my nose off.  The unscented is neutral.  I prefer the chemical composition of cedar wood, vanilla, and sweet orange.Each bottle has a built-in dropper.  The dropper design is not pipette tipped but with a small circular tip.  I guess this is their way of measuring a dab of oil.I dropped a small quantity of sandalwood on my skin to test.  I felt a warm sensation at the beginning.  After a minute I felt a need to scratch my skin.  Hmmm, something in this oil my skin is complaining for.  I will not use this for my mustache since the skin around my lips is more sensitive.I cut my hair short and sometimes I can see that it needs moisturizer.  I may repurpose this beard oil for that.
hypos: Slabé santalové dřevo - Není pro moji citlivou pleť. Holím si vousy, ale knír nechávám na pokoji. Nikdy jsem předtím nepoužil/a olej na vousy. Jen aplikuji, co mi zbylo z pleťového krému na ruce, na svůj knír. Tak jsem se rozhodl/a to zkusit. Lahvičky jsou malé a podle etikety každá obsahuje 20 ml různých olejů. Otevřel/a jsem každou a používám svůj citlivý nos, abych zkontroloval/a vůni. Mám rád/a santalové mýdlo, takže první, kterou jsem zkontroloval/a, byla ta uprostřed - Santalové dřevo. Vůně je zklamáním. Cítím slabou přítomnost santalového dřeva, ale je tam také něco přidaného, co mi vadí. Bez vůně je neutrální. Preferuji chemické složení cedru, vanilky a sladkého pomeranče. Každá lahvička má vestavěnou kapátko. Design kapátka není špičkový, ale s malým kulatým špičkou. Myslím, že tohle je jejich způsob měření kapky oleje. Dal/a jsem malé množství santalového dřeva na svou pleť, abych to otestoval/a. Zpočátku jsem cítil/a teplý pocit. Po minutě jsem cítil/a potřebu si poškrábat pleť. Hmmm, něco v tomto oleji si moje pleť stěžuje. Nebudu to používat na svůj knír, protože pleť kolem mých rtů je citlivější. Stříhám si vlasy na krátko a někdy vidím, že potřebují zvlhčovač. Možná tento olej na vousy přizpůsobím na to.

source_doc: It worked. I’m not a veterinarian, but homeopathic remedies typically do more than just treat a symptom. My dog has collapsing trachea, which causes her to cough after she drinks water. I well, when you get enough water that went the wrong direction and into your windpipe you’re going to have a dog that’s coughing on a regular basis. I tried this stuff not really expecting anything and boy was I wrong. Within two days the cough was drastically reduced. She still coughs after drinking water, but all the coughing in between is gone. I ordered a second bottle and miss placed it, and the coughing came back after about three days.  I ordered a third bottle and started the drops up again and had the same positive results. This stuff is staying in my arsenal. I find that you can reduce the dose as the cough subsides. I don’t stop it anymore. I just drastically reduced it. The cough is still gone. I have little porous dental treats that my dog loves. I put the drops on those and she doesn’t mind at all. If I run out of treats, I put a couple of drops in her bowl and squirt a little bit of whipped cream on top and that does it as well. This was a miracle for us.
hypos: Fungovalo to. Nejsem veterinář/ka, ale homeopatické prostředky obvykle dělají víc než jen léčí symptom. Moje pes/jedna má kolabující tracheu, což jí způsobuje kašel po napití vody. No, když dostanete dostatek vody, která šla špatným směrem a do vašeho průdušnice, budete mít psa, který pravidelně kašle. Zkusil/a jsem tento prostředek, aniž bych očekával/a cokoli, a jak jsem se mýlil/a. Do dvou dnů se kašel drasticky snížil. Stále kašle po napití vody, ale všechno kašlání mezi tím zmizelo. Objednal/a jsem si druhou láhev a nešikovně ji položil/a, a kašel se vrátil asi po třech dnech. Objednal/a jsem si třetí láhev a znovu začal/a s kapkami a měl/a jsem stejné pozitivní výsledky. Mám malé porézní zubní pamlsky, které moje pes/jedna miluje. Dávám na ně kapky a vůbec jí to nevadí. source_doc: Sounds Nice But Doesn't Work as Expected (Until I Drank a Energy Drink) **UPDATE** Today, I took 3 of these as suggested again and did not feel the effects as expected, but after I forgot I took these, I had an energy drink, and DANG. This stuff either kicked in or combined with the energy drink, and I was pumped up about 30 minutes after I started drinking my dink. Three hours later, I still haven't finished my drink and am still going.FYI - Be careful if you take these with extra caffeine.These pills have some positive mentions in the way that when I took three pills (Number suggested for use), I felt like I had a cup of coffee or two ~ 30-40 minutes after, but that was all.While these pills are OK, the serving size of everything is based on three tablets, with 90 capsules per bottle. If this had the same amount of ingredients but in only one drug, then this would have gotten a better rating; it seems like too much money to drop on "Energy-Pills/Supplements" for only a 30-day supply when they don't work that well.

source_doc: I actually doubted I would like this but I do! I have neck problems and had surgery for scoliosis many years back. I have been having issues with pain with sleeping and often switch pillows. I have tried a memory-foam wedge pillow in the past but it was not contoured like this one is. I hated that pillow and didn't use it longI also turn a lot in my sleep and I have the habit of putting my arm under my pillow. So I figured I might not like the pillow if I can't side sleep with my arm under it but so far I've been doing good with it.It is very comfortable to be on my back and also be comfortable on my shoulders. My shoulders seem to perfectly rest against the pillow and it has an ideal firmness about it that is comfortable for my neck and head to rest on. I still sometimes sleep with my arm underneath while I'm on my side. That's still pretty comfy but I'm trying to get myself to be mostly on my back 🤦‍♀️

Nenáviděl/a jsem ten polštář a dlouho jsem ho nepoužíval/a. Také se během spánku hodně otáčím a mám zvyk dávat ruku pod polštář. Takže jsem si říkal/a, že se mi nemusí líbit, pokud nemohu spát na boku s rukou pod ním, ale zatím mi to s ním jde dobře. Je velmi pohodlné ležet na zádech a také mít pohodlí na ramenou. Moje ramena se zdají perfektně opírat o polštář a má ideální tuhost, která je pohodlná pro odpočinek mého krku a hlavy. Někdy stále spím s rukou pod sebe, když ležím na boku. source_doc: Finally a mirror that works in my Honda! I was struggling greatly to find a rear facing baby mirror for my Honda Civic.  The reason? All of the backseat headrests are NOT movable! The headrest is part of the seat. Most mirrors with attached straps and gadgets direct you to strap the mirror under the headrest which does not work for my type of backseat. I was trying my best not to purchase a suction cup mirror to place on the window because I knew it would fall off depending on the weather, condensation and so forth. Luckily I came across this mirror, and even with reading reviews, I could not come across anyone who had my same type of backseat issue but gave it a try anyway. I was hesitant because just like the others, it came with straps to go across and under the headrest. Fortunately, I was able to strap the mirror around my attached headrest seat without using the strap used to go under the headrest. I pulled it tight and was able to maneuver the mirror to angle down on my baby perfectly! It works so well and doesn’t move! The mirror is very large so as I looked in my rear view mirror, I am able to see my child fully and clearly! She loves looking at herself too!I am very happy with this purchase- I just wished I bought it sooner!

source_doc: Can compression socks be soft and comfortable! These prove YES. I have blood clotting issues, which is not a surprising thing since I'm turning 60 this year. Our bodies betray us, and we need to accommodate.I had yet to find compression socks I could tolerate, but when I saw these that leave the toes free, I was like OH YEAH, no crunched tootsies! I was worried they might be scratchy, as most compression socks are, but these are soft and easy to wear. All around, I am so pleased I can finally tell my doctor that yes, I am wearing my compression socks daily, because I don't mind these at all.As for sizing, I am 5'6" and around 140 lbs. I ordered a Large, which is snug but not tight.

source_doc: This thing is wild. I have used a variety of TENS units and have really enjoyed them.  This thing is much more powerful so be advised.  I do wish that there were lower levels as I find 1 pretty powerful.  I have not been able to increase from level 1, but I am sure with time I will get used to it.  I'm just taking it easy in the beginning.  I like that is adjustable with a variety of modes.  The pucks that drive the system are easy t use and attached and I like that one cable will charge them all. The charge lasts quite some time as well.  I have mostly focused on toning my stomach and I know I need to use it for longer to see more results, but I am excited about the journey.

source_doc: I use it every day. I'm not a great photographer, and it's not like I can capture the "soul" of a water bottle because it's simply a water bottle. However, I am not exaggerating when I say that for the first two days that I had it, practically everyone at work questioned me about it. I'm not sure if it's because I had it full of ice water and everyone was thirsty and saw that my bottle was full of ice cold water and it just made it more desirable or what. I do, however, know that this water bottle has not yet leaked on me. I like how the ml of water is labeled on the side. Oh, and I'm reminded of how puzzled I was when I first tried to open this thing, but now I think it's one of the best aspects. So, when you go to drink, you press a little button in the front, and it flings your lid off. It is both quick and convenient. However, at first glance, it appears to be something that slides up and down. One of my friends told me they tried to drink from it, but they couldn't open it. (Fortunately, I didn't want their lips on my drink in the first place.)So, Basically I LOVE IT

source_doc: Color not the same as description. This does work great for storing a carseat and holds our Graco infant to toddler one perfect. The straps also make it easy to use for traveling or anywhere you need to bring it with you. Having said that, I almost removed a star because the color I recieved is purple, but not dark like I thought it would be. I specifically chose this one for the color, and had I known it would be this light, I would have gotten a black one instead.  For me, this matters as a someone who chooses things by specific colors a lot.  I wanted it to match another item, and it does not. Having said that, I am still happy with the quality of this, and it will definitely still get used. But I struggled to give a full 5 stars for something I was harshly disappointed with when I initially opened. The good thing is, it is super easy to put the carseat in and take it out as well. Other than the color being different, it really has no other issues. I added a photo of what I expected so you can see what I mean on the color difference.

source_doc: Simply Beautiful. I got these lights in with no idea of what exactly I was really ordering. Which is very odd for me because I don’t spontaneously get products without reading every little detail. When they arrived and I saw that the strand was 400’ long,  I was surprised and then a little disappointed in myself for ordering them. Until my brain started to click. I decided to take the forever long, flexible and sleek looking strand and I literally wrapped each branch of my Christmas tree from the top to the bottom and still had plenty left over. They were so pretty, blended right in and had people asking me if my tree was a pre lit. I didn’t have to worry about gaudy light string’s being seen, lights never got hot and I was able to change them from being on steady to blinking, twinkling or fading in and out. I also loved how it came with a remote control as I was able to change the brightness level. I do recommend that If you do use these and decide to wrap them up afterwards, take your time and go slow or you’ll end up with a big birds nest as I did. I was able to get it straightened out but it took some time!

source_doc: Love it! I really like these “mood ease” gummies. I seem to worry about everything, and this supplement has definitely helped with my anxiety.  I imagine it’s because of the Chamomile and Ashwagandha, which seems to work for me. I love gummies so I was glad to see that this product is sugar free. The suggested use is two gummies a day, so one bottle will last a month. The bottle was sealed very tightly, and the product seemed fresh. I really enjoyed the flavor which had a slight cranberry flavor.  I would never have thought to try a product such as this, but I am really glad that I did. As long as this keeps working for me, I plan on continuing its use. I recommend it!

source_doc: Can't be placed under a cabinet without pulling the coffee maker out to fill with water. I was specifically looking for a coffee maker that I could place under a cabinet and not have to pull out each time I needed to add water.  That may be a minor thing to most people, but it was what I wanted the most besides good, hot, coffee, an auto shut off feature, etc. Things most people look for when shopping for a coffee maker.After researching for days and weeks I thought I had found it in this model, but the measurements on the product page did not match the measurements I needed to make this work on my counter.  I was disappointed because after a ton of reading I discovered how happy people were with the Hamilton Beach brand.  I had to return it and now I have to decide if I want another 4-5 cup maker again - I know that one will fit.

source_doc: Making a clunk noise when R click. I bought this mouse March 2021 so it's not 2 yrs old yet and the last few months I have noticed a loud clunk when I right click. It still works just fine, but the noise makes me think it will be dying soon. I don't ever use the lights and am not a gamer so there is no rage banging or throwing. I use this mouse for CAD.  I don't use any of the other buttons other than R & L click. I just like the shape of the mouse. It is really comfortable, although sometimes my pinky is hanging off to the side and gets stiff. The battery lasts a long time. I shut it off when I'm not using it to preserve battery as well as not use the lights as I stated above. I purchased the protection plan so I guess I will put that to use and get a new mouse. Would expect this mouse to last longer and not make funny noises even at the low price.

I was supposed to stand at my table for like four hours but just couldn't  This stool was just the right height so I could take a load off my feet yet still be upright enough to be attentive to the shoppers I was demonstrating too.Now I have one in my kitchen. I am getting older and would rather not stand for any length of time if I don't have to. It is great for waiting for the microwave to finish when I'm fixing a meal. And when I don't need it any more it folds so easily - just release the catch and jurk upwards on the seat and it folds right up small enough to slip into that space between the fridge and the wall. I don't remember what the weight limit is supposed to be, but I weigh 265 lbs and it has no problem supporting me.

source_doc: More than just a vase, this is a piece of art! I was expecting to like this vase but I was blown away with seeing it in person. I was thinking it would be much smaller than it actually is. It's large and so beautifully shaped. I love the primitive look of it. To me it looks kind of like an ancient cave wall drawing brought to life. I love that it's got a really nice, somewhat rough, texture to it. I wasn't sure I would like the black and was thinking I may spray paint it but the black really does work. I'm still deciding how I want to use this piece. It's not really a vase for fresh flowers at all. I have several different types of dried floral and pampas grasses I am going to try out to see which look I like best. I am really happy with this art piece and it's quality and I can happily recommend it!

source_doc: Received Broken Twice, could be great if not broken. I think this product could be great - AMAZING - even. I was so excited to get it. But the first one I ordered arrived broken as in the first picture above. One of the little screw brackets to hold stuff in place was broken right off.I contacted Amazon and they sent me a replacement immediately. It LITERALLY just arrived today. I was so excited - and the 2nd one is broken in the EXACT same spot, in the same way.I don't know if the newest batch is broken or if I have the worst luck, but I'm going to return this one for my money back and look at alternatives. Byl/a jsem tak nadšený/á, že jsem to dostal/a. Ale ten první, který jsem objednal/a, dorazil rozbitý, jak je na první obrázku výše. Jeden z malých šroubových držáků na upevnění věcí na místě byl odlámaný. Kontaktoval/a jsem Amazon a okamžitě mi poslali náhradu. TA PŘESNĚ dorazila dnes. Nevím, jestli je nejnovější šarže rozbitá nebo jestli mám nejhorší štěstí, ale vrátím to a požádám o vrácení peněz a podívám se na alternativy. source_doc: Choking hazard for some dogs. My Boston terrier loves, loves, loves them. I noticed that many reviewers mentioned that these don't last more than a few seconds when they give them to their dog’s so, I tried to time Phoebe eating them. The first one I gave her, she took about 4 minutes to finish; which I thought was really good but then, the next few she ate quicker at around 2 minutes and it got shorter and shorter from then on. I will say that Phoebe also has those yak hard sticks to chew but now, she really only seems to chew those at night but, anyway, back to this product... One day I gave her one of these sticks as kind of a snack, they are high in calories for a snack but whatever; she must have been really hungry because, I noticed that she was acting like she was having trouble swallowing so, I stuck my fingers down her throat and dislodged almost half of the stick. Phoebe still gets them but now I hold them and she has to take bite size pieces. Phoebe really loves them and I actually do think that they calm an upset stomach so it is worth the grossness of the saliva getting all over my hand; I just wash my hand thoroughly afterwards. :)

source_doc: Not for my sensitive skin. I liked the concept of this dry body brush. I thought the bristles would be much harder but they aren’t. They are softer which I thought would be a positive for my sensitive skin. It’s designed so it’s easy to hold. I initially used it as a dry brush but my skin had a bad reaction so I felt I could benefit by using it in the shower after my skin had moisture from the water. After about 10 minutes in the shower I began to use it & still my skin just didn’t like it. I brushed slowly, softly but despite the soft bristles redness was formed & I had to stop. From my personal experience I’d say this isn’t suited for sensitive skin. I feel it would greatly benefit one who doesn’t have sensitive skin. For the price it’s a nice quality brush. I would suggest, due to the nature of the wetness the bristles would get, that if you do use it in the shower that you put it in a location in your bathroom where it can fully ventilate to prevent mold.

source_doc: Nearly useless. After receiving these, but prior to using them, I left a raving review, but now they are nearly useless. I followed the instructions for washing them, which I did, of course, before planning to use them. I placed the lids in the top rack of my dish washer, and when the cycle finished I TRIED to secure the lids onto the bowls. I was able to snap shut only one or two of the four sides in place. The only bowl that I was able to fully secure the lid onto was the smallest. Granted, I have arthritis in my hands, but never have I had this issue with a set like this from another manufacturer. So, here I am with bowls without the advantage of a proper lid. Again, this is the only set of bowls with snapping lids that has not worked out for me. I absolutely do NOT recommend this product. I left a previous glowing review, but that was prior to washing this set and attempting to secure the lids to the bowls.

source_doc: Nice bag. I love my yoga sandbag weights. I’ve been doing yin flow yoga a few times a week and using the weights has really helped me stretch and I find them very relaxing. This is a very pretty bag- I love the purple color and it feels well made. There is an inner liner then the cover with a zipper. My only criticism is I couldn’t fit 10 lbs no matter how hard I tamped down the rice I used to fill it- I could fit 8.5 lbs of rice. Maybe I should have used another fill material - and I guess the weight is close enough to the 10 lbs it will work- but I do wish I had been able to make it a full 10 lbs

source_doc: One glaring issue for my instance. I really like this. My only issue that I ran into was corrosion on the battery whip side. They do not have any sort of protective heat shrinking where the wire is crimped to the metal connector. I mounted my quick connect to the front diver side of the bumper of my truck this past June and it corroded this winter. I live in Western NY where road salt was certainly a factor. I bought loom to encase the wires and taped it but, never looked at the original wires at the connection point. Luckily, I had enough extra wire that I was able to cut off the corroded wire and I soldered new connections, put dielectric grease on the area where the wires were reconnected and then used heat shrink over the section where the new connection was made. I hope this review helps anyone who buys this. I would buy this again, I would just make sure I used the grease and the heat shrink before I installed it.

source_doc: I like it! I had read that COQ10 is good for your heart, blood pressure and cholesterol so I decided to try it. I found the taste was not unpleasant although the consistency was a little thick. I found that after a couple of days I seemed to feel a little more energetic and I felt less anxiety.  I have never taken a COQ10 supplement in a form such as this, but since I hate to take pills, this works better for me. The only thing I dislike is that this has to be refrigerated after opening which makes it more difficult to remember to take.  The bottle is supposed to be used within 45 days of opening so if I miss a few days, the product will still be good.  I won’t know of course if consuming this supplement will help with my cholesterol levels until the next time it is checked so if there is a marked improvement, I will update this review.  In the meantime, I really like this supplement.

source_doc: Very strong. This thing is so much better than the mighty mule I mean I’ve only had it working for a couple weeks now, but it is so much stronger and quieter than the mighty mule. I have a 14 1/2 foot gate that I made myself out of 2 3/8  thin wall pipe no I don’t know the exact weight of the gate but I’m guessing 250 maybe 300 pounds and this thing swings it like it’s not even there I like the soft close feature. and the electric lock takes a lot of pressure off of the actuator on a windy day. I’ve had two of the mighty mules granted they were the smaller models.3500 I believe is what the model was but I burn two of them up in one year like I said I’ve only had this one going for a bout a month so it’s a little premature I will give a year end review but so far, I’m really liking it. It’s faster than the mighty mule as well. The only thing I don’t like is the cheap ass remote control the damn buttons. Get stuck it’s just cheaply made but other than that I love the gate opener I can’t say much about tech-support because I have not had to use them. It is pretty simple to install and I’ve had no problems with it. I highly recommend it if you have a heavy gate well worth the money.

source_doc: Fantastic bag. So I wish MR made a 'toned down' tacticool version of this due to the nature of my work. I use this as my primary laptop/work bag. I appreciate how "close" everything feels in the pouches. All of the compartments are very accessible and have the appropriate attachment points so I can carabiner/zip tie the zippers if I am in a pickpocket area. I would recommend this bag to anyone who is on the go for work. It flies through TSA security stuff and has ample room for all of the stuff I need on the go. I leverage packing cubes for all of my stuff and carry a Dell 15" laptop and a USBC Dell secondary monitor, as well as an anker 737 battery and all appropriate cables. I typically keep my glasses case/sunglasses in the outside pouch and in the other, I keep gum and keys I don't put in my pocket. The inside zipper keeps pens (in ink proof cube), passport, immunization card, and some cash. This is a very nice system for the price and very durable construction compared to most of the bags in this class.

source_doc: Great for a toddler. I needed a 2 pack so she can have 1 by toilet and 1 by the sink (she being my 3 year old toddler). For reference, I already own a similar stool by IKEA and it's basically the same stool. I do not have an IKEA locally so would have to pay to ship it, since I didn't have anything else I needed from them I chose to just buy this set on Amazon instead this time. It's exactly what I wanted and I liked that I could get white with gray instead of having to get the white with green, which is IKEA's only color option. If you did purhcase this set in the white with green it'd probably be just like the IKEA stools. I would never use this for an adult but I see in the reviews some people are. This is pretty flimsy and really is meant more for like a 20-40 pound toddler not for an adult or anyone over 90 lbs. That's pretty risky, imo.

source_doc: Really Good Quality. I ordered this sink mat because I am having a new farmhouse sink installed and want to make sure it is protected from day one.  I have seen the metal ones but it seemed to me that those could scratch the sink so silicone makes more sense.  It is also easier to remove to clean it and the sink.  This silicone mat is good quality and feels like it will hold up well.  I like the cutout for the drain so I will be able to use the stopped if I want to without having to remove the mat.  I like the ‘teeth’ on the bottom too that allow the water to drain.  They are a sufficient height.  After I got it, I decided to order another because I realized I could put a drying mat under it to use as a dish drain when I hand wash larger pots etc.  It will also be good as a heat mat for larger casserole dishes.  Good quality and the price is good..
hypos: Opravdu dobrá kvalita. Objednal/a jsem si tuto podložku pod dřez, protože mám instalovaný nový venkovský dřez a chci se ujistit, že bude chráněn od prvního dne. Viděl/a jsem kovové varianty, ale připadalo mi, že by mohly dřez poškrábat, takže silikon dává více smyslu. Také se lépe odstraňuje k úklidu podložky i dřezu. Tato silikonová podložka je dobré kvality a vypadá, že bude dobře držet. Líbí se mi výřez pro odtok, takže budu moci použít zátku, pokud budu chtít, aniž bych musel/a podložku odstraňovat. Také se mi líbí "zuby" na spodní straně, které umožňují vodě odtékat. Jsou v dostatečné výšce. source_doc: If you have a UV manicure light, you need these gloves! I am not one to get my nails done frequently. But since my daughter got a UV light and some gel nail polish she's been doing my nails. The one thing I noticed was that I could almost feel the skin in my hands shriveling while under the UV light. Okay really more like sunburn, but all the time I was thinking, "that can't be good!"  It bothered me so much that I bought some cheap fingerless manicure gloves to use when she did nails. When I saw these pop up as available on Vine I grabbed them. I'm really glad I did because they are night and day compared to the other ones. I mean the other ones do the job but these ones look, and feel, and are constructed so much better. This seams on these ones are secure. There's better movement because each finger has an inset sewn into it which creates more flexibility. This seams on the inside are soft and non irritating. The material is a much better quality. Plus, how cute are those adorable little doggies!I am so glad I chose these, I would buy them again and recommend it them wholeheartedly.

source_doc: You Get What You Pay For. EDIT!!! I increased my rating to 4 stars. I think one of the batteries I received is just weaker than the other. I used one of the batteries to screw down some decking today. I drove about 240 screws and the battery was still going. So maybe I got one great battery and one mediocre battery.Here's my original review:The battery life is terrible. I fully charged both of them before use. I put the first one into an 18 volt Dewalt circular saw and cut some pressure treated 2x4's and 2x6's. I made about 12 to 14 cuts before the battery was completely dead. And even at the beginning, when the battery was fully charged, I could tell that the saw was struggling to cut through the wood. With the factory Dewalt battery that's not an issue.I used the other battery in a drill to drive decking screws. It lasted about half as long as I would expect my factory battery to last.Having said that, a 2-pack of Dewalt batteries costs $200, so for $200 I could buy 2 Dewalts or 11 of these batteries. So I guess these are a bargain. But hopefully you have more than 1 charger, because you'll be constantly recharging these.

source_doc: Wow just wow. I bought a Grote 335 style guitar a few years ago and am extremely happy with its quality and performance. Because of its price, I thought it might be a fluke. Last week I decided to buy the LP Grote. This guitar arrived in less than a week. I picked the purple tone. I don’t care that it’s a printed front. It’s stunningly beautiful. I am a guitar tech and luthier but I haven’t done a set up to either Grote’s I own and they sound decent right out of the box. That being said, if you are hitting the road or doing studio work I would recommend doing a pro set up on these guitars. I love the amplified sound of the 335 style Grote I own so I expected the same when I tested the new one. when I plugged in the LP I was blown away at the warmest sound I’ve heard in years. source_doc: Oh so soft and thin enough for what I need. I bought several different types of washcloths because I need something for my dog’s (mastiff with large ears) that I could use to wipe the spaces in his ears when they get dirty.Wow!  These are so very super soft. None of the other ones I bought will work. I washed these and after I used them once I bought 3 more packages. The loop to hang them is also soft (won’t scratch sensitive parts) and is great for hanging them where I need them and then somewhere to dry.Although I love my dog, the new washcloths are for me to use on myself. They feel so luxurious and well made. They are thin enough to use in small delicate places but they feel like such good quality. My regular washcloths are now cleaning rags because once I used these, I don’t want to use anything else.They are thin enough to make a difference when putting them in the cabinet as well. I am going to use them in the RV where space is more limited.If you are searching for soft, thin, or both, you won’t go wrong with these.

source_doc: Unplayable. I really wanted to like this game.  Visually its a very appealing game and the background music is good.  However the controls are way too sensitive and combat is clunky.  These are things I think I could have gotten used to over time.  However what I can't get used to is the horrendously long respawn times after you die.  It consistently takes over a minute for the game to load back up after you die.  I even timed it and the load time was 1m 05s 95 seconds.  This is completely unacceptable.This game was free with Playstation Plus, but I will be deleting it because I can't even enjoy it when most of the time is the stupid loading screen.  Months ago, this game was on sale but for some reason I decided not to get it. Knowing what I know now, I'm glad I didn't waste my money for an unplayable game.Thanks EA for reinforcing a decision I made nearly 15 years ago to never buy games at price, if at all.

source_doc: An honest review. I initially really like these lights. Three come in a set, so I put two in the kitchen and one in the living room closet. I purchased these on January 5th and as of today March the 18th, one light is not working. The particular light I am referencing, seem to need to be charged faster than the other two lights. I thought maybe I had the brightness set too high and I charged it and placed it in the living room closet where it only needed to turn on when the doors open which isn't often. I also made sure for the directions, that I had the right setting. Went to charge it the light was red and when the light was green I tried to turn it on and it did not turn on. Overall, I would purchase these again.

source_doc: It really works. I was a bit wary of devices to help cool my Series X and finally decided upon this one.  I am glad I did.  I know some mentioned the fan gets noisy, but I really do not notice it.  On my Series X, the temperature has definitely dropped and i like the temp readout on the unit.  It does have three automatic fan speeds with corresponding colours, but it has kept the unit cool enough that it always stays on the lowest speed, despite playing nex gen games.  I really am glad I bought it.  It fits perfectly on the top of the console, I have mine laying on its side and it looks like it came from the factory with this installed.  I would recommend it at this point as I have had no issues.

source_doc: I was really hoping for more than it delivered. UPDATE...After a lot of trial and error I have found the Mustang Micro to be much better than my original review. I have used it for recording and the results were very good.I have had a Fender Mustang V for a few years now and I record with it often. When I saw this device I thought it might be another recording option. Technically I can record with it. However, in the very short time that I actually tried it plugged into my 1970's era reissue Strat it sounded very overdriven. In every mode I tried. Don't get me wrong, I do like some nice overdrive. But this is too much. To the point of having a crunchy sound. I tried my 2010 Teloecaster. Same thing. Then my Epiphone Dot. Same. I tried other amp models, effects, EQ, different volume settings. All of them super crunchy. Which knocks this down from a possible recording amp to only a practice device. And even then the tone is highly unsatisfying. So if you are curious and you have an extra $120 lying around then give it a try. Maybe it's just what you are looking for. But if you like good tones coming from your guitar then move along. This is not for you.

source_doc: Well made, good value. This one I am keeping. I have purchased other guitars with semi hollow jazz style design. I have gotten rid of all of them, mostly because of feed back and tunning issues. I did spend a lot of time getting the action to my liking. At first I thought I would not be able to accomplish this but I got it. I was tempted to buy the classic vibe model because I already have one in 50's tele, which I really like. However, I really like the simplicity of design on the affinity model in spite of some of the bad reviews I have seen. Did not really find them on this guitar. The neck set up was a bit of a challenge but I got there. I also own an American made tele and strat. Nothing plays as easy or as well as those. This one poses a good competitor at a really substantially lower cost and it is really pretty, The pups are not the greatest but still really ok and I can refine the tone with my modeling style amp. I truly enjoy playing this guitar.

source_doc: The Strings I Didn’t Know I Couldn’t Live Without. When I first tried these strings I was highly skeptical because they are a fairly heavier gauge than I’ve always used on my stringed instruments.  But when I started playing a friend’s guitar I noticed quickly how incredibly BEND-Y they are!!!  It’s honestly hard to describe how smooth these strings feel.  I ordered some and put them on my favorite Strat, and I loved them so much that they are now on almost every stringed instrument I own!  They last a really long time too because they are pure nickel.  I was ride or die for the vintage nickel fender strings for the longest, but these are BETTER.  I would recommend them to anyone for electric and acoustic stringed instruments.  I like to build and mod guitars for my friends sometimes and I always put these on and even include an extra set because as someone who’s been playing guitar for over 20 years, I want them to experience what I finally “discovered” a couple years ago.  As I mentioned, they last a really long time, but I still subscribe for a new set every month because I like to stock up and I have way too many instruments 🤣

source_doc: These may be overkill for what I ordered them for. I'm a little paranoid.  I recently started making my own soap and the first time I did I got a small granule of lye on my foot and got a teeny, tiny chemical burn.  But now I'm paranoid and every time I make another batch I feel like I just bathed in lye and it is all over me.  So I thought getting some good gloves might put my overactive mind at ease.These definitely do the trick as far as protection.  They o all the way up my arms and make me feel ready to take on nuclear waste. I appreciate the elastic on the top to help keep them in place.  Relatively soft and flexible.  I don't have any issues measuring and dumping lye out of the bottle when wearing them, but they do still interfere with my dexterity so I wouldn't want to try and do anything that requires precision and delicacy in them.But as far as providing the protection they are meant to do, two big (blue) thumbs up!

source_doc: Works well for me. I have bought quite a few Camilla  hair barrettes.  I like the rubber on the clasp and I like the way they look.  Nicely made and hold up well.  I think they're worth the extra cost as you get what you pay for.  I do not have a lot of hair, very fine, medium length.  This clip holds my hair in a ponytail and because it's wider than a hair tie, I think it might make it look like I have more hair.  I think it would be too small or people with thicker hair.  They have plenty of 4" clips that would be better for really thick hair in a ponytail.  Of all the Camilla barrettes I have, none have ever come out of my hair, even with my hair being so fine and thin.  I even have some of the bigger ones and they work fine for me, but this size is ideal for my type of hair in a ponytail.  I would really like to see some models wearing their hair accessories so I could get a better idea of what they look like.

source_doc: Operation money Grab. I needed this cord so badly that money was not an option for me. I didnt even look at my bank account when I bought his cord so I said to myself why not, I needed a rope for mountain climbing and this was probably the most affordable. So I gave it to my wife, by the way is my X wife now, somewhere hiding at the bottoms of some valley but that's not important whats important is this review. We started off on a beautiful mid summers day camping and my wife had a climbing rope but it was her birthday so I surprised her with this state of the art $1000 dollar futuristic rope tested by Nasa. She was hooked! although we didnt have internet so she couldn't look up the information but she trusted me and it looked pretty legit. As we climbed up the mountain I told her to save the special Nasa Strength Rope for the highest peak because that's when we will need it and she agreed. I can not believe she did not hold on correctly so it was user error but the cord is still intact. I will not be returning the Technologically made cord just incase I may need it for my next date. Thank you so much in selling me this incredible gold digger saver.

source_doc: A game changer for hunting. I used to talk smack on hunting accessories like this, but now I am older and wiser and want to take ethical long distance shots more often that free hand. I haven't used this to reach way out and hit targets, but I did use it in a stand to take a fox this year. The shot was about 90 yards with a 17 WSM. Could I have done it free hand? Most likely. Was I more confident in my shot placing with this stick? You're darn right.It makes a little bit of noise when adjusting the height with the thumb button. I plan on doing a light disassembly and lubing up the spring inside. Either way, it barely makes any noise. It may scare a deer that's less that 15 yards out, but they normally don't get a chance to get that close to me, so it doesn't affect my hunt at all.I sit in a chair, I am 6'3" and the stick has plenty of adjustability to meet my needs. I have not tried adjusting it to full length to see if I can use it comfortably standing. When I have used it out walking, I just kneel and adjust the stick with the thumb button accordingly.If you are looking for a solid rest that packs down tight, this should fit your needs.

source_doc: This thing went on so incredibly easy. I never leave reviews but I need EVERYONE to know how easily and beautifully this screen protector went on my Switch OLED. When smart phones and screen protectors first came out, it was like doing surgery to handle them and get them on correctly, and maybe, maybe after three tries you got it right.I am no expert, so when I got my Switch today, the absolute last thing I wanted to do was put the screen protector on. I’ve had the people at the store do them for my phones, because I just worry I’m going to get bubbles or dust under it.But this went on like butter. I used the wet wipe and then the dry and then peeled off the first step layer and I was careful in positioning it (having a case on helped) and then all I did was drop it down gently and it smoothed itself out, and then I pressed gently with my finger to make sure. After peeling the second layer off, it was PERFECT. No bubbles. No dust. I did it on a whim because you can’t let the screen protector see your fear — and I cannot be more amazed at how utterly effortlessly it went on.Plus, you get three for this price and should something ever happen to it, I have backups. I cannot recommend this product enough.

source_doc: Works great for me! As I have gotten older and I suppose less active, I seem to have more trouble going and staying asleep. I did not want to take a prescription sleep aid, so I tried the Nature’s Renewal sleep herbs with melatonin. supplement, and I am glad that I did. I have tried other melatonin supplements but really did not have good results. This product not only helped me get to sleep faster, but I stayed asleep most of the night with the exception of having to get up to go to the bathroom as usual. I also suffer from restless leg syndrome and even that is better when I take this supplement. I believe that it is because of the addition of Tryptophan, passion flower and St john’s wort, among other herbs that has helped with the restless legs. The suggested usage is two capsules and since this bottle has 60 capsules this product will last 30 days if used every day. I think the price of this supplement might be a little high, but with the quality ingredients used in this product and how well it works, I think it’s worth it. I am very impressed with the results I am getting from this sleep aid, and I highly recommend it.

source_doc: Problem Solver! I cannot tell you how many times I have battled with trying to remove stripped screws!  The most recent was when I was trying to remove my bathroom cabinet doors to repaint them.  I spent well over an hour trying to get a damaged screw out and ended up having to repair damage to the actual cabinet as a result.  I have tried most of the methods I looked up on the internet but nothing worked easily.  When I saw this set of screw extractors, I seriously did a happy dance.  I don’t know why I never saw this when looking up ways to remove damaged screws but this is genius!  It will make it so much easier when faced with this irritating problem and I won’t have to come up with new and creative curse words anymore lol.  The set includes six different types/sizes and comes in a plastic latching case.  The tools are good quality, especially at the price!  Must have for the diy-er!

source_doc: Security light. I ordered this since I just moved into a new home and the backyard light it came with provided zero lighting.That said this arrived as described on time and without issue. Conversely, I finally got it installed and it genuinely impressed me.Install was an absolute breeze. I especially like the connector type. Once I plugged everything on, screwed it in place and hit the light switch it exceeded expectations.The difference in lighting is 10x better than the crappy light I had. The options it has for sensitivity and for motion are second to none.I installed it in the evening, sunset had set by 7pm, I finished installed it a bit agter 8pm so it was dark outside.As you can tell by the last picture, I had to adjust the lights to point down more since it really lights up my backyard.What makes it even better is the fact there's an app for it, makes this one of the best lights I've installed, especially at this price point.If I could give this 6 stars I would...Moreover I wouldn't hesitate to recommend it. Excellent product, easy to install, and performs better than expected.In my opinion it's worth it!

source_doc: Nice, but I don't feel like it cleans my teeth as well. I had a really nice electric toothbrush, but it stopped working. I decided to give this one a try. I have super sensitive teeth, so the different vibrations of this one bothered me at first. I guess I've gotten used to it now, though. The bristles are super soft, which I think I like. I don't feel like it cleans my teeth as well as my old one, though. I've had to use this one longer at a time to make up for it, and hope that it doesn't make me end up with cavities. I brush well at least twice a day, floss at least once a day, use a flouride mouthwash every night, and go for my cleanings every 6 months. (I'm also careful with sugar and take vitamins.) Cavities are still a struggle for me, so I don't know if I'll keep using this toothbrush and take the risk. If I didn't have to be so careful with my teeth, I'd be happy with it, though. It works well otherwise and it looks nice and durable. I also love that it comes with 8 replacement heads. Those can get expensive with other brands.

source_doc: It works best for my neck and shoulders. I ordered this bath cushion realizing that the reviews were polar extremes. My tub is pretty uncomfortable so I thought I would give it a shot anyway. I took into consideration the review that said suction cups were necessary, so I put those on first. They were not as difficult to insert as I had anticipated. You just have to use two hands and pull one of the honeycomb openings apart, then using the thumb and finger on one of your hands insert it into the opening. I had no trouble doing it, but my mother with arthritis could never manage it.I first tried this on my lower back and it was comfortable but a little bulky. I know that my issue taking a bath is a scrunched neck so I slid the pillow up on the tub to my upper shoulders and lower neck and that gave me the support that I wanted and needed. While it is still a little more bulky than I I would have preferred, it really helps my neck. I'm pleased and glad I chose it.

source_doc: at 73yrs old, I need to be picky! Just read other reviews and am surprised that some do not like this.  I try many brands of drugstore foundations but hardly ever Almays' which is ironic since I have sensitive, allergic skin!  By chance I tried this one (first I love that it comes in a tube rather than a bottle) (seems more hygenic), and then liked that it has the word "prebiotic" in the name.  I am somewhat on the light side, with cool undertones, pretty descent skin for my age with some wrinkles, no age spots, average pours.  Skin is normal but can tend to be dry if I don't work at it.  I bought the 130 beige because in the pictures it looked like a cooler tone than the 120 color and I am more than happy with this.  It looks natural and very healthy looking and I am picky.  I put it on with my fingers all over my face including my eyelids.  I just love how this looks even out in the bright sunlight.  I would be one to highly suggest mature women like me try this out if you are on the fence, looking for a natural foundation that is hypoallergenic with descent products in it.  I would totally rebuy this a second time.

source_doc: Nice little solution for a problem I didn't know I had. This is a great little portable blender. It works quite well and is just so easy to use. I can just fill it the night before, put it in the fridge and when I am ready turn it on and voila, smoothie. Just great really. I can also take it to work and then turn it on when I am ready for it.It is quite powerful and doesn't take long to make a nice little smoothie at all. I also like that I can take it to any gathering in case they need an extra blender. Really a nice solution to a problem I didn't know I had. it is pretty easy to clean and use. I find myself making smoothies now that I haven't before.

source_doc: Love this grinder and the bag it comes with. I've been getting into whole bean coffee here recently and I wanted something that I could fine-tune better than an electric grinder so I got this.  It came packaged just fine and I didn't see any defects or dings on the grinder.  In the package, you get the grinder, a storage bag, and two cleaning brushes. It is basically 3 main pieces the handle which has a nice wood knob, the grinder which has all the guts, and the collection bin which catches your grounds.  I got a whole bean that I hadn't tried before and loaded it up and got to grinding.  It was really easy to grind although I set it for a bit too fine on my first go-round so unless you are old hat at manual grinding you will probably have to play around with it to find your preferred setting.  Cleaning it was a breeze too, it says not to get it wet so I took it most way apart (I left the grinder guts in) and took my electronic duster, and just blew it out. What I really like about this one compared to the others I have is it comes with a storage bag so I don't have to keep it in a big bulky box.  All in all, I do really like this and its matte black color looks great.

source_doc: Condominium life assurance. I live in a condo and one thing I learned FAST was that pug + beagle + separation anxiety = howling and barking all day.  I've tried the citronella collars, thunder shirts, and standard bark collars but keep on the lookout for something that's user friendly and effective.This was priced right where I look for and seemed to have a nice interface.  I don't use it often but when I do, I know whether or not it's working thanks to doggy cams.  I like that I can disable shock mode - usually the vibration are enough to correct the barking and even the beeping is a good warning that a vibration is next.  I also like that unlike other collars I know when I should charge it before it dies on me.  It's good looking and effective and has a bunch of little features like longer prongs and prong covers.It worked for my dog without hurting him so yes it's been a game changer for me.
hypos: Život v bytovém družstvu. Žiji v bytě a jedna věc, kterou jsem se rychle/a naučil/a, byla, že mops + beagle + úzkost z odloučení = vytí a štěkání celý den. Zkoušel/a jsem citronelové obojky, trička proti bouřím a standardní obojky na štěkání, ale stále hledám něco, co je uživatelsky přívětivé/ý a účinné. Tato věc byla cenově přijatelná tam, kde hledám, a zdála se mít pěkné rozhraní. Nepoužívám to často, ale když to udělám, vím, zda to funguje, díky psím kamerám. Líbí se mi, že mohu vypnout režim šoku - obvykle je vibrace dostatečná/ý na opravu štěkání a dokonce i pípání je dobré varování, že následuje vibrace. Také se mi líbí, že na rozdíl od jiných obojků vím, kdy bych měl/a nabíjet, než mi to vypne. Vypadá to dobře a je to účinné a má spoustu malých funkcí, jako jsou delší hroty a kryty na hroty. Fungovalo to pro mého psa, aniž by mu to ublížilo, takže ano, byl/a to pro mě změna k lepšímu.

source_doc: I use this for my dog and cats. This camera is decent for what I wanted it for. I actually got it so I can monitor my cats and dog, while they hangout, or play, on my fenced in porch. The camera isn't rated to be outdoors, but I have an overhang that keeps the camera dry, and then I just move it inside at night. Since setup is super easy, it's easy for me to move it back and forth as needed.If my animals had it their way, I would be hanging out on the porch with them the entire time, which I don't mind doing, but unfortunately, I have chores to get done. So, this camera gives me the ability to go back into my house and do a little work while they hangout. I can monitor what they are doing, and if they are misbehaving, I can call their names through the two way talk, and it's clear enough that it actually will stop them in their tracks. The picture quality isn't fantastic, but like I said, it's a decent monitoring camera for what I intended it for.

source_doc: Not safe. I wanted to love these, and I saved them for when I got a new car. When I put them in they were fine, until I did the test with the carseat and no matter what I did to tighten down the carseat, they still moved substantially with these protectors underneath them. I could move the carseat more than 2 inches side to side, and I grabbed my kids dad to see if he could tighten them more and it didn't change much. With that movement and my kids car seats, I won't be using these. There are also standards I didn't know about when I first ordered these... any accessory meant to go with or under a carseat (even harness strap covers) must be crash tested and approved. I could find no evidence that these had been crash tested and approved.

source_doc: Do not use two days in a row when starting out. I have fairly sensitive skin, and was careful when reading the directions about applying daily. I tend to get milia under my eyes, my cheeks and chin so I was hoping this would keep it from developing. I used the first day and had no issues so I thought I was safe to use it again the second. Again, I was ok. Third day, I was working out and sweating quite a bit when I felt my face start to burn. It was annoying but nothing alarming. I immediately thought of the retinoid. I took a shower and washed my face. Afterward it was burning so so bad. Even applying my regular moisturizer stung. The next day I realized it had completely destroyed my t zone. The corners of my mouth, under my eyes and nose were so raw and peeling. Even applying light make up hurt so bad. It’s been three days and I am still trying to put as much moisturizer on my face as possible just to get it back to normal. I hate to completely bash a product that may be a god send to someone else. It’s just not for me and I highly advise not using it daily in the beginning even it feels fine.

source_doc: Not really that bright. I got these for my 2002 F350 SuperDuty.  I installed them and was excited as I was replacing my old incandescent bulbs that seemed very dim and yellow.  I read the description and was looking forward to the bright new fog lamps.  I put them in and waited for nighttime to come.  As I was driving I turned them on waiting for the great reveal and I didn't even know they were on.  I actually at first thought that they didn't come on at all.  I actually waited to pull behind a car where I could see the reflection and saw they were indeed on.  Unfortunately it really doesn't make a different.  I'll leave them in for now though they really seem more like driving lights than fog lights to help see the road.  I won't buy these again.

source_doc: it works! I had a rash on my arm that wouldn't go away.  I had tried all the normal creams like Neosporin and Lotrimin.  I saw this California Baby Cream, and loved the ingredients, so I thought I might as well try it. It smells very nice, natural, and mild.  I was amazed that it made a huge improvement the first day. And was almost gone after a few days.I also tried it on my granddaughters diaper rash.  It stung at first so I wiped it off, but tried it again the next diaper change, and she didn't seem to notice it at all.  It helped but I wasn't with her the next day to keep using it, so I can't say if it would have cured the diaper rash.I have used it on various little bumps and things since then, and it makes everything feel better. I love it. I want to keep it around.

source_doc: First Canister Vac - So Pleased. I have gone through three stick vacuums in the past 5 or 6 years. I have had Dyson, Bissel, and Shark. I have three pets - 2 dogs and a long hair cat. My entire house is ceramic tile. The stick vacuums would clog horribly with pet hair. I had to take them apart about every week to deep clean just to get a lackluster clean on the floors. This vacuum, whoa! I have vacuumed my entire house, furniture, door and window frames. The attachments are fantastic, and the vacuum is just stellar so far. One caveat for which I didn't deduct a star, if you have never used a cannister vac like myself just understand that it takes a minute to adjust how you vacuum. I felt like everything was awkward and too big the first two or three times I used it. Like I said, first canister vac. After that, I have had zero problems. And I really do love it.

source_doc: Don't fall for the same bait and switch I did. I had decided that I was going to purchase the carpet One, non-Pro version. When I pulled up the page, I was looking at prices and the carpet One pro had a $100 off coupon available. This made the price $499 which was the same price as the non-Pro version at the time, so it seemed like a no-brainer to me. A couple of days after receiving it, I went back on Amazon to see what current prices were and I was  let down. The non-Pro version is now selling for $349. They had obviously raised the price to get people to switch just like I did, probably because they needed to unload some. I contacted them about being upset about being duped, and their solution was to offer me a free bottle of cleaning solution. I felt that was rather insulting. The carpet One pro is definitely not worth the extra money spent. The Wi-Fi function is pointless. While the LED screen is fancy, it doesn't do much more than what the non-Pro version does. I do feel like the sensor showing how dirty the area is, or the sensor showing how damp the area is, are both gimmicks. I have not noticed any consistency with either of those functions. I do feel like it is a good carpet cleaner, but definitely not for more than $349.

source_doc: This comes in real handy even if you think it won't. These oil 'suckers' have been around for a while but I never thought I would use one. Let me tell you I was wrong. I wanted to do something simple as a test so I changed the oil in one of my mowers. I removed the dipstick and inserted the larger tube and pumped a few times (maybe 5-6) and the oil began flowing out.  I pumped a few more times and within 3-5 minutes I had removed all the oil from the crankcase. There was no mess. The spherical accumulator showed the exact amount I removed and I replaced that amount into my mower. Very easy deal.I will note that many new zero turn mowers are sold with 'lifetime' filled transaxles and I had been putting off purchasing one because of this. Now that I have this extractor pump I know I can change the fluid and prolong the life of the transmission. Fluid changes can be very cumbersome for a unit that was never meant to have the fluid changed but this extractor will make it easy.I wish there was storage for the tubes and the extra caps that come with the unit. Also, you need to be careful to keep the rubber isolator straight (unbent) between the tube and the tank or you may lose vacuum while pumping.Overall, this is a good deal on a very useful tool.

source_doc: Awesome AirPods Max stand. I LOVE my Airpod Max headphones! I already had what I had hoped was the perfect AirPods Max stand, purchase as a kickstarter and I waited for 9 month to get it... it was minimal and came with a mag charger set-up that automatically start charging when you set the AirPods into it... I LOVE it, and it has one fatal flaw: It does not sleep the AirPods. I am always having the AirPods pick up calls when I answer the phone. I spent twice what this cost for that and I had to stop using it for that reason.That said, I received this stand totally broken. Amazon seems to have sent me a returned item and once I contacted the seller they politely, quickly and efficiently sent a new one. The second stand is flawless and works perfectly. it is attractive and sleeps the AirPods immediately when set into it. The padding is perfect to not mar the beautiful finish on my AirPods. I do wish there was a more perfect charging solution, but I am very happy with this and recommend it wholeheartedly. It feels premium for premium headphones.

source_doc: Maybe mine is defective... When this bottle warmer arrived I was so excited to try it.  After unpacking I noticed that ours is missing the lid for the formula cup---we don't use formula so I thought that is not a big deal.  I cleaned all the pieces and charged it overnight for use the following day.  The next day, I took a bottle out of the fridge, found the correct adapter, screwed it on tightly, and set it to heat the bottle to 98 degrees Fahrenheit.  After about seven minutes, the milk was ready.  I turned the warmer so the bottle was upright with everything attached and it leaked milk all over my hand.  After removing the bottle from the warmer, I turned the warmer on its side which is supposed to stop the heating function, but I noticed that the little red light that indicates the device is heating came on.  For a bottle warmer that costs $79.99 USD, this should not leak, and the automatic turning off of the heating element should work as advertised, but the one I received did not.  It is possible that I simply received a dud, but for the price I am not impressed.

source_doc: TIPS TO EASY! I was going to buy a Rubbermaid 2 step, step stool. As I was looking for it I came across this and because it folded I bought it. The 1st day using it, it tipped as I was getting in my raised bed. I weigh 248 and it says holds 300lbs but every time I left my right foot off it tips as I’m working to get my left leg up. I needed this because I had left knee replacement. I’ve been fighting to keep it but last night I finally fell off as it finally tipped all the way over and my son said that’s it you have to send back. He went to Lowe’s and got me the Rubbermaid one and it’s definitely sturdy. I hate to send this one back.

source_doc: Nice!! This is my first experience with a pet water fountain. At first I was unsure where the cord went because it didn't really show it with part in the water. But I figured it out. It's very sleek and looks perfect where I have if. Luckily there was an outlet where the animals eat anyhow. It's quiet and the little fountain goes along keeping the water fresh. I haven't caught our cats drinking it but my dog really drank! I did have to find a spare bathroom rug and I put the cat food bowl, dog food, and the fountain on it. I found my dog dripped water more than usually drinking from this fountain. One more thing, I used half cold water from our fridge dispenser and half from the faucet. I was very surprised that, about 5 hours later, the water still seemed pretty chilled, which is nice. It isn't stainless steel or anything so I am not sure how it maintained its temp but I am glad.I looked at several water fountains and landed on this especially because it had a viewing area to see the level of the water. Again, I am very impressed with this little machine!

source_doc: No manual or instructions. So far completely unsatisfied. I bought the renewed headset and didn't get a manual or instructions.i dont use headphones very often, i dont know what any of the buttons do, theyre not marked. At this point I can't tell you if it works or not. I tried google and all the instructions are not for my headset or for what im trying to do. Ive seriously wasted about an hour and have gotten nowhere. Halo just put out a new update, so i want to be playing right now, not doing this. I have xbox series X. Instructions i find are for Playstation, or bluetooth with android. I found instructions for Razer Kaira Pro black and green, but i have halo edition, and the very first diagram, is not the layout of what i have. So instead of playing right now, im doing searches on google, bing, and YouTube, writing this review, then im going to to play with the wired set i already have and put these back in the box. I don't even know if i have everything that is supposed to come with it or not. Other than the manual, i know i dont have that. Ruined my whole day. Feel like just going to kohls and sending tgem back. As far as im concerned theyre incomplete.

source_doc: Really considering this: I don’t usually write a review when I havent bought something, and I will up/down grade when I do 🤪.  I have been looking for 24+ hours for something that I can transport my 4 legged kids, they are both under 20 #, but tend to get into a battle with each other when they see ANYTHING!  I looked at single dog pack packs, which means one will need to walk, then trying to find a twin pet stroller, but it seems the weights don’t work OR they didn’t seem very good quality . So I have found this ! ! !  I know I will need to make some modifications to keep them inside, like putting an additional screening/net over the top to secure the “canopy” and they not get out;  I’ll also need to put some kind of divider between them.  Apparently per one of the video reviews I think it was the Pivot vs ? Another brand, it has a “panel” that will close off the foot well so that can make the “floor” a full solid piece.  I won’t need it for a while, but it’s sitting in my shopping cart !
hypos: Skutečně o tom přemýšlím: Obvykle nenapisuji recenzi, když jsem něco nekoupil/a, a upravím/hodnotím to, když to udělám 🤪. Hledal/a jsem více než 24 hodin něco, co mohu přepravovat své čtyřnohé děti, obě váží méně než 20 kg, ale mají tendenci se mezi sebou poprat, když vidí COKOLI! Díval/a jsem se na batohy pro jednolité psy, což znamená, že jeden bude muset chodit, pak jsem se snažil/a najít dvojitý kočárek pro domácí mazlíčky, ale zdá se, že váhy nefungují NEBO se nezdály příliš kvalitní. Takže jsem našel/a toto! Vím, že budu muset provést nějaké úpravy, abych je udržel/a uvnitř, jako přidání dalšího plátna/síťoviny nahoře k zabezpečení „střechy“, aby nevyšli ven; také budu muset dát nějaký druh dělítka mezi ně. Zjevně podle jednoho z video recenzí, myslím, že to bylo Pivot vs? Jiná značka, má “panel”, který uzavře prostor pro nohy, takže to může vytvořit “podlahu” jako plný kus. Nepotřebuju to nějakou dobu, ale už to je v mém nákupním košíku!

source_doc: Love THIS PRODUCT!!! :) I love this new shampoo and conditioner !!I normally use bed head shampoo and conditioner and periodically I have used Ola Plex. I started using BedHead during the pandemic, because I had tried all other shampoos and conditioners, at a value price, and found them not to be as great as bed head ..however, I stumbled across this shampoo and conditioner and I absolutely love it. I love the smell ..I love that I don’t have knots in my hair.. I  have long thick hair, I also use this on my 6 year old and 8 year old girls and they love it too.. my 6 year old has natural curly hair, so it’s super important to use a quality shampoo and conditioner.. I love That it lathers nicely and I love that when I have my hair in a bun and I take the bun out  it smells so wonderful a little bit like oatmeal raisin cookies.. or soft brown sugar sent.. I would definitely recommend this product if you were looking for something that has quality results at a value price ..like I said, it’s even better than bed head  shampoo and conditioner :)

source_doc: Absolutely brilliant device. I am an instant fan of this adorable egg cooker. I found out about it only a few days ago and I am so happy I got this.To start, my boyfriend suffers from a highly sensitive egg allergy, to the point where if he's in the kitchen while someone is frying eggs he will feel unwell from the fumes. As a result, I gave up cooking eggs for myself for over 5 years.This device is a blessing because I can finally eat eggs again without worrying about bothering my boyfriend. I might not ever make fried eggs again but being able to enjoy them boiled, poached, or as a tiny omelette is more than enough for me.The domed lid keeps the "fumes" contained pretty well until I have to open it, but since all the cooking is steam powered it's really not bad. This morning I attempted soft boiled eggs and as you can see I think they turned out wonderfully. My boyfriend didn't notice any discomfort in the kitchen either.So so happy this is in my life. It's very easy to clean and I love that you can set it and forget it, since it plays a little tune when it's ready.
hypos: Absolutně skvělé zařízení. Jsem ráda, že jsem se okamžitě stala fanouškem tohoto roztomilého vařiče vajec. Zjistila/jsem o něm teprve před několika dny a jsem tak šťastná, že jsem ho dostala. Na začátek, můj přítel trpí vysoce citlivou alergií na vejce, až k tomu bodu, že pokud je v kuchyni, zatímco někdo smaží vejce, bude se cítit špatně od výparů. V důsledku toho jsem se více než 5 let vzdala vaření vajec pro sebe. Toto zařízení je požehnáním, protože si konečně mohu znovu vychutnat vejce, aniž bych se bála, že obtěžuju svého přítele. Možná už nikdy neudělám smažená vejce, ale mít možnost užívat si je vařená, pošírovaná nebo jako malé omeletky je pro mě více než dost. Zakulacené víko dobře udržuje "výpary" uvnitř, dokud ho nemusím otevřít, ale protože celé vaření je na páru, není to opravdu špatné. source_doc: Best keyboard I have ever had! I have a laptop but I never use the laptop keyboard as it is not comfortable to me. I love this keyboard and I have had many in the past. The palm rest is perfect (as I usually have my keyboard on my lap) and I was thrilled with the weight of the keyboard. It is very sturdy. The fact that there is no cord (to charge) and has a battery along with bluetooth makes it just that much better. The touch on the keyboard is light and works perfectly for me. I used to have the Logitech 800 with backlit keys but I have to say I don't miss it at all! I cannot say enough about how great this keyboard is. I have a second laptop coming and believe that I will be able to link this keyboard to both laptops which will be so much easier! Everyday that I use my new keyboard I fall more in love with it!

source_doc: This stuff is amazing. So, I buy the 8 oz concentrate. I like that I can vary the amount that I use. This stuff is magic. I have two puppies that like to step in poop and then run around the house leaving poo prints everywhere. Also, the mat I keep by the balcony doors can obviously get a bit dirty. If I can’t see something, I use a black light. It’s crazy how you watch spots instantly disappear under the light. I let it sit for a bit and then blot. I also use it for the balcony pee pee pad right after they go. Literally zero foul smells. Also, the hand towels I use to soak everything up used to smell so gross in the wash as I was waiting to fill up the machine. Now that I use this instead of other cleaners, the wash smells nice and I don’t get grossed out walking by it lol. I have used it on carpet, different fabrics, my furniture, and toys. It has done a wonderful job on everything. It’s expensive, I will say that. But I’ll be a lifetime user of this stuff. Oh, and the smell is amazing! I love how authenticity orangey it smells :)
hypos: Tyto věci jsou úžasné. Takže kupuji 8 oz koncentrát. Líbí se mi, že si mohu měnit množství, které používám. Tyto věci jsou magie. Mám dvě štěňata, která ráda šlápnou do hovínka a pak běhají po domě a zanechávají trusové stopy všude. Také, rohož, kterou mám u dveří na balkon, se samozřejmě může trochu zašpinit. Pokud něco nevidím, používám černé světlo. Je šílené, jak rychle mizí skvrny pod světlem. Nechávám to chvíli působit a pak to nasávám. Také to používám na podložku na balkon na čůrání hned po tom, co jdou. Doslova žádný odporný zápach. source_doc: Nice. I just got into doing my own press on nail designs. I got this one so I can do multiple nails on my nail painting stands. I love the size, the preset times, and being light weight. I can fit both my hands and still have room. Enough room to not make a mistake and touch the inside. I haven’t a problem curing either. I would say (I probably need to read the instructions) I don’t like once I put my hand in the light comes on. I get that it’s convenient for nail techs, but I’d rather it come on after I hit the time. The whole reason I wanted to do this was to keep my hands from under UV lights. Other then that, great product.
