source_doc: Perfect extension for my camper sink! I could not believe it when I found this faucet extender.  It is the perfect size and design for what I wanted it for.  My wife and I are avid campers.  We have a small, old popup camper and have the “kitchen” outside.  We have one of those folding sink tables and use a drop in faucet with it.  The problem is that my existing faucet, while being tall, it does not extend far over the sink area and washing things is a hassle.  This extension is exactly what I wanted.  It goes out just far enough, but also allows the multiple angles of adjustment.  Wow, if I made it myself it would not be this good.5 stars and thank you!Note: I have been an Amazon customer for almost 20 years. I write all of my reviews to reflect my personal observations and opinions on a product. It matters not if I have purchased the item myself or if it was provided to me for review. My goal is to provide other potential customers as much real-world knowledge as possible to make an informed decision. In most cases I will return to my review in 6 months or less to see if I should alter my original observations. In no case will the cost of a product influence my opinions at all. In addition, I will try to include multiple images and or videos on each product, if practical.

source_doc: Bummed. While initially I loved it, there were some things I didn’t like.The cord linked up often.The temperature when changing it sometimes would glitch back and forth and I would never know truly what temperature it was on.I purchased this June 25, 2021. This morning, January 12, 2023, this straightener officially died on me. I was straightening my hair before work when I noticed it was no longer very hot. I checked it and the light was off. I unplugged and tried turning it on and nothing. I moved to a different outlet, unplugged and tried again but nothing.I left it plugged in and set it on the counter and the light turned on. I picked it up and the movement caused it to shut back off again. I threw it away.$70 and I couldn’t even get a full year and a half out of it.

source_doc: Surprised. I've often worried about my Shady being warm enough, especially this winter where it's been so cold. He mainly sleeps with me but he still feels cool to me. source_doc: Great aftermarket upgrade for you Sony Pulse headset. I decided to try these replacement earpads because I often found the factory pads getting too warm on my head, and they weren't exactly the most comfortable.  These new pads are noticeably cooler and are a decent improvement in comfort as well.  I really like them!I found the process of replacing the earpads to be a pain.  Taking the earpads off is simple, but for whatever reason I couldn't get two of the clips to snap into place, so there was a gap, which I knew wasn't right.  I didn't want to break anything either, as I thought I was pressing too hard already.  After failing to snap them in place I found the factory ones didn't want to go back on either.  So then I knew it wasn't the fault of these earpads, but the design of the headset.  Turns out you have to use more force than you are comfortable with to snap two of the clips of the earpads onto the headset.All turned out well, but man I really thought I was going to snap some plastic while installing the earpads.  Again, not the fault of these pads.  I love these and would recommend them to anyone.

source_doc: My cats love this bed! I just ordered 2 more! The bed arrived in great condition and was easy to fluff up. My cat immediately left her old bed and climbed into this one. I waited to write this review until I washed the bed, and I am glad I did. It came out great. I washed in in cold water and dried it on a medium heat. When I pulled it out of the drier it had fluffed up even more than when I first opened the bag on delivery. And you really can't beat the price. I just ordered one more in the 20 inch size so the cats don't have to share, and one in the 24 inch sized for my dogs - 2 chihuahuas that snuggle together. My larger chihuahua is a super chewer and is notorious for destroying beds, so I am always on the lookout for inexpensive beds. Hopefully this one will be so comfy that it will survive for a while ;). The photo is when she left her favorite older bed for this new one. Overall I am very pleased with this cat bed!

source_doc: I wish I had known about Keychron before I bought my Ducky One 3 Daybreak. I bought my Ducky one 3 daybreak back in January of 2022 when I started to get really interested in keyboards. I wanted something with hot swappable switches and a variety of keycap options. After using that for about year the keys started to double type. I did everything from updating the firmware on the KB to replacing every individual switch after cleaning it out with compressed air. Unfortunately I concluded that it was a PCB (printed circuit board) issue, and none of it ever worked and so it's been sitting on my shelf since October.The Keychron Q6 is a breath of fresh air. I was hesitant to spend over $150 for a KB again after my previous experience but wow am I glad I did. Almost immediately you can feel the quality in this absolute unit of a KB. It is heavy, I cannot emphasis enough with how heavy this KB is. The sound is rich and comforting using their lubed reds. I thought I'd miss an illuminating RGB experience but I've gotten to the point to where this subtle south-facing RGB is perfect for my needs. The customization is endless using the VIA software that it recommends.I will absolutely 100% recommend this if you want something built on a proper platform with room to grow in whatever direction you so desire.

source_doc: Not soft, smelt like burnt plastic, lots of fuzz after the first wash. Despite others reviews, my set came completely the opposite (in a bad way). I got the gray set, and was super excited to use some new, soft towels. That didn't happen.First off, after taking them from the box, removing the bag, they stunk. Like burnt plastic stink.. I HAD TO wash them, because no way was I about to use that on my clean body.Secondly, after washing (cold, light detergent, low spin), and I threw them in the dryer (low heat, light tumble, fabric sheet)... there was so much lint. I am not certain that is normal, but it shed worse than my husky in the middle of July. They aren't losing any stitching, tassels, but it must have been there - somewhere. I know the lint I saw in the catcher was from it because I clean it before each dryer use.Thirdly, they are thin. This might be a good thing in terms of drying times (after bath/shower and leaving on a rack).. but we're talking see-through thin.So overall I am not happy, and I would not recommend INK+IVY Nova 100% Cotton Terry Bath Towel Set. The other reviewers like it, so it is possible I just got a defect. Hopefully so.

source_doc: Great Dry Bag! I like this bag because it has a clear window so I can kinda tell where things are at. I purchase towards the end of the season so I only have used it a few times I can not really comment on the durability. It appears to be constructed well  however there are seams throughout the bag its not 1 peace nor do I think it would be possible to make it that way. Like anything with seams its more apt to leak in wet conditions although the few time I had it out kayaking on the water and exposed it to water everything i packed in it stayed dry. I can fit a beach size towel some sweats and sweat shirt a t-shirt socks etc. my DSLR with a lens an additional lens snacks etc its pretty roomy and it all stayed dry rolling around in the bottom of the boat. I may have had a few drops of water on the top layer where it was folded twice and not 3 times but it was stuffed and I was experimenting how much i could actually carry with me. I say its a good quality for the price and would recommend to anyone looking for this size however I can not comment on durability as I've only used a few times at the end of the season.

source_doc: So far, So good  a tip. I don't know about anyone else, but always hated those old mercury thermometers.And I knew if I was going to get a digital one, I wanted one you didn't have to touch skin.This one seems to give a good and LIGHTNING fast reading.Also comes with batteries, but I don't know how good they are, so will keep some to change out.And I also like you can read temp in a dark room!TIPS:  Let it get to room temp before using.  Mine had been in my cold mailbox awhile, but whether in cold or heat, just try to give it time to really adjust to room temp.  I was in no hurry, I waited an hour, but probably didn't need to wait that long.ALSO LOOK at example of WHERE to place it, not too close or too far from forehead and I place above the center of my eyebrows.BOTTOMLINE:  GLAD I got it.  In these times, one NEEDS a thermometer and I am pleased with this one.  Will UPDATE if anything changes.  Oh, and for older peeps, which I am one, our temps can be below 98.6.  NORMAL temps can range for different people, different ages.  I'm concerned more with how HIGH my goes.

source_doc: American AF. I have a really extensive, high quality knife collection and this particular knife I believe would be the one knife I would take if I could only have one. I have knives that cost much more, made of "better steel", superior finish etc, but this is the one. On mine I used a manual mill and a 3/8 endmill (better than filing imo) to take off just enough to give it a sharp 90 deg spine. Not necessary but that's what I did and that is the only mod that I wanted to do. May get a leather dangler sheath for when I want it like on my rat7, but I love this sheath. It's kinda tacticool, but rides high for my liking. SOLID locking in the sheath though. Surprisingly easy to unsheath with a little thumb push. This thing just works well, feels intuitive and doesn't leave you wanting. It's high enough quality that it always looks the part if ya know what I mean. A no brainier. As a (I hate "as a" comments) American, I believe we should be issued on of these at birth.

source_doc: Medical Esthetician’s Two Thumbs Up! I am a retired medical aesthetician with a license for 20 years! Believe me I am a skin care product junkie like none other than I do have to say this mask is a game changer! It might be a teensie  bit reactive to extremely sensitive skin but I believe some of the reviews here are from people who use skin care cleansers with ammonia, Laureth  sulfate which is extremely drying so when a product that is nourishing and cold is applied to the skin it can sting! I recommend a 5.5 pH balanced cleansing bar such as the one by 100 senses  or cleanser perhaps from JLo’s line about which I can’t say much I love you, because I haven’t used her cleansers! Regardless, hyper sensitive skin that is sensitized will always sting until rebalanced no matter what you use on it.Regardless, I have been using this mask consistently  since October 2022  and it’s now March 2023 and I will say consistency is truly key and will pay off! Unlike what the instructions on the mask say I rinse the serum off after doing a facial massage and apply my own serum, but I there’s an option to leave it on all night!  If you have a normal skin that is aging a highly recommend this mask, it truly is a game changer!

source_doc: Love this!! I've been wanting something to keep my exercise equipment organized but never thought to look for anything.  I don't like shopping (even online although it's a little better than going to the store) so I just don't think of it.  But finally I had enough of the mess and nothing in the same place and started looking around at reviews etc.  I saw a few videos of this being put together and everyone seemed to be pretty happy with it so I gave it a try.  I love it! It holds all my stuff plus a couple of my husbands torture rollers.  I have to do a little rearranging for my new yoga blocks but they will fit as well.  It also rolls on the carpet pretty easy.  I only had one hand available and I was able to move it.  I would buy another if I needed to.

source_doc: Had a horrific allergic reaction - swollen eyes, teary… Is this even FDA approved?? I had a terrible allergic reaction to this product - and I even wore gloves the whole time I was handling it! My eyes were so swollen I debated going to the ER but I decided to take some Benadryl and wait it out (after I tossed the cleaning gel in the trash!) I was feeling better the next morning, thankfully, but the ordeal made me realize that I have no idea what is in this stuff or if any of it is toxic. It reminded me of the slime my daughter used to make in elementary school (if not identical.) Some of those recipes use Borax, which is indeed toxic, so perhaps that is what I reacted to… It did a great job cleaning some used camera gear I was prepping to trade in though, I have to say… Next time though, I will look up a recipe for nontoxic slime instead.

source_doc: Everyone said I was dumb for getting this. Literally everyone I spoke to who mentioned this type of product wrote it off and said it was unnecessary and I was dumb for wanting it. They said I’d be too busy cleaning my newborn I would just apply creams with my finger and wouldn’t care.I do care. I care a lot lol. Personally i’m the type of person who eats chicken wings with gloves and washes my hands 20 times when cooking. I hate having random textures or residues on my hands. I made it maybe 3 days with my newborn before I ordered this because I was going insane feeling butt cream residue.I am so relieved I bought this. We switched from our expensive butt cream to cheap petroleum jelly, which works for our baby so much better lol. This spatula is godsend. I just swipe a glop of jelly onto it before the change and then smear it on my baby’s bottom like icing on a cake. The flat sides are great because you can get jelly right in the crack without hassle. You can also tackle their legs and arms without worry of getting them messy with jelly. It is easy to clean with a baby wipe after as well

source_doc: This product is the best thing I’ve ever purchased! Peace of mind knowing my baby is monitored!! I recommend this product or any and everyone who has a baby!!! This thing is super accurate and I read all the instructions to know that you can’t put the bed under vents or ceiling fans because it can cause false alarms etc but if we forget to turn it off when getting him out of the crib this thing will go off and I LOVE how loud it is!!!! I sleep great knowing my baby is still breathing when I wake up. I give this 10 stars ⭐️ if I could!! The owlet monitor is a huge waste of money!!! Their false advertising should get their product removed in my opinion but this thing, this is the best thing I’ve ever purchased and I highly recommend it to others!! Our baby was in the nicu for 4 weeks and I was terrified to bring him home because i was confused about this monitor at first but when the owlet monitor didn’t work I was upset and decided to try this out anyways and I’m so thankful I did!!! I can’t say how much battery life it has because it’s only been 4 weeks but I will say I’ll update if I remember in 6 months!!! This one is so easy to install as well 🥰

source_doc: I like it. I’ve used myrrh essential oil in the past, when I made homemade natural skincare. But I’ve never before used it as something to ingest. I tried one of these capsules for the first time about a week ago. I’ve been in rather poor health, and I guess I hoped to discover a natural remedy. The first day I tried these, I took one and stayed attuned to my body to see if I felt different. After a bit, I did feel a subtle sense of relaxation and also some pain relief. A few hours later, I felt, ever so slightly, a sort of blood sugar type of jitteriness and irritation. I waited a day and tried it again, same way: one capsule. This time, I didn’t get any kind of jitteriness or irritation, as if I drank too much coffee. But I did feel mild, gentle pain relief….or, I should say, I felt as though “something” took the edge off of the pain I’ve been experiencing. Since then, I have been taking 1-2 capsules per day. source_doc: disappointed! I just gotten an 8-month-old English Cream Golden retriever and she was not responding to the training that my trainer is help me with, so we talked about a shock collar. I recommend if you are thinking about purchasing a shock collar don't pick a cheap one, because they will only last 6 months dispending on brand.

source_doc: Worried that it's starting to fail already. I purchased this one after our long lasting heater finally gave out.  At first I was thrilled to have it.  We share it among out front desk staff depending on whose working.  But after just a short while I am wondering if it is starting to fail.  It seemed to be much more worm on the lower setting and it seemed to blow a bit harder than it does not.  I even tried the higher setting. which we don't use a lot, and it also seems to not blow as much or get as hot as it did.For a mild chill like today, it is working, but I am having to have it much closer to me than I did in the past.I am certain going to start looking up the warranty information.Would I recommend?  Considering how worried I am at this point... I don't think I would.  I just hope maybe I am wrong, but I don't think so.

source_doc: Sounds Great in the Mix. First, please know that I'm not a great drummer- basic beats, keep it simple, minimal kit, that sort of thing. But I've been singing, guitaring, and songwriting in bands for 25 years, and I'm also a studio engineer, so I know what I like when it comes to how cymbals sound. I recently bought this Wuhan Crash Ride to round out my own small kit for jamming with my buddies, and I didn't really think it was going to be anything special for the money... to me it seemed like buying a Squire rather than a Fender. I do have to say, though, after hearing this thing in a pretty decent live recording of a show we played the other night, I really dig it. It sits in the mix just right, lots of dark wash but not so much sustain that it takes over past where it should fade out. I have a more traditional ride (Zildjian vintage blah blah) that I like, so the Wuhan functions as a crash... but I do find myself riding it a bit, especially on louder songs where I want it to really cut. I love it when the affordable option turns out to be really fun and sounds great.

Nedávno jsem si koupil/a tenhle Wuhan Crash Ride, abych doplnil/a svůj malý set na jamování s kamarády, a opravdu jsem si nemyslel/a, že to bude za ty peníze něco zvláštního... přišlo mi to jako koupě Squire místo Fendera. Miluji, když se cenově dostupná možnost ukáže jako opravdu zábavná a zní skvěle.

source_doc: I LOVE This Pan. This pan is one of the most remarkable pans I have ever used in my life.  First, let's talk heat distribution, which is often a factor in cooking and also, often a problem with a lot of pans.  Whatever process they have for making this pan, they have figured out the best and truly, I need an entire set of them. I have actually tried- it just won't do it.  I love that feature and it doesn't seem to matter which burner I put it on, the pan cooks evenly through it's entire surface.  The handle is not only a "stay cool" handle, it's comfortable to hold and the overall pan is just extremely well-balanced.  It's very easy to clean and this is one of, if not THE go-to pan I use for most things I am cooking unless I need a bigger pan.  Although, this pan is quite big.  This would make a good pan for any gift, and they would LOVE you for it.  I intend to buy several more in different sizes and I feel like this company has really figured it out, through and through.  I highly recommend this and you can thank me later!  I hope you find this review helpful!!

source_doc: Awesome 8 inch stainless steel fry pan. I have been looking for a well built 8 inch stainless steel fry pan. I did not want something heavy and it had to have a sturdy handle. I came across a company named Babish that has everything from pots & pans to knives & cooking utensils. I noticed they had a 8 inch tri-ply stainless steel frying pan. When reading all the information about the pan, I decided to give it a try. Upon receiving my pan I could not get over how light it was which I loved. The handle fit so well in my hand. I knew right then I had made the right choice. I also liked the fact it was dishwasher safe, but they recommended hand washing which was fine with me. I read the information that came with the pan on how to clean your pan before you use it for the first time. Upon cleaning the pan I decided to give it a try. I fixed one of the best veggie omelette I have ever made. The pan cooks so evenly-no hot spots. I let the pan cool before I washed it. Clean up was a breeze. I am so happy with my pan, I am planning on ordering more items. I would HIGHLY recommend this pan. It exceeded my expectations.

source_doc: My GPRO TKL Replacement. I hate to admit this but I'm a Logitech fan, and all of my peripherals, until now, are Logitech hence why I have a GPRO TKL and a G604... Both of which have problems after 2 years.. Anyways, goodbye Logitech, and here I come Keychron. I originally bought the K3 v2 since I wanted a little bit more space on my desk and improve the ergonomics. Summary is it didn't work out. I kept hitting the LED and Page Up keys so I got these instead. For the price, this keyboard has A LOT to offer especially since I outgrew the RGB trend. I also don't care for the software or custom macros. For the past 2+ years I've owned my GPRO and G604, I never touched custom macros and key binds.As a Logitech fan, it hurts me to say that the quality of this keyboard is probably better than their G lineup. Only time will tell if this will hold true for me, but it probably doesn't matter because I can just replace the switch and keycaps when this dies, unlike the GPRO TKL (you can desolder it...).

source_doc: Quality seemed fine, but a major, unique screw was missing . . . . . . as it was "two-ended" with a smoothe surface in between that was required to hold the basket between two of the poles. Because China was the likely place I would've had to wait to receive it from, a return was suggested. I bought a larger one from a different company and all the hardware was there. I will say about the one I returned that you have to place four of the poles inside the cubby-hole portion, and it was impossible to see and get the screws lined up to screw into the poles inside, especially at the back area, as I kept thinking I'd gotten it, only to discover that I had not. I became frustrated after trying too many times in two different intervals, but I finally succeeded, only to realize that my efforts were futile due to that unique screw missing. The one I returned it for had the same requirement, but I had no problems with it, either due to a better design or due to the cubby-hole being differently shaped. Anyway, I suggest you read more reviews besides mine before deciding whether YOU want to give it a go.

source_doc: Looks nice, seems to blunt sounds. I used these in my office to reduce sounds from coming out and disturbing others in my house while I am working or just watching videos.  For that purpose it seems to work well, but I think I will need to get a few packages to make a nice design or add to the sound dampening effect since it only comes in a 12 pack.The panels themselves are pretty solid and feel dense as advertised.  I made a nice backdrop pattern behind my monitor, but eventually, I think I will buy a few more packs and add panels all over to match my current design and make my office a bit more visually exciting with the added benefit of more sound dampening.I do not do much recording so I can't speak to any increased audio quality on recordings of yet, but I can't imagine it not helping since it should cut down on echoes and dilute random sounds.7/10 I would recommend it.  I hope this review is helpful.

source_doc: Very lovely fragrance- Jamilla. I am a bit of a tomboy but I love my perfumes and I love getting compliments on my perfumes. I have a ton but I will be wearing this a lot. It is a floral sweet smell  with just a touch of sensual news to it. The floral is not over powering or, believe me, I wouldn’t like it. The gentle blend of citrus and sweet is just perfect. I couldn’t stop putting my wrist to my nose,,,It literally made me feel comforted, to smell this fragrance. My husband wanted me to put some on his pillow, so he could smell it as he went to sleep. It’s not watery, like standard perfumes, it is an oil so it will last a long time. It has a dropper applicator. The bottle is beautiful,,,you’ll feel elegant, just opening this.  I’m going to transfer some of it into a small roller bottle to travel with. I put it on this morning, as soon as I got it, and it’s 12 hours later and I can still smell it. Not crazy strong,,,just enough to make me smile.  Read the notes of the perfumes, from this creator, to find one that suits you, and I’m sure you will, I know I will most certainly be purchasing more. Thank you for such a heavenly fragrance.
hypos: Velmi nádherná vůně - Jamilla. Jsem trochu tomboy/holka, ale miluji své parfémy a ráda dostávám komplimenty na své parfémy. Mám jich spoustu, ale tento budu nosit hodně. Je to květinová sladká vůně s nádechem smyslnosti. Květinová složka není dominantní, jinak bych ji neměla ráda. Jemná kombinace citrusů a sladkosti je prostě dokonalá. Nemohla jsem přestat dávat zápěstí k nosu... Doslova mě uklidňovalo, cítit tuto vůni. Můj manžel chtěl, abych mu trochu dala na polštář, aby ji mohl cítit, když usíná. Není vodnatý, jako standardní parfémy, je to olej, takže vydrží dlouho. Má kapátko. Láhev je nádherná... budete se cítit elegantně, jen když ji otevřete. Chystám se přenést část do malé roll-on láhve, abych s ní mohla cestovat. Dala jsem si ji dnes ráno, hned jak jsem ji dostala, a teď je 12 hodin po tom a stále ji cítím. Není to šíleně silné... jen dost na to, abych se usmála. Přečtěte si poznámky k parfémům od tohoto tvůrce, abyste našli ten, který vám vyhovuje, a jsem si jistá, že najdete, já určitě koupím víc. Děkuji za tak nebeskou vůni.

source_doc: Bring the water bottle! Due to a surgery I had, I'm extremely prone to dehydration, so I carry a water bottle with me everywhere I go. My favorite is my Owala Free Sip 32oz. I drive a 2020 Toyota Highlander, and the bottle doesn't fit in the cup holders. So, I've been driving with my bottle between my legs, which makes things awkward and less safe. When I found this cup holder, I was excited about finally having a solution for the car. Tip...be sure to check the size of your cup holder before ordering to be sure you get the right size. I got the large one, and it adjusted perfectly in my console without having to offset. It is big and makes the cup holder the focus of the center console. My husband hates it and told me I just need to use a smaller cup. But when you have to drink as often as I do, that's not a good option. I love this thing, and I love that it's made it safer for me to take care of myself while driving. It's easy to insert and doesn't scratch the existing cup holder or console. Great for me!

source_doc: Does not charge cause it’s defective. I have had this for over a year. I rarely use it which is why it only stopped working recently. source_doc: This product has changed my life. I care for my elderly father who is confined to a wheelchair but can get himself on the toilet. He is constantly bumping his feet and his toes are always bleeding. As a result when he goes to the bathroom there's always blood on the floor. I take a diuretic and when I have to go, I have to go. I use these pads to stick to the floor in front of the toilet so that if I go in the bathroom and he has been in there bleeding, all I have to do is rip the mat up off the floor, and I can go to the bathroom without stepping in the blood. This product has changed my life and probably saved my kidneys. I will be subscribing to regular deliveries of this product. There are probably so many other uses for these wonderful pads. If I could give 10 Stars I would. Also the price is reasonable for such a quality product.

source_doc: Make the clay bar process much easier. So when I picked up my car from an overnight stay at the service center, I was beyond livid.  Some ‘genus’ left my pristine black car parked by their sprinklers and it left horrible water spots.  After the tried to wash them off with no success, I took it home expecting a long tedious day of detailing to try to get my paint back to normal.  While I know that using a clay bar does not usually remove water spots, I decided to try these clay mitts anyway because nothing else was really working.  I made sure to keep the area of the paint and the clay mitt well lubricated with the aerocosmetics wash/wax spray I use.  I used no pressure because Tesla black paint scratches extremely easily.  After two times, the spots were almost gone - even the deep ones.  I then used a polish to make sure I had not swirl marks and now my car looks even better than it did before.  The process took a fraction of the time I expected to spend.  The quality of the Ragnify Clay Mitts are really good and saved my paint.

source_doc: Maybe I don't love these, but I really really like them. I take that back - maybe I actually do love these. I have about 300 miles now with these and have yet to find a deal-breaker with them.  I hike all types of terrain and haven't had any problems with them.  I never used poles before, but after tripping and falling last year when hiking some really difficult terrain, I thought it prudent to try something for added stability.  These Foxelli's have been great for me.  They remain locked in position for me and I haven't had problems with them sliding out of position, even in very cold and changing temperatures.  I can see how one might break them if they aren't paying attention - especially if using on really rocky trails where the tip can get caught between rocks and jam.  But that’s not the pole’s fault - it’s “operator error".  What I really like is the lower handhold which is sooo useful when going uphill in changing terrain.

source_doc: They are OK. I've got a bunch of par lights, and I guess I was hoping for a little more with these. Most of my lights are about the same size. Their LEDs are in different patterns, but when I put them all on my truss, they look comparable. These guys are smaller. I guess you can call them compact. But they won't look right in-line with my other pars. They are bright... in fact, they are brighter than a name brand pair that I have. However, the blue had more purple in it. The red and green looked OK. The spread is wider when I tested these side-by-side with my name brand. The name brand gave me an even circle on my ceiling. This pair washed a larger area with a hot spot in the middle. What I do NOT like is the plug. It is ungrounded. If I use them inside, they will work OK. I will probably use them behind a scrim or façade since the brackets are extremely flimsy. I didn't expect name brand quality for sure. But I think I expected just a little bit better.
hypos: Jsou v pořádku. Mám spoustu par světel, a myslel/a jsem, že jsem doufal/a v trochu víc s těmito. Většina mých světel je zhruba stejné velikosti. Jejich LED diody mají různé vzory, ale když je všechny dám na svůj truss, vypadají srovnatelně. Tito kluci jsou menší. Myslím, že je můžeš nazvat kompaktními. Ale nebudou vypadat správně v linii s mými ostatními pars. Jsou jasné... vlastně jsou jasnější než značková dvojice, kterou mám. Nicméně, modrá měla více fialové. Červená a zelená vypadaly v pořádku. Rozptyl je širší, když jsem tyto testoval/a vedle značkových. Značková mi dala rovnoměrný kruh na stropě. Tato dvojice osvětluje větší plochu s horkou skvrnou uprostřed. Co se mi NELÍBÍ, je zástrčka. Není uzemněná. Pokud je použiji uvnitř, budou fungovat v pořádku. Pravděpodobně je použiji za záclonou nebo fasádou, protože držáky jsou extrémně křehké. Očekával/a jsem určitě kvalitu značky. Ale myslím, že jsem očekával/a jen o něco málo lepší.

source_doc: nice texture, goes on well, no irritation (but i am starting with 1-2x per week, not nightly) Was hard for me to figure out what exactly the differences are between the 3 products. That didnt inspire confidence, especially for the price. The only thing I could differentiate is that the professional option has stronger retinol, which I really dont want to get into since I my skin isnt acclimated to such ingredients. I have had "retinol uglies" in the past, and want to avoid another mishap. SO I went with the seemingly more gentle sounding "renutriate advanced". I want more oomph for my 40 something skin, but nothing super harsh. Would rather go low and slow than to irritate my already semi sensitive skin.So far so good. Nice texture, absorbs well. So far just using 1-2x a week to start. Then will increase as my skin gets used to it. Says to use nightly, but I am not just jumping in like that.Ingredients are typical and promising. No problems so far. I dont rate on price, you will have to decide if this fits into your budget or not. I will update if I find myself buying more.
hypos: Pěkná textura, dobře se vpíjí, žádné podráždění (ale začínám 1-2x týdně, ne každý večer). Bylo pro mě těžké zjistit, jaké přesně jsou rozdíly mezi těmito 3 produkty. source_doc: Not Enjoying All the Possibilities. In 2020 I bought this preorder from the manufacturer (before they were shipping). It came with no user manual. I found a manual on their internet site, but I wasn't able to find much that was helpful to me. My initial problem was that the app did not work on my i-phone 6 operating system. I set the amp aside until I recently bought an i-phone 14. I recently (2023) downloaded the App. First message was that I needed to download a firmware update for the Spark40. That required a computer. I tried a computer with Windows 11. Then I tried one with Windows 10 Pro. Neither computer recognizes the amplifier. After contacting customer service (very nice response), I connected to a different USB port on the Windows 11 computer and the update worked. This amp is supposed to do wonderful things, and many are happy with it. In my small amount of time using it, I found adjustments on the App difficult to make because of the small phone screen size. Maybe an i-pad would be easier, but that would cost a lot to gain that capability. I'm impressed by all the Spark40 is supposed to do, but not very pleased with the learning curve and the amount of supporting equipment needed (App capable phone or tablet, and a computer for updates of firmware). Make sure you have a phone with an operating system that can run the App.
hypos: Nedokážu si užít všechny možnosti. V roce 2020 jsem si objednal/a tento předobjednaný výrobek od výrobce (než začali posílat). Přišel bez uživatelského manuálu. Na jejich internetových stránkách jsem našel/a manuál, ale nenašel/a jsem mnoho, co by mi pomohlo. Můj počáteční problém byl, že aplikace nefungovala na mém i-phone 6 operačním systému. Ampér jsem odložil/a, dokud jsem nedávno nekoupil/a i-phone 14. Nedávno (2023) jsem si stáhl/a aplikaci. První zpráva byla, že potřebuji stáhnout aktualizaci firmwaru pro Spark40. To vyžadovalo počítač. Zkoušel/a jsem počítač s Windows 11. Pak jsem zkoušel/a jeden s Windows 10 Pro. Ani jeden počítač nepoznal zesilovač. Po kontaktování zákaznického servisu (velmi milá reakce) jsem se připojil/a k jinému USB portu na počítači s Windows 11 a aktualizace fungovala. Tento zesilovač by měl dělat úžasné věci a mnozí s ním jsou spokojeni. Ve svém malém množství času jeho používání jsem zjistil/a, že úpravy v aplikaci se těžko provádějí kvůli malé velikosti obrazovky telefonu. Možná by i-pad byl snazší, ale to by stálo hodně, abych získal/a tuto schopnost. Jsem ohromen/a tím, co všechno by Spark40 měl umět, ale nejsem příliš spokojen/a s učením se a množstvím podpůrného vybavení, které je potřeba (telefon nebo tablet schopný aplikace a počítač pro aktualizace firmwaru). Ujistěte se, že máte telefon s operačním systémem, který může spustit aplikaci.

source_doc: Hard to open—at first… I do a lot of traveling—and I mean a lot. I ordered this eight compartment pill organizer box in hopes that it would be helpful on my travels. The price is super affordable and I like to make sure I’m always stocked with the basics. I was really disappointed however, to find out that the individual compartments were nearly impossible to open. I struggled with them for several minutes, even breaking a nail before I decided to head to the reviews. Thanks to the angel who mentioned removing the silicone band, I was finally able to get the compartments open. Once they’re open and shut a few times they open much easier. Phew! I wish the compartments were a little larger because they really don’t hold that many pills and I need plenty of room for my overseas travel days. I still think I’ll use this, but probably when I’m traveling not as far.

source_doc: Absolutely Beautiful!! As an avid, long time bass fisherman, I am quite used to paying, what my wife considers to be, big money for a good reel.  I use only bait casters for my bass fishing and relegate spin casters for light stuff like crappie and brim.I really didn't expect too much considering the price of the reel.When I took it out of the box and unwrapped it, my chin dropped to my chest.  This reel is beautiful.Once I got past my initial surprise, I started to inspect it closely for the features that I would pay big bucks for.  I found all the features of my more expensive reels and more.  I would normally change out the crank handles for the ones with soft, grippable rubber handles.  This reel already had those.  I got the owners manual and read it from cover to cover and found it to be the most comprehensive and instructive manual I have ever seen.  It explained every single thing about the reel in very understandable English.I have yet to fish this reel, but if it works as good as it looks, I won't be dissatisfied in the least.I highly recommend this reel to serious fishermen everywhere.  I am considering buying another for my flipping rod.

source_doc: Honestly, I love this bag. I got this bag specifically for one day of a three day music festival I went to out of town. I flew in the morning of, attended the show, stayed in a hotel, flew home. I had to take everything I needed to the show with me because I wouldn’t be able to check in before the show. Granted I packed light, but this bag held everything I needed for a day in the sun and an overnight.Ive since taken the bag on a handful of travels where we’d venture out all day without returning to the hotel and it was perfect. Everything I need for the day AND room for some crap I’d buy along the way, one time it was three books and a T-shirt! It was stuffed, but it held it all.I’ve been looking for something a little better quality because I’ve grown to love this style and I can’t find anything that I like as much as this bag. I’m not having issues, but there are a lot little strings from unraveling fabric that’ll eventually cause problems.I carry it almost every day now. It’s gonna wear out, but I figure I’ll carry it gladly until it does.I took the patches off and put a couple of my own on, looks much better now.All in all, great bag. Probably 8L or so. source_doc: My hair drank this up. I don't use a whole lot of product in my hair but every so often I think it's good to get shampoo like this just to strip out any gunk that has got deep into my hair.  This came packaged just fine with no leaks though keep in mind I did not receive a pump lid like in the picture.  I hopped into the shower and lathered this up in my hair.  I was surprised at how much I had to use as my hair just drank this stuff up like it wasn't even there,  which tells me that my hair definitely needed a product like this.  It rinsed out just fine and I noticed after drying my hair that it felt super clean.  All in all, I really do like this product, maybe not be an everyday type of thing but I will use it at least every week, I do wish it had come with a pump handle but I was able to manage.

source_doc: Well-made, sturdy, elegant case. Just received this yesterday. The first impression is, as the title says, that it is a well-made, sturdy and elegant case. I read reviews that said the handle was uncomfortable. I don’t think it is. also read reviews that the straps were uncomfortable, that if you just hold by one strap the bass Flips upside down. That’s not true. The shoulder straps are fine. I wonder if people know how to adjust them? I opened them up all the way. That works for me.To put the bass in the case, you really do have to open it up almost all the way. And the extra pads at the bottom or a little bit in the way sort of. I didn’t want to remove them because I like the extra padding there. I don’t want to take the strap off my bass when I put it in the case, but that would probably make things a lot easier.  Anyway, it fits in there the case itself as I mentioned is very good looking in an understated sort of way  - you could show up at symphony hall with this thing and fit right in. It feels very sturdy and solid and stiff. The best of both worlds between a case and a gig bag. In my opinion I bought it because I fly sometimes in like to gate check the bass. this I think is as good as it gets for that option.

source_doc: Auto headrest tablet and hat holder that works OK with an additional installation step. I had a bit of trouble installing this. Rotating the knob behind the tablet holder is not as easy as they make it sound in the instructions. I couldn't get it tight enough to keep my 11" iPad Pro from drooping, so I thought I had it cross threaded. Through my efforts to tighten it by hand, I broke the knob. I glued and tried again the next day, but this time I used a pipe wrench to grip the knob while hand turning the tablet holder, which worked well enough so that now the tablet does not droop so easily. It's probably best for use with cellphones or lighter tablets.I love the hat holder feature. I keep large brim hats in the van to protect against the sun when going out for walks. Before I installed this holder, I was constantly moving the hats around in the van because I didn't have a good permanent place for them. As seen in the photo, I have two hats in the hat holder, the one in the back is hanging by it's chin strap.I wish I could use the nicely collapsible tray AND the hat holder but one is forced to choose between them.Now that it's installed and working, I'm happy to have this auto tablet and hat holder.

source_doc: It’s a pretty decent tray. First off the tray, does not come with any instructions, so I had to assume how to place it on the steering wheel, which is somewhat obvious sorta. It is a zip up case that you could probably use to transport papers or something like that because of the handle on the outside, and the fact that it zips up. So it is extremely portable. The outside pocket is actually the part that goes over the steering wheel. It wasn’t until later on that I realized that the straps on the inside actually go together to hold it up in place. It’s not a hard surface and it is bendable. But I do prefer it over the other one that I had simply because the other one that I have is hard and it is not fold up , so I just pretty much slid it between the seat of the door when I wasn’t using it. So I took off stars due to not having instructions and not really knowing where that extra strap goes and the fact that the bottom part is somewhat bendable. I’m not saying that it’s flimsy or won’t hold up but then again, I really don’t know because I haven’t been using it for a long time. I only used it for a few minutes to enter some information on my computer.

source_doc: Awesome for first time bike user! I love this bike! I have never used an exercise bike before but after researching what exercise equipment is good for low impact I thought I would try this out. I read another review that said this bike is only good for experienced users and I highly disagree. I will say I did have to replace the seat with a comfort seat as the stock seat hurt so much. I have zero issues with the new seat and can go for a while on my bike. I love the water bottle holder and the outlet for my tablet. I haven't downloaded the free app yet as I have been using other free videos for exercises. I highly recommend this bike for first time users!

source_doc: Decent size for all the info. I found that the personal touch from the CEO with this letter and description of the company was beyond what I expected. I just got this and put it on my cat, I know it says SiliDog, but I loved that I was able to get the amount of information on this ID tag that I was able to. Its amazing so far. I was able to put information on both sides, which I wasnt able to with her previous one. Also its rubber and so easy to put on her collar that unlike a metal one it wont tarnish, like her previous one did because of her water bowl. So even though I just got it and Oreo seems to approve, because its not bothering her yet, I would say that I would recommend it.Oreo approved!!! Lol.Side note: I think whoever had it as an example that said "Only indoor cat. If I'm out I'm lost" is genius because I put it on hers!!!! Love that about it.

source_doc: Amazing red light handheld. I got this because around the winter I tend to get cold sores and I currently have one on the side of my lips and I want it gone.  It came packaged well and I didn't notice any defects on it.  In the package, you get the light, two batteries, a charger for the batteries, glasses, a microfiber cloth, and a case for it all.  I really like that this comes with removable batteries instead of being charged in the device as when one battery dies I can have the other ready to go. The light really is really bright and you can feel your skin heating up when you have it on. There are three different lights red, blue and red, and blue though I primarily use blue and red. I used this on my cold sore and I guess it has made it speed up healing kinda hard to tell without going to the dr.  Out of all the handheld red light devices I have tried this one is definitely the best I've tried.

source_doc: Excellent nest holder but no instructions; Khaki color looks like a pasta nest. First of all this Khaki colored nest looks like some sort of edible pasta that has to be cooked. It comes with absolutely no instructions either when received or online. I almost was going to throw this out. However, after manhandling it for a few minutes, I had to strongly pull it apart. Once I opened it like an accordion, I understood how to use this.I have short to medium fine curly hair and I was able to roll my hair up in a  bun and then close this over the bun while holding my hair with the other hand. This then formed a nest. I tried unsuccessfully to take photos of it in my hair, so I only got a photo of one side. However, it holds exceptionally well because it is very strong.If using this with a ponytail, I recommend holding the ponytail with an elastic first and then pulling it through and clamping this over the hair. This is both unique and a wonderful hair implement. I do not love the khaki color, but I love the design. It also appears to be well-made. I would have rated this 5 stars had it come with instructions.The current price of $4.99 appears to be competitively priced for such a unique design and strong holding hair nest.

Přichází s naprosto žádnými instrukcemi, ať už při převzetí nebo online. Téměř jsem to chtěl/a vyhodit. Nicméně, po manipulaci s tím několik minut, jsem to musel/a silně roztrhnout. Jakmile jsem to otevřel/a jako akordeon, pochopil/a jsem, jak to použít. Mám krátké až středně jemné kudrnaté vlasy a podařilo se mi svázat vlasy do drdolu a pak to zavřít přes drdol, zatímco jsem s druhou rukou držel/a vlasy. To pak vytvořilo hnízdo. Snažil/a jsem se neúspěšně pořídit fotografie s tím ve vlasech, takže mám jen foto jedné strany. Nicméně, velmi dobře drží, protože je velmi silné. Pokud to používáte s culíkem, doporučuji nejprve držet culík elastickým páskem a poté ho protáhnout a uchytit to přes vlasy. To je jak unikátní, tak úžasný pomocník na vlasy. Khaki barvu nemám moc rád/a, ale design se mi líbí. Také se zdá být dobře zpracované. Ohodnotil/a bych to 5 hvězdičkami, kdyby to přišlo s instrukcemi. Aktuální cena 4,99 USD se jeví jako konkurenceschopná pro tak unikátní design a silné držení vlasového hnízda.

source_doc: Simple plug and start using. Was getting tired of using my earpods for video calls on phone. The mic just wasn't clear for those on the other side.I was curious about these and well, decided to try them.  WOW... worked great right out of the box.  My iPhone quickly connected and I was able to start using.  I did a voice recording so I could hear the quality. It was sharp and crisp.Now I have no excuse to podcast off my phone other than I don't like hearing my own voice.I at times have a friend with me and we do video call and have to position phone to get both our voices or hand it back and forth.This came with TWO lapel clip mics so now we can each wear one and keep the phone propped for video call.Will need to get proper cable adapter to try and get this to connect to my laptop. It doesn't have iphone or usb-c ports so I will have to get back to y'all once I get proper cable.  I expect it to work.I'm wondering if I can get a small speaker to connect this to when I am working the company booth. I usually end up almost yelling and losing my voice at days end.  That is my next project for these.

source_doc: Hard to deflate. I have tile floors and babysit my grandson frequently. I bought a hiccapop 69” play yard because he’s starting to crawl. This fits it perfectly. It has to inflate and can take awhile. I personally crawled on it and it did offer some cushioning. I am overweight and have bad knees and I could crawl on this. I can’t crawl on my tile floor so I know it will help. I do wish it was a little more firm so I might buy another.  I saw some tips about how to make it more firm but haven’t tried them. It is difficult and time consuming to let the air out so if you want to put it away like I do keep that in mind.

source_doc: Excellent product. I purchased this product in hopes it would help with scratch marks from my English Bulldog jumping on and off my large leather sectional couch. I had read all the reviews and decided to give it a try. I am so glad I did, I followed one of the reviews given by GingerInkc and did one section at a time using microfiber cloths to put the product on using circular motion. When dried I went over the area with a barely damp microfiber cloth...(I forgot to mention before starting this project I used my leather cleaner to clean the sectional). I finished with the leather conditioner provided in kit. I wish I had taken before pictures but l didnt. I can tell you my leather sectional looks brand new!!! I too had only used maybe a third of the of the coloring balm if that! A little amount goes s long way! Very pleased with this product!!By By scratches!

source_doc: Works just as it should. I love this and I have three of them. I have a job where I'm on the road all day. It is a real pain to use nasty road bathrooms and take off my work uniform. This little guy eliminates that issue. I can go anywhere, and do so without exposing myself. That's worth it's weight in gold. At first I was very nervous about using it, for fear of spills or leaks. However, I have had no problem with that - not even once. I started off practicing at home, and then went to single person bathrooms at work. Now I use it wherever and whenever I can do so with discretion. I even use a urinal with zero issues if one happens to be present. I also am an avid camper and hiker, and I use this off the job for that. It's one less thing I have to worry about. If you use this thing correctly, it works every time. I have zero complaints.

source_doc: Reminds me of my other more expensive name brand sound machine. Worth it! I love the sound options. I always wish I could get it a little louder for covering noises in the house. But all in all I love the sound machine aspect. I like the ready to wake clock. My kids respond well to it. I like that there is a clock display for my. If kids who can tell time. The nightlight options are great. I LOVE that you can adjust the brightness!  love that it had battery back up so I don’t have to reset it every time I unplug it to move it. That’s such a pain. I wish it had a battery power option for when a storm knock out the power but it’s not a deal breaker. Overall it reminds me of my expensive Hatch sound machine that I like as well.Edited to add: I LOVE that it is a Bluetooth speaker! I can play audiobooks for my kids through it and they love those!!

source_doc: Dressing up the stairway. I had been looking for ideas to dress up the risers on the stairs going to my second floor and was thinking stencils, or different paint, when I came across YouTube videos where diy shows were using this type of dress up for that project.  I had been looking around for awhile for some pattern I liked and came across this one.  It's neutral colors of beige/taupe and blue/grey that should blend in well.  It has a variety of patterns so each stair riser would be different and I like that idea and the look.  Haven't started that project yet as I have to prep the area.  It takes me awhile but I will get to it and I am excited to see how it turns out.  I will post an update when I get to that point.  The strips are a little over 7 inches wide and about 40 inches long.  There are 15 pieces, each a different pattern, all in the same muted shades.  Each piece has backing to protect the sticky side.  Feels pretty sticky so should adhere well.  I believe well worth the $$ if I can get this project done with my time and $40!  We shall see.

source_doc: My life is officially complete. I am in southern CA, so definitely not a cold climate.  But I am free.zing this winter-like can't feel my fingers and toes freezing.  I had purchased one of these for my daughter when she was in college in  (truly cold) Minnesota and she loved it.  Not sure why I waited a couple of years to buy one for myself but I finally did.  It arrived quickly but felt like forever, and I couldn't tear that box open fast enough.  I didn't even wash it before putting it on and immediately realizing that this Comfy is what I have been needing in my life.  I am warm!  Like snuggly, fully and comfortable warm! My husband no longer has to live in a sauna with the heater blasting because I am in charge of my own temperature regulation.  I wish I had known about this when my kids were younger and in sports instead of wishing I could park my car with the heater and seat warmer blasting on the field. Get it.  You'll love it.

source_doc: Comfortable but not slippery, cute steering wheel cover. This is my first time having a steering wheel cover. I have a 1st Generation Toyota Sienna. I measured my steering wheel and it was close to 15", so I figured this would work. It was a bit of a struggle getting it on but not too bad, I didn't need any help or tools. I do wish I would have given more thought to where the seam on the cover would be, because I didn't and it ended up being on the right toward the bottom which isn't as bad as if it were closer to the top, but I think I would prefer if it were in the middle at the bottom as a clear point of reference. It's a pretty thick seam. I don't want to have to remove the cover and put it back on though, it was a tight fit. I chose this Bohemian design because I think it goes pretty well with my old and ugly brown interior. The cover does make the steering wheel quite thick, which, I guess, is easier to hold onto. The fabric has a tooth to keep my hands from slipping, but it still feels pleasant to the touch. I'm picky about how fabrics feel on my skin, and this feels pretty good.

source_doc: Not a clear wipe. I guess I am old, but I remember replacing wiper blades quickly and easily. I have a 2014 Pathfinder and somehow the driver wiper (26") cracked. Still worked fine, but I noticed a slight scratch in the glass. I had a 17" replacement for the passenger side a few weeks ago. I thought I bought the same. Duh. That one is great(Rain-X 5079283-2 Latitude 2-IN-1 Water Repellency Wiper Blade, 17") put on by mech at last oil change. This one hat two other adapters, and I finally removed the one on it as I had the old hook style. Slid on easily, but the cover at the end would not snap shut. I redid it three times. Anywho. at the center of the blade under the connection there is water that is not cleared, and when it hits the water on the right ( next to the rear view mirror) pushed by the passenger blade it hardly wipes it. I am about ready to reorder another like the 17" and keep this for emergencies.

source_doc: Best Wipes - From a Preschool Teacher! I’m very fortunate in that I teach a class of twelve toddlers who all require diaper changes throughout the day. I’m fortunate because while I was pregnant, I was able to test out ten different kinds of wipes! These were by far my favorite. Most wipes are too dry to really get anything clean. I felt like I was scrubbing some of the kids’ bottoms to get them clean, which obviously isn’t very comfortable. These wipes are a dream! Wet enough to get the job done, and thick enough that I have never felt like I was going to get anything on my fingers. (Granted, I wear gloves at the preschool. I mean with my new daughter!) My girl has never had diaper rash, and while she has eczema on her little face cheeks, her booty remains clear! I had 3 boxes of these wipes, and she is ten weeks old. I still have 3 packs from the second box, and I’m only opening the third to send some to daycare. They last a while! Just get them!
hypos: Nejlepší ubrousky - od učitele/ky v mateřské škole! Mám velké štěstí, že učím třídu dvanácti malých dětí, které během dne potřebují měnit pleny. Mám štěstí, protože když jsem byla těhotná, mohla jsem vyzkoušet deset různých druhů ubrousků! Tyto byly rozhodně moje nejoblíbenější. Většina ubrousků je příliš suchá na to, aby opravdu něco vyčistila. Měla/a jsem pocit, že některé děti musím drhnout, abych je vyčistila, což samozřejmě není moc pohodlné. Tyto ubrousky jsou snem! Dostačující vlhké, aby splnily úkol, a dostatečně silné, že jsem se nikdy necítila/a, že bych si něco dostala na prsty. (Pravda, nosím rukavice v mateřské škole. Mám na mysli s mojí novou dcerou!) Moje holčička nikdy neměla opruzeninu, a i když má ekzém na svých malých tvářičkách, její zadeček zůstává čistý! Měla/a jsem 3 krabičky těchto ubrousků, a ona má deset týdnů. Pořád mám 3 balení z druhé krabičky, a třetí otevírám jen na to, abych poslala nějaké do školky. Vydrží dlouho! Jen si je pořiďte!

source_doc: Love the Purple Color and the faux Purple Fur. I wear medium clothing but I ordered an XL because I read that it ran small.  I like my coats big so whatever sweater I wear under it fits in the sleeves .  I live in FL so don't get a chance to try on Winter Coats but I need them when I travel for warmth and protection from rain.  I figured I'd usually would get a Large, so I ordered an XL and I love the fit.  The jacket may come normally to the waist, but because I got bigger it comes down and covers my butt.  Perfect.

source_doc: Mixed. I'm a little mixed & unsure as to whether or not this is really helping. When I ordered this I realized that this was basically a rubberband in a sense, with some items that are & aren't needed in my opinion. I really don't think you need the first remover for this specific product it doesn't really relate, the tweezer are a definite must though, they were a big help. Anyway once I put it on I really kind of expected it to be tighter, or I guess not as easy to just swing the joystick around, in essence showing me that this is holding it together better. But that's not what happened, I feel no difference in the resistance from now & before I put it on so I'm disappointed but I also can't price that it isn't working hence the mixed feelings. I'm not really sure if maybe I'm not supposed to feel any difference & I'm just supposed to wait & hope that I see it in the longevity, I don't know but I don't think that I would actually recommend this since I can't actually feel any difference.

source_doc: Not accurate, irritated my wrist. I really wanted to like this watch, as my friend has 1 and we could join eachother and share our progress with one another, etc. I was amazed at how many steps I was doing each day- until I realized that it was adding steps when I wasn't even walking! I bought another less expensive watch and wore both of them on my wrist for several days. sure enough, the Fitbit showed many more steps then the other- which showed to be more accurate when I was watching.My second complaint is that though it is less bulky than some watches, it irritated my wrist. I don't know if it is the materials it is made out of or what, but it wore a rash into it.Lastly, the App. They want $80 a year for their "premium" edition, which my other watch app gives me for FREE! Plus, my other watch monitors my blood pressure, which the fitbit does not, unless I enter it manually. All in all, I can say I tried it but I am not impressed. The seller, however was great. I had the watch in less than 2 days.

source_doc: Not very good quality. I doubt this is truly a therapeutic grade oil. I wasn’t expecting the best oil, at the price…but I was disappointed. It had an unusually greasy feel to it for an essential oil, the smell is basic, and if the sting of clove oil is any indicator of its purity, this is not pure. I’ve put clove oil in my armpits a few times and regretted it. I actually put this one on to test it, and eventually I did feel a little heat. But I wasn’t sure I would at all. I do like the dropper feature though. I bought it to use under my finger nails while fighting a pinworm infection with a toddler, so I didn’t care if it smelled great, I just wanted something I could use frequently after diaper changes. Hmmm, perhaps latex gloves would have been a better choice.

source_doc: You need this! Love this swaddle carrier! I had one similar to this one I got from Walmart a couple years ago (but I got rid of it thinking I wouldn’t have another kiddo) and I struggled to find one that you don’t have to wrap all yourself until I came across this one. source_doc: Works perfectly for what I need. I just moved my toddlers into their own bedroom. While I do have a Ring Camera in there which sends motion alerts, I was needing something that would alert me of sound in real time. This monitor does just that.Set up was super easy. I literally just plugged them in and they paired instantly. It picks up every sound so I can even hear when they move. I like that the volume can be adjusted so I can lower it down while they’re settling to go to bed and turn it up when I myself am ready for sleep.I do not use the cordless feature as the parent monitor is plugged in to sit on my nightstand and the one in my kid’s room is also plugged in so I can’t comment on the battery life.The night light on the kid monitor is a really nice touch and I like that whenever there’s higher sound the parent monitor lights up orange to alert.When we have our next baby I will definitely be purchasing another one of these. They are really simple but work perfectly for what I need. I wish I bought them when my little ones were in the baby phase to help when we put them in another room for naps.

source_doc: This battery delivers its rated capacity of 100Ah. I have a Bluetti AC200P connected to a 6 circuit manual transfer panel and this works well.  I was looking for some extra battery capacity and watched many reviews of the different brands of 100Ah LifePo4 batteries.  Power Queen was a highly rated battery and their price was equal to about all the others.  However, Power Queen was running a promotion where you would get a 12.8V 6Ah battery for free with each battery purchase so I took advantage of that.  I decided to go with 2 of the Power Queen 100Ah batteries.  I use the smaller battery in my electric start gas generator.  I was able to test their capacity to ensure that I was getting the advertised 100Ah from them and I am pleased to say that each one delivered about 101Ah.  I now have them wired together in series to get 24V and then attach them to the solar generator through an adapter.  This works well although the solar generator only charges at about 340W.  I can't speak for the life cycle of these batteries but with a 5 year warranty, I am not to concerned about that.  I did have the opportunity to ask a question via email to Power Queen and they responded within a day.  I think that they were a good value and would buy again.

Power Queen byla vysoce hodnocená baterie a jejich cena byla srovnatelná s téměř všemi ostatními. Nicméně, Power Queen měla akci, kde jste s každým nákupem baterie dostali zdarma 12.8V 6Ah baterii, takže jsem toho využil/a. Rozhodl/a jsem se vzít 2 baterie Power Queen 100Ah. Měl/a jsem možnost otestovat jejich kapacitu, abych se ujistil/a, že dostávám inzerovaných 100Ah, a s potěšením mohu říci, že každá dodala asi 101Ah. Nyní je mám zapojené dohromady v sérii, abych dostal 24V, a poté je připojím k solárnímu generátoru prostřednictvím adaptéru. To funguje dobře, i když solární generátor nabíjí pouze asi 340W. source_doc: VERY STRONG FRAGRANCE!!!! Smell is extraordinarily fragranced. I left this box on my bathroom counter for a half day while I did other things. Returning to my bathroom area, I could smell it out in the hallway. I ended up double bagging it in ziplocks.I don’t like scents and I can have allergic reactions but usually shampoo smells are okay. So, I kept it. Finally tried it this morning. The black shampoo + the green conditioner. Worked okay but again, the smell was EXTREMELY STRONG. I felt my lips tingling in the shower so I was definitely having a reaction.Anyways, an hour later I got migraine. I get them very infrequently - maybe once a year or less. This one was only visual but the strongest visual one I’ve ever had. Kinda suspicious I got it right after using a new product. No one to know for sure.Long story short, everything was double bagged and put into the trash.I really, really would like to be doing better and using and discarding less plastic but not at the expense of my health.Definitely not a good product if you are sensitive to fragrances.

source_doc: Build Quality Could be Better. I purchased the ES110 based on exhaustive research and reading reviews. I also own an upright Kawai piano. What convinced me to purchase it was the key action and sound quality. I primarily wanted a piano and didn't need a lot of other features.When I set up the ES110 I noticed a fair amount of noise from some keys clacking when released (plastic on plastic). Most keys seemed adequately sound dampened but some were not. I contacted the vendor and Kawai support. The vendor told me to contact Kawai support as well. I never heard back from them.The clacking key noise was driving me crazy so I returned the ES110 and asked a few different music stores what they would recommend. I Purchased the Roland FP30X. I didn't purchase the Roland initially because a reviewer said the keys were a little too heavy and it might not be the best for high speed fingering used in classical music. I've also been very satisfied with my Kawai upright.The Roland keys feel much more solid with no clacking noise. The build quality on the Roland seems better than the ES110. Maybe the key feel is a little heavier but you can adjust the Key Touch to make it feel lighter.I really wanted to love the ES110 and was very disappointed. Maybe I got a lemon. The Roland FP30EX has been great so far.

source_doc: Great lighting, excellent key feel. I had a Nighthawk X8 MAX keyboard I loved. It worked for years. Then the coffee happened. I tried many keyboards and eventually settled on this one. The lighting is bright, the keycaps have large letters and numbers, and most importantly, the keys feel "right". I am also pleased that is is a tenkeyless keyboard that still has print screen, etc. I would like for the caps lock indicator to be brighter, but that is the only complaint I have. I actually have two of these so I am ready when the Nighthawk I have at my office finally dies, or when I inadvertently kill the one I am typing on.

source_doc: Stains skin, medium brown is black. I have been using henna on my hair for over a decade and never though of dying my eyebrows with it since usually the package says not to. Anyway henna is too orangey for my brows anyway, that are naturally very light. So I tried that kit, but 2 things happened:- the color never lightened and stayed dark so now I have black eyebrows with red hair and I guess I'll soap my eyebrows everyday hoping that product doesn't last too long- it really stains the skin! When I do my hair I slather the henna and it goes on my ears and neck and has never stained even though I keep it on all day. I had to scrub around my eyebrows really hard and damaged my skin. It also has absolutely no instructions so I had to come here. I wish I could return it but the window closed yesterday.Next application I'll mix it with my regular hair henna so it doesn't get too dark, and will make sure it doesn't go on my skin at all.
hypos: Skvrny na kůži, středně hnědá je černá. Henna na vlasy používám už více než deset let a nikdy mě nenapadlo jí obarvit obočí, protože obvykle balení říká, že to nemám dělat. Každopádně je henna pro mé obočí, které je přirozeně velmi světlé, příliš oranžová. Takže jsem vyzkoušela ten kit, ale staly se dvě věci: - barva nikdy nezesvětlila a zůstala tmavá, takže teď mám černé obočí s červenými vlasy a asi je budu mýt mýdlem každý den, doufajíc, že produkt nevydrží příliš dlouho - opravdu skvrní kůži! Když si dělám vlasy, natřu si hennu a jde mi na uši a krk a nikdy nezanechala skvrnu, i když ji mám celý den. Musela jsem si kolem obočí opravdu hodně drhnout a poškodila jsem si pleť. Také nemá absolutně žádné instrukce, takže jsem musela přijít sem. Přála bych si, abych to mohla vrátit, ale okno se včera zavřelo. Při další aplikaci to smíchám se svou běžnou hennou na vlasy, aby to nebylo příliš tmavé, a budu dbát na to, aby to vůbec nešlo na kůži.

source_doc: Worst piece of fitness equipment I own. Not going to lie, I wanted something for the wife that was just easier than grabbing a bar and bench in limited basement space.  I have all types of equipment down there, and this was just going to supplement workout routines.  I had high hopes when I got this thing.  Then I started to try and out it together.  Let me tell you, the hardware us not marked, the instructions leave a lot to be desired, and holes do not line up (had to ream out two holes).  Sturdiness after being assembled is questionable, and the design is severely flawed.  There are two hooks that insert downward and attach with nuts on the back (floor side) of the platform.  We'll, these hooks protrude further than the feet of the platform and hit the ground more than the supposed platform feet.  Let me tell you, I was pretty upset when I discovered these hooks had dug themselves into my floor and sratched it all up!  I had to grind these protrusions down and tape them to ensure they wouldn't scratch anything.  I tried the system after I assembled and do not feel confident that it will last more than a month.  Everything is cheap!  I am super upset that this thing is like this, and feel cheated.  Honestly, this is the worst piece of equipment I now own!!!

source_doc: Large capacity storage bags. These hold more liquid than most breast milk bags. I like that they are reusable, I keep them in my pump bag for work just incase I forget to grab enough breast milk bags for the week. The daily use of them is hard because it's only a 2 pack. I pump around 4 regular bags a day, so I feel like I would need to purchase maybe 6 because of the larger storage space. I did have to push really hard to pop the lid when testing it, before filling it. I think that the best advice I can give is do not completely fill it because you do have to mess with it a bit before completely sealing the lid. I think the only down side is the cap and the fact that it's only a 2 pack and the 4 pack is 32 bucks. Also I noticed in the listing it says BAP free. I sure hope that they mean BPA free.

source_doc: Not gold and not absorbant. These are really soft and fluffy microfiber towels!  I've never seen microfiber towels like these.  I got them because I have a new color theme in my bathroom that includes a bright egg yolk yellow.  I was trying to liven it up from the grey, beige, black and white in there.  I bought a new rug, new bath towels and a couple pictures to hang on the wall.  I wanted these to wipe off the faucet handle and tub spout after I take showers.  We have a new home and I want to keep it looking new as long as possible. These microfiber towels are labeled as gold and look more yellow in the description than what I recieved.  Mine are bright orange, not gold at all.  But what I don't understand is why they are considered absorbant...?  They smear around the water on the faucet.  I thought maybe I didn't get all the stuff out they use when they are manufactured so I hand washed them again in fragrance free detergent, and baking soda.  Tried again and they still don't wipe off water like my old cotton towels.  I tried them several times.  I think they might be good at dusting.  They probably pick up dust well.  They probably also work great at washing things, but I specifically ordered them for their color and their absorbancy and neither work for that purpose.  I will find another use for them, but I am disappointed.

source_doc: I absolutely LOVE it. I love this thing.  Got it on a lightening deal and so glad I took the plunge.  It took a while to put it together, but if you follow the directions exactly (something hard for my hubby to do), it goes together perfectly.  It was also very easy to hang.  It has a lot of space, and just what I needed in my laundry/half-bath.  We wanted to keep a few first aid items in there, and I also have a good place to store extra toilet paper.  I love the little open shelf.  I put an extra hand towel and I will also add something decorative as soon as I find something that fits with my decor.  The only thing wrong was on my part.  I thought this was mission style doors, but they aren't.  My fault for not paying better attention.  I really don't care because I love it so much.  Oh, and I changed the knobs only because I wanted it to match the rest of the cabinets in the laundery room.  If not for that, I would have left the included knobs because they look really nice.  I would most definitely buy this again.
hypos: Opravdu to MILUJI. Mám rád/a tuto věc. Koupil/a jsem to za super cenu a jsem opravdu rád/a, že jsem do toho šel/šla. Dalo to chvíli, než jsem to sestavil/a, ale pokud přesně dodržíte pokyny (což je pro mého manžela/ku obtížné), všechno do sebe perfektně zapadne. Také se to velmi snadno zavěsilo. Má to hodně prostoru a je to právě to, co jsem potřeboval/a ve své prádelně/poloviční koupelně. Chtěli jsme tam mít pár předmětů první pomoci a také mám dobré místo na uskladnění extra toaletního papíru. Miluji malou otevřenou polici. Dal/a jsem tam extra ručník a také přidám něco dekorativního, jakmile najdu něco, co se hodí k mému dekoru. Jediná věc, co bylo špatně, byla má chyba. Myslel/a jsem, že jsou to dveře ve stylu mise, ale nejsou. Je to má chyba, že jsem nevěnoval/a pozornost. Opravu mi na tom nezáleží, protože to miluji tolik. A změnil/a jsem knoflíky jen proto, že jsem chtěl/a, aby ladily se zbytkem skříní v prádelně. Kdybych to neudělal/a, nechal/a bych si ty zahrnuté knoflíky, protože vypadají opravdu hezky. source_doc: Great personal electrical guitar amp. First off, I knew that it was on the small side and I know how small audio amplifier circuits can be made because of my degrees, but I still was not expecting this amp to be this tiny.  If it was not for the battery pack adding on some size, I bet this amp could fit in my guitar case.  But I love how small this is, and yet how loud it can get if needed.  The only reason for 4 stars is I heard a hum on some of the strings as well as some of them are fuzzy, so I am not sure if this is the amp or guitar yet.  I did not hear this with no amp attached obviously.  I found out that electric guitars need to be setup and I don't think this guitar has been setup yet before being used as I was not told about it.  So once that is done, if the sound improves I will increase my rating, if not, well you know what happens then, but I will do my best to find the cause of the hum and fuzz that have been found now.

source_doc: Great pants but order the right size. I really like these leather pants.  It’s hard to find leather pants in a store unless you go to a motorcycle store, but those pants are more about protection in case of a fall or crash.  The other place to find leather pants is at a kink store but those pants are very expensive.  I decided to order online, but when I read the reviews they all said to size down.  I followed their advice, and it was wrong!  I normally wear a size 36 in Levi’s, so I ordered down like everyone said and ordered a 34.  That pants was too small and too tight.  I then thought maybe I should order a size bigger so I ordered a 38, and that pants was too big.  Finally I ordered a 36, and it was perfect.  My advice is order your normal Levi size, and you should be good to go.  Just so you know I weigh 220 and I’m 6-1 who wears size 36 in pants.  Hope this helps someone out there.

source_doc: Poor Quality. I am extremely disappointed with this controller. I ordered this and the first one that arrived would lose connection from my Xbox Series X about every 10 minutes. I was about 5 feet from the console when using it, so there should be no reason for this. I actually have a second Xbox Series X in my living room, so I tried it there and experienced the same issue. I decided to exchange the controller and get a new one. Now that I have the second controller, this one has stick drift in the left thumb stick. I've tried every troubleshoot with Xbox support, but now they recommend that I send it to them for repair. I am just going to return it and go with a different option. Also, I did not play with the controller to cause the stick drift. I noticed it fresh out of the box, so it was not dropped or damaged and it is not dirty from use. It's literally brand new. Extremely disappointed, I wanted to really like this controller.

source_doc: Bright and pretty lights. I absolutely love the way these solar lights look. I have been eyeing them for a long time before I ended up ordering them, and when I got them I was first a little disappointed because I expected them to be taller, but that is my fault- I should have checked the measurements. They are very light weight so a stronger wind will blow them over especially if they are not anchored, and since I keep them on my deck I can not anchor them. The quality seems pretty good and the light seem to last pretty well. I had them for about 6 months and I am very pleased with them.
