source_doc: Very disappointed, and had to return. As someone with MCS - multiple chemical sensitivity- any fragrance can make me extremely ill. Someone can walk past me wearing perfume or fabric softener or lotion, and I can become so ill. I will have to be in bed for two or three days. People don’t realize how toxic things are, or are to others around them. Therefore I use products that are natural and clean and pure as far as fragrance goes and have always had good luck with Mrs. Myers products. So I purchased these bottles of hand soap. However, I had a reaction to this fragrance. This does not smell natural. It smells more chemical I used it for about three days in a row to be sure that it truly was this product. I was reacting to, and without a doubt, even after using it, and with the fragrance lingering in the air, I could not enter the room.  Therefore I will no longer use Mrs. Myers products as I cannot trust the source of their fragrance. I do not react to natural essential oils so if the source is truly a natural fragrance, I’m usually good, but not with anything that is chemical. This fragrance does not smell at all natural and smells more chemically derived. I absolutely cannot recommend this product .

source_doc: Unable to assemble. Requires much more strength than I have. Impossible to turn screws into place. I really wanted to be able to use this product. I was excited when it arrived to discover that it is a much more sturdy and heavy duty metal construction than I had expected, and tried to assemble it immediately so that I could start using it. Unfortunately, i was unable to assemble it. I started by following the instructions which showed how to screw the first standing rod to the cross bar that the tp roll slides onto. I spent more than 20 minutes trying to get that one screw in place but it was not possible for me. It requires much more strength than I have. The screw did not seem to properly fit into the hole it was supposed to be screwed into. They provide a lever to use to screw it in more tightly. But it didn't work. I tried and tried but was unable to get it to budge no matter how much strength and force I applied. I was finally forced to give up. Bummer. IF u can find some strongman with way more strength than I have who can actually get the parts screwed together into their proper place, I would think it would provide u with a useful and durable stand/storage for your TP. Good luck with that.

source_doc: Amazing at first and then all the issues came. Great customer service and replacement BUT. I really wanted to love this automated cat litter box.  A friend highly recommended it so I took a chance and spent over $500.  It was amazing for the first 6 months and then the issues started.  First, the waste bin kept saying it was full even after I emptied it.  I did everything to try to fix it but couldn't so I asked the company how to fix it.  They sent me a new litter box.  The 2nd litter box was great for 4 months then unused litter kept filling the waste bin.  I couldn't fix it and don't understand why this started happening.  I messaged the company again but this time I had a really hard time sending the information and the video clip.  Now the odor removal sensor keeps telling me there is no liquid even after I fill it. Well, I guess having this automated litter box for a year now has spoiled me so I need to buy a new one that works!  Any suggestions?

source_doc: No complaints with quality. I got this for an emergency pull rope / strap for the trunk of my car.. 4" did not really register as to how wide that actually is, or how thick this strap actually is, until I got it in.. One of those (brain fartt) moments where you could kick yourself in after thought.. In any case, this is way more then I need for an emergency strap, so I am going to look for another.. I have one that is thinner and not as wide in my one vehicle, and I wanted one for my other vehicle.. If you want one for something like that, this is going to be much thicker and heavier then most people will ever use..With that being said, the testing I did do with it, it worked fine.. But let me be honest when I say.. 16,000 pounds is like towing a semi.. I have nothing that will use or need that kind of a heavy duty strap to tow.. But then again, I have seen smaller one break trying to pull out bushes and stuff.. So better too heavy then not heavy enough and breaking.. Just know, if you are looking for compact, this is not for you.. But from what I can tell so far, it is nicely made and I have no complaints about its quality.
hypos: Žádné stížnosti na kvalitu. Dostal/a jsem to jako nouzovou táhnoucí šňůru/řemen pro kufr mého auta.. 4" mi opravdu nedošlo, jak široké to vlastně je, nebo jak silný tento řemen vlastně je, dokud jsem to nedostal/a.. Jeden z těch (úplně blbý) momentů, kdy byste si mohli nakopnout sami sebe zpětně.. V každém případě, tohle je mnohem víc, než potřebuji pro nouzový řemen, takže se podívám po jiném.. Mám jeden, který je tenčí a ne tak široký ve svém jednom vozidle, a chtěl/a jsem jeden pro své druhé vozidlo.. Pokud chcete jeden na něco takového, tento bude mnohem silnější a těžší, než většina lidí kdy použije.. S tím ale řečeno, testování, které jsem s tím provedl/a, fungovalo dobře.. Ale buďme upřímní, když říkám.. 16 000 liber je jako tahání kamionu.. Nemám nic, co by používalo nebo potřebovalo takový těžký řemen na tahání.. Ale zase jsem viděl/a menší, jak se zlomily, když se snažily vytáhnout keře a podobné věci.. Takže lepší být příliš těžký než nedostatečně těžký a zlomit se.. Jen vězte, že pokud hledáte něco kompaktního, tohle není pro vás.. Ale z toho, co mohu zatím říct, je to hezky vyrobené a nemám žádné stížnosti na jeho kvalitu.

source_doc: It has built in gloves and I feel so cute. After three years of pandemic and quarantine and wfh, which also included a pregnancy, I had very few pieces of clothing left that fit and suddenly I was being forced back into the office. It's January and cold, so I decided to treat myself to a cute new winter coat to help with the transition back.This coat is everything.It is cozy and warm without making me overheat and it doesn't feel heavy. The sleeves have built in fingerless gloves which I love because I always forget my gloves. The pockets are deep but they don't bulge when full. I can easily fit a 20oz waterbottle in the pocket and hardly notice it is there.Literally the only downside I've experienced is that I can't get to my smart watch because of the gloves, but I'm sure if I really wanted to I'd be able to.This coat made me feel cute for the first time in three years and I am so glad I got it.

Doslova jedinou nevýhodou, kterou jsem zažila/ zažil, je, že se nemohu dostat ke svým chytrým hodinkám kvůli rukavicím, ale jsem si jistá/ jistý, že kdybych chtěla/ chtěl, dokázal/a bych to. Tento kabát mě poprvé za tři roky učinil roztomilou/ roztomilým a jsem tak ráda/ rád, že jsem si ho pořídila/ pořídil.

source_doc: Its a gd enuf substitute. Glad i found this, i really hate to throw away a working Fairywell E11 just bec they do not sell replacement heads anymore. Mighty irresponsible of this company and i am not going to buy another Fairywell product bec i am forced to be so eco unfriendly. I must thank the customer who replied to the question if these heads can fit FW-E11, and he said he managed to use them for his E11. I went ahead trusting his ans. It does not click fit, but it works fine. I dare not take chance on those heads from other sellers that clearly state not meant for FW-E11, although i suspect it probably also can work.Anyway, this heads are smaller than the original FW heads, but i am ok with it bec i like small heads brushes that can reach further in anyway. They are not as lasting as the originals as well, but its not by too much, and at this reasonable pricing, i am happy to change them out to be more hygienic.

source_doc: Excellent storage and organizer. I bought two of these storage boxes, and quickly bought two more. In fact, I may order more before long.I had a large collection of knitting needles stored in a diorganized mess, in a large storage box. I wanted to sort the needles into straight, double points and circular needles. I also wanted to store the needles under my couch, so the storage containers could be no more than 6 inches high. I spent over an hour on Amazon, looking for the right boxes. I found these and ordered them.They perfectly meet my needs. The containers are strong and sturdy and the locking clips are easy to open and close. I sorted out my knitting needles, and now quickly find the ones I need.I started to sort out my office supplies and plan to buy more of these boxes. I can stack the boxes on top of each other to make more efficient use of my storage space.In conclusion, these boxes are wonderful. They are a great way to store various items. I wish I could give them a 5+ star rating.

source_doc: I hope the instruction comes with recommended settings. This is my first Red Light Therapy belt and I was just so excited to use it. However, although I have done research on what red light/infrared light can do for your overall health, I know that I am still a beginner and needs some guidance and a lot of informations on the use of it.Having said this, I hope this product would have included in its intructions the recommended settings. I was grasping what is the ideal frequency/ hz should be so I just placed it on 100 not understanding what's the difference if its higher or lower nor the effect of it in the body. I didn't even know if this belt should be warm on the body or what. Or at what level will it go warm. Also, the timer seems a lit bit faster than the regular clock.The belt came with a great description and packaging! I like that it came with a pouch which makes it portable and can carry anywhere. I appreciate the size as it can totally cover a petite person's abdomen like me. The quality of the material is superior and I like that velcro came witb a protective cover. My only issue is the lack or limited instructions of the product! Overall, this product is worth a try!

source_doc: Perfect exercycle for me! I love this little stationary bike! And the price point is incredibly reasonable!! It's sleek, compact, cute, sturdy and tucks into a corner of my living room. It's SO quiet!! I can't believe it! I can listen to music, TV, read or watch Youtube while riding. My last recumbent bike made lots of noise, so I couldn't cycle if anyone else was around. I love the simple display that gives me all the parameters I need, including pulse - which at my age, is a good idea to watch when exercising. I target my heart rate. I had to have my husband put it together for me because of the few electronic parts. I didn't want to mess it up. I suppose if I HAD to have done it myself, I'd have eventually gotten through it. It really wasn't that hard to do, my husband said. All the parts were clearly labeled, well packed (in spite of the box arriving opened and smashed). Nothing was broken or smashed. Instructions were clear. Seat is comfy. I LOVE IT!! I'd buy it again in a heart beat! :)
hypos: Perfektní posilovací kolo pro mě! Miluju tento malý stacionární bicykl! A cena je neuvěřitelně rozumná!! Je štíhlé, kompaktní, roztomilé, robustní a vejde se do rohu mého obývacího pokoje. Je to HODNĚ tiché!! Nemohu tomu uvěřit! Mohu poslouchat hudbu, televizi, číst nebo sledovat Youtube při jízdě. Můj poslední ležící bicykl dělal spoustu hluku, takže jsem nemohla jezdit, pokud byl někdo jiný poblíž. Miluji jednoduchý displej, který mi poskytuje všechny potřebné parametry, včetně pulsu - což v mém věku je dobrý nápad sledovat při cvičení. Cílím na svou srdeční frekvenci. Musela jsem nechat svého manžela, aby mi to sestavil kvůli několika elektronickým částem. Nechtěla jsem to pokazit. Myslím, že kdybych to MUSELA udělat sama, nakonec bych se s tím prokousala. Opravu to nebylo tak těžké udělat, řekl můj manžel. Všechny díly byly jasně označeny, dobře zabaleny (i přes to, že krabice dorazila otevřená a zmačkaná). Nic nebylo rozbité ani zmačkané. Návod byl jasný. Sedlo je pohodlné. MILUJI TO!! Koupila bych to znovu během srdce! :)

Musela jsem požádat svého manžela, aby mi to sestavil, protože tam bylo pár elektronických částí. Nechtěla jsem to pokazit. Myslím, že kdybych to MUSELA udělat sama, nakonec bych to zvládla. Opravu to nebylo tak těžké, říkal můj manžel. Všechny díly byly jasně označeny a dobře zabaleny (přestože krabice dorazila otevřená a zmačkaná). Nic nebylo rozbité ani poškozené. Návod byl srozumitelný. Sedlo je pohodlné. MILUJI TO!! Koupila bych to znovu v mžiku! :)

source_doc: Missing a piece (update) EDIT2 TO ADDAfter contacting the seller and letting them know what happened they have replaced my charging dock very quickly! They were more than accommodating and quick to respond <3 now that I can use this entire dock I absolutely love it!! I’m so happy with my experience.Edit to addI’ve had this since January, never being able to use the headset charging bc of the missing piece, however it worked for my controllers, I’ve used it about 5/6 times and yesterday I went to charge and noticed the right one didn’t turn red, I checked the health and it’s at 40% so I know it needs charged, this morning I tried again and still not luck! There’s nothing in the way it blocking the connectors! So basically I have a 50$ charging dock for my left controller 😢😩Well I’m only giving this 3 stars unfortunately I only get to use this to charge my controllers which works great. However the magnetic piece that is supposed to plug into my oculus to be able to charge it wasn’t in the box so I have no idea how well that one works and if you have silicone skins on your headset, it will not fit into the holder, which is not a huge deal. I assume You just take them off and back on like I do with the controllers

source_doc: In LOVE!! I have the rucksack (small) Gootium to carry groceries in but I wanted something that was just for me.  Soon as I opened the package I was in love!  I bought the "khaki" color but it looks golden to me.  It's gorgeous!!  I love all of the inside pockets, internal key clasp, the secret zip pocket on the back of the bag and the big zipper pocket on the front.  I love the smell of the leather on the handles and the zipper pulls are my fave! I was afraid of the straps twisting or fraying but there has been no problems so far but I also, don't weigh my bag down with heavy things. I was on the fence about getting this bag until this color came out and I knew I had to have it. I'm so glad that I did because it is my favorite bag I've had (and that says a lot because I'm a "Bag Lady" hahahaha!)

source_doc: Incredible speaker cable. I was looking for a speaker cable for my system. I had a pair of basic Nordost, so I started looking cable from different companies, if you are looking for 10 awg cable 15 feet length price starts from 5000$ a pair from AudioQuest, Nordost Kimber Cardas etc. I always look to Amazon before I look elsewhere, and I found this 10 awg 15 feet cable. I said what the hack, I will give a try, only 70$ for a pair. OMG no other tweak made this much improvement in my system. I felt like I have new amplifier and speakers. Everything improved unbelievably. Base is tight, fast, accurate, mind blowing. Mids opened up, vocals clarified. Sound stage and dept improved. Layering widened. You can hear everything, every cymbal every note. This is really a remarkable cable. Literally saved me 5000$. I can say best cable for the price. You will not believe your ears.

source_doc: Great for Price, Better after Tweaks. Loved the lamp. I am particularly fond of the design which is why I got it. As a student moving from dorm to dorm it folds nicely. Great Student lamp. It has two different strips of lights that cause the change in color. It is not the best light I have had but for the price it is pretty decent. Lumens I provides enough light for the tasks I perform at night which are normally just computer work, occasional solder, tiny tool usage and eating at my desk. I was really annoyed with where the switch was so I cut it off and reconnected close to the base of where the clamp is. I can now easily reach the on and off and lumen adjustment. I would have preferred the switch be closer to the head or arms of the lamp but I am happy with where it is now. I added a rubber pad to the clamp so I don't get charged for damages to the desk. I also had to un hinge a spring and tighten a few of the screws. The springs are unevenly strong that it pulls the light in funky ways and after removing a few and then tightening screws the lamp still adjusts and moves and stays where I want it. I have been pretty happy with it.

source_doc: Love This Air Fryer. I was hesitant to buy this air fryer because I wasn't familiar with the brand. I used to have a name brand air fryer and it died some time ago and I wasn't sure I needed to replace it because I wasn't using it much. I finally decided to try this one because of it's size and price. It's a perfect size for feeding 1 or 2 people. I also like the color. It's a big bigger than I had imagined before it arrived but it fits fine on my counter. This air fryer is easy to use and even easier to clean up; the non-stick interior just wipes right up. I still don't use an air fryer a lot on my whole food plant-based diet but I'm glad I got it. I think the price was reasonable and if you are looking for an air fryer, I highly recommend this brand.

source_doc: Fantastic , portable amp. This is my second positive grid amp, I also own the the bigger 40 watt version. This one is much smaller, easier to carry and just as easy to use as its bigger brother. I love that it has a built in battery and charges via usb C. I haven’t charged it in almost a month and it still holds a charge. Given, I don’t play very often. I would say about 2 hours a week. So I imagine you’d be charging it more often if you play a lot. It only has a couple of built in presets, so you must have a tablet or smartphone to get the best use out of it, but that isn’t a huge deal for me. I like it. I like being able to search an almost infinite library of tones that people have shared. You can also play music and jam along with the app. I love it! I can even Connect my wah or flanger pedal to this without a hitch. I don’t regret buying this. It’s perfect for home jam sessions. If I had to pick between this and it’s bigger brother I’d go with this one, just because of the built in battery and usb C port.

source_doc: Great for making some 'fancy' coffee. I really like this brother.  It's easy to use, and quicker and easier to clean than the frother cups (although, I do love my frother cup when I want heated milk).The frother itself is very nice quality, and the digital display is nice and clear.  I've had it for a few months now, and I haven't had any issues with it.  I've only tried the wisk attachment, because I can't for the life of me find the other attachment. I don't know if I didn't get it, or if I misplaced it.  But, the wisk does a great job at making some fluffy milk foam for my lattes!  Operation is smooth, and it's easy to adjust the strength of the mixer by twisting the little ring with the ridges.I keep this on the coffee station, in front of my frother cup, because I use this one more because of its ease of use when I'm in a rush (which is always).The stand only works for me if I remove the wisk attachment, so that's what I do.Overall, I'm really happy I got this.  It's been saving me a lot of money that would have gone to Starbucks.  Now, I have my own coffee shop in my home.  The price is comparable, and in my opinion this one is a better deal over others because of the smooth operation of it, along with the digital screen.

source_doc: I thought I would use it more. This UV light for nails is very lightweight and as simple to use as any I've ever used. I got this for when I do my nails, so I could cure my nails all at once rather than one at a time, and it definitely works good for that when it's the finished nails. I have nerve damage in my right hand,  so I actually find that initial gluing of nail to finger works better for me if I just stick with the single nail at a time. So, unfortunately, this has only been used 1 time. I really thought I would use it more,but it's too hard for me to keep my hand straight long enough to put all nails on then under the light. I just bend them and they come off and it becomes a mess. But, having said that, it is a decent light for anyone who will not have issues like I have. Or great for even curing nail decor that needs UV light after the nails are already glue on. I wish I could have given a better review of this product, but from what I can tell, it does what it says, and works as good as it says. So I am going to give it a 5 star based off it being exactly as stated in the description.

source_doc: Good lock for the price. I like this lock so far.  I attached the mount to my bike via the water bottle bolts, but I decided to move it to my bike bag instead.  The mount worked fine, I just missed having my bottle there.  This lock is pretty heavy, which is to be expected.  It is large enough for any bike rack and most poles I would use to lock up my bike.  It is too short for locking down your frame and front wheel to a thick pole.My only complaint is that the coating might end up scratching or wearing the paint on my bike.  This has not happened yet since I don't lock my bike up often, but I really wish there was some rubber on the parts that contact the bike.  I am considering adding some foam tape or something similar to limit the wear.All in all, this is a great folding lock for the money.  I like to budget about 20% of the bike's value for its lock so this falls well within that range for most of my bikes.  I will still use higher-security locks for any very expensive bikes, but that is just due to the higher risk involved.  This lock is far more secure than most cable locks I have seen and is much easier to carry than a U-lock, so this gets my recommendation.

source_doc: Nice to have on the road. I ordered this because I stay on the road and thought that it would be a good addition to my vehicle. I like the tray that sits up high so that when I’m driving and if I need to eat on a snack in between destinations I can. This extended cupholder makes it really convenient. It’s also convenient when I have multiple cups or bottles that I need to sit in the vehicle. So far it’s worked out pretty well. At first I didn’t know how to tighten it so that it would stay in the vehicle original cupholder but after looking at it for a few minutes, I saw that you actually turn the bottom which expands the sides to ensure a secured fit.  The only issue that I have is that the cupholders and tray seems a little difficult to turn. At first it got in the way of my gear shaft. If you’re not using the extended cup holder, it can seem a little bulky as far as room space . So at times I will take it down if I’m not going to use it in a reasonable time.

source_doc: Warm White Light Bulb. Exactly whT I expected. I got the warm white color. 3000 Lumen or whatever the rating is. I knew these were not dimmable. I didn't see the note on the site that clearly says do most dim these or else they may flicker or hum. My microwave does have 2 settings for lighting underneath. They do flicker a bit only when on the lower setting. As they clearly posted. However, I decided before I bought these to not use the lower setting. Not a big deal. We use it as a kitchen night light. Why didn't I buy the dimmable ones? Because the ones I saw came in a pack of 6 and I only needed 2. If it really bothers me later I will buy dimmable lol. These are good bulbs. I didn't rate the longevity because they have only been in my microwave for 5 mins.
hypos: Teplá bílá žárovka. Přesně to, co jsem očekával/a. Dostal/a jsem teplou bílou barvu. 3000 lumenů nebo jakékoli je hodnocení. Věděl/a jsem, že nejsou stmívatelné. Neviděl/a jsem poznámku na webu, která jasně říká, že většina z nich není stmívatelná, jinak mohou blikající nebo hučet. Můj mikrovlnná trouba má 2 nastavení pro osvětlení pod ní. Trochu blikají jen při nižším nastavení. Jak jasně uvedli. Rozhodl/a jsem se však před koupí těchto, že nižší nastavení nebudu používat. Není to velký problém. Používáme to jako noční světlo do kuchyně. Proč jsem nekoupil/a stmívatelné? Protože ty, které jsem viděl/a, byly v balení po 6 a potřeboval/a jsem jen 2. source_doc: Headset is great! But I didn’t get my extra batteries! The headset is really nice I love it! It’s very comfy, the strap is not really necessary and can easily be removed entirely which I did to give it a bit more movement. The honeycomb style rubber swappable inside is nice as well. The passing is very soft and does the job nicely. I definitely see myself using this headset daily! But unfortunately I also got this combo because it came with extra batteries. I didn’t even get a single battery. Let alone 2! I thought the package felt light but all that was in it was the pieces to assemble the headset. There was a smaller box with what I thought were batteries but it was just a dock to charge batteries! Which was weird because I bought the combo pack. Is there anyone on the support team I can talk to about getting my batteries? Other than that everything’s great but my rating will remain unless I get my batteries because that’s what I paid more for to not get them makes the entire headset kinda weird looking and useless with the empty spot at the back of the headset.

source_doc: Worth it so far! I live in the Carolinas and have a lot of humidity here. I was 24 and pregnant with my only girl when my hair went from straight and unable to hold curl at all, to being super wavey, frizzy, and stubborn. Fast forward 20 years and I have tried I swear all the curly hair products with not much luck. I wash my hair twice a week. I have used this product 3 times since my purchase. Right out of the box this smell is AMAZING! After the wash my hair felt a bit dry, I did not use any product because I wanted to give a proper review, once dry my hair was soft, and manageable even without product. The poof was minimal, and the dry feeling decreased as it dried. I have used this with product twice, and the wave definition is unreal! I am very happy and satisfied with the product, and will continue to purchase it. I have since bought everyone in my home their own bars. Make sure to get the correct one for your hair type, but don't hesitate, this is awesome stuff!
hypos: Stálo to za to zatím! Žiji v Karolínách a mám tu hodně vlhkosti. Bylo mi 24 a byla jsem těhotná se svou jedinou dcerou, když mi vlasy šly z rovného a nebyly schopné udržet kudrny vůbec, na super vlnité, krepaté a tvrdohlavé. O 20 let později jsem vyzkoušela, přísahám, všechny produkty na kudrnaté vlasy s moc šťastným výsledkem. Myji si vlasy dvakrát týdně. Tento produkt jsem použila 3krát od doby, co jsem si ho koupila. Hned po otevření krabice je tenhle pach ÚŽASNÝ! Po umytí se mi vlasy zdály trochu suché, žádný produkt jsem nepoužila, protože jsem chtěla dát správnou recenzi, jakmile uschly, byly mé vlasy měkké a snadno ovladatelné, i bez produktu. Objemy bylo minimální a suchý pocit se s sušením snižoval. Použila jsem to s produktem dvakrát a definice vlny je neskutečná! Jsem velmi ráda/štěstná a spokojená se produktem a budu ho i nadále kupovat. Od té doby jsem koupila všem doma jejich vlastní tyčinky. Ujistěte se, že si vyberete tu správnou pro váš typ vlasů, ale neváhejte, tohle je úžasná věc!

source_doc: It's noisy but there's a cheap and easy fix. For the price it is a great elliptical. The resistance levels are good and I get a whole body workout on this thing. It's sturdy enough for the asking price, but the bolts on the main strut make an extremely irritating noise after a while due to the metal washer rubbing against the metal of the strut. I was pulling my hair out over this for a long time, because for a while I wasn't even sure exactly where the sound was coming from. Eventually I narrowed it down to the bolts holding together the two parts of the main support beam. I tried tightening them, lubricating them with WD-40, but nothing worked. I was about ready to throw the whole unit away until I had an epiphany one day. What if I put some rubber in between the metal washers and the strut? All I did was take a spare koozie I had lying around and cut 1-inch squares out of it. In the squares I cut a slit half way up the center and a 1/4" hole in the middle. I then loosened the bolts and slid the rubber koozie square between the washer and the main support and tightened the bolts again. Now the machine is silent! I couldn't be happier now.
hypos: Je to hlučné, ale existuje levné a snadné řešení. Za tu cenu je to skvělý eliptický trenažér. Úrovně odporu jsou dobré a mám na tom kompletní trénink celého těla. Je dostatečně pevný/á za tu cenu, ale šrouby na hlavní vzpěře po chvíli vydávají extrémně iritující zvuk kvůli kovové podložce, která se tře o kov vzpěry. Dlouho jsem si s tím lámal/a hlavu, protože jsem si nějakou dobu nebyl/a ani jistý/á, odkud ten zvuk přichází. Nakonec jsem to zúžil/a na šrouby, které drží spolu dvě části hlavního nosného trámu. Zkusil/a jsem je utáhnout, namazat WD-40, ale nic nefungovalo. Byl/a jsem téměř připraven/a celou jednotku vyhodit, až se jednoho dne dostavila epifanie. Co kdybych dal/a nějakou gumu mezi kovové podložky a vzpěru? Vzal/a jsem jen náhodně ležící koozie a vystřihl/a z něj čtverce o velikosti 2,5 cm. Do čtverců jsem vystřihl/a štěrbinu až k polovině a otvor o průměru 0,6 cm uprostřed. source_doc: Soooo much easier than I thought. My slider was in such bad shape it took Rocky to open it. I didn’t want to pay megabucks for a repair man so I decided to try myself. I am a 56 yr woman but I am handy. I did need help getting the door on and off because it is heavy. You lift and pull out from the bottom. Now that’s the hardest part! With my particular door I only needed to take out 2 screws on each side and the rollers removed in a slot next to the screws. Replace the rollers and screws that’s it. One of the screws gives you the ability to raise and lower door. I wish I had done this a year ago. I can not tell you about how long this item will last but I can tell you I can open my door with 1 finger now. Hint.. when putting the door back on be sure the rollers are level with the door, not sticking out.The product itself seemed flimsy to me. Not as solid as I thought but it was I believe $20 and works great. Now If I need to replace it soon I won’t cry over my $20If your a newbee like me. Just do it.

source_doc: Super helpful to prevent foggy lenses. I was tired of getting foggy glasses every time I worked out with my Quest 2. I had to interrupt my workout to sit in front of a fan every 3 minutes otherwise I couldn't see what I was doing. I was so annoyed that I had to wear glasses, but without them everything was blurry. Once I got this cooling fan I haven't had this issue anymore. I should have gotten this a long time ago. The only reason I would give it 4 1/2 stars is because for some reason the attachement moves very easily. I dont think it attaches properly, but it's not a big deal to me. I just adjust it and start playing.

source_doc: Cable works great, Operator is clueless. A few decades ago I was a techie and computer programmer.  However management and 20 years in retirement have taken a toll on my knowledge as this stuff keeps getting more complicated.  Before the Quest 2 I had an Oculus Go since it came out.  I finally decided it was time to upgrade with the 2.  I'm struggling comprehending this new adventure.  I probably should have just stayed with the Go.Anyway, I thought tying the 2 to my laptop would do something for me so I ordered this cable as the cableless method reportedly has disconnects.  I found information on line on how to connect and started the process.  I found the required software, App in today's vocabulary, and loaded  it on my laptop.  I had one hiccup attaching the cable since my laptop only has USB C connections and I needed an A.  I tried one adapter and it wouldn't connect.  However, on a second one, it hooked right up.The cable works great as far as linking your PC to the Quest 2.  What you do afterward, I don't have a clue.  I think I need to find a seven year old to teach me or find the Youtube that I haven't found yet.

source_doc: So sadly disappointed. I bought this sticker for my son’s wall above his computer where he plays his computer games. I thought that the pattern and the writing style were super cool and I knew my 10-year-old would love it. I ended up ordering this item twice because the first time it never arrived the second one that I got. I cleaned my wall before sticking it and  made sure it was dry before placing it where I wanted it. Once I stuck it on, I could tell there were going to be problems because it immediately started peeling on the sides where the first letter is and the last letter is the next morning after the day I put it up the entire sticker had fallen off my wall. I wish I could send it back, since I have it stuck to a piece of cardboard in case the company will work with me and returning it but please don’t buy this unless your walls have no pattern or any type of raised parts to it. I’m not sure if that’s why it didn’t stick but I cleaned it and ride it so I don’t see why the sticker did not stay on my wall.

source_doc: Worth the price. I hate chapped lips but I'm particular in what I want in my chapstick. Yes, it's cool that treat beauty offers cool flavor options and I really like the gummy bear flavor. However, there are other qualities in a chapstick that I find more important. 1) I hate when you apply chapstick and then it leaves a residual chemical/chapstick flavor on your lips. I am happy to report that this chapstick doesn't do that. It's slightly sweet, but not with a weird chemical taste. 2) I hate reapplying chapstick every 30 minutes or so. For me a good chapstick will linger on your lips until you eat. I drink water throughout the day and I don't want to reapply chapstick every time I take a sip of water. Yes, I know it will wear off, but a good chapstick wear off slower. This is a good chapstick by my standards.Added bonuses are the variety of flavors, cute packaging and huge size. I just ordered more from the treat beauty website because my daughter loves the gummy bear flavor and I told her she could have it.

A cream background. Four BIG dogs. Spring (mud season) coming out here in the sticks where the ground gets so saturated in spring it is like walking through a muddy swamp.I may put it in our guest bedroom. The canines are really never allowed in there unless one follows me, so I feel it will be best place for it. It will stay cleaner and pretty, and I have no worries about general wear and tear and dirt in a bedroom. It looks really pretty.

source_doc: Best sleep ever!!! Okay, so I know this is an "Air Bed" (super-sized mattress) and not a standard or "real" bed but I've tried a bunch of "real" beds and have consistently had lower-back pain when I got up each morning. In desperation I thought I couldn't lose by buying and trying this Air Bed. Changed my life!!! EXTREMELY comfortable ALL NIGHT LONG! As you can see from the pics, I use it differently than most: (a) I found the fabric side with the channels to be less comfortable than the bottom so I inverted it with wonderful results; (b) by inverting the bed, the fabric catches on the carpet better than the smooth side so it doesn't shift when I get on or off of it; and (c) I didn't want to have to deal with fitting sheets so I just bought an inexpensive sleeping bad and it worked perfectly. I have the twin xl version and a double sleeping bag fits just right. I use this EVERY NIGHT and have been doing so for weeks. I do have to top off the air each night for about 10 or 15 seconds as there is a tiny leak. I couldn't find any air escaping so I'm assuming it's getting out through the built-in fan assembly. source_doc: Great stuff. I first bought thus through somebody i know who lives im Mexico. At the start I didn’t like it because of the strong fragrance and i had breakouts. I stopped using it but my husband loves it so I re-ordered. I then tried it agian “just because” … i kind of adjusted to the smell and i no longer get breakouts.  My friend said to just use a “pea” size bcoz it spread out all over the face.Since i have a lot of products I leave it for my husband to use. I use it only every once in while.Highly recommended.

source_doc: Grainy texture, mild flavor. I wasn't impressed with how the safety seal came right off when I opened the lid. Was it secure? This is a packaging flaw I shouldn't have overlooked, but everything else seemed clean and intact, so I gave it a go.As for the gummies, which I did try (against my better judgment?) they have a mild taste that could be strawberry, but just seemed kind of generic, and have a very grainy texture that I do not enjoy. I wanted to try these in particular because this is a brand I thought I liked, but now I'm wondering if I misremembered.Overall I would not buy again, unless I was assured the packaging issue was fixed. If their manufacturing and packaging practices are truly cGMP as claimed, this seal issue should never have made it to the hands of buyers.

source_doc: Headache relief!! Sometimes I need 2-3 ice packs for my head when I have a bad headache. I usually use the eye mask kind but stretch it across my forehead, but then I can't get relief across the top of my head when I have tension headaches. I just tossed this pack into the freezer. I forgot about it and expected a block of ice, but wow. This head wrap was still soft and pliable, not frozen at all. It was cold like it was frozen though! I slipped the wrap over my head and immediately realized this product is way better than everything I used before. I can get relief in all areas of my head and eyes, unlike all of my other packs. The material is soft and silky like a fancy eye mask. I will be ordering more to switch out since I usually need more than one pack. I'm really relieved to have found a great product to help me deal with my tension headaches.

source_doc: These really work! I took these for the first time and had great results. I chose a night when I was pretty sure I would have trouble sleeping (Sunday night for teachers is the worst and I napped too much on Sunday afternoon). I took one gummy a hour and a half before bed because I wanted to make sure it wore off by morning. I was sleepy within 30 minutes! I made myself wait until bedtime and then slept peacefully. My cat woke me up once and I woke up another time naturally to go to the bathroom. Normally I wake up several times a night, so this was a huge improvement. I also have an issue with eating snacks at night, but I did not eat a single thing that night. I’m not sure if it keeps you too tired to be hungry or if it creates an appetite suppressant effect, but whatever it is, I am pleasantly surprised. I will be reordering when I run out. I will also be taking the gummy closer to bedtime!

source_doc: My feet don't hurt this morning. I expected these inserts to have an effect while I was wearing them - and they did. I was surprised about the impact the next day. My first steps after getting up were pain free, and I can't remember the last time that happened. I'm definitely sold on these insoles. Though the packaging says it can take two to three days to get used to them, my right foot was completely comfortable immediately. The left not so much. I won't call it UNcomfortable, but definitely more noticeable. That's a "me" issue, though.My feet were slightly more sweaty when I took off my shoes after about four hours, but not annoyingly so. Of maybe I just didn't notice because I live with a teen athlete and anything other than cleat feet doesn't register.I found the template a little annoying. Not enough to knock off a full star, but maybe an eighth of a star. Neither of the shoes I use these in has removable linings. I tried the template on the outside of the shoe, as it suggests, and, to no surprise, it said I needed the full-length insert, which didn't fit in my shoe. I got it right after three rounds of trial and error, but perhaps marking with template with shoes sizes (men's on one, women's on the other) would eliminate a few steps.

source_doc: Once Upon A Time. Once upon a time I used to stand on a metal box that I place on a chair just so I could reach the light bulb socket.  This light bulb socket is located in the hallway leading upstairs.  So I had to place a chair on steps that was dangerous.  Now that I am older (60 years), weigh more and not comfortable with relying on my stability, I searched for something that I could use to reach the light bulb socket safely.  I am so happy that I found this product.  I did not buy the pole but used a old sponge mop pole which worked just as well.A lot of people said that they had problems with the spiral light bulbs, I did notice that as I was screwing counter clockwise, the standard light bulb gripper also was unscrewing.  I just tightened the screw on the light bulb gripper onto the mop pole and it worked.  I haven't tried any of the other grippers but am looking forward to seeing if it will work on the flood light bulb outside.

source_doc: Nice Fit and Look but Having to Replace the Washer Nozzle with OEM Disappointing. I really liked the look of this and it was a perfect replacement. I ordered the black version to accent my Black Jeep which I was really glad I did for the look!However there is where my problems came and why I only gave 3 stars. It comes with a paper saying to replace the Washer Nozzle that comes with it with the old OEM version from the one you are removing.YOU MUST DO THIS because The Nozzle that comes with it is terrible and basically squirts a stream of water down the back instead of spraying it. I found this out the hard way.First, because I ordered the Black version it would look real goofy with the Red nozzle on it. That’s why I ignored the manufacturers direction. So I had to mask off and paint my old red nozzle to match black.Second, because the original OEM nozzle was old the plastic was brittle and one of the securing clips molded into it was broken in the process. You cannot buy just the nozzle and have to buy the whole light assembly so I had to do some engineering to make it work.The manufacturer needs to fix this functional nozzle issue and not make Customers have to hassle with this. If it weren’t for this I would have given it 5 stars!

source_doc: Takes fabric pilling off sweaters, couches.... Well, I did it.  I read several of the reviews and took the plunge.  Usually I take a pair of old hair clippers and shave my sweaters but that has caused too many snags.  This little shaver DOES NOT create snags.  You charge this little bugger up and in no time you're digging through your closet and bringing out stuff you forgot you had and shaving everything down.  After that now I have sweaters ready to wear and a pile destined for a Lawn Sale.  What can I say... it's the cycle of clothing.  I like just about everything about this shaver.  It's small, rechargeable, fits in my hand well the only thing that I found a tad irritating is emptying out the collection of sweater lint/nubs.  It was really difficult at first and to pop it off I had to ask my husband hoping that he wouldn't break it.  He got it off and we emptied the bin and it was a hard snap back in.  It kinda scared me at the amount of force that had to be used.  It did NOT break (phew) and I've been using it practically weekly.  Overall - I would agree with the reviews and the amount of people who have purchased this item.  It really gets the job done. Enjoy and I hope you don't become a fanatic about keeping your sweaters pristine like I have. (slight nervous laugh).

source_doc: I LOVE This Little Light Of Mine. All kidding aside, I really love this little tactical flashlight.  The light is extremely bright and and versatile.  LED really does make a difference and it seems like the battery life is extremely long after a full charge.  The price is absolutely reasonable and I have been using this little flashlight for over 6 months and oddly, I find myself having to use it more than I thought I would.  I usually always buy those cheapy ones at the hardware store, they don't last very long and aren't anywhere close to as bright as this one is.  The fact that you can recharge is definitely a money saving bonus.  This would make a great gift for anyone as well.  I have since purchased 3 more so that I can keep them handy in different locations like the vehicle, that tool box, my desk and the tackle box.  I highly recommend this one and I hope you find this review helpful!

source_doc: So HAPPY with this roll!!  Delighted! I have a Cuisinart Steam Toaster Oven and its very difficult finding pans that fit correctly. They are usually half an inch too long in one direction. Being my only oven, I want as large as will fit.  Before now, I buy a roll of  Parchment Paper and cut it to size each time. The one with already cut sheets are too big. The ones I tear off I always have to adjust and fold over the edges and so on. A real Pain. I cut a piece off this roll to size first and then one a little bigger that goes up the sides a little. Sometimes I only need to wipe it with a wonder sponge and its clean! I am Happy beyond words!  I found once in a while it stains, however, not often. I simply remove it, wash with a Wonder Sponge and its Clean! No grease left over like my other ready made silicon mats. I imagine the Wonder sponge would clean them too. (I only use it for specific things like this.) I have baked several things on the first sheet and it still looks new! Very Happy with this purchase. Just rolled the roll back in the paper and tucked in the ends for the next thing I think of to use it for! Perhaps rolling out pastry?

source_doc: Probably my favorite mouse of all time. I had a G502 Hero wired mouse before this one. The way I had my cables routed I was constantly dealing with drag issues. I would leave the mouse still and watch the cursor move as the cable sagged. It's a minor annoyance at best...and I could have fixed it...but I treated myself to a new mouse and I'm not disappointed in the slightest. I'm not really a huge gamer but I do IT work from home and am at the computer for 8 - 12 hours pretty much every day. A comfortable mouse is a must and this is it! The battery seems to last about 2 - 3 weeks between charges. If I ever have to go back to the office, the fact that this is the non-RGB version works in my favor and it won't attract too much attention.The software is a bit on the finicky side. I like to run mine at 6400dpi. The defaults are not great and when the software updates I'm stuck waiting for the speed to pick up again while watching the splash animation play out. I kind of got around this by enabling on-board memory mode but even then it randomly turned down the DPI for no discernible reason. I'm not hitting the buttons either, I have the default DPI up and down buttons disabled as well as the profile select button.

source_doc: Does not work... never did. Bought in 2020 didnt use it right away, just wanted to have it on hand when I needed it. When I finally needed it would not turn on... and it has never worked!Ive tried it on a 2006 pontiac G6, 2002 GMC Yukon, and a 2009 Jeep wrangler. It never turned on. I thought it was just me using it wrong. Then I lost it in some boxes. Found it three months ago and tried it in the jeep. It wouldnt turn on.03/11/23 I thought Id try it again in a 2002 GMC sierra... it didnt turn on. Tried it on a buddies s10 and it came on but wouldnt connect.Updated 03/19/23 I went back to the 2002 GMC sierra and started checking fuses. Found 2 blown fuses (cigarrete & DRL) and replaced. Reconnected scanner tool. It comes on but wont connect. Retried multiple times... same results. Next I guess is the drag test... where you use a paper clip to test each pin hole on the vehicles scanner port under the dash.After reading some other peoples reviews of this unit, I thought I should add my review to the list. No pins are broken, none are bent, and plug was pushed all the way in.If I could return it I would its really been no help so far, and a waste of money...

source_doc: slightly narrow, might want to size up. Good grip on dry items. Basic good gloves. Basic, decent gloves. Nice for added grip on dry items (love gloves of this style for picking up/moving heavy items). Glad to have them, but there isn't much stretch. Usually the work gloves of this sort will have a decent amount of stretch for best fit. I find that these run a tad small. II have 3.75" wide palms with short fingers. These XXL fit, and I can just pinch a little extra material, but I suspect these would be a very tight fit on truly beefy XXL hands.I originally was going to go with a Large, or maybe XL, but decided on the max size since sometimes I wear a pair of thin liner gloves under these gloves when I am working out in colder temps. I can probably still do that, but I think it will be tight.  Anayway.. I grabbed the XXl because I figured bigger is better. I am really surprised how narrow these are. Doubt they would have fit at all if I went based on the size chart.Fingers are quite long. My fingers are on the short side, so I am used to a little overhang, but these have more overhang than usual.Despite the odd fit, they have been and will be used. Price is reasonable for a pack of 3 ($10.99) not that I rate on price.3.5/4 stars
hypos: Trochu úzké, možná byste měli zvolit větší velikost. Dobrý grip na suché věci. Základní dobré rukavice. Základní, slušné rukavice. Pěkné pro lepší uchopení suchých předmětů (miluji rukavice tohoto stylu na zvedání/přesouvání těžkých předmětů). Jsem rád/a, že je mám, ale není tam moc pružnosti. Obvykle pracovní rukavice tohoto druhu mají slušné množství pružnosti pro nejlepší padnutí. Zjistil/a jsem, že tyto jsou malinko malé. Mám dlaně široké 3,75" s krátkými prsty. Tyto XXL sedí, a mohu jen trochu přichytit extra materiál, ale mám podezření, že by toto byly velmi těsné rukavice na opravdu robustní XXL ruce. Původně jsem měl/a jít do velikosti Large, nebo možná XL, ale rozhodl/a jsem se pro maximální velikost, protože někdy nosím pod těmito rukavicemi tenké podšívkové rukavice, když cvičím ve studenějších teplotách. Pravděpodobně to ještě mohu udělat, ale myslím, že to bude těsné. Každopádně jsem vzal/a XXL, protože jsem si myslel/a, že větší je lepší. Opravu mě překvapuje, jak úzké jsou. Pochybuji, že by vůbec seděly, kdybych se řídil/a tabulkou velikostí. Prsty jsou docela dlouhé. Moje prsty jsou na krátké straně, takže jsem zvyklý/á na malé přesahy, ale tyto mají více přesahu než obvykle. I přes zvláštní padnutí byly a budou používány. Cena je rozumná za balení 3 ($10.99), i když to nehodnotím podle ceny. 3.5/4 hvězdičky.

source_doc: Easy to swallow capsules. I purchased a bottle of Surebounty Magnesium Malate 90 count. When reading all the pro’s & con’s about this product, I knew I wanted to try it. The one thing I liked was the fact their capsules are so easy to swallow. That means a lot to me. As I get older I am not able to swallow big capsules anymore. The direction on the bottle says you can take 1-4 capsules a day. I have been taking 2. The reason I do that is because I take other supplements that already has some magnesium malate in it. I am happy to see they do not use any fillers or binders. The capsules are non GMO/dairy/gluten free. So far I am very pleased with this product. I would definitely recommend.

source_doc: I wish I found this sooner. I’ve had my leather couch for about a year and my bulldogs had put a few scratches on it and I knew I had to do something to protect it fast.  I ordered several different kinds of covers and had to send them all back because my cushions are connected to the couch.  This doesn’t move very much and so far I’m not having to constantly adjust it even when I recline it, they go back pretty much like they were.  My frenchie is crazy and she runs and flies onto the couch like a tiger is chasing her and it has stayed put for all those shenanigans so far.  The rubber grippers on the back work well.  I haven’t washed it yet but when I do I will air dry it because I know from past experience that a dryer will ruin them.  I wish I had found this cover and started using it when I first bought the couch but better late than never.

source_doc: Good wireless earbuds. These are nice wireless earbuds. They fit pretty good, I have had one fall out a few times at the gym (I may need to change to a different ear cushion, which are included). I think the sound is very good, I like the bass-heavy music while working out. They seem to hold a charge a long time. The controls are a bit sensitive and I’ve accidentally skipped the controls I wanted. I have not used this for phone calls, so I cannot comment on the quality of talking on the phone. When I first connected my phone to these, the Bluetooth for the ear buds came up twice, and I only could hear out of one speaker (depending which one I chose, the left or the right) and I couldn’t get them to sync. The way I resolved it was “forgetting” both and shutting my Bluetooth off, then after turning it back on, it was only listed once, and they’ve worked fine ever since.

Tento produkt jsem nepoužil/a na telefonní hovory, takže nemohu komentovat kvalitu telefonování. source_doc: I Don't Know How I Ever Lived Without! I had to buy myself one after I babysat a baby who's mom had packed this for her! I HATE putting cream on with my fingers. I don't know how I raised two kids without it. It is so easy to spread and it's even easier to wipe clean. I love the suction cup feature so that I can suction it while I finish changing the diaper, to prevent the cream from touching anything else until I can get it wiped off. 10000000% recommend.

source_doc: Incredible audio and customer service! I purchased this monitor in June of 2021. I use it for monitoring my mom with severe Alzheimer's. The sound quality is amazing! I can hear her breathing from across the room on this monitor. Sunday morning about 2 am, I started getting a notification beep that the battery was about dead on my monitor. I checked the cord, battery, everything. I emailed customer support at 2:30 in the morning on a Sunday morning, I had a response later Sunday. Long story short, they expedited a replacement cord to me and I received it just now (Tuesday morning). Free of charge. Wow!The picture quality is pretty good, just small on this camera, but as I said the audio is amazing. $49 is a steal for this camera! I have purchased a lot of baby monitors to find the best one. This has much better sound pickup than any of the others I tried- including expensive ones. Expensive price is not equivalent to quality. This is a great buy! I can't say enough good about them. Oh yeah, the monitor also will pick up across the street as well. I can carry it over to visit with a neighbor and keep an eye on my mom as she sleeps.Buy it!

source_doc: Find your studs before ordering. I assumed I would not have trouble laying out the footprint I hade in mind. But the studs in my garage walls appear to be irregularly spaced. Two different stud finder tools failed to help. So I had to probe around. I attempted to pop the wall plates off of a light switch and an outlet, identify the corresponding wall stud, and measure in 16 inch increments and higher, and couldn’t figure a consistent interval. So I ended up just using my smallest drill bit with some guesswork until I found enough spots that would work.Wish I had spent some time getting lines down on every possible stud before I opened boxes and stuff everywhere. I made it work by combining some 4’ and 3’ spans (from the 6’ model).Now that I got them up, I’m satisfied with how they look and getting my crap off the floor.

Any of them that I it was about to purchase before I either returned, or did not purchase because they were not sufficient. But I was desperate and needed to find some thing at all before my guests arrived and this one is the closest I could find to what I have been looking for! It’s well-made , it’s a good quality and fits about 97% of what I’m looking for therefore I do recommend.

source_doc: Easy to setup. I have some of these smart plugs and they are a different brand, When I set them up it took me a couple of try's to get them connected. The RCA was fairly easier. The only problem I had was I think I plugged it in too soon and it had stopped blinking so it would not connect. Once I noticed it had stopped blinking I reset it and it had it connected in less than 3 minutes. I have been using this for a few days with no problems. O know with the other brand I have to reset them periodically so I am hoping this one will go longer. If I have any problems I will provide an update.

source_doc: Clear, not colored. As much as I love these little guys, I feel the description is misleading. The photo shows these are colored, and I honestly would probably not have ordered had I known they were not. I hate when this happens, as a simple adjustment to the title, would have solved any misunderstanding of whether they were colored or not. Or switching the opening photo. Still, they are very cute, thicker, yet small Mason jars. They are the same size, thickness, etc that I imagined they would be when ordering, just not the color. Overall, these would be great for little gifts, or just cute little guys to have for no other reason than they are just cute. I had the idea of filling with glitter in my craft room. Give them the color I thought they had. I have not yet decided what I will do with these yet,  but if it's a good one, I would order more for sure. The quality is there, and again, just cute cute cute. Many uses. The only reason I deducted a star was for the misunderstanding of what I thought I was getting (colored) versus what I got (clear). It in no way reflects quality. Quality and usefulness would definitely recieve a 5 star rating.
hypos: Jasné, nebarevné. Tak moc, jak tyto malé kousky miluji, cítím, že popis je zavádějící. Fotografie ukazuje, že jsou barevné, a upřímně bych je pravděpodobně neobjednal/a, kdybych věděl/a, že nejsou. Nenávidím, když se to stane, protože jednoduchá úprava názvu by vyřešila jakékoli nedorozumění ohledně toho, zda jsou barevné nebo ne. Nebo změna úvodní fotografie. Přesto jsou velmi roztomilé, silnější, ale malé sklenice Mason. Jsou stejné velikosti, tloušťky atd., jaké jsem si představoval/a, když jsem objednával/a, jen ne té barvy. Celkově by byly skvělé na malé dárky, nebo jen jako roztomilé malé kousky, které mít bez jiného důvodu, než že jsou prostě roztomilé. Měl/a jsem nápad naplnit je třpytkami ve své dílně. Dát jim barvu, o které jsem si myslel/a, že mají. Ještě jsem se nerozhodl/a, co s nimi udělám, ale pokud to bude dobrý nápad, určitě bych objednal/a více. Kvalita je tam, a znovu, prostě roztomilé roztomilé roztomilé. Mnoho použití. Jediným důvodem, proč jsem odečetl/a hvězdičku, bylo nedorozumění ohledně toho, co jsem si myslel/a, že dostanu (barevné) versus co jsem dostal/a (čiré). To v žádném případě neodráží kvalitu. source_doc: Good product for my dogs. First I want to start by saying that I tought this was CBD, I didn't know hemp is a bit different. I still don't fully get it. Before I was giving my elderly dog CBD tincture from med terra, but 1oz is about $28 plus tax and shipping. Expensive! I decided to give this a try but did wonder why it was so cheap. Anyway, my dogs dont mind it as I put it on their food. It has helped my elderly dog with her anxiety as she is blind and has gotten very anxious. I am giving it to all my dogs daily and I see they sleep better and are more calmed as my babies tend to be anxious and have lots of separation anxiety. My elderly dog has Glaucoma and although it is a condition the vet will most likely need to remove the eye. I noticed that upon giving her the hemp oil, the inflammation of the eye has reduced a lot. I don't know if its helping the pain as my dog can't tell me but I definitely noticed her eye that was about to pop, did sink down a lot. Meanwhile I save for the very expensive eye removal. I give it to her daily in a higher dose than stated as she is most anxious and  has her bad eye. I am on the second bottle and just ordered more.
hypos: Dobrý produkt pro mé psy. Nejprve chci říct, že jsem si myslel/a, že to je CBD, nevěděl/a jsem, že konopí je trochu jiný. Pořád to úplně nechápu. Dříve jsem dával/a svému staršímu psovi CBD tinkturu od med terra, ale 1 oz stojí asi 28 dolarů plus daň a poštovné. Drahé! Rozhodl/a jsem se to vyzkoušet, ale přemýšlel/a jsem, proč je to tak levné. Každopádně, mým psům to nevadí, když to dávám na jejich jídlo. Pomohlo to mému staršímu psovi s její úzkostí, protože je slepá a velmi úzkostná. Dávám to všem svým psům každý den a vidím, že spí lépe a jsou klidnější, zatímco moje děti mají tendenci být úzkostné a trpí velkou separační úzkostí. Můj starší pes má glaukom a i když je to stav, veterinář pravděpodobně bude muset oko odstranit. Všiml/a jsem si, že po podání konopného oleje se zánět oka hodně snížil. Nevím, jestli to pomáhá s bolestí, protože mi můj pes nemůže říct, ale rozhodně jsem si všiml/a, že její oko, které mělo brzy prasknout, se hodně snížilo. Mezitím šetřím na velmi drahé odstranění oka. Dávám jí to každý den ve větší dávce, než je uvedeno, protože je nejsvízelnější a má své špatné oko. Jsem na druhé lahvi a právě jsem objednal/a více.

source_doc: Looks Nice, Quality Is Good, But... ...it didn't fit the dog I ordered it for. Did I measure wrong? I don't know, but I usually order a small or medium for my Chiweenie, this time I ordered a medium and it just doesn't fit. It's too small. The velcro straps barely touch when I put it on him, and it's too big to fit my next smaller dog.However, the quality is very good. It appears very sturdy and well made. I like that the velcro area on the strips is pretty big, so it really offers a secure closure, plus the 2nd closure option, the buckle, also feels sturdy.It's not adjustable in the sense that you can't shorten or lengthen any straps, but it is adjustable in the sense that you can adjust the velcro closure to fit.It's mesh and breathable and looks quite nice. The only thing I would see as a con, (instead of a "pro"), at least for me, is that it doesn't have a any stretch like other similar harnesses do. I feel like with a little bit of stretch, there's a little bi of give, so it doesn't hurt him if I happen to pull on the harness. Some owners may not want any stretch, so I guess this just depends on preference.All in all, I do recommend it based on quality, but unfortunately, it just didn't fit. Make sure to measure correctly!
hypos: Vypadá to hezky, kvalita je dobrá, ale... ...neudělalo to těm psům, pro které jsem to objednal/a, dobře. Změřil/a jsem špatně? Nevím, ale obvykle objednávám malé nebo střední pro svou Chiweenie, tentokrát jsem objednal/a střední a prostě to nepadne. Je to příliš malé. Suché zipy se sotva dotýkají, když mu to nasazuji, a je to příliš velké na to, aby to padlo mému dalšímu menšímu psu. Kvalita je však velmi dobrá. Zdá se, že je to velmi pevné a dobře vyrobené. Líbí se mi, že plocha suchého zipu na popruzích je dost velká, takže to opravdu nabízí bezpečné uzavření, navíc druhá uzavírací možnost, spona, také působí robustně. Není to nastavitelné v tom smyslu, že byste nemohli zkracovat nebo prodlužovat žádné popruhy, ale je to nastavitelné v tom smyslu, že můžete upravit uzavření suchého zipu tak, aby to sedělo. source_doc: Works great for my very fine thin fragile hair, but it's a bit sticky... This TRESemmé Hair Mist Texture Mist works great for my very fine thin fragile, and somewhat curly hair. This spray mist is a bit sticky, but I guess that's what gives it its grippiness.Whenever I go out, I always wear wigs, but at home I sport the little bit of hair I have, as it's just more comfortable. This works as a double duty product. It provides a bit of texture and volume to my natural hair, making it look like I have more than I do.It also gives it more grip for keeping my wigs in place. I'm unable to wear a wig cap, only wig grips. This gives them something more to hold on to than just my wimpy looking hair. When I remove my wigs, I can just spray with water, scrunch, and let my hair dry to revive it.This is not the type of spray or mist that you can easily spray onto your hair, as it actually doesn't create a mist. I just spray it into my hands, rub them together, and apply it throughout.Even though it is not technically a mist, I still like this texture, volume, and grip it provides to my natural hair, and would absolutely recommend it!
hypos: Skvěle funguje na mé velmi jemné tenké křehké vlasy, ale je to trochu lepivé... Tento TRESemmé Hair Mist Texture Mist skvěle funguje na mé velmi jemné tenké křehké a trochu kudrnaté vlasy. Tento sprej je trochu lepivý, ale asi je to to, co mu dává grip. Když vycházím ven, vždy nosím paruky, ale doma nosím to málo vlasů, které mám, protože je to prostě pohodlnější. Toto funguje jako produkt se dvojím účelem. Dodává mým přirozeným vlasům trochu textury a objemu, což vypadá, jako bych měla více, než mám. Také poskytuje více gripu, aby udržel moje paruky na místě. Nemohu nosit parukovou čepici, jen gripy na paruku. To jim dává něco víc, čeho se mohou držet než jen mých slabých vlků. Když si sundám paruky, mohu je prostě postříkat vodou, zmáčknout a nechat uschnout, abych je oživila. Toto není typ spreje nebo mlhy, kterou můžete snadno postříkat na vlasy, protože vlastně nevytváří mlhu. Jen si to postříkám do rukou, třu je dohromady a nanáším to rovnoměrně. I když to technicky není mlha, stále se mi líbí tato textura, objem a grip, který poskytuje mým přirozeným vlasům, a rozhodně bych to doporučila!

source_doc: Heavy Duty! This is awesome because it turns your wire rack shelves into solid shelves in seconds.  I hate it when I put something on the shelf and it wiggles it's way off. Or it doesn't stand properly because it doesn't fit across the shelf properly. No more! Now I have shelves that feel like they are solid.My only gripe is that I wish I had done these BEFORE I put stuff on the rack. I had to take everything off. Which was time consuming, BUT no fault of the manufacturer. And truth be told, it was like moving - I got to declutter some stuff that I probably didn't need any more.I'll know for next time. Buy liners BEFORE placing things on rack. If I buy a rack, will order liners before I build it.

source_doc: Mine were different than the picture. I’m not big on beauty products, but I occasionally get eyelashes that curl under and poke me in the eye so I like to use an eyelash curler to help with that. I don’t need anything fancy since I only use it occasionally. I saw this one and thought it was super cute so I thought I’d give it a try. It feels the same quality and works the same as the other eyelash curler that I have from the dollar tree. I don’t know if that’s good or bad, but it gets the job done for my purposes. The eyelash curler that I received was not the same one in the picture though. It has the same iridescent rainbow coloring, but it doesn’t have the cute mermaid handles, they’re just the basic regular handles with the loops. I would have preferred the mermaid handle ones as I thought that’s what I was getting.

source_doc: Absolutely worth it! I needed a replacement table and found this one. I was worried bout some of the reviews, but it came in pristine condition and was very easy to put together. My 14 year old son and I put it together.For a small table it's decent sized and serves its purpose and I think it looks adorable.Only complaint I have is to the delivery company. I live on the second floor of an apartment and they sent 1 poor delivery driver to push this thing up two flights of stairs. I didn't realize this til he was already at my door. I felt awful for him.But huge rave for him! He was kind, and sweet, and pushed 123lbs of awkward sized box up all those stairs all by himself and was so polite and acted like it was nothing. I truly wish I would have known, because I would have helped and at least tipped him, but I had no cash on me. :(

Žiji ve druhém patře bytu a poslali jednoho chudého řidiče, aby tuto věc vynesl nahoru po dvou schodištích. Neuvědomil/a jsem si to, dokud nebyl už u mých dveří. Bylo mi ho líto. Ale obrovská chvála pro něj! Byl/měla laskavý/á, sladký/á a sám/sama vynesl/a 123 liber objemné krabice po všech těch schodech a byl/měla tak zdvořilý/á a choval/a se, jako by to nebylo nic. Opravu bych si přál/a, abych to věděl/a, protože bych mu/ji pomohl/a a alespoň mu/ji dal/a dýško, ale neměl/a jsem u sebe žádné peníze. :(

hypos: Je to dobré. Líbí se mi to, je to roztomilé a dělá to, co potřebuji. Vidím své obočí, když si je upravuji :) Můžu to použít na nějaký makeup a ráda/a to používám, když si čistím zuby… světlo v tom je skvělé, nebolí to moje oči (jsem extrémně citlivý/á na světlo). Ale… myslím, že by to mělo být o něco širší. Musím být hodně blízko, abych to dobře viděl/a, a vidím vždy jen jedno oko najednou, nebo svůj nos, nebo své zuby… když jsem tak blízko, abych viděl/a, co potřebuji vidět, ať už používám jakýkoli nástroj (kartáček na řasy, pleťová voda, zubní kartáček), není mezi mou tváří a zrcadlem dostatek prostoru. Nechám si to, protože to dobře sedí na zrcadle v mé koupelně a dobře drží. Ohebný rameno nedrží zrcadlo příliš velké, snadno se spouští a když s ním pohybuji, hlava zrcadla snadno vyjde z ohebného ramena. 🤷🏻‍♀️ Je to dobré, ale mohlo by to být lepší co se týče velikosti a pevnosti ohebného ramena.

source_doc: JONATHAN Crystal/Metal LED Table Lamp. I have to say that I am extremely pleased with the Jonathan Crystal/Metal Table Lamp set. These lamps are very attractive, weigh a descent amount, and are made very well. I purchased four of these for the bedroom, and with the crystal stems and brass crystal base these really look elegant. I tend to read a majority of the reviews when I am purchasing a product, and based on those reviews I purchased two sets of these lamps, even though I read a few of the following concerns.  The lamps have an electrical cord that is covered with a lead woven covering, and the top part of the bulb socket has cardboard inserted inside it, in addition to the metal. This could have been a deal breaker for me, but you have many options for the wattage size of bulbs you may use. I also spent so much time looking for lamps on Amazon, and I was so pleased with the appearance of these lamps that I just did not want to send them back. source_doc: I like it a lot. I had an old one I bought years ago that was smaller. This one is large enough to easily accept a paper shopping bag, and it’s a little taller than my old one, so if I have a bunch of plastic shopping bags, I can pile them up higher.  It’s pretty cool that I could fold it up if I needed the room for something else, but I never do that..  I don’t understand why some people complain that it slides around. The back of my SUV is plastic, and it doesn’t slide around (and I am not the most gentle driver either, but if I had to slam on my brakes, I would say all bets are off and I would not blame this product).  I’ve heard some of them fall apart, so I pulled on mine from different directions, and it’s not falling apart. I don’t doubt with automated manufacturing that some of them would be defective. (check them out before the return window closes)..

source_doc: Almost perfect. Better as a light feature. I tried a few sound machines but this one was the best I found for my needs. I tried the portable frida, VTech soother with the app (similar to hatch), Google mini speaker, or just a fan running. I wanted a sound machine that worked with Google Home, had a reliable app, good sound quality and sound options, and dynamic lighting that I could change colors or dim. The govee sound machine fit most of these. My only issue was the sound options and the speaker sound could be improved. The app had mostly 'natural' sounds like wind, rain, river, fire, and some lullaby options. I just wanted a basic flat white, pink, or brown noise. The closest I found to the white noise is the wind and for some reason the speaker quality didn't block a lot of background noise. I noticed some of the other ones I tried did really well blocking noise because it had better sound frequency range. Other than that this would be perfect. My baby woke up more often using this for sound. The lighting options are really unique so I'll give it that. I like the gaming mode and different lighting combos. I now just use this as a light so I'll keep it.

source_doc: I have thought about buying like 10 of these. I am a nail girly - I spend a lot on at-home nail products. So I have spent quite a bit on nail drills that always end up breaking. I usually buy the ones that are around $80-$100. I can honestly say, none of them have ever been anywhere as great as this one. I've had this for a few months and it is still going strong. I am not sure how long it'll last, but my others usually only lasted this amount of time. If this broke I wouldn't be upset, I would just order a new one because it is worth every penny. I LOVE that it is cordless, but ESPECIALLY that it isn't bulky like most cordless nail drills that are attached to a big block. It is legit perfect. Another thing I LOVE that makes this so much better than others, is that it can go fast, but more importantly, it can go slow. Even on the slowest setting every other nail drill was too powerful sometimes, but this one is perfect. Power when you want, but gentle when you don't. I would spend $100 on this and it would still be worth it.
hypos: Uvažoval/a jsem o koupi asi 10 těchto. Jsem milovnice/nehtová holka - utrácím hodně za produkty na nehty doma. Takže jsem už docela dost utratil/a za nehtové vrtačky, které se vždycky zasekly. Obvykle kupuji ty, které stojí kolem 80-100 dolarů. Mohu upřímně říct, že žádná z nich nebyla nikdy tak skvělá jako tato. Mám ji už několik měsíců a stále funguje skvěle. Nejsem si jistý/á, jak dlouho vydrží, ale ostatní obvykle vydržely pouze tuto dobu. Kdyby se to rozbilo, nebyl/a bych naštvaný/á, prostě bych si objednal/a novou, protože to stojí za každou korunu. MILUJI, že je bezdrátová, ale ZVLÁŠŤ že není objemná jako většina bezdrátových nehtových vrtaček, které jsou připojené k velkému bloku. Je to prostě dokonalé. Další věc, kterou MILUJI, která to činí mnohem lepší než ostatní, je, že může běžet rychle, ale co je důležitější, může běžet pomalu. I na nejpomalejším nastavení byla každá jiná nehtová vrtačka někdy příliš výkonná, ale tato je perfektní. Síla, když ji potřebujete, ale jemnost, když ji nepotřebujete. Utratil/a bych 100 dolarů za toto a stále by to stálo za to.

source_doc: As flimsy as paper. I was looking to replace a wonderful bass clef magnet I'd had on my car for many years. I liked the romantic look of this treble/bass clef design, and was excited to get it. It arrived in a regular envelope, and I had no idea what was in it. I almost didn't open it, because the return address was not familiar. When I did open it, the magnet slid out like a piece of card stock paper, and the 2 "dots" that rest on the outer edge of the bass clef were 2 loose little black circles --- not in any way what I expected, and I certainly can't put it on my car. The first rain would wash them off. The extension at the bottom of the treble clef is flimsy & weak. I don't really know what I can do with it. I put it on my refrigerator, because I can't use it for what it was intended, and it won't stick to anything else.

source_doc: I love the thickness and double sided design of this bib. I really like this bib. In our household we go through bibs and always have a pile on hand as backups. My little one uses bibs as his lovey and comfort. I've gotten numerous bibs on here but this is definitely one of the thickest, if not the thickest bib I've gotten. I (and my toddler) prefers thicker bibs over the super thin ones. This one feels even slightly thicker than the bibs I usually get, which is the type with the fleece underside. I do love that the design is on both sides, but of course it is going to cost more. I only wish this was slightly a bit more affordably priced, but I also understand this is better quality (thickness, double sided design, etc) than most bibs, which is why it is priced at this amount. This is great for heavy droolers, especially if your little one is at the height of teething and drooling non stop. I still recommend it even if your little one is not a heavy drooler. I got this yellow safari animal design and the color is beautiful and vivid. I noticed there are also other designs available, and they are all equally adorable and have vivid colors. Overall I am very happy with this bib and highly recommend it if you can splurge a little.

source_doc: Make my eyes feel weird, so must be working. These patches are drowning in liquid, and I made a mess not realizing that when opening. They definitely sit in place properly,but it's hard to get them correct without feeling like the stuff is getting in your eyes. They honestly make my eyes feel very weird. Almost puffy. So I do not know if this is a bad reaction, or just the patch doing its job. Honestly,  I see no visible results, so I have no idea. I suppose these are like any other beauty product out there, and what may work for one, may not work for another. So far, they are not working on me, but I have only been using for a few days as well. I am sort of in the middle on these. If I change my mind and I like them, I will update my review. If I do not update, it means they Never worked. Will use these to the end of the container.

source_doc: I LOVE Being Able To Just Unplug The Cable, And It DOESN'T BUZZ! IT'S GREAT! This "LEKATO Instrument Cable with Dual Mute Plug Ends" works quite well!I REALLY LOVE being able to just unplug the cable, and NOT HAVING IT BUZZ!And, I don't know WHY I waited so long, (50 years!), to get a cable with this Auto-MUTE SWITCH Feature!It's quite a flexible cable, and, it has the all-important Gold-Plated Connectors, too, so I won't get any corrosion! It goes perfectly with the gold Pure Tone output jacks, that I like to add to all of my guitars. (THAT WAY, it's gold-to-gold, and I avoid any 'dissimilar metals effect"...)I also like having the right-angled connector on one end, too. It works nicely going into my little Fender Mustang I V.2 Modeling Amp, which I have placed on a chest-high shelf. The 90 degree-end takes all of the strain off of the cable, in that setup. And then, of course, the other, straight-end goes nicely into my Strats, my Teles, my Mustang, my Toronado, my Les Faul... or whatever...BTW, BOTH ENDS of the cable offer the auto-Mute Switch functionality.So, in short, I think it's a pretty good option for an Auto-Mute Switch Instrument Cable, especially for the price.I like it!Have fun.-C(NOTE: I did NOT receive this product through any Promotion, I bought and paid for it myself.)

source_doc: I have been using this mouse for years! I love this mouse!  I have been using this model for years!
