I see that they have the new highly rated wireless model now, but I prefer a wired mouse, so this been the one for me and I have been totally satisfied with it.

I would however have confidence that should I need Honeywell’s tech-support that it would be very good.

source_doc: I would buy it again if needed. I couldn’t find the spring isolators for a decent price so I bought this kit. I figured if the springs were junk like everyone said I would still be money ahead buying this kit and a set of springs. Great news, the kit was great. Springs are a good ride height and everything went in easy. I don’t know why this product had such mixed reviews. Install took about 2 hours with good tools. Extending the axle enough to put the new spring in was expectedly tough because I couldn’t find my spring compressor but I was able to use a small bottle Jack to get the axle separation I needed. If I buy another sequoia I will buy this air spring delete instead of working on the air suspension every 6 months.

source_doc: Hard to say if it's the car or me or this part. I ordered this to replace the crankshaft position sensor in my 2011 Nissan Sentra. It was throwing a code for a multiple/random misfire and I replaced the plugs and all of the coil packs so this was next on the list. After I replaced the sensor I am getting lights on the dash and even more codes then before I replaced it (basically it made it worse). I don't know if it's the sensor, the way I replaced it, or anything of that nature because I am not a professional mechanic, which is why I'm giving it a 'neutral' review. The sensor was definitely brand new and looked fine before installation so I can't 100% say it's faulty right now. After I get everything worked out I will probably update this review.

source_doc: Best price to features for this type of product. I looked at others similar to this, Hart, Dewalt, Milwaukee, Bauer, etc.  I liked the Hart and this one because I have batteries for both of these.  The Hart was near 2x the cost, so I took a chance on the Meliff.  Two days after I ordered this, I found a Hart tool marked down due to a damage box - funny but it was actually cheaper.  I got this one in first, it worked well.  Quick to inflate, I liked the auto shut off feature.  Then I got the Hart in.  I tried the Hart out and it works well but has no cut off feature.  You have to hold the trigger the entire time.  Both are equal in speed and battery life.  Both weigh about the same and seem equal in construction.  The Hart is a little prettier in cosmetics.  End of the day, I prefer the Mellif and will be ordering another (they've jacked the price up 12% in past two weeks).

source_doc: I LOVEEEEE IT - but not for work. I eyeballed this keyboard for the LONGEST time before deciding to buy it.  I wanted something pink.  I wanted something backlit.  I wanted something CLICKY.  And this keyboard gave me all of that.  I don't like rechargeable keyboards because I never remember to charge them.  So this being wired made me happy.  I use it all the time for gaming and personal work.  However, when I am working I switch back over to my Apple keyboard.  Only because the clicks of the keys are loud and I don't feel like it is professional.  I prefer a muted keyboard when I am on the phone with clients and I'm typing away.  That's just a personal preference for myself.  I'm sure not everyone is bothered by it, it's just who I am.  So I can easily flip between my personal keyboard and my work keyboard.  That made this thing even better!

source_doc: Requires you to close your doors into it. I have an older car (Toyota Solara), and wanted this to protect it from the times I can't park in the garage. I've used another cover previously however it has gotten worn down from seasons so I wanted to give this one a try.The good news is that the clips are plastic, which I LOVE. The old cover I used had metal clips, and if one isn't fastened properly, that'll scratch up the car in the wind as it shakes around. I prefer plastic or rubberized clips any day.The bad news, is that they want me to close the doors into this in order to hold it in place. I did not realize that is how it is supposed to work, and I have a major problem with that- The Solara doors don't have a top frame, it is glass against the rubber gasket of the car's top. With material in between like this, you are asking for leaks into the interior of the car around the door seams. I don't like that at all. It fits fine on my other car (Honda Odyssey) but I'm disappointed I can't use it on the car I wanted to.

source_doc: Ryobi 3/8 in. Variable Speed Drill (Renewed) I ordered this drill because funds are tight but I needed a drill to do some home maintenance. It is refurbished. The drill came without a case or any bling which is exactly what I expected. It did come with an instructional manual and a full 1 year warranty which was enough to impress me. I have used it a couple of times and I am not disappointed at all. It has plenty of power for the size of drill it is. I am a 60 year old disabled woman and I was able to fix my own wall that was bulging out due to blown insulation settling. I search high and low to find this Ryobi drill because I still have the 9v cordless I bought about 18 years ago and it is just now dying and no batteries are made for it anymore. Ryobi is a great product line. I wish I could afford 1 of everything they make. Don't be afraid to order the refurbished drill. It was a fantastic purchase choice for me.

source_doc: White Light=Bright White. I have used several different Chemical Guys detailing products. Some I like better than others and this is one of them. I have a white metallic vehicle and I wanted to see if I could find a product that really makes the white “pop.” I tried a few different things and even though they looked good, I never got the “pop” I was seeking. Also, many of these other products are magnets for dust and even though I don’t drive anywhere near dirt roads or live in a particularly dusty area, my car would would coated with dust just days after I detailed it. I did not find that issue with White Light. In fact, it hasn’t rained in a week since I detailed my vehicle and it doesn’t have much dust sitting on it at all. The white is bright and crisp and has a deep shine. I will definitely continue to use Chemical Guys White Light for my white vehicle.

source_doc: Simple Tool Makes for Easy Work! I love these. I have been buying them for a few years. Fret polishing is a task that never goes out of style and these fret erasers make easy work of a tedious task. This is the first time I got the 180 grit eraser so I am really excited to see how that will work on some of the more stubborn scratches and tool marks that I find on frets. They are pretty simple to use, I tape off the fret board and then use them just like an eraser. I go fret by fret with each eraser working my way up from the lower grits to the higher polishing grits. This kit has the 1000 grit which I have already but I would encourage buying the 2000 grit eraser or using a finger nail buffer stick to really nail the mirror shine. I not only recommend, but I use them myself and love them!
hypos: Jednoduchý nástroj usnadňuje práci! Miluji je. Kupoval/a jsem je už několik let. Leštění pražců je úkol, který nikdy nevyjde z módy, a tyto gumičky na pražce usnadňují nudnou práci. Toto je poprvé, co jsem dostal/a gumičku s 180 zrnitelem, takže jsem opravdu nadšený/á, jak to zabere na některé z odolnějších škrábanců a stop po nástrojích, které nalézám na pražcích. Použití je docela jednoduché, zakryji pražcovou desku páskou a pak je používám jako gumičku. Jdu pražec po pražci s každou gumičkou a postupuji od nižších zrnitostí k vyšším leštícím zrnitostem. Tento set má 1000 zrnitel, který už mám, ale doporučuji koupit gumičku s 2000 zrnitel nebo použít pilník na nehty, abychom dosáhli opravdu zrcadlového lesku. Nejenže doporučuji, ale používám je sám/sama a miluji je!

source_doc: Undecided on these stirrups. I bought these for an overseas riding trip in Ireland. I will be riding cross country and jumping. The place where I ride will outfit you with the horse and saddle, etc. however, I've brought my own stirrups and leathers before and just swap them out. The climate is pretty wet. I specifically bought these because when I ride there, my boots are always slipping off the stirrups due to the wetness of the land we're riding through. I have mixed thoughts on these. I like the light weight nature of the stirrups. I normally ride in MDC sport stirrups and they are quite heavy. I like that my feet don't slip out of my stirrups when my boots are wet. I don't like that they're hard to get your feet back in if you lose a stirrup because they lie flat against the flank of the horse. I'm not sure if they're more comfortable. I have been trying them out during my normal riding and lessons. I will keep the stirrups and take them on the trip but I think I'll switch back to my MDCs for normal riding.
hypos: Nejsem si jistý/á těmito třmeny. Koupil/a jsem je na zahraniční jezdecký výlet do Irska. Budu jezdit terénem a skákat. Místo, kde jezdím, tě vybaví koněm a sedlem atd., nicméně jsem si přivezl/a své vlastní třmeny a řemeny a jen je vyměním. Počasí je dost deštivé. Koupil/a jsem je konkrétně, protože když tam jezdím, moje boty se mi vždy vyzouvají z třmenů kvůli vlhkosti v terénu, kterým projíždíme. Mám smíšené pocity ohledně těchto třmenů. Líbí se mi jejich lehká povaha. Normálně jezdím ve sportovních třmenech MDC a jsou docela těžké. Líbí se mi, že mi nohy nevypadávají z třmenů, když jsou boty mokré. Nelíbí se mi, že je těžké dostat nohy zpět, pokud ztratíš třmen, protože leží rovně pod břichem koně. Nejsem si jistý/á, zda jsou pohodlnější. Zkouším je během mého běžného ježdění a lekcí. Třmeny si nechám a vezmu je na výlet, ale myslím, že se vrátím k mým MDC pro běžné ježdění.

source_doc: Strong, lasting fragrance...& rash. Update:Although I washed this off soon after because I couldn't stand the smell, I broke out in a rash on my arm where I tested this.I love the convenience of a spray sunscreen, but I couldn't tolerate the fragrance added to this one. While I detect the coconut and maybe it's the shea, it's overwhelmingly a chemical, plastic, perfume smell that reminds me of something you would spray your car with or buy in the dollar store. I only sprayed it on my arm, and it's giving me a headache. I can't imagine how awful I would feel if I sprayed it all over, not to mention on others around me. The spray is very strong and generous and dries quickly. I do like how lightweight it is. I also like the twist lock cap. Each of the bottles was sealed, and they were in a resealable bag. The trio is $45.60.

source_doc: Does not work. I don’t like leaving bad reviews, but here it is. I bought this lapel mic in December and JUST opened it up to try and use it. I charged it up, at least I think I have, but this thing will not turn on. I used the cable that came with the mic and a trusted wall charger and I don’t know if it is charged or not because it won’t turn on. I’ve tried to get it to work, my tech savvy husband (who warned me not to buy a lapel mic this cheap), and my tech savvy father in law. It’s been plugged in to charge at different points in the house and with different charge ports/bricks, all of it. It will not turn on. I unfortunately did not realize that the return by date was yesterday (the 31st), so now I have to buy another one. I’m pretty sure I got a broken/bum mic. Some people praise this mic and I took a chance. Just my luck.

source_doc: I wish I bought this years ago - worth every penny! I suck at soldering. My hands are really shaky and I don't do it often enough to get the practice. I can't believe how much of a difference this made over the cheap stuff (which have thousands of 5 star reviews!) I'd been using. It flows where I want it to go, very easy to use, low temp..For years I've been thinking about trying this, but the price compared to others is significant. I had tried a little tube of it awhile back and didn't like it at all. I didn't know I had brought the wrong type  (the naming of various solders is a bit confusing)  I finally broke down a few months ago and bought this. I was getting so frustrated soldering I started buying in stead of making.  It is absolutely worth the price.It's not a miracle tho - I still suck at soldering, I just suck less now.

source_doc: My very first VR set! So worth the money! I finally decided to plunge into the world of virtual reality — and I’m so glad I chose this item as my first “attempt” at VR! I really liked that any adjustment (minus the strap) could easily be done even while wearing the device without interrupting gameplay! As for the strap, just a simple fix of placing the joycons down, fix it, and bam, you’re immediately back to gameplay. I saw other reviews say it was heavy… honestly I found it to be light!My only downsides to it (which neither have nothing to do with the product itself), are…- The games offered. I wish Nintendo would offer a VR mode for more games- Because I have thick hair, if I moved a certain way, the straps would slide up to the top of my head (due to gripping) and I would have to pause the game and reset it on my head before continuing. But I’ll try wearing a ponytail next time!All in all, I really enjoyed my time with this, and I can definitely see it as a more long-term option than what Nintendo offers!

source_doc: Better than expected. I used this as a junction box on my utility trailer. My trailer doesn't have brakes so I didn't need all the lugs but I wanted a box like this to use in wiring the trailer and didn't find anything like it for a four wire setup so I went ahead and got this one and I'm glad I did. I did add a rubber gasket and I sealed around the wires with silicone RTV where I brought them into the wiring box through the rubber plugs that came with the box.The box itself is pretty stout but the strain relief clamps on the ends of the box could definitely stand some beefing up. It would be a better product if the side enty ports also had strain reliefs.In spite of its shortcomings, I like this box well enough that I bought another one which I intend to use when I rewire another trailer of mine next summer.

source_doc: Very Sturdy. I have bought what feels like a ton of these over my adult life for all kinds of different, practical applications not just for hanging a shower curtain and this one has to be one of the sturdiest ones I have ever purchased.  I wasn't so sure about the black as I normally stick to white, off-white or a light tan but for the purpose of my purchase, I was indifferent because I just needed a sturdier rod in my laundry room.  I use this rod to hang the clothes right out of the dryer and sometimes, the weight of clothes can be so much that a regular, cheaper rod, will buckle under that kind of weight.  I was hoping that this rod would solve my worry about that because I had my other one fall on me, a couple of times by that buckling under the weight of the clothes.  This one is absolutely the answer.  It is really easy to install and extremely sturdy, I can easily hang about 3 loads before I have to put them in their respective closets.  That's a LOT of laundry, and an amount that my other rod couldn't even dream about holding.  The price is very reasonable as well, so if you are in the market for a really sturdy rod, this is it.  I hope you find this review helpful!

source_doc: Beware. I was extremely disappointed in this product because when I opened it and went to use it i held it up to my lamp next to my mom's bed and I could see that the container was half full.  Brand new never used!!! I paid for an item that I only got half of . I don't know if this was purposeful or if this is how it comes. I would have liked to have left a message to the seller instead of writing a review.  I felt it's important to warn others to check theirs before using.  Buyers you might want to know this in advance if you decide to order it.  I'm pretty sure that this is one of those items that you can't return so just a warning. Other than that I really like the powder and I like the price. This is the first time I've ordered this item. I was excited to use it because the powder smells great and the ingredients in it that would help my mom who is bedridden.

source_doc: Important to know!! We had a harrowing experience just now Daisy our cavachon ripped apart the monkey and on the floor next to the monkey was a little tiny battery.  I was hoping to attached a picture but I was able to post it.  UGH!!  I never would've dreamt that those batteries were in there. Anyways, we threw them out because I don't want to take a chance because I thought we were going to have to run to the emergency vet that she might've swallowed one. But we able to figure out there were three and then we called the manufacture, and he confirmed it was three and when I suggested they note it they have those batteries in their toys as a warning but he said it’s on the outside of the packaging.  I could not debate the packing because I ordered it through amazon and I really couldn’t recall if there was special notation on the package it came in. So I thought I would just forewarned when your dog is chewing that there are those tiny little batteries there like hearing aid batteries and be careful!

source_doc: Use to be good, but not anymore. -UPDATE- I bought these almost a year ago, I don’t remember how long the 1st one lasted, but I replaced it at some point, and gave 1 away to a friend. Recently I’ve had problems with my camera focusing, and wondered if the lens had gotten dirty somehow, so I removed it. (it is a problem some phones have apparently) I couldn’t get it to stay on, so I ordered more. In less than a week the first one was shattered, even though I didn’t drop my phone. I just noticed yesterday the 2nd one is now cracked. Not sure if material got cheaper or what, but all I can think is that they don’t hold up even if I’m lightly leaning against a desk or something, because I haven’t dropped my phone in a long time, certainly longer than I’ve had these lenses for. Guess I’ll have to see if I can’t find a better option.-UPDATE-After leaving my review, the seller reached out to me and offered to send a replacement. So far it’s worked out. Wonderful customer service.

source_doc: Everyone should have one of these. I went out Christmas Eve (Subzero temps outside) to go to my bother's house and my car didn't start. Fortunately I was home and my neighbor was able to help me. I realized that I didn't want to depend on someone else to keep my car running  so I ordered this. The day after I got this I went out again (now much warmer) and my car wouldn't start again.  I hooked this up, turned it on and my car started right up. It was easy to use and its great peace of mind to know I'm safe if this happens when I am out and about. This is something everyone needs in their car but especially women.  My only "complaint"  is I wish the cables were just a few inches longer. This would make the hook up a little easier.  I have tried several other brands that had good ratings and they didn't work.  This one is great!

source_doc: A life saver. I’ve been suffering from migraines for eleven years and I’ve been taking acetaminophen for so long even more to just make sure I don’t get them, sometimes 4-6 a day, I finally needed fast relief and after some searching I found this product on YouTube and so I decided to try it out.Just a few minutes before writing this review I had gotten a bad migraine, mine are mainly in the eyes, they make me go blind and all I see is a gray screen, these migraines have kept me from trying to get a drivers license for so long, but right when I lost my vision due to the migraine I grabbed this tool and found where to put it and applied some pressure feeling the pain I couldn’t believe it.4-6 minutes later I had gained my vision back and didn’t even have a headache afterwards.My hand hurts a little but considering that the migraine is gone I am so glad.I recommend this to anyone who’s been suffering from migraines, don’t think about buying this, make the step and purchase right away.Control you’re life, don’t let the migraines control you.

source_doc: Is okay - not good for long-term. I bought this because I wanted a clicky keyboard for when I WFH (I know - a silly reason but I prefer the aesthetic of it). It wasn't hard to set up - The mouse and keyboard function with a USB inserted into the computer/laptop and no batteries are involved. The downside to this is having to re-charge your keyboard every so often. The first time I charged the keyboard (using the cable they provided) it worked fine and I was able to use it for a couple days (maybe 3?) There's no real indicator that tells you how much battery is left - if you turn it on and the battery symbol is red that means it needs to be charged again but other than that nothing. The second time I tried to re-charge it I had plugged in the wire and had it charging for 12 hours. When I went to go unplug and use it though it was completely dead. I figured that the wire might have been faulty so I tried again with another micro-USB I had in the house that I knew worked. Still nothing. Because I couldn't replace batteries or resuscitate it really I had to toss it, which was unfortunate because the mouse was still fine.

source_doc: Good for the Price..But. I have some nice heavy duty solar lights that I want to hang in my yard along the back fence line which overlooks a wooded area.  When I saw these 9ft light poles, I knew it would be the perfect solution!  I was so excited when the box arrived but then quickly disappointed because apparently I did not read the description well enough - I saw the beginning of the title ‘Patio String Lights Poles” and assumed I would be getting two poles.  It does say ‘Pole’ singular further in the description.  So if you order these, you may want to order two.  I cannot hang lights from one pole lol so I will have to order a second one.  Having said that, the price doubled is about what other sets of two cost.  The pole comes in sections that you just screw together so assembly is simple.  I wish it was a little bit heavier duty because I’m not sure how well it will support my lights but it may be fine.  The pole doesn’t wobble much once in the ground with the five spikes.  Overall they are decent quality.

source_doc: Love this... and so does my soon-to-be 19-year-old Kitty! I purchased this on December 17th, 2022....  Came on the 19th.  I plugged it in and placed it in my elderly kitty's soft basket on top of his blanket.  At first he was hesitant, but I plopped him in there.  He had been slowing down and cold, and I had moved his basket next to the heater in the kitchen and he was happy.  Well, he has not left his basket since.  He loves this heating pad.  I have set it to No. 4 bar.  I have never turned it off and it's still working.  I am surprised.  I figured it would have burnt out, but so far so good! (Fingers crossed!!!)  He is walking better and so happy!  He loves it.  I haven't washed it yet.  I just turned it over.  I can't get him out of it to wash it.  I feel bad.  I did vacuum it.  LOL!  Now, it doesn't look all plush like in the picture, mind you, but it is soft.  As long as he is still alive, I will replace it if it burns out.  I think it helps him feel better.... Heat is good for old joints for all of us :)

source_doc: In The Stars. I LOVE this scent and have it in the body lotion and spray. When I saw the fragrance plug in I had to try it. I have never used a wallflower plug in before so I had no idea how it would work or how I would like it. The product came on time, packaged well with no damage. I put one in my small guest bathroom and WOW. It smells just like the body products! If you love In the Stars, you will love this. The room is small but the throw is just perfect. The smell is noticeable but not obnoxious. It makes me happy when I walk in there. I just added one to my bedroom so I’ll see how it works in a larger space. This scent is clean while being sexy, girly and like nothing else. It is not overpowering and not too feminine that my husband won’t like it. It just plain smells amazing! I will probably put at least one downstairs too. I think I’ll buy more because it is not gettable on the BBW site. Did I say I love this?

source_doc: This is a compact unit that will work with your existing ratchet wrench or breaker bar. This tool has a solid, compact storage case, and the unit will work with 1/4, 3//8, and a half inch drive.  The unit will display and work with numerous torque measurements and specifically inch-pounds and foot-pounds that I need. To test its functionality I loosened a wheel lug on the tractor.  I then connected the electronic torque tool to my existing click adjustable torque wrench.  I adjusted the electronic device to 83.5 foot-pounds and the click adjustable to 86 foot-pounds.  As I tightened the bolt, the electronic device began beeping at just under 80 pounds.  My initial thought was "this isn't good".  So I next set both to 86 foot-pounds.  The beeping began around 83 foot-pounds but I kept going.  At 86 foot-pounds I heard the click and the tone switched from beeping to solid simultaneously.  Great, I figured out the beep is "approaching" and solid means you're there.  I later went back to the manual and found a "note" explaining the beep means you're within 20% of the target.  So, I like the unit and the audible feedback.
hypos: Toto je kompaktní jednotka, která bude fungovat s vaší stávající ráčnou nebo ráčnovým klíčem. Tento nástroj má pevný, kompaktní úložný obal a jednotka bude fungovat s 1/4, 3/8 a půlpalcovým pohonem. Jednotka zobrazí a bude pracovat s mnoha měřeními točivého momentu, konkrétně s palcovými-librami a stopovými-librami, které potřebuji. Abych otestoval/a její funkčnost, povolil/a jsem šroub kola na traktoru. Poté jsem připojil/a elektronický momentový nástroj k mému stávajícímu ráčnovému klíči s nastavitelného kliknutím. Nastavil/a jsem elektronické zařízení na 83,5 stopových-librách a nastavitelného kliknutím na 86 stopových-librách. source_doc: great for cat hair and taking on the go. my uniform for work is 100% black and having 6 cats, yeah my clothes get covered in hair. now, using a lint roller isn't anything new to me, but the one i had ran out of paper and i had no clue it was out. so ofc i ran to amazon to buy one that would arrive quickly. this one came up and i was intrigued by the design, i've only ever had the straight ones. so i took a chance on this one and omg i'm never going back. the design of this one somehow makes it easier to roll. and i love the fact that it has a cover, because a lot of the time i forget to lint roll before i leave, so it's nice that i can just keep this in my bag and use it once i get to work.it was a little hard to figure out how to peel the paper off but once i did figure it out, it became easy.

source_doc: I Want To Learn To Play The Drums. I literally just told my mom I want to learn to play the drums. I'm old enough to get those senior citizen perks and looking for something new. So when I saw this on the vine list I giggled and ordered. I love how quiet this is even when I'm really pounding away. It has a nice pad on the back to keep it from scratching and also helps dampen the noise. When I learn the basics I'll move on, but for now I love my new drumming pad. It came with two sets of sticks and a zippered case. I love that I got it from Vine but would have paid what it cost. Can't wait to get good enough for a real set of drums! source_doc: Great Upgrade from HF Cheap Spray Gun! I will start by saying that I am not a professional, really only a weekend woodworker so my experience with HVLP spraying is limited at best.  I bought a discount big box store HVLP sprayer to dip my feet in the waters, only to find that it did not come with a nozzle wrench. After using it a few times and using channel locks to remove the nozzle for cleaning, etc. I decided it was time to buy a wrench, however just finding one is a chore and they tend to cost as much as another HVLP sprayer, so when I found this set I thought "Why Not?" since it comes with a wrench and a couple of other tips.Upon receipt of this gun, I decided to give it a try because I struggled with my cheap gun to get a good finish when spraying polyurethane. All I can say is there is a night and day difference. This gun is easy to set up and the spray pattern is SO MUCH BETTER!!! Not only that, cleaning it seems to also not be as tedious, not sure why because it basically has the same parts. If I ever need to replace it, I will order another one and recommend it to anyone looking to jump into the world of HVLP spraying.

source_doc: On the Fence….Good Microphone With Flaws. My wheelhouse is electronics and security so I have used my share of microphones either in security equipment or setting up electronics for a band. The problem I had with this was volume. Maybe it was the App I tested it with, maybe it bugged me that there was no way to monitor the volume. I don’t do YouTube, so maybe this can be tweaked in editing but this did not give me enough volume for the App I was using even at max. I gave it a generous 4 stars because the sound I heard I guess sounded good but I would not use this anyway as it has to be unplugged to hear what you recorded. I don’t know why anyone would go through that pain. Points for quick set up and instant pairing. I guess I’ll leave the rest to the professional YouTubers but I see no use for this unless you are a pro blogger or something. I thought it would work on calls and I could clip it on and walk around but does not work for that. A niche product for video bloggers.

source_doc: Great for Dog Training Gloves. I have learned that my dogs and I both do better when I wear gloves while training them. I have a better grip on toys and tugs, and when my pups see me don a pair of gloves they get excited because it is time to WORK. I have been using leather gloves, and they get gross very quickly.These Manusage work gloves are exactly what I need for training. Obviously, they'd work well for gardening and other things around the house too, but dog training is what I'm most excited about. Slobber doesn't soak through these gloves to make my hands cold or stinky. The gloves themselves dry out quickly so they don't get stinky (leather gloves...ewwwww). The gloves grip things very well so I am no longer dropping slippery slobbery toys and balls. They do actually work on a touchscreen - I tried them out just to see - but I highly doubt I will be using a screen with slobber covered gloves.After multiple sessions of training dogs with the same pair of gloves, I may never need to buy any again...or at least, it will be a couple of years since I have 12 pairs now. The medium size fit as I expected as I typically wear a medium in work gloves.
hypos: Skvělé pro tréninkové rukavice pro psy. Naučil/a jsem se, že moji psi a já se oba cítíme lépe, když nosím rukavice při jejich trénování. Mám lepší úchop na hračkách a tazích, a když mě moji štěňata vidí, jak si nasazuji pár rukavic, jsou nadšení, protože je čas na PRÁCI. Používal/a jsem kožené rukavice, a ty se velmi rychle špiní. Tyto pracovní rukavice Manusage jsou přesně to, co potřebuji pro trénink. Zjevně by byly skvělé i pro zahradničení a další věci kolem domu, ale trénink psů je to, co mě nejvíc těší. Slina neprosakuje těmito rukavicemi, aby mi zchladila nebo znepříjemnila ruce. Samotné rukavice se rychle vysychají, takže se nezapáchají (kožené rukavice... fuj). Rukavice pevně uchopují věci, takže už neztrácím kluzké slizké hračky a míče. Opravu fungují na dotykovém displeji - vyzkoušel/a jsem je, abych viděl/a - ale velmi pochybují, že budu používat displej se slizkými rukavicemi. Po několika sezeních trénování psů se stejným párem rukavic, možná už nikdy nebudu potřebovat koupit další... nebo alespoň to budou ještě pár let, protože nyní mám 12 párů. Střední velikost mi padne, jak jsem očekával/a, protože obvykle nosím střední velikost u pracovních rukavic.

source_doc: Very beautiful. This pool cue has no flaws, and is very beautiful. The brown has an almost tigers eye look to it under the light, which makes it that more stunning. It has a nice feel in your hands, and is pretty good quality. I was surprised I liked it even better than I thought I would. The case is also pretty well made and I see no flaws with that either. The cue fits nicely in it without any issues. For the price, I did not expect it to be one of my favorites, but alas, it might just be my favorite pool cue to date, mostly due to the look, yes, but the fact it also has a nice feel, and works as good as any as I've used, plays in that as well.  I will note I am not an avid pool player, but I have played with a league team (as a stand in) previously, and have some experience beyond being new to the sport or just messing around. So I am only giving my review as an in the middle player, not a professional. Regardless, I think this would be a nice addition to any players collection, be it a beginner, or all the way to a pro.

source_doc: Great product and great company. I got this high chair for my 2nd baby. It converts to a little chair when it’s not needed to be a high chair anymore. It can also attach to a dining chair which is great for space saving. I’ve had the chair for over 2 years now. As you can see my son picked at the face, Chewed it and all that. It had started to bubble up on the fox face before he picked at it. I think from his head being warm and rubbing on it. Anyway I was dissatisfied because I wasn’t happy with how it looked but I kept on with it until it got to the point of the picture I posted. So I went to the manufacturer and told them about the problem and asked if they had any replacement parts I could buy. They emailed me back, asked for details and that was the last I heard from them when I sent the email back. Well today 6-8 days later I got a new replacement part sent to me for free. I love when a company listens and goes above and beyond. I’ve had this chair so long I was fully willing to pay for the part but they just made it happen. The chair is durable and easy to clean and it’s cute. I would buy this again and again.

Může se také připevnit k jídelní židli, což je skvělé pro úsporu místa. Mám tuto židli už více než 2 roky. Jak vidíte, můj syn si povytáhl obličej, žvýkal ho a to všechno. Začalo se mu na liščím obličeji tvořit puchýř předtím, než si na to sáhl. Myslím, že to bylo tím, že měl hlavu teplou a otíral se o to. Každopádně jsem byla nespokojená, protože jsem nebyla šťastná s tím, jak to vypadalo, ale pokračovala jsem v používání, dokud to nedosáhlo bodu, na kterém jsem vložila fotografii. Tak jsem šla k výrobci a řekla jim o problému a zeptala jsem se, jestli mají nějaké náhradní díly, které bych mohla koupit. Odpověděli mi e-mailem, požádali o podrobnosti a to bylo naposledy, co jsem od nich slyšela, když jsem poslala odpověď. No, dnes po 6-8 dnech mi poslali nový náhradní díl zdarma. Miluji, když společnost naslouchá a dělá víc, než by měla. Mám tuto židli tak dlouho, že jsem byla plně ochotná zaplatit za díl, ale oni to prostě zařídili. source_doc: Waste of money. Works great... until it stops working. I purchased two for a trip I took last December/January where it was going to be cold. I live in Florida, so I did not have to use them again until another trip up North about a month ago. I packed them along with the charger and when I got up there, found they were not working (the light would not turn on once it was connected to charger). Thankfully other friends packed extra disposable hand warmers. I emailed the company because I purchased this over disposable hand warmers thinking they would last a while, and I only used them for one trip that was a week long. I was two weeks past my 1 year warranty so I lost my money and nothing can be done. They suggested to charge every once in a while when they are not in use and offered to give me a coupon for my next purchase with them. I respectfully declined as I am sure that product would break as well. Would be great if they included that suggestion along with the product, so their clients would know to charge it every so often to make it last longer. Might just stick to disposables for next trip.

source_doc: Meh... It's OK for low volume playback. So, I have 2 offices I work out of in my home. My small office has a set of M-Audio AV32.1 to play background music at low volume, but I always find the low end lacking. I run a 10" Monolith sub in my other office, paired with Mackie XR624 monitors and I'm mostly happy with that setup, so I thought I would get another Monolith, but I think if would be way too much sub for the M-Audio speakers. Thankfully, Monoprice makes a very inexpensive 10" sub that supposedly plays down to 20hz. I played with it for a couple of hours, and so far, it's ok. I'm cycling now to break it in, but overall it adds that little depth  I was missing on the M-Audio speakers. I'm sure they'll sound better once they are broken in. I'm still on the fence about this sub, since it lacks authority like the Monolith or the 15" DR. HSU I have for my main setup.  Then again, I haven't added a proper crossover to the small office setup, so the verdict is still out...  For small room, low volume - I give it a 3 out of 5.  If you can afford it or wait for a closeout, the Monoprice Monolith 10" is 10 x better.

source_doc: I believe and have hope. I haven't been on this product long enough (4 days) to determine the effect is has on my health and wellness.  But I believe.  And I hope it will help me with the multivariate of health issues I have experienced since May 2022.  I'm a naturalist and a self healer and pray this product will relieve some of my issues.  I've read the reviews and some claim it works after two weeks of use.  If it does, I will be back to update this review.  So far, I've had no side effects.UPDATE: Feb 17, 2023  I've been on this product about 5 weeks and I can honestly say I feel better.  I'm in less pain and because of that, I will continue taking it.  I've had no side effects whatsoever.  And I'm not sure, but I think it's helping me lose weight, without trying.  I've also noticed my right ankle and foot isn't swollen so much from the referred pain from multilevel lumbar degenerative disc disease (lumbar radiculopathy).  It will be interesting to see how I feel after using it for one year.

source_doc: pretty good at getting a close shave wherever you choose to shave. I use a popular subscription service, but I keep forgetting to order a new handle. I like to keep 2 handles, 1 in each bathroom. I use it to shave all over, including my face (no, tis a total myth that hair grows back more course). It helps keep my skin ultra smooth, and unless going to a professional, it is the exact same thing as other so called DIY dermaplaning gadgets. I swear, the pink tax on some stuff, some of which is our fault for buying into it all. So until I actually remember to buy another handle, I decided to just grab one of these. I like it enough that I may or may not bother with an additional handle (though I have dozens of razor heads so I may not want to have to add in another purchase). but for $15 or so bucks, I think it is reasonable. Has a good close shave, skin feels soft and smooth, if I take care of the razor head it should stay sharp for awhile. So far so good.
hypos: Docela dobrý/á v tom, jak dosáhnout blízkého oholení kdekoli se rozhodnete oholit. Používám populární předplatné, ale neustále zapomínám objednat novou rukojeť. Rád/a si držím 2 rukojeti, 1 v každé koupelně. Používám to k holení po celém těle, včetně obličeje (ne, je to naprostý mýtus, že vlasy rostou zpět silnější). Pomáhá udržovat moji pleť ultra hladkou, a pokud nejdu k profesionálovi, je to přesně to samé jako u jiných takzvaných DIY dermaplaning zařízení. Přísahám, ta růžová daň na některé věci, nějaké za to můžeme sami, že jsme to všechno koupili. Takže až si skutečně vzpomenu koupit další rukojeť, rozhodl/a jsem se prostě vzít jednu z těchto. Líbí se mi to natolik, že se mi možná/nebo nebudu starat o další rukojeť (i když mám desítky hlavic na holicí strojky, takže možná nechci mít další nákup navíc). Ale za asi 15 dolarů si myslím, že je to rozumné. Má dobré blízké oholení, pleť se cítí jemně a hladce, pokud se postarám o hlavu strojku, měla by zůstat ostrá nějakou dobu. Zatím dobré.

source_doc: Work great. Good quality. I switched my trailer axle from a 7500 lb to a 2000 lb axle. I just don't need that big of one way overdone. I went to a couple local places to try to get the u-bolts in the plates but just couldn't find the right size.These are for inch and 3/4 round axle. I think I'm going to need to replace the leaf springs because there's four leaf springs. I need a little softer ride. The trailer is only going to be maybe 1500 lb so I need to switch out those as well.But what I'm getting at for the leaf springs is it fit around four leaf springs and the axle?. After I cranked and tighten the bolts, the bolts are nylon. No washers. But the fact that I have four leaf springs. The bolts barely make it through the nut. Just kind of flush with the top so once I replace the springs I should have a little bit more thread on top of the bolt. I think it would be fine even with three leaf springs.As for quality, definitely quality product, the u-bolts the plates, the nuts, even the coupler that goes between the shock leaf and the axle high quality. I definitely recommend it but it again it is for a inch and 3/4 axle or the 2000 lb load?.If this fits your axle, it's a good product. Get it.
hypos: Pracují skvěle. Dobrá kvalita. Vyměnil/a jsem nápravu na přívěsu z 7500 lb na 2000 lb. Takhle velkou vůbec nepotřebuju, je to přehnané. Šel/a jsem do pár místních obchodů, abych se pokusil/a sehnat U-patky do desek, ale prostě jsem nemohl/a najít správnou velikost. Tyto jsou pro kulatou osu o průměru 1 a 3/4 palce. Myslím, že budu muset vyměnit listové pružiny, protože jsou čtyři listové pružiny. Potřebuji trochu měkčí jízdu. Přívěs bude mít jen asi 1500 lb, takže je taky potřebuji vyměnit. Ale co se týče listových pružin, tak se vejdou kolem čtyř listových pružin a osy? Poté, co jsem utáhl/a šrouby, jsou šrouby nylonové. Žádné podložky. Ale vzhledem k tomu, že mám čtyři listové pružiny. Šrouby sotva procházejí matkou. Jsou trochu zapuštěné, takže jakmile vyměním pružiny, měl/a bych mít trochu více závitu na vrchu šroubu. Myslím, že to bude v pořádku i se třemi listovými pružinami. Co se týče kvality, rozhodně kvalitní produkt, U-patky, desky, matice, dokonce i spojka, která jde mezi pružinou a osou, je vysoce kvalitní. Rozhodně to doporučuji, ale opět je to pro osu o průměru 1 a 3/4 palce nebo pro zatížení 2000 lb? Pokud to pasuje na vaši osu, je to dobrý produkt. Berte to.

source_doc: Fashionable Diaper bag. Before I got this diaper bag, I got my self one of those other diaper bags that is abviosly look like a diaper bag. I tried a couple of those and none of them I was not a fan of.First, I didn't realize how heavy they are even with nothing inside. It's even more heavy when I put everything that my baby needs. I also find that they are very bulky and NOT fashionable.So, I got this diaper bag and what I like about this is that is SUPER SUPER LIGHT.Very roomy inside Not a lot of compartment though not like those Bulky diaper bag but I didn't mind that.I don't really need a lot of separate compartment for every single thing.Inside, it has 2 compartment for bottles one for laptop or for changing pad. The changing pad I got on my own as this bag did not come with one.It didn't come with one because the bag it self can be a changing pad but I didn't like that idea due to, I have to take everything out in order to use it as one.Any I really really love this diaper bag it's super light and FASHIONABLE at the same time.

source_doc: Engine power is reduced? This can be your fix. Ok, another Cadillac story, it has been showing "engine power is reduced" for as long as I got the car as a gift. I don't mind to work on it, and for 2 months I learned a lot. I programmed all the modules that I replaced, still, engine power is reduced...So the last two things I was going to do was to change the fuel, then change the accelerator pedal, since I already changed the throttle body, the accelerator pedal was one big thing on the DTC report. My friends thought I was wasting my money, since how the Accelerator pedal can cause that? Well, that part was under water...so...why not? I took my old pedal out, to my surprise it was really easy to get it out, basically just one screw! Then I opened it, it had some corrosion on it, I tried to clean the chip with contact cleaner and wire brushes, didn't work. So I waited till next day this delivered, replaced it. Turn on the car, the "engine power is reduced" message is gone!! I ran GDS and it didn't show any DTC code, so this was a successful fix!

source_doc: I couldn't consistently keep the remotes charging. I was really excited to find this product! I have the old Wii system and I have several remotes and I thought this was a great solution to be able to use that system again. However, the product was cheaply made and it seemed to be a wobbly docking station. Once everything was plugged in and remotes were set on the charger the slightest movement stopped the charging process on some remotes. I would mess with the remote on the station and it would start charging again. But, whenever I went back to check it always seemed like a few of them were not charging again. So, I would readjust it to get it charging again only to come back and find that some were charging and some were not. After 15 to 20 minutes of this I decided to return it. I have no idea what triggered it to stop charging. But, the slightest movement seemed to disrupt the whole base. And if you left it alone it still had issues with the position of the docking station and where the charger sat. it was too much of a headache. So I returned it.

source_doc: Not sure if it worked, but my tank was cycled quickly. I watched a bunch of youtube videos and was expecting to get some giant algae bloom or a huge spike in nitrites and then nitrates.  I never experienced any of this. I was so unsure if my tank was cycled. I tested my water consistently, for 2 weeks no change. Then i bought a small rock covered in algae from petco and put it in there. I shined a flashlight that night and saw it had some good hitchhikers in it. Tiny Stomatella snails, and alot of amphipods. I watched them for a week and they were thriving so i knew it was obviously cycled now. Then i bought one fish, a diamond goby. That guy is the best purchase ive made. He is a workhorse and keeps my entire sandbed clean of all extra food. Anyways... he was happy in there. So then i knew it was safe to add more.  My tank is 75 gallons with live sand and dry live rock carib sea. The only wet live rock i added was that tiny one from petco.  I think it works. Still not sure really if it was this stuff or the extra time i gave it.

source_doc: Great auto feeder for those that work long days! This is a great auto feeder for those that work long days! I just changed jobs recently, and I'm now working 12 hr shifts. I was worried about how I would keep my 2 small dogs on their feeding schedule, as I leave before their breakfast time and get home after their supper time. This has been a lifesaver knowing my little fur babies are being fed on a regular schedule. It is simple to set up and very simple to use. The portions that dispense are perfect for my dogs. Now I can control when and how much they eat when I'm away working. I also love the fact that I can watch them and speak to them. Although they get a little excited when they hear my voice, I see disappointment when I am really not there. So I keep the speaking very limited. But sometimes they want to fuss with each other when the food comes out, so I can tell them to stop, and they typically will at that point. All that said, this is a great auto feeder with many features and will provide peace of mind knowing your little fur babies are getting their food, and seeing how happy they are when they do. I highly recommend this feeder.

source_doc: Tore My Skin - Also NOT Returnable. Sadly this “gentle” tape stuck too well. After changing my bandage only twice my skin tore as the tape was removed. I do not have thin skin. I’ve used a variety of tapes over the years, and yes skin can tear after multiple bandage changes, it happens, the skin just gets worn down. But I’ve never had it happen on the second change. The tape was really really stuck after just four hours on my skin. I slowly removed the first piece, when that gave me trouble I tried soaking the second piece. It didn’t work. I definitely don’t recommend using this product if you DO have thin skin. And I would think twice about getting this if you’re going to have to change the dressing multiple times.Worse, I had bought two different widths of this tape. When I went to return the unopened one I learned that it is not returnable. If you look at the return policy on the side bar it says it IS return or replaceable. But when you actually click on it the message pops up that says you can’t return it. No, I do not usually click on it when I see you can return it. I guess I will have to do that from now on since it is misleading to say the least.Lesson learned.

source_doc: Fit well and actually work! When buying these I was a bit skeptical because they were so much cheaper than pants from an actual motorcycle store. However, I got a jacket from a store and was trying to save money so I decided to purchase these pants. Unfortunately I got into a motorcycle accident a couple weeks ago; however, I found out the pants actually work!! There was rain on the road, I had to make a sudden stop, my bike lost traction, slid on its side, and threw me off once it hit a car. I must have slid 15ft on the asphalt, got up and was completely fine besides a few impact bruises. On top of me being fine, the pants are also fine, no rips or tears. I will continue to wear them once I fix my bike. After this experience I had to write a review because I did not see any that mentioned wearing them in a accident.A few reviews mentioned upgrading the padding inside, which I could definitely see and probably would have helped with the impact bruises. But overall these pants are WELL worth the price and I would highly recommend. Saved me from some really bad injuries!Will try to upload pictures when my phone is fixed.

source_doc: Works great on my long haired Maine Coon. I have a Maine Coon cat with really long hair. This comb really helps pull the loose hair out of his coat. I use it about once a week on him and I am always shocked at how much hair I get, between a golf ball size to tennis ball sized clump of hair when I am done. You would think after pulling up that much hair that he would be thinned out, but every week there is more. I think it really helps with the fur ball problem because I don't hear him trying to cough up the fur balls as much since I started using this every week. You just have to go slow, don't pull to hard, and if it starts to have resistance just pull up away from the body. Just watch if he likes it or not, if he is purring I good to go but if I start getting the look and the wagging tail I had better slowdown or back off. He is 24 pound cat that you want to treat right. Afterwards I give him some freeze dried chicken as a treat and he is very happy with me. I like this comb, very happy with it, best out of the five I had prior to this one.
hypos: Skvěle funguje na mé dlouhosrsté Maine Coon. Mám kočku Maine Coon s opravdu dlouhými vlasy. Tento hřeben opravdu pomáhá vytahovat volné vlasy z jeho kožichu. Používám ho asi jednou týdně a vždy mě šokuje, kolik vlasů dostanu, od velikosti golfového míčku po chomáč velikosti tenisového míčku, když jsem hotový/á. Mysleli byste si, že po vytahání takového množství vlasů by byl prořídlý/á, ale každý týden je toho víc. Myslím, že to opravdu pomáhá s problémem chlupatých koulí, protože ho neslyším se snažit vykašlat chlupaté koule tak často od té doby, co to používám každý týden. Musíte to dělat pomalu, netahat příliš silně, a pokud začne klást odpor, jednoduše táhněte pryč od těla. Jen dejte pozor, jestli se mu to líbí nebo ne, pokud mručí, je to dobré, ale pokud začnu dostávat ten pohled a mávat ocasem, měl/a bych zpomalit nebo ustoupit. Je to 24kilová kočka, kterou chcete správně ošetřit. Poté mu dám sušené kuře jako pamlsek a je se mnou velmi spokojený/á. Tohoto hřebene si moc vážím, jsem s ním velmi spokojený/á, nejlepší z pěti, které jsem měl/a před tímto.

source_doc: I feel like I was ripped off for the bracket… I’m unclear what is happening?  I’ve come back to post about the mounting bracket I bought, not about the light, but about my feelings that the ad was deceptive.  But I can’t even find the link to the bracket. The link that I had in my “orders” take me back to the light only. No bracket.  I can’t find the mounting bracket on Amazon?  Let me just say what happened,  I ordered a second “mounting bracket“ so I could share the light between two bicycles… It was I think $11.  And for $11 my brain assumed I was buying a “mounting bracket“ not “a single 1/2“ of what would be the ability to mount the light on a second handlebar… so now I would have to buy another bracket bringing my total over 20 dollars to have a complete second bracket, which is nearly the half the price of the light… with two more rackets!  But as I said, I guess it’s gonna post under the light and not under the bracket, because the two have been merger something?  The light works fine, would be better if it had some waterproofing. But what’s up with his bracket problem?
hypos: Cítím se jako bych byl/a podveden/a ohledně držáku… Nejsem si jistý/á, co se děje? Vrátil/a jsem se, abych napsal/a o držáku, který jsem koupil/a, ne o světle, ale o svých pocitech, že inzerát byl zavádějící. Ale ani nemůžu najít odkaz na držák. Odkaz, který jsem měl/a v „objednávkách“, mě vrací zpět jen ke světlu. Žádný držák. Nemůžu najít montážní držák na Amazonu? Nech mě říct, co se stalo, objednal/a jsem druhý „montážní držák“, abych mohl/a sdílet světlo mezi dvěma bicykly… Stál/a to myslím 11 dolarů. A za 11 dolarů si má mysl předpokládala, že kupuji „montážní držák“, ne „jednu polovinu“, co by byla možnost namontovat světlo na druhý řidítka… teď bych tedy musel/a koupit další držák, což by přivedlo moji celkovou částku přes 20 dolarů na úplný druhý držák, což je téměř polovina ceny světla… s dvěma dalšími držáky! Ale jak jsem řekl/a, asi se to bude zveřejňovat pod světlem, a ne pod držákem, protože tyto dvě byly něco jako fúze? Světlo funguje skvěle, bylo by lepší, kdyby mělo nějakou voděodolnost. Ale co se děje s tímto problémem s držákem?

source_doc: Great, until it fell apart! I am in a nursing home, and I had it sitting on a table at the end of my bed. I reached for it with my grabber tool, to pull it towards me, and the side literally just popped off. There are two miniscule nails holding it together, which are as thick as office staples. As soon as that side came off, the rest of it started to come apart as well. I started to do a return, but it said it had to be returned in original packaging, which of course I didn't keep. Or I could get an exchange, but I what if that falls apart too? I noticed that beside the tiny, insignificant nails, there is a trail of wood glue that is about the width of a human hair. I think if they had used bigger nails or more wood glue, it would have stayed together. I'm just going to try and hot glue it back together. If that doesn't work, I have elbow joint brackets I can screw on to each corner. If not for it falling apart, I would have given it 5 stars. The concept is awesome to store your different sizes of zippy bags in. Just wish it had been put together better.
hypos: Skvělé, dokud se to nerozpadlo! Jsem v domově důchodců a měla jsem to položené na stole na konci mé postele. Natáhla jsem se po tom se svým uchopovacím nástrojem, abych to potáhla k sobě, a ten bok doslova právě odpadl. Drží to pohromadě dvě miniaturní hřebíky, které jsou silné jako kancelářské sešívačky. Jakmile se ten bok odlepil, zbytek se také začal rozpadat. Začala jsem provádět vrácení, ale řeklo to, že musí být vráceno v originálním obalu, který jsem samozřejmě neuchovala. Nebo bych mohla požádat o výměnu, ale co když se to také rozpadne? Všimla jsem si, že vedle těch malých, bezvýznamných hřebíků je vrstva dřeva, která je široká asi jako lidský vlas. Myslím, že kdyby použili větší hřebíky nebo více lepidla na dřevo, zůstalo by to pohromadě. Jen to zkusím slepit horkým lepidlem zpět dohromady. source_doc: Awesome thermometer. I love this thermometer! I never worried about a thermometer until the RONA hit. The first time I caught it was right before we could get vaccinated and I have Fibromyalgia so even the CDC told us that I was going to have a rougher time of it than my mom. And I did, I fought with a fever for over a week while she never had a fever. (That's just the pertinent symptom here) We had gotten 2 thermometers one for the temple and I got a regular one because I had to be able to use it simply and in the dark and didn't want to fumble with it. But they both used button batteries. Guess what, a couple years later when I got it a second time (proving I was more prone to it because I didn't pass it to my mom as she had passed it to me) Both thermometers were dead and we couldn't check my temp, though I didn't have a fever. So when I saw this one and saw it took normal every day run of the mill always on hand batteries and that it displayed the same as the ones we had I grabbed it right up and it didn't disappoint. And while I don't need it yet, I did try it and it works perfectly. I'm so happy with this thermometer.

A bylo to tak, bojoval/a jsem s horečkou více než týden, zatímco ona horečku neměla. source_doc: So Easy. You just put the clips on them and they are ready to learn. I have a liftmaster + security. I looked on the garage door opener for the dangling wire, took the light cover off and saw a red button. This is my learn button. I long pressed II & III until the LED came on and then blinked a bit and went off. Since my learn button was red I clicked the I button 3 times. then pressed one of the different buttons (II or III). Then I pressed the red learn button on the garage door opener and immediately clicked the I button on the new remote. I heard 2 clicks. My light bulb is out or else it probably would have blinked 2 times as well. Afterwards I hit the I button on the remoter and the door opened. Then I hit it again and the door closed. Very easy for me. If what I said isn't clear refer to the directions that are in the box. Plus your learn button may be different. Inexpensive way to get extra remotes or replace broken ones.

source_doc: Bought 3. 1 worked. 1 won't turn on. 1 wouldn't even charge my phone and won't recharge. Seriously. I was pretty excited to find something my wife and kids could just carry in their car that would jump start it in an emergency. So I bought 3 of them. When I got them I pulled them all out of their boxes and checked the charge. The first one was 3 of 5 bars so I plugged it into a usb charger overnight. Next day I tested it out on my RV with a V10 Ford engine that had a very weak battery and it cranked like the battery was new and started right up. Still at 5 of 5 bars.I checked the second one and it was at 5 of 5 bars. I plugged my phone into it and it took my phone to 65% over about 3 hours, and then it was at 1 of 5 bars. I plugged it into the same USB charger I had the other one in and came back a few hours later and it was still at 1 bar. I let it charge overnight and it's still at 1 bar. Flashlight won't turn on and won't start anything.I checked the third one and nothing. No bars of 5. Flashlight won't come on. I plugged it into the charger for a few hours and nothing. No bars, no flashlight.

source_doc: Strange angle of mouthpiece. I think I've played just about everything that has keys or strings - even a theatre pipe organ - and I was looking for something different that was fun to play.  I did play the recorder a number of years ago, but again, I wanted something unique.  And that, is when I came across the ocarina.  I didn't want to invest a lot of money, but wanted something that had a good tone.  A little research on line brought me to the Night by Noble.  And I love it -- but my right wrist Does Not.  The mouthpiece just seems to be at an odd angle.  I did a little comparison to other brands and sure enough the angle and length is a bit odd.  Again, I really like this particular instrument, but might consider another brand with a longer and,more importantly, more angled mouthpiece, in the near future.Update - I purchased an STL Aria ocarina yesterday.  What a huge difference!  The mouthpiece angle is perfect and definitely longer.  And it gives me a great finger wrap for the balance needed in high notes.  It was three times the price of the NbN, but you pretty much get what you pay for.  I got a thick velvet carrying bag with the NbN, but wanted something more protective for a ceramic instrument.  Ended up finding a camera case that was just the right size.  I'm happy, my wrist is happy, so all is well!
hypos: Podivný úhel náústku. Myslím, že jsem hrál/a téměř na všem, co má klávesy nebo struny - dokonce i na divadelním varhanním potrubí - a hledal/a jsem něco jiného, co by bylo zábavné hrát. Před několika lety jsem hrál/a na zobcovou flétnu, ale znovu, chtěl/a jsem něco jedinečného. A tehdy jsem narazil/a na okarínu. Nechtěl/a jsem investovat hodně peněz, ale chtěl/a jsem něco, co má dobrý tón. Trochu výzkumu online mě přivedlo k Night by Noble. A miluji to -- ale mé pravé zápěstí ne. Náústek se zdá být v divném úhlu. Udělal/a jsem malou srovnávací analýzu s jinými značkami a opravdu, úhel a délka jsou trochu zvláštní. Znovu, opravdu se mi tento konkrétní nástroj líbí, ale mohu zvážit jinou značku s delším a důležitějším, více zkoseným náústkem, v blízké budoucnosti. Aktualizace - Koupil/a jsem včera okarínu STL Aria. Jaký obrovský rozdíl! Úhel náústku je dokonalý a rozhodně delší. A poskytuje mi skvělý úchop prstů pro rovnováhu potřebnou v vysokých tónech. source_doc: Bulky. I have large chihuahua so I ordered the medium according to their size recommendations.  I was surprised at how bulky this collar is.  It was a bit larger in circumference than I expected but I was able to size it down fine to fit, some of the lights are now tucked under, but there is still plenty of brightness.  The battery box and the AirTag holder are big though.  I put it on my giant Chihuahua and he was like, "what the heck is on ma neck, lady?" He got used to it quick.  I do really like the light show.  You can choose your color and your blink pattern.  This collar is bright!  Very visible will be the dog you put this on.  You can see in my one of my pictures the width of the battery box controller, and airTag holder which is what I docked the star for.  This collar is holding up well with our rainy winter night walks, but this thing verges on apparatus rather than collar.  Maybe it's just me having a smaller- but still *relatively* giant- dog and not being used to what a big dog might wear.  It came with a seatbelt adapter but I use a dog seat so I gifted that to a friend who likes it. I don't know how safe it keeps the dog but it keeps her out of the front seat!

source_doc: Day 3 and I am Hopefull. I was skeptical because for a year, nothing had worked except LOTS of medication to control the pain from the herniated disc that was causing severe sciatic pain. I have spent hundreds of dollars on pillows, creams, braces, etc and nothing has worked out.I see this on here and I decide to give it a chance. I figure if it didn't work, I'll send the sucker back. I put it together and use it for a few minutes and almost immediately, the pain was less. I do it again a couple of times the same day for just a few minutes. With each time, the pain was less and less. By the second day, I only took the Meloxicam and had alomost no pain through the day. I used it twice the next day and I had no pain. Day 3, I am not even taking the Meloxicam and I am having no pain. I am NOT saying to stop your medications! Do what your doctor says but I personally think that this is worth a try if you can afford it. It doesn't have to be this brand. There are cheaper and conversely, more expensive versions, but this partiicular one is sturdy and does what it says (for me anyway).

source_doc: Thick, plush & WARM as advertised!! Sir Thomas is a stray ( in pic), roaming the neighborhood; came up missing for a few days; when he did return, he had been in a fight. I brought out the new (still in box) thermal cat mat-pad, folded a blanket throw underneath the Morapet, so he’d be elevated a bit. This fellow didn’t hesitate; it’s as if his name was on it, got right in, laid down and was out like a light. Slept several hours. Outside temp was 47°. I called our Vet, no openings for another 4 days. I’m trying to get him to trust me more, so I can get him fixed, but this injury took front-runner, I can work on trust later. Originally, I had browsed all the other brands of self-warming mat-pads for one of our senior indoor cats, as I needed another self-warming mat-pad for Geno… I settled on this one for it’s plush fabric &  thickness, but when I saw Sir Thomas’ eye injury,  the 3 deep gashes on his paw and small bit of missing fur on his hind area, I felt this warming mat-pad really needs to go to him. Before his injury, he’d just sleep wherever he could.I was so impressed with the quality of workmanship, the thickness, plush & warmth of this product. I will be buying another 1 or 2 to replace Geno’s.  YES I would recommend this product !!

Vyndal/a jsem nový (stále v krabici) termální kočičí podložku, pod Morapet jsem složil/a deku, aby byl trochu vyvýšený/á. source_doc: Took me a long time to figure this out, but happy with it now. I was eager to try this as a way to record from my guitar onto a Macbook Pro, but was totally new to this type of device.  I understood that I would need to download 'digital audio workstation' (DAW) software, so I read about a few options and decided to go with the free version of Waveform. After downloading it, and connecting my guitar to the BOMGE, and connecting the BOMGE to my laptop (all of which were simple and quick), I spent an unsuccessful hour trying to achieve a recording. Then I downloaded Audacity software and retried, but was again unsuccessful. At that point, I had no idea whether the trouble was the BOMGE or just me not being able to figure this out. Turned out it was me. I returned to Waveform, re-watched a couple of its Youtube tutorials (which I highly recommend for beginners), and eventually got the hang of this. (With the guitar plugged into port 2, make sure that the 'inst' button is set on, and in Waveform, set the input for the recording track to 'input 2.') After that, the info page that came with the BOMGE was meaningful, and I have found the device to be just what I hoped for. It is compact in size and provides a fine sound quality for my amateur level.

source_doc: Works well, seems well made. Ok, I hate cleaning my shower. I mean it's not gross, but it's not spic-and-span either. I was glad to receive this and as soon as I got it, I plugged in the included charger and charged it for an hour or so. (It shows a red LED when charging that flips to green when fully charged.) As the pic shows, it consists of the head, where the brushes attach, along with 2 other sections, one of which contains the battery, the other is an extension piece that also telescopes to provide more length. You also get 4 brushes of various sizes.After charging it up, I sprayed down the shower with a soap scum cleaning spray and let it sit for about 5 minutes. Then I went to town on it with this little baby. I made the mistake of trying the large, flat brush, and I quickly realized the large rounded brush is a much better option for shower cleaning. Otherwise, it's a little hard to control and it dances around a bit.It worked well, and made the job simple - no awkward bending, reaching, standing in the tub, etc. Glad I purchased it. I've not tested the battery duration yet, but it didn't slow down, and still had plenty of power after I used it.

Byl/a jsem potěšen/a, když jsem to obdržel/a, a hned jak jsem to dostal/a, zapojil/a jsem dodanou nabíječku a nabíjel/a jsem to asi hodinu. (Během nabíjení svítí červená LED dioda, která se při plném nabití změní na zelenou.) Jak ukazuje obrázek, skládá se to z hlavy, kam se přichytávají kartáče, a ze dvou dalších sekcí, z nichž jedna obsahuje baterii a druhá je prodlužovací část, která se také teleskopicky prodlužuje pro větší délku. K tomu dostanete 4 kartáče různých velikostí. Po nabití jsem postříkal/a sprchu čisticím sprejem na usazeniny mýdla a nechal/a to působit asi 5 minut. Poté jsem se s tímto malým pomocníkem pustil/a do úklidu. Udělal/a jsem chybu, když jsem zkusil/a velký plochý kartáč, a rychle jsem si uvědomil/a, že velký kulatý kartáč je mnohem lepší volba pro čištění sprchy. Jinak se to hůř ovládá a trochu se to s tím kroutí. Skvěle to fungovalo a usnadnilo mi to práci - žádné nepohodlné ohýbání, natahování nebo stání ve vaně. Jsem rád/a, že jsem si to pořídil/a. Ještě jsem netestoval/a výdrž baterie, ale nezpomalilo to a po použití stále mělo dostatek energie.

source_doc: Almost impossible to play as it came. The guitar looks beautiful and I was very happy until I realized the strings had never even been tensioned....meaning the neck could easily warp.  So I got to work on it, I'm very familiar and used to setting up acoustic guitars.  First the sound hole hex key adjustment is one I've never seen...bizarre...they provide a very long and difficult to use adjustment hex....and it barely works.  This guitar came with action so high it could not be played really.  I play out fairly regularly and have some very high end guitars, even affordable Alvarez guitars I have came setup and easy to adjust.  I have no idea right now what I was do.  I know a good luthier and will get his opinion.  I'm extremely disappointed.  This instrument is not well thought out in terms of design of the neck tension system at all and the copy I received had very little care before it was taken out of a very beaten up box...perhaps it was one sent back.  But this is unplayable.  I may send it back, I wanted a jumbo that I could take out to play and not worry about a super expensive guitar...I've seen half the price guitars that are better than this one...but the finish etc is nice...what a shame the rest isn't.

source_doc: Have to use force when plugging or removing from switch. I figured it would be great alternative for my switch that I can travel with for my system, but it makes me feel iffy when I plug it into my switch. I have a hard time unplugging it and even plugging it in. As if it's tougher to insert into and remove from the c-port. I figured with decent reviews it would have been perfect but I just don't feel good about using it when I have to use force to even use it. I don't want to ruin my switch or the cord itself, but mostly my switch. I use it as a last resort. Maybe I would have better luck using it with my dock? Or maybe my cord was just not that great? Either way, I recommend looking for a better one or even the real Nintendo cord since I wouldn't want to recommend any cord that could possibly ruin someone else's system.

source_doc: Not Just for Babies! I always like to sleep with some sort of sound going and I usually like the sound of a fan noise blowing however, when I go away which is a lot, I never have any sounds I can take with me besides what I get from an app on my phone. When I saw this popup in my feed, I knew this would make the perfect addition to my travels.The product itself is small and compact. I can throw it in my suitcase and use it when I get to my destination at night in my bedroom for when I sleep. There are about 5 lullabies you can choose from and also nature sounds which is what I use to help me fall and stay asleep.

source_doc: Super impressed, I love this bra! I love this bra way more than I originally thought I would. Unfortunately I don’t have a portable breast pump so I’m stuck to a machine every 3 hours and was extremely uncomfortable balancing the cups and not being able to do anything else. The flanges fit perfectly into the bra and stay put while I pump so I can be on my phone and do other things while I pump. As per other reviews I ordered a size smaller (usually a large I’m a 34DDD) and I got a medium and it fits perfectly snug where I feel like I have a great amount of support. Bra is also really soft compared to another nursing bra I have. All in all I would definitely repurchase!

source_doc: Great product! I am very glad I ordered this product! I have lots of clear organizational types of jars and containers on my counter, which look very cute when displaying things like pasta and grains. I wanted smaller jars to display spices, such as peppercorns. These small jars are perfect for display. There are many jars to cover every spice I own, and additionally, they come with tons of labels. Some labels were pre-printed, and some were blank so I can write on them myself! They even included a pen for convenience. These glass containers will be easy to clean, easy to display, easy to stack, etc!When I opened the package, I was looking at the jars and noticed that the lids were off-center from the container. At first, I was irritated at the poor craftsmanship, but then I realized that the lids just needed to be adjusted to look right on the container. It was simply a matter of moving the lid around to make it look better. I thought I would include that note just in case anyone had the same thought!

source_doc: Buckwheat pillow for life! I have no other buckwheat pillow to compare this to, but I can say that using this pillow has eliminated neck and shoulder pain. I have not woke up with strain in my neck since I started sleeping on this pillow. Feels odd at first, as the granules collect in places and lump up, but I got used to having to shift them around to create the areas of support I need when I first lay down. Once you shift and mold the pillow to suit your neck and head, it feels like a supportive hug whilst you sleep. I use this pillow on the couch as well, as throw-pillows do not seem right after using this. There was extra buckwheat that i had to remove and I am going to make an airplane pillow out of it so I do not wreck my neck whilst flying.. BONUS!!

source_doc: Useful Microphone For Making Social Media Content. I have enjoyed using this set of microphones to make small videos for social media.  I am not super experienced but I wanted something to be able to more clearly narrate the videos I was making.  I found this set to be super user friendly.  Right out of the box, I was able to figure out how to use them.  I was a little bit apprehensive but these are really just plug and play.  The sound quality is good, probably not the best there is, but I think better then using only the microphone on my iPhone.  I didn’t use them at a distance so I cannot comment on that.  I think if you are looking for a something to get started with, at the price of  $24.99 this is a pretty good place to start.  A few of my friends have seen me using it and have even inquired about where the can pick a set up.  Definitely recommend.

source_doc: The shrimp are healthy! The shrimp are beautiful and healthy and so fun to watch.  DO NOT put them in a tank with a betta, guppies or Harlequins.  I have 2 tanks, and at first, I thought it was the betta that was eating them, so I removed him to my second tank. They still kept disappearing, so I removed the harlequins, because after hours of observation, I saw them get aggressive to the helpless shrimp. All that was left was guppies, and they still got eaten. I loved the shrimp so much, they were so fun to watch, but if I try again, I will have them in their own tank with nothing else.  They all arrived alive, healthy and very active.  Their color is so striking.  I feel terrible the research I did online was wrong.  I do wonder if you can keep different colors of shrimps together?  The red and white ones are so cool, too.  So learn from me, people, and don't put them with other fish or they will become a very expensive appetizer!

source_doc: Attractive and everything I wanted but..... I adore Lobster and Crab so I was excited to get this set.  The Crab Crackers were the best tool.  They were sturdy as were the red tools. But I was disappointed.  The Shellfish Scissors were flimsy, and I was afraid they were going to break.  I was super careful with them, and the metal picks were also flimsy, and I was afraid they were going to bend so I was afraid to pull crab meat out of the shells. I did not try the set on Lobster.  It was not an expensive set so I guess I got what I paid for............

source_doc: Love it. I get very bad motion sickness, i carry dramamine with me 24/7 because of it. In the car i have to roll the windows down and close my eyes so i dont puke. I was looking for a drug free salution, this has changed everything. I wear it in the car even on short trips. The day i got it i just got home from shopping and felt nauseous so as soon as i got it i put it on and felt relief almost instantly. I wish i knew about this last year when i went to busch gardens, i may have enjoyed the rides more but now that i have it ill be good for next time.

source_doc: Awesome product for the $18 I spend for it. Especially since I have a 44 oz thermos. This was one of the few insulated pocket carriers for drinks that I could find in the 44 oz plus. The short story is at my local Ross I bought a number of drinking thermoses because I do a lot of rollerblading, hiking, and outdoor activities. Yet, it's rare that I can find an insulated carrying case for such drink containers. I felt very fortunate when I found this particular product for its price. I appreciated this product so much that I purchased one for a friend and gave it to them for Christmas and I purchase one more for myself so that I had one on my camping bag and one on my rollerblading bag to carry my insulated drinking container.

source_doc: Sturdy stainless steel utensils. I was looking for some large stainless steel spoons and forks. I noticed one day that I was missing several spoons & forks. If anyone has teenage boys like me, you know silverware seems to disappear. When I finally decided to purchase some spoons & forks, I knew I wanted stainless steel.
