source_doc: Didn't Work !!! I bought this Jump Starter in summer because I  knew I might have problems with my car during the winter time and it happened. I didn't use my car for couple of day's and my battery was dead and it was really cold outside. So I decided to jump start it. I connected the jump starter per all the instructions and it didn't help. Unfortunately I came to the conclusion after I googled some info that it's a waist of money. It won't start your car when you have dead battery. Fortunately I asked my neighbor to jump start me and he had a really powerful portable jump starter that started my car in seconds. And I don't have old car, it's from 2017. I just don't drove very often. You can still use it as a portable power bank to charge your phone and light and that's about it. To expensive for a power bank.

source_doc: Great to use. I was extremely happy to purchase this at the price point that I did. I've been looking for a wireless keyboard for so long to reduce clutter. Definitely wanted to wait for a sale as I didn't want to spend original price for it.I've had mechanical keyboards now for over 10 years now. Some corsair, and some off-brand ranging from $20-$150. This has definitely been the best keyboard that I have typed on, and love the wireless function. I have not had ANY delays. I've played MMO's, FPS, and various strategic games and have no issues. I also type a fairly high amount as I am in a work from home position and typing a good portion of the day.As part of anything that may be faulty, I did notice in plenty of reviews people complaining about the quality of the keycaps. I have no issue with it as I know that these keycaps are so light to press. Wife has a keychron (also great) and I can definitely tell the keycaps are bigger, but will also require a little bit more force for similar switches.

source_doc: So much more than I expected. Ok, so I open my package and my heart sinks. I see this tiny little thing about 1/3 the size I imagined. So charging took about 2 hours and I was on pins and needles waiting for it. So fully charged connect it up and BOOM! Wow! So much more sound quality than I expected. The distortion and clean are exactly what I would expect. The bluetooth let me jam along with a backing track AND since BT and INPUT both have separate volumes you can mix it in perfectly. The delay AND delay time is precious and then you still have gain and a 3 band EQ! I can’t wait to run this into my Valve JR head and out my 2 12” cabs. Oh oh I wonder how harmonica sounds through it? Damn, gotta wait till tomorrow to “GET LOUD” I can’t turn this up more than 1/4 if I want to be able to turn my guitar up. So much louder than I expected… I might just have to call this thing a great affordable Christmas present for all my music jamming friends!

Nabíjení trvalo asi 2 hodiny a já jsem byl/a na trní, když jsem na to čekal/a. Po plném nabití to připojím a BAM! Wow! O tolik lepší zvuková kvalita, než jsem očekával/a. Zkreslení a čistota jsou přesně to, co bych očekával/a. Bluetooth mi umožnilo hrát s doprovodnou skladbou A protože BT a VSTUP mají oba samostatné hlasitosti, můžete to perfektně zkombinovat. Zpoždění A doba zpoždění je cenná a ještě máte gain a 3 pásmový EQ! Nemohu se dočkat, až to zapojím do své hlavy Valve JR a do svých 2 12” beden. Oh, oh, zajímá mě, jak zní harmonika? Sakra, musím počkat do zítřka, abych „DOSTAL HLASITĚ“. Nemohu to zapnout víc než na 1/4, pokud chci být schopen/a zvýšit hlasitost své kytary. source_doc: if you use festool, with makita vac…it’s a must. it has taken me a long time to work with multiple tool platforms.  Not having a money tree and moving among trade work, construction, and wood working it is also a fact that festool doesn’t make every tool under the sun.  I like the makita vacuum and have really enjoyed it, but bouncing back and forth between AWS gear and plugged in festool devices I got the idea to get this product and velcro a festool power chord to it.  Now when I use my festool planer or sander, I swap hoses (which is easy unlike other extractor or shop vac platforms) and attach the one with the chord.  No it’s not the festool system, but it works for me and has made my desire to get another dust extractor not be a hot button issue.  The older I get the more conscious I am of what I am breathing in.  I can’t say I gave much thought into sanding walls in my fraternity house 30 yrs ago. What I can say is that while I work alone in a job, I will have several extractors, but as far as I am concerned this hose has at least temporarily saved me $900.
hypos: Pokud používáte Festool s vysavačem Makita… je to nutnost. Trvalo mi dlouho, než jsem se naučil/a pracovat s více platformami nástrojů. Nemít peněžní strom a pohybovat se mezi řemeslnou prací, stavitelstvím a truhlářstvím je také fakt, že Festool nevyrábí každý nástroj pod Sluncem. Líbí se mi vysavač Makita a opravdu jsem si ho užil/a, ale při přecházení mezi vybavením AWS a zapojenými zařízeními Festool mě napadlo pořídit si tento produkt a připevnit na něj pomocí suchého zipu napájecí kabel Festool. Teď, když používám svou frézu nebo brusku Festool, měním hadice (což je snadné, na rozdíl od jiných platforem odsavačů nebo vysavačů) a připojuji tu s kabelem. Ne, není to systém Festool, ale funguje to pro mě a udělalo to můj zájem po pořízení dalšího odsavače prachu nezávažnou záležitostí. Čím starší jsem, tím více si uvědomuji, co dýchám. Nemohu říct, že bych o broušení stěn v mém bratrstvu před 30 lety příliš přemýšlel/a. Co mohu říct, je, že když pracuji sám/sama, budu mít několik odsavačů, ale co se mě týče, tato hadice mi alespoň dočasně ušetřila 900 dolarů.

source_doc: stopped working after less than 1 month. i like the design, feel and style of this keyboard. it's one of the few that's not the annoying RGB-colored nonsense that i personally find tacky. everything's great... until less than 1 month goes by and i noticed my text would delete itself while typing, or it'd bring up a random window, or command prompt... then it got worse.i take every key off and clean it with air - still broke. so i look up a keyboard input tester. if i press any bottom row key (like space bar for example), it thinks i'm pressing every single bottom row key (ctrls, alts, windows, fn, and even the left, down and right arrow keys)it progressed so far that i can't use it for gaming, web browsing, writing emails - ANYTHING. it's useless junk. instead of jumping to a negative review, like i am now, i contacted the seller directly and they want to put me through the rigamarole instead of giving me a refund. they do this to demotivate people from getting a refund, and they will waste your time - i've been through this before.maybe i just got a defected one, but even if yours isn't, they're not keen on giving refunds, so i think that says a lot, personally. i 100% regret purchasing this.

source_doc: Very useful, built in metronome is nice. As a person who has been playing bass for almost 16 years now, I tend to try to get whatever equipment I can. For years I had been looking for a metronome, but never really found one at a price point I wanted. After seeing that this tuner has a built in metronome, I decided to give it a try. I charged it with the included cable and first tested it as a tuner. I used the included (piezo?) sensor on the headstock of my acoustic and it seems to be just as accurate as any other tuner I've used in the past. Afterwards, I played with the metronome for a bit, adjusted the tempo, changed up the rhythms, and was quite surprised with the variety of beats I could get out of it. If I didn't already have a designated tuner pedal, I'd probably use this at my local church where I play bass. Display is pretty good, and easy to read, too, so there's that.Overall, I'm satisfied with it. I give it a thumbs up.

source_doc: Good support for every day activities. I received this item quickly. I bought these due to laxity and history of sprains in both of my ankles.  I wanted something that I could wear if on my feet for extended periods of time that wasn’t as restrictive as a brace.  I wouldn’t recommend these if playing sports or doing an activity where a lot of support is needed.I find the material comfortable and great quality, while being reasonably priced.  I ordered a small, which is the size I usually wear.  I found them true to size.  They are not easy to get off, but I wouldn’t expect them to be, given they are made for compression.  I have washed them on the delicate cycle in my washer machine and line dry them and they have held up very well.  I would recommend these for anyone looking for ankle support for every day activities.

source_doc: This worked so good!!! I just bought a new to me 2020 Charger. When I first got it, I could see water spots, so I went and washed it, got it all nice and wiped down and still water spots on all the windows...ugh! So, then I got my windows tinted and the water spots really showed up after that...it was horrible. so, I found this and I wish you could see but my camera just couldnt get the pic I wanted...it got rid of all my water spots, like awesome! I worked in small sections, wiped side to side with a microfiber cloth for about a minute, I used, their speed wash to neutralize it, when I was done with a whole window, I wiped it down again with glass cleaner. Dont forget to roll your window down slightly to get the top. But this stuff worked wonderfully!!!!

source_doc: I love this brand. So i actually bought the white one last year and i loved it but the keys where so loud but overall i loved it. I am a gamer, and the mouse did start to miss a few clicks so i decided it was time for a new keyboard and mouse. I decided to go with the pink one this time because white is hard to keep clean and i just didnt want to do the black since my mouse pad and mic are black. Anyways i actually love the pink one a lot more and the keys are a lot quitter, and the lights are more fun and easier to control and there are so many more options with this one then the one i had before. The only issue that i have is the space bar is a little harder to hit. And while that isn't a big deal for just typing it can be when you miss a jump in a game. Other than that, yeah i would buy this keyboard and mouse again. the mouse is perfect so far and I haven't missed a click.

source_doc: No small hole in either of the lids. This product comes with two lids. I would be much happier if it came with just one lid, as long as the lid had a small hole to let air in as you drink. Since I have two lids, I may even drill a hole in one of them. I would like to find a was to seal the hole I drill  when the lid is closed though.Also, note that this bottle is 32oz and not 32fl oz as this page correctly states. I knew the plastic water bottles I usually by are 16fl oz so I was expecting this to be about two bottles. Guess I didn't pay enough attention, but that is fine. source_doc: What I expected for the price. I had to send the first order of these baskets back due to damage to the large & medium basket. The return procedure was very simple and I quickly received the replacement order. These baskets are exactly what I expected for the price I paid. Before I ordered I read through the reviews. I was surprised that one of the complaints was that they were not made of wicker but plastic. A set of natural wicker baskets would cost way more than the $40 I paid for these. In spite of the plastic they look very nice and seem sturdy. I have not put any items in them yet but I am sure they will be fine. They are woven around a wire frame and I am sure they will hold up once filled, Another complaint was the inside metal pieces that hold the straps in place. The baskets I purchased are safe. The pointy ends are tucked under the weave. I figured if there was any danger I would simply cover the metal with some sturdy tape, All in all I am pleased with my purchase and I would recommend these baskets.

source_doc: Comparable to other standard wipers but is definitely not premium. I was fortunate in the fact that I got to utilize the wipers in the rain and slush right away on a 10 hour drive across state (California 2/24/2023) and it happened to rain 9 out of those 10 hours too. The wipers I would say were very quiet and I did not hear any noise from them what so ever, however they do bend a bit at the top tip when moving across the windshield which makes me question its longevity in terms of quality. The wipers were also labeled as premium and they are definitely not. I did get steaks on one of the wipers as it moved back into the down position and it did it every time throughout my drive but while going back up, it cleared it. For the price, I would say its worth buying and should last through the season I hope. Would I buy them again?... I most likely would not. On a side note, I did buy three sets for all my cars and none of them came labeled with the sizing so I had to measure the lengths to determine which was for which vehicle.

source_doc: This continues to be very popular!  Three dogs, and they love it. I was dubious about how this would hold up, or that it would keep my dog's interest, but after three months it is still a hit!  I mean, I know it's the FOOD that makes them interested, but they all will keep moving around, finding every last piece of dog food out of it.  It takes some time to load, but I've found that I can just sprinkle regular dog food (small bite sized) while I'm spreading apart the folds and it goes pretty quickly.  I expected that with two puppies and an adult dog that they'd start chewing up the polar-fleece type fabric, but they haven't done that at all.  It's big enough that it doesn't slide around, since they're typically standing on at least part of it, and I like that I can just fold it and then roll it up, with the built-in strap holding it together like a small sleeping bag.  When I want to use it, I just unroll, load the kibble in, and then I let the dogs in from outside and watch them just go at it!  They're busy, busy, busy, with their tails wagging the whole time.  I love it!
hypos: Tohle zůstává velmi populární! Tři psi, a milují to. Byl/a jsem skeptický/á, jak to vydrží, nebo jestli to udrží zájem mého psa, ale po třech měsících je to stále hit! Myslím, že vím, že to je JÍDLO, co je činí zainteresovanými, ale všichni se neustále pohybují a hledají každý poslední kousek psího jídla z toho. Nahrávání to zabere nějaký čas, ale zjistil/a jsem, že mohu jen nasypat běžné psí jídlo (malé kousky) zatímco rozkládám záhyby a jde to docela rychle. Očekával/a jsem, že s dvěma štěňaty a dospělým psem začnou kousat syntetickou látku typu polar fleece, ale to vůbec neudělali. Je to dost velké, že se to neposouvá, protože obvykle stojí alespoň na části toho, a líbí se mi, že to mohu jen složit a pak srolovat, s vestavěným popruhem, který to drží pohromadě jako malý spacák. Když to chci použít, jen to rozbalím, naplním granulemi a pak pustím psy ven a sleduji, jak se na to vrhnou! Jsou zaneprázdněni, zaneprázdněni, zaneprázdněni, s ocasy vrtícími se celou dobu. source_doc: Disappointment. Bought these based on the reviews that were like "Oh my god these damaged my stairs when I removed them!" because I didn't plan on removing them and I wanted them to stick as good as possible.Well... they don't. These are old stairs. Still though, I prepped them as I would anything that I plan to stick with adhesive. They were very easy to stick down but unfortunately they're not that sticky. I've walked over each piece on each stair back and forth multiple times to get as much pressure on every point of contact and they just won't stay stuck. I don't know what to do other than maybe some contact cement around all the edges.These are cheap and look alright. I'd be more upset if they were priced higher but I should have figured this would be the outcome for what I paid. I guess I was just hoping that the reason other reviews say they damage stairs when they're removed is because they stick SO well. Not the case, actually.

source_doc: Long story short Gotta go with OEM. Had a Delta Bathtub faucet leaking, I looked for replacement but Delta OEM ones are very expensive.I went with the after markets one to save money. Every since I replaced OEM with After Market.When I turn on hot water, my pipe was making knocking noise inside of wall. first I thought maybe air went in there while I was working on replacing the cartridge, I bleed air out but problem persist. I looked through online trying to figure out why, but no one had same problem like I have. On some youtube somewhere I saw someone had similar problem (Different brand) and using OEM parts fixed the problem. So I finally decided to buy OEM and boom, problem fixed. I think it was because it is not properly sealed, maybe size is very very slightly different. So in long story short. Don't buy after market it is useless Buy OEM, worked like a charm.

source_doc: It's perfect 💕 I love the look of this basket. The color the pockets are deep. My dog seems to like it. I started a return on this purchase because I thought it was just to big. Then I couldn't get the walls to stand up. I didn't understand that at all.  To top it off the basket was touching my tire without my dog being in it.  I was very disappointed. I read the description on the site and thought I measured it right. I got up the next morning determine to make this basket work.  I just loved the look of it especially the color  Ok, the side walls...the openings are hidden up under the Velcro. Which you wouldn't know unless you was really looking.  Once I figured that out the basket was sturdy. Then I tried it on my bike again. You have to pull all the straps up and make it as tight as you can to make sit right. After doing this, the basket no longer sat on my tire. I put my dog in the basket and it was a perfect fit. I'm so glad I didn't return it. I'm in love with all over again. I see my dog and I doing a lot of riding. I just love it💕

source_doc: Pretty good vs regular melatonin. I use melatonin sometimes when I'm having issues sleeping so when I saw this was 20 mg I decided I would have to try them.  When I was setting down for the night I popped one of these pills and waited for the magic.  It took about 15 minutes and I was out out for the night.  I did notice the next morning I wasn't as groggy as I had been with just plain melatonin (guess that's the magnesium)  so I like these more that the usual melatonin I get.  The taste and smell are n/a to me as I just open it and pop it in with a drink of water.  The pills are a bit big so I would use water with them.  All in all, I like these for sleepless nights and they will be my go-to from now on.

Když jsem si večer lehl/a, vzal/a jsem jednu z těchto pilulek a čekal/a na kouzlo. Trvalo to asi 15 minut a já jsem byl/a spánek na celou noc. Ráno jsem si všiml/a, že nejsem tak grogy jako jsem býval/a s obyčejným melatoninem (myslím, že to je tím hořčíkem), takže mi tyto vyhovují více než obvyklý melatonin, který mám. Chuť a vůně mi připadají bezpředmětné, protože to jen otevřu a spolknu s douškem vody. Pilulky jsou trochu velké, takže bych k nim používal/a vodu. Celkově se mi tyto líbí na bezesné noci a od teď budou mými favority.

source_doc: I can't believe how cheap this was. Because it certainly doesn't feel or look cheap. It looks higher end than it is.I've been using it for a little while, before deciding to write a review, and I love it just as much now as when I first got it. The keys are clacky, in a pleasing textile-ish kind of way, if you like that, but also not obnoxiously loud at the same time. I did notice the space bar is a bit springier sounding than the other keys like others have said, but I honestly don't even think about it when I'm using it anymore. The contrast of the white keys against the stainless is very aesthetically pleasing. I wish it had dedicated volume buttons, but I'll live. Because the keys are raised, I find it very easy to dust when cleaning--it even includes a cleaning brush to get between the keys, which I thought was a nice touch. The different light modes are fun, though I usually just keep them stationary. It just makes my work area a little more playful, and I love that because it's so me. I don't know much about gaming keyboards or what actually makes a keyboard a **gaming** keyboard, so maybe those who are more hardcore might be able to pick it apart. But I bet a kid would absolutely love this. I'm 38 and I sure do!
hypos: Nemohu uvěřit, jak levné to bylo. Protože to určitě nepůsobí ani nevypadá levně. Vypadá to luxusněji, než ve skutečnosti je. Používal/a jsem to už nějakou dobu, než jsem se rozhodl/a napsat recenzi, a miluji to stejně jako když jsem to poprvé dostal/a. Klávesy jsou příjemně klepající, pokud to máte rádi, ale také nejsou nepříjemně hlasité. Všiml/a jsem si, že mezerník zní o něco pružněji než ostatní klávesy, jak říkali jiní, ale upřímně na to už ani nemyslím, když to používám. source_doc: Perfect Wireless Keyboard for Home Office. I work from home all the time.  This one is the perfect keyboard to use on daily basis.  I really love the inbuilt lights since I like to work in a dark place.  You can see the keys clearly with the use of built-in lights.  I thought the keys will get stuck before ordering it.  But after I received it and started using it, the keys never got stuck.  I have a new experience since I never used a wireless mechanical keyboard.  I have a personal Macbook and I tried using the keyboard with it.  It works well with Macbook too.  I am using it for gaming purposes too.  It is really very ergonomic since I am on my laptop for at least 10 hours a day.  I would say it is 100% worth buying it.

source_doc: Mind blown. These were easy to get setup. Fill water to the fill line then drop one of the tubes in and stick the sprayer in and twist tight until you hear it click. It's fun to watch the concentrate go in the water. Each one has its own scent and are for certain areas and materials. It suggests spraying the soiled areas and let them soak for 10 minutes. Then I take the color coordinated cloths that came with them and wipe up the mess. It literally works really well. So far I've used the kitchen one my countertop. I purposely left my cupcake mess from the night before and just cleaned it and I could not believe how easy it was to wipe off( and there was hard frosting on there). Then I used the glass and sprayed the mirrors. I've always used a foam and paper towels but I used the cloth and I seriously couldn't believe it. There were NO streaks and I didn't have to go back over the areas. The last one I used tonight was the shower. I didn't go all gung-ho on the shower but I sprayed it on some areas that get build up quite often and let it sit for a little bit. Again, I couldn't believe how easy the grossness comes off. Tomorrow I'm tackling the bathroom with a blacklight and will update with video!
hypos: Mysl vybuchla. Bylo snadné to nastavit. Naplňte vodu až po vyznačenou čáru, pak vložte jeden z trubek a nasaďte sprchu a pevně otočte, dokud neuslyšíte cvaknutí. Je zábavné sledovat, jak koncentrát jde do vody. Každý má svou vlastní vůni a je určen pro určité oblasti a materiály. Doporučuje se stříkat na znečištěné oblasti a nechat je nasáknout po dobu 10 minut. Poté vezmu barevně sladěné utěrky, které s nimi přišly, a uklidím nepořádek. Opravu to funguje skvěle. source_doc: Decent quality at a good price. I am one of those old retired guys that has been building at stuff for, well, since Kennedy got elected.  Anyway, I have so many types of bits it is crazy, but counter-sinks are something I never have enough of.  These are pretty good.  They are not the best you can buy, but they are well worth the money.  The actual bit is ok, but that does not matter a lot to me as I have a substantial number of titanium bits to replace them.  The counter sinks work well in wood and aluminum.  The taper design is something that can work very well, when needed.For the price and the value quality, I feel compelled to give them a 5.Note: I have been an Amazon customer for almost 20 years. I write all of my reviews to reflect my personal observations and opinions on a product. It matters not if I have purchased the item myself or if it was provided to me for review. My goal is to provide other potential customers as much real-world knowledge as possible to make an informed decision. In most cases I will return to my review in 6 months or less to see if I should alter my original observations. In no case will the cost of a product influence my opinions at all. In addition, I will try to include multiple images and or videos on each product, if practical.

source_doc: I bought this for my two dogs excessive itching. -This was nicely packaged.  No breaks or leaks.  Also came with three different pumps.  A screw on/off, pop top, and a pump.  I personally like the pump.  It’s the easiest.-Make sure to read directions.  I was giving my dog too much out of habit from another brand I was using.  She starting getting runny poops and I think it was making her feel sick.  I skipped it a couple days and just started giving her one pump and I have no more issues.-It doesn’t seem to bother the dogs at all.  I do a pump over their food and they eat it all!  It doesn’t smell at all.  Makes their bowls greasy but I expected that.The reason I give it a three star is because the other brand I was using seemed to work better.  It definitely helped the itching but they still do a bit as where the other brand seemed to stop it completely.  Noting that.  I wouldn’t buy this again I would stick with the other brand

source_doc: Perfect for small pet food cans. The wet food that I feed my cats comes in small cans and these lids are perfect for saving any leftovers in the refrigerator. They fit perfectly and create a good seal which keeps my refrigerator from smelling like cat food. They’re very easy to wash with soap and hot water. I believe they can even go in the dishwasher but I’ve never tried it. I just wash them when I wash the cat food dishes every night. I’ve had these for nearly a year and they still look and work like they did when I first used them. I highly recommend them for any pet owner that needs to save leftovers.I should mention that I took one of these over to my Mom’s house after Thanksgiving because she wanted a top for leftover canned cranberry jelly (you know the type of gross wobbly cranberry stuff in a can that is somehow a staple of Thanksgiving every year) and she hasn’t returned it because she really likes it. I can’t fault her for that so I guess I really should buy another pack of two. Life is easier when you have more than one of these so I suppose what I’m trying to say is that you should buy more than you think you need. :)
hypos: Perfektní pro malé plechovky s krmivem pro domácí mazlíčky. Mokré krmivo, které krmím své kočky, přichází v malých plechovkách a tyto víčka jsou dokonalé pro uchovávání jakýchkoliv zbytků v lednici. Skvěle sedí a vytvářejí dobrou těsnost, která zabraňuje tomu, aby má lednice voněla jako krmivo pro kočky. Velmi se snadno myjí mýdlem a horkou vodou. Věřím, že je lze dokonce dát do myčky, ale nikdy jsem to nezkoušel/a. Jen je myji, když myji mističky na krmivo pro kočky každou noc. Mám je už téměř rok a stále vypadají a fungují jako když jsem je poprvé použil/a. Velmi je doporučuji každému majiteli domácího mazlíčka, který potřebuje uchovat zbytky. Měl/a bych zmínit, že jsem jednu z nich vzal/a k mamince po Díkůvzdání, protože chtěla víčko na zbylou plechovku želé z brusinek (víte, ten typ odporné, kymácející se věci z plechovky, která je nějakým způsobem základním jídlem Díkůvzdání každý rok) a ona mi ji ještě nevrátila, protože se jí opravdu líbí. Nemohu jí to mít za zlé, takže si asi opravdu mám koupit další balení dvou. Život je jednodušší, když máte víc než jedno z těchto, takže asi to, co se snažím říct, je, že byste měli koupit víc, než si myslíte, že potřebujete. :)

source_doc: I can't imagine having My switch without this product. I absolutely love my glass screen protector for my Nintendo Switch! I've always been worried about accidentally scratching the screen or ruining it in some way, but since I've put on this protector, I don't have to worry about that anymore. It's super easy to install and doesn't take long at all. Plus, I can't even tell it's there when I'm playing my games.What I love most about this screen protector is that it doesn't affect the touch screen sensitivity in any way. I was a little worried that it might, but it doesn't at all. I can still play my games just as easily and smoothly as I could before. I also really appreciate that it's crystal clear, so I can see everything on my screen without any distractions.Overall, I am so glad I got this screen protector. It's a must-have for anyone who wants to keep their Nintendo Switch screen in pristine condition. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a high-quality and effective screen protector.

source_doc: Skunk odor shampoo. This product did not work. It was night of course when my dog got sprayed by a skunk. I did not have this shampoo,  so I did a quick Google search on how to remove the skunk smell. It was recommend to use peroxide,  baking soda and a drop of dish soap. I left my dog outside,  and grabbed a bucket. I quickly mixed solution in a bucket and grabbed a rag. I gave my dog a sponge bath outside with this solution. I left it on for about 15 minutes and  then brought her inside to shower to rinse off. I applied some conditioner,  then gave her another good rinse. It really worked well. I could barely smell any odor. I then ordered this shampoo. I received it 2 days later. I gave my dog a bath again using the shampoo straight from the bottle on dry coat, I then added water and began lathering it up well. I let it sit on for 10-15 minutes. She now smells like a skunk again,  I was very disappointed,  I am returning the shampoo,  waste of time and money.

source_doc: Very easy to use. I bought this for my front door because I noticed light and cold air leaking through where the door meets the frame.  I must admit that I am not very handy and a bit of a diy dunce.  I really thought this would be a good temporary fix until I could call a handyman.  Much to my surprise,  it actually works great and I didn't need any help at all with it.  The whole process is fairly simple,  but don't skip the preparation steps.  Simply measure out how much you need and cut it to size.  Clean off the area first.  I used rubbing alcohol because it dries so quickly.  This helps the adhesive stick to the surface without getting messed up by dirt or dust.  Peel off the backing and stick it in place with a fair amount of pressure.  I let it cure for 24 hours before I used the door again.  That might be excessive,  but I wanted to be extra cautious.  The D shape is really neat because it expands into the little gaps.  Nothing is getting through now.

source_doc: I didn't think I would love it. I honestly wasn't expecting to love this game.  I was waiting for Frosthaven to arrive from the kickstarter and was jonesing for a card game fix that was easy to set up.  Then I saw the reviews for this and figured I'd give it a try since I had a gift card to burn.  Well glad I did, I put 70 hours into it before the credits rolled and I'm waiting for all the DLC to get released before playing it again on new game plus. I'll be honest I haven't had a game tickle me like that since DBZ: Kakarot a few years back.The game loop is nice; get cards, get powers, and make friends.  The combo of it all worked perfect for me, and I was telling my wife dumb stories from the game about blade and captain marvel cute romance or the book club which I found hilarious.  Also one of the first times I've liked captain America.  Or I should say I got him in a way the movies/comics never worked for me.  I still don't like Tony, but that's not a surprise he's a terrible human being.I'm excited for the DLC and what they add since I figure I'll be putting in another 40-60 hours easily to platinum the game on my NG+ run.

source_doc: Super soft exactly what I was looking for. I bought this bc I have a hole in one of the cushions of my couch and I just don't have the money to buy a new couch. Anyway. This cover is really nice. It feels super soft like a brand new couch and super stretchy. I got a large for my couch and I think I could've used an extra large since my cushions are very big. I'm 8 months pregnant and i got it on by myself in maybe 10 minutes after I figured out how it was supposed to go. It's mostly walking circles around your couch pulling on it until it doesn't look weird. I also obviously didn't care too much about that, it covered a hole. I got black because it was the cheapest, if you don't like obvious pet hair or dirt marks, obviously black is a bad choice for you, be aware of that. Overall it's super nice and I'll probably buy more to keep rotating until I can buy a new one but I'm super happy with this. I haven't tried the water resistant factor but even if it's not, I'm not mad about it.

source_doc: Not a fan. I liked this keyboard at first.  I work from home and although my employer happily provides me with a keyboard that functions just fine.  I don't like cords.  My old Logitech wireless keyboard was still going strong but I wanted something you could actually see letters on the keys on, I'd worn the writing off of most of my keys.  So I picked this one, I didn't notice that it was rechargeable until after it arrived.  I thought oh that's kind of cool no more batteries.  Then about day four middle of a phone call with a client my keyboard just stops working.  I tried quickly plugging it in to my phone charger hoping it would allow me to keep typing, but no it didn't. There was no warning that it was about to run out battery life 🔋, no battery power warning or anything.  I tried it again after being plugged in for a while and it worked again.  However I can't have my keyboard just stop working mid work day.  So I returned it for something without flashing keys and something that ran off batteries.  In the 5 years my Logitech was in use I only put a new battery in it once.  If you can remember to charge it daily it might be great.

source_doc: Color match is terrible. I read so many amazing reviews so I had to try this; and I was so excited to try it!! Unfortunately I was matched with 010 “light beige” and it literally looks like I put orange costume makeup on my face, and it’s not a very pleasant texture. It breaks up and feels kinda chalky. I’m VERY fair/pale skinned but the colors online aren’t true to how they look in person. Online it said I could return it but once it arrived they said they don’t allow returns. I tried to return it before I even opened it because I could tell this was WAY too dark for me. Very disappointed. I’m going to give it to my mom who has a deeper olive complexion. I want to try this brand again in the lightest shade but I won’t purchase until it goes back on sale. Gosh I really I wanted to love this.I’ve ben looking for good foundation for literally years. I might just have to go to a higher end brand.

source_doc: Learning How To Play at 66! I have loved Gospel Music since I was 18 years old!  I vowed that I would learn to play it at some point in my life. Well that point is here and after looking for the standard organ in Black churches, I decided that I didn’t need a Hammond and Leslie in our house.  After researching dozens of keyboards and reading hundreds of reviews, boom!  Here I am with this keyboard in my house and me practicing scales with proper finger placement!  This is an amazing keyboard. It is amazing how accurate the instruments are and it has organ voices that emulate the Hammond and Leslie, which is the main reason I bought it!  I am so excited about the feel of the keys and the ability for it to run off of AA batteries!!Now that I have no excuse, it is on to the included DVD and booklet and YouTube instructional videos for playing Black Gospel music and finally my next purchase of full size base pedals that plug into it. Yes, I have a headset so that my wife doesn’t need to endure what we endured when our kids were learning instruments. I highly recommend this amazing instrument. Top quality and design and a definite value for the money.
hypos: Učím se hrát ve 66 letech! Gospelovou hudbu miluji od svých 18 let! Sliboval/a jsem si, že se ji v některém bodě svého života naučím. No a ten moment je tady a po hledání standardního varhan v černických kostelech jsem se rozhodl/a, že nepotřebuji Hammond a Leslie v našem domě. Po výzkumu desítek klávesnic a přečtení stovek recenzí, bum! Tady jsem s touto klávesnicí v domě a cvičím stupnice s správným umístěním prstů! Tato klávesnice je úžasná. Je úžasné, jak přesné jsou nástroje a má varhanné hlasy, které napodobují Hammond a Leslie, což je hlavní důvod, proč jsem ji koupil/a! Jsem tak nadšený/á z pocitu kláves a možnosti napájení z AA baterií! Teď, když už nemám žádnou výmluvu, přecházím na přiložené DVD a brožuru a YouTube výuková videa pro hraní černé gospelové hudby a konečně na svůj další nákup plně velikostních basových pedálů, které se do ní zapojí. Ano, mám sluchátka, abychom se s manželkou nemuseli trápit tím, co jsme zažívali, když se naše děti učily hrát na nástroje. Důrazně doporučuji tento úžasný nástroj. Nejvyšší kvalita a design a rozhodně výhodné za peníze.

source_doc: Exactly what I needed. These are great! I started woodworking and whittling as a hobby and the gloves are the best. I recently burnt my thumb while cooking and was still worried I'd stab my thumb while working. Sure if I intentionally tried to make the knife go into the glove it will happen, it's cut resistant not stab resistant. I have accidentally stabbed a few fingers but there was enough padding for it to cushion it so I didn't bleed or get seriously hurt. I mainly use whittling knives, though.The bumpy grip stuff is great. I have arthritis in my hands and sometimes things slip my grasp, but not with these.Make sure to order a size down because like the other reviewers say: they run big. I would fit a medium by the charts standards but I fit into a small. I have no problem with the finger length since I have "piano player length" fingers. Your hands will get sweaty if worn too long but isn't super horrible, I wear them for 3-5 hrs at a time.They don't wear down too fast. With what I do and judging by the one month I've had them, I could see them lasting 3-4 months before needing to replace them.I give all 5 stars cause it's exactly what I was looking for.
hypos: Přesně to, co jsem potřeboval/a. Tyto jsou skvělé! Začal/a jsem se dřevosculpting a řezbářstvím jako koníčkem a tyto rukavice jsou nejlepší. Nedávno jsem si při vaření spálil/a palec a stále jsem se obával/a, že si při práci propíchnu palec. Jistě, pokud bych se úmyslně pokusil/a, aby nůž pronikl do rukavice, stane se to, je to odolné proti řezu, ne odolné proti propíchnutí. source_doc: Decent, feels like you need a lot though. Thus works a lot like your average face masks. You definitely see a brightness to your skin immediately after use. I want to add, that it seems like I need a large amount the couple times I have used this, and I'm not sure if this is just me and battling the different texture it is, or that I really do need more than I do with other masks. Still, it does work as good as your average ones. My face feels and looks radiant after use, so for me, this is a value for price review. The amount I get and use vs the price compared to other masks, is a bit steep for my liking. I have found 8 dollar ones of different brands that have 3 times more, and work the same as this, so the value just hits in the middle for me. This is something I would definitely order again, if it came in higher quantity, but until it does, I can save money by shopping in store for other brands that give the near same effect. This will be something I definitely will check in on to see if I can get a deal ever though, so it's better than some out there.

source_doc: Great replacement and easy to install - All tools were included. I've had my Aeron chair for nearly ten years. I picked it up used to replace my crappy old chair from one of the big box stores when it finally gave up the ghost. So recently I heard a "crack" and saw that the back frame of the seat had finally worn down and broken.I was beside myself. I didn't want to buy another chair, so I looked for repair shops in the area. One of the shops referred me direct to this product page and said, "order this, and if you want, I can install it." So I did.Fast forward and, still sitting on the broken seat, busy with work, I decided to look up what the repair entailed. I found a tutorial on youtube. Four bolts for the seat. Two nuts to transfer the j-bars. I figured I could handle it.This replacement seat kit came with the hex wrench needed to undo the seat, and a fitted wrench and a T25 torx driver to quickly transfer the j-bar. It took a few minutes, and a bit of leaning in because the bolts were really in there, but the replacement was easy. I literally didn't take out my toolbox because I had everything I needed in the kit.Really well designed chair and replacement was super easy. Five stars.

source_doc: My teeth squeak all the time now. My teeth squeak all the time now. Not in a cheesey mouse way or a "squeaky clean", but whenever I eat anything they start squeaking. It is the most uncomfortable thing ever and I only used two of the packets (one of the rapid ones and one of the normal) two weeks apart. Basically feels like the equivalent of nails going down a chalkboard but with your teeth.My teeth were never very sensitive and I would die for them to be super white so when I saw the deal on Black Friday, I HAD to cop. I was super excited to potentially see results, but after the two I used that obviously had no results, I was hoping that I could at least keep using them to try to get them to lift. However, for some reason a few days after my last strips I craved almonds. And that is when I first found out how teeth squeaking feel like. I thought I was going insane and looked it up and sure enough, almonds do make some people's teeth squeak. But it wouldn't stop after that. Just eating certain foods will make my teeth squeak and it made life a little more unenjoyable. Literally would have felt a little better if my teeth lifted a little bit. Thanks, Crest.

source_doc: Fine 4 daytime but will leak. I use these for daytime because I used them 1 time during the night and they leaked as though he didnt have one on at all. Also, I ordered the solid color set with blue green and black the first time in XS they fit perfectly for my 7lb Long-Haired Chihuahua but ordered again but orederd a decrative set same size XS and they were way too small, so had to send them back. Was going to reorder in the same color set of blue green and black but in the mean time, as I said...he leaked through in the night and it was as though he didn't have a diaper on at all. That prompted me to find a thicker diaper...which I did. I use the thicker diaper at night and I use these during the day.I will say, when I found that the 2nd set I ordered didn't fit the company allowed me to return the order immediately and refunded my $$ I was able to reorder or not at my choosing! I would reccomend the merchant. The product is fine for daytime use if you are able be with your dog and monitor potty times!!! ;)
hypos: Jsou dobré na den, ale budou prosakovat. Používám je na den, protože jsem je použil/a jednou v noci a prosakovaly, jako by na sobě neměl/a vůbec žádnou. Také jsem poprvé objednal/a sadu v jednobarevném provedení s modrou, zelenou a černou barvou ve velikosti XS, perfektně seděla mé 7lb dlouhosrsté čivavě, ale objednal/a jsem znovu, tentokrát jsem objednal/a zdobenou sadu stejné velikosti XS a byla příliš malá, takže jsem je musel/a vrátit. Chystal/a jsem se znovu objednat stejnou barevnou sadu modré, zelené a černé, ale mezitím, jak jsem řekl/a... prosakoval v noci, jako by na sobě neměl/a vůbec žádnou plenku. To mě přimělo najít silnější plenu... což jsem udělal/a. Používám silnější plenu v noci a používám tyto během dne. Musím říct, že když jsem zjistil/a, že druhá sada, kterou jsem objednal/a, nesedí, společnost mi umožnila vrátit objednávku okamžitě a vrátila mi peníze, mohl/a jsem znovu objednat, nebo ne, podle mého výběru! Doporučil/a bych tohoto prodejce. Produkt je dobrý na denní použití, pokud můžete být se svým psem a sledovat časy na toaletu!!! ;)

source_doc: Awesome keyboard for those that loved the IBM Model M. I have been looking for a new keyboard for a while. I have been using a Logitech model that supported 3 computers. It was OK, but the keys were very mushy. I downsized to one computer so I thought why not switch to a new keyboard too. I knew I wanted something similar to my old beloved IBM Model M keyboard, but something without the large size and also had wireless capabilities. After MUCH searching for a decent mechanical keyboard, I focused on the Royal Kludge models. Mostly for the excellent price, as some mechanical keyboards can be costly. I got the 90% model, and I couldn't be happier. The feel is very similar to the Model M, but definitely quieter (although not exactly silent.) What I love most besides the feel is the magnetically attached wrist rest. That feature alone is pretty neat. There are plenty of other options I have yet to explore of fully utilize, such as the lighting of the keyboard. I have yet to play with many of the key mappings either. But I mostly just type, so these features aren't very important to me. Note: I am running Linux (Pop! OS to be specific), and the keyboard works great with Linux out of the box.

source_doc: Works as well as the name brand. This product is very similar to the name brand purple shampoo and conditioner that I had been using. The shampoo seems like it is a clarifying shampoo and leaves my hair feeling a little rough, after I use the conditioner it is soft and moisturized. The directions are to leave the shampoo and condition on 3-5 minutes each. When I was using this I felt there was no scent to this product, no perfumes or unpleasant scent. It smelled like nothing at all. After I read reviews stating that it smelled of peppermint I went back and smelled it while in the bottle and I guess it does small vaguely of peppermint.The results are the same as the others, soft hair, but can't tell if either is doing anything. For reference, I had natural red hair, and the front is quite white, while the back still has red (dye) coloring at the ends, the new hair growth is dark, not red like when I was young. The white part of my hair is not brassy at all, nor is the new growth, and I have been using purple shampoo about once or twice a week. So I can't say if it's the shampoo or not, but my hair does feel moisturized with this shampoo.Very purple coloring, does not stain the shower or shower curtain.

source_doc: Didn’t Work. I bought one of these quite a while ago and never installed it. I finally got around to installing it. The concept is great, mine just didn’t work. I tried it on two different Leviton switches thinking that perhaps the contacts just didn’t quite line up on the first switch I tried to install it on. I made sure the switch (on the SnapPower faceplate) was in, power was in to the switch, and I covered the sensor/switch to test it. Nothing. I removed the SnapPower faceplate, inspected it, and tried again. Same result. I tried another switch, and same result. I had an extra Leviton switch, so I checked to see whether the SnapPower contacts line up with the screws. They do, not perfectly, but certainly enough to make adequate electrical contact that they should work. So either my SnapPower face plate is defective, or it doesn’t work if the hot and return wires are connected to the switch using the push-in connectors rather than the connector screws? It has been too long for me to return this one, so I’m stuck with an overly expensive spare faceplate. I’m pretty handy and technically savvy, and these are ultra simple, so it’s definitely an issue with the one I bought.

source_doc: A pleasant surprise! I have to admit to being skeptical about this head wrap. I fully expected it to feel too tight or too heavy, but I was pleasantly surprised by how comfortable it is to wear.While it does feel heavy when you hold it, I didn’t find it too heavy when it was on my head. And though it’s tight, it wasn't too tight. It stays in place well, so if you choose to be up and about while wearing it, it shouldn’t slip down. It’s possible to pull it down over your eyes or leave it above your eyes, whatever best suits you. Personally, when I have a headache, I want the cooling relief over my eyes.Since it’s winter here and was below zero when my package was delivered, even though I took it from the drivers hand, the head wrap arrived cold. I’ve realized it always feels sort of cool to the touch, but I keep in the freezer as I like it colder. I haven’t tested it in the microwave since I don’t intend on using it that way.

source_doc: The seam is so close to the curved edges at the bottom that it could eventually rip. I have a 30 oz. insulated water bottle that I strive to fill 3X with water to drink throughout the day.  I take it with me when I drive, positioning it in the cup holder.  However, there are times when I walk that I wish I could take my water bottle with me.  I ordered this 2 pack of Tainehs Water Bottle Holders because I figured my bottle would fit inside it based upon the product page's measurements: 7.4" X 3.5", and my boyfriend could use the other bottle holder when we go hiking.  I like the rectangular shape to fit keys, a Chapstick, a protein bar, etc.  I could slide a credit card, money, ID, etc. in the front zipper pocket, in case we stop somewhere to walk and shop.I think these water bottle carriers are handy. The nylon material feels durable. The inch-wide strap is adjustable.  My only concern is the stitching.  The seam is so close to the curved edges at the bottom of the black one that it could eventually rip and come apart at some point.  The pink one isn't as bad.  (See photos.) The current price of $16 might be a bit high, IMO, but you do get 2 of them.
hypos: Šev je tak blízko zakřiveným okrajům ve spodní části, že by se mohl nakonec protrhnout. Mám 30 unce izolovanou láhev na vodu, kterou se snažím naplnit 3x vodou na pití během dne. Beru ji s sebou, když řídím, a umisťuji ji do držáku na nápoje. Nicméně, jsou chvíle, když jdu pěšky, kdy bych si přál/a, abych mohl/a vzít svou láhev na vodu s sebou. Objednal/a jsem tento 2 balení držáků na láhev Tainehs, protože jsem si myslel/a, že by má láhev do něj mohla podle rozměrů na stránce produktu pasovat: 7,4" x 3,5", a můj přítel/partnerka by mohl/a použít druhý držák, když jdeme na túru. Líbí se mi obdélníkový tvar, který pojme klíče, balzám na rty, proteinovou tyčinku atd. Mohl/a bych do přední kapsy na zip vložit kreditní kartu, peníze, průkaz totožnosti atd., pro případ, že bychom se někde zastavili na procházku a nákupy. Myslím, že tyto nosiče na láhve na vodu jsou praktické. Nylonový materiál se zdá být odolný. Popruh široký jeden palec je nastavitelný. Moje jediné znepokojení je šití. Šev je tak blízko zakřiveným okrajům ve spodní části černé láhve, že by se mohl nakonec protrhnout a rozpadnout se v určitém okamžiku. Růžová není tak špatná. (Viz fotografie.) Aktuální cena 16 dolarů se mi může zdát trochu vysoká, podle mého názoru, ale dostanete 2 z nich.

source_doc: Not just a pregnancy pillow! I had 2 major abdominal surgeries and was absolutely struggling to find a comfortable way to sleep. When sleeping on my non surgical side, I rolled to my belly in my sleep waking me up in terrible pain. I gave this pillow a go. I wish I’d have gotten one of these years ago! It comes vacuum packed, I tossed it in the dryer on air fluff for about 30 mins and left it out to form as suggested and washed the cover in my sensitive detergent (dried cover on very low heat because of the fabric type). It formed beautifully! I couldn’t wait to try it out. I did add a bit of extra poly fill on one side to make it more firm only because I wanted a firm barrier to prevent me from rolling on my belly. It worked perfectly! I never rolled on to my belly once. I’ve been using this all week now and I have noticed that my incision sites aren’t anywhere near as painful and it’s even helped with painful joints from fibromyalgia. I wish I could give it far more stars. It wasn’t flat like many other pillows and their reviews, it was truly perfect. This is a fantastic investment. Now I just have to work on getting the hubby to stop resenting my pillow for replacing him lol

source_doc: I modified it. So I decided to do this a little different. I like to keep sanitizing wipes and tissues in my car. But I did not want to have them right in the cupholder beside me. source_doc: Who owns a Karaoke machine? This guy! (Woohoo's with glee!) I have always thought that I would never have any reason to own my own karaoke machine, but now that I do, I can tell you that I can find a reason to own one almost every week. It is a party machine. I would say that is the biggest valid reason to own your own karaoke machine. If you sing, and love to sing in front a crowd, but you still don't have a recording contract, then this machine allows you to increase your odds of landing a contract by increasing the volume of your voice. I mean, it can't hurt, can it? Sing loudly and sing proudly. This machine is well made and has not had a single problem since I received it 6 months ago. It has been to the beach and back it did well. It sounds good, it gets loud, and the two microphones that it comes with are a cinch to use. They are up and running in less than a minute after I power up the speaker. It comes with a smartphone holder so that you can display a song's lyrics as you sing. The speaker rolls on two wheels, and it has a pull-out handle like a rolling suitcase. I have had a lot of fun using this machine and I have had zero problems with it. If you are looking for a karaoke machine, this is a good choice.

source_doc: Maiden voyage success. I was looking for an affordable sleep system that didn't frustrate me like the perpetual tangled mess I was in my mummy bag but that would still be cozy and warm. I'm a toss-n-turn sleeper from side to tummy to side and mummy bags are too tight around the legs and don't let you roll over. I tried this for the first time tent camping at Valley of Fire in late December and it worked out great. Temps were in the mid-'30s to low '40s and I was plenty warm with this and my r4 sleeping pad. I did pull it up over my head for added warmth during the night when it got windy. (I'm 5'7", 155 lbs) It has slick fabric on both sides so that was the only minor drawback. It slipped off my body when I rolled over but I was wearing silky long johns so I will revisit my sleep clothes for future trips. I swapped the compression sack it came with for one that has four straps and was able to decrease the packable size. I didn't wear it as a poncho this trip but I'm heading to the Grand Canyon in late Feb so I may use it to hang around camp.

source_doc: DIY, Save the mony. The detailer's wanted $1300. I watched 15 different YouTube Videos then decided on Adams. I do have a Quick Jack which made it a bit easier with the car lifted. It was easier than I thought ( I did do my homework). I took my time, started in a less noticeable spot and off to the races. I did have another advantage the car was freshly painted, I waited 3 weeks for the paint to gas off and I was done in 4 hours. It is a Miata MX5 a bit smaller than most cars. I left it in the garage for 24 hours before driving it. The first wash left beads of water and I dried the car with a 550 CFM leaf blower. Didn't even need a towel. I save me some big bucks and felt really good doing it myself.

source_doc: Deathadder without the wire! I've tried different brands/models of mice but have cumulatively used a Deathadder for over 7 years. I've always been too scared to pull the trigger on wireless mice because I had a bad experience with one and I'm not a fan of charging things constantly but the feel, the performance, everything, is amazing. I absolutely love it! It's exactly like my Deathadder Elite but without the wire.The only thing I will say is that I was disappointed with the battery life. I game much anymore and just casually hang out on my computer on days off from work. I also have the power saving mode set to 5 minutes because I'll go AFK to clean or hang out with my dogs often, so I'm not using it a ton. I guess I just expected a little more. The product advertises a "70 hour life", which I know is on the high end, but I expected more. Overall, I love this mouse and don't mind charging it for the convenience of not having a wire anymore.

source_doc: So great for travel. This is such a creative idea for a traveling mom. I got it for an upcoming cruise because I thought I would be pumping and this would be perfect, but I ended up drying up too early. I was still able to use it for little visits to grandma's house, etc. I like that it has little separate branches for all the parts. I probably could have used a couple more, but it worked well. I did not personally like the silicone bottle brush that was included so I just brought my own regular bottle brush. I did really like that it came with a small soap bottle. I think this would be perfect for a working mom who is pumping and doesn't want to leave their pump stuff all over the icky shared kitchen or something.

source_doc: Going back to knipex. Long story short, I tried to use these, and they weren’t for me. After cutting what turned out to be a hot wire thanks to sloppy wiring in the past, I discovered these after watching a video recommending them.  I thought the pliers would be sort of a two tools in one for my tool belt.  If I need to cut a heavy gauge wire, the button would give me additional leverage without going back to my tools or carrying one more tool around.  What happened instead was the 85% of the time I was just cutting 10, 12 or 14 ga romex that the pliers were awkward in my hand and about half the time locked shut.  It would turn  a no look grab from tool belt, cut and return to tool belt into a grab, fiddle, cut, return.  I don’t have small hands but I am certainly not palming basketballs either (typically size L glove). The wihas were bulkier than my knipex cutters. The difference was a tool that took little thought was replaced with a tool that just didn’t fit or feel right.  When I was removing some old chain link fence, I appreciated the extra leverage but how often do I do that.After trying them for a month, I finally just went back to my knipex cutters.  Maybe I didn’t give these a fair shake, but I really don’t like using tools that offer me no benefit.

source_doc: Quality feels well made. This feels sturdy and strong. I love how tall it is so I don’t have to bend over to get this out like a my other baby gate. This does come with some wall caps that screw in but they aren’t necessary so I didn’t use them that way I can move it if I want to. The gate is easy to open for an adult with a button on top of the handle and below that have to be pushed at the same time so a baby wouldn’t be able to open it. I had my husband help me set it up but I could’ve installed it alone but easier with two people. The gate also can be left open which I like as I don’t always need it closed. I’m happy with this gate I just need two more I can close off my main living area.

source_doc: I was skeptical at first but thought I would give it a try.  BOY, AM I GLAD I DID!!! I wanted a way to get a better view of the back seat of my car. I was so easy to install and once attached, it stays completely in place as if it were factory equipment. And not only do I get a full view of the rear seat of my car, because of the extra wings on the mirror, I can actually see out the rear passenger windows without ever turning my head. Amazing. One of the best accessories I have ever purchased for my car and at a terrific value.

source_doc: Great office chair! This seems like a nicely made computer chair. I am not very good at putting things together, but I managed to get this chair together all by myself! It suggests having two people put it together, and I agree that two people would make things much easier! I didn't have an issue until I tried to put the back of the seat on. I just couldn't get it in the right spot because I needed two hands to screw the bolts in. It took awhile, but I got it!The chair is very sturdy and the seat is very comfortable! The neck support is nice. The only issues I noticed were some of the wheels wouldn't roll as I pushed it back to my office. I assume with use, these wheels will start working. Also, I had planned on using it for my bar-height desk, but it is a few inches too short, so I will have to find another use for it. I think I assumed it would adjust that high, but I should have looked at the measurements.

source_doc: Best value for the price. I like the Old Mother Hubbard minis.  They're the perfect size for rewarding my dogs (I have large dogs).  I appreciate that the ingredients are better than many of the comparable treats, such as Milk Bones, and yet the price is more reasonable than brands like Blue.  My dogs are eager to be treated with them, so they must taste good.  As I stated, I have large dogs, so we do go through them somewhat quickly.  For this reason, I buy the 6lb boxes.  I get more for the cost.  I do feel like these could be better packaged.  The box isn't tightly sealed, just taped along the middle.  The biscuits are in a large plastic bag inside the box which isn't sealed either.  I do worry that these could easily be contaminated by their surrounding environment.  It would not be difficult for a mouse to crawl under the flap of the box and get inside the bag of biscuits.  Definitely something I think the manufacturer should consider.  When I get mine, I fill the treat jar and then store the remaining in the deep freezer until I need them.  (My German Shepherd is allergic to storage mites, so this helps me negate that issue.)

Mí psi se těší na to, že je dostanou, takže musí chutnat dobře. Jak jsem uvedl/a, mám velké psy, takže je rychleji spotřebováváme. Z tohoto důvodu kupuji krabice o hmotnosti 6 liber. Sušenky jsou v velkém plastovém sáčku uvnitř krabice, který také není uzavřený. Obávám se, že by se tyto mohly snadno kontaminovat okolním prostředím. Nebylo by pro myš těžké lézt pod klapku krabice a dostat se do sáčku se sušenkami. Určitě něco, co by měl/a výrobce zvážit. source_doc: (Almost) Perfect! I just got a new sports car, and I hate to have things flying around. Plus I just really like organization. I like to keep a few things like a small box of Kleenexes, hand wipes and an umbrella in the cabin of my car, but I don't want to have it look messy. Plus I like that this keeps them close at hand and that I can easily take everything out and move it to the trunk when I have passengers. This fits exactly in the space behind the passenger seat and meets all my criteria. I also like that it has a divide in the middle and several elastic netted holders to keep the things more organized. If I have something small but I don't want to have tip over I can put it in the second compartment. It's not the most durable thing given that it's only made of cardboard. But I've had it for several months and it still looks like the day I bought it, and I love it! I definitely recommend it.

source_doc: Wow was I surprised when I opened this! I purchased this but thought maybe I should have bought glass instead. When I saw it it looked so much like glass and even felt and sounded like glass. It wasn't just me I bought one as a gift for someone else and she couldn't believe it was not glass either but best of all, it fell off the counter the other day. I was sure it would crack or something. Instead it bounced! That sucker hit the ground hard on a hardwood floor and not even a scratch. I don't know about the floor though LOL! I highly recommend. If you're going to make triple layer cakes go for something a little taller but it is great for a double layer cake and I use lots of fluffy whipped cream icing. Fits right over the top and I also cover the bottom with the cardboard cake rounds. I don't know if that's necessary but I figure if I ever want to use the bottom as a charcuterie tray I don't want to mix my meats and cake so as a precaution I use the cake rounds. Excellent item!

source_doc: Non Invasive. I was really scared 😱 about using something that looked like it would drill a hole into my toe. But I read the directions two or four times and I followed them and everything was smooth. I had an ingrown toenail in my big toe. I’ve had it for several months. Talk about excruciating pain and I was able to finally understand what people meant about seeing stars ✨. I didn’t actually see stars ✨ it’s just a figure of speech. I made sure that I had the correct attachment on, the correct speed and the right direction clockwise or counter clockwise. I was able to lift the corner up a little bit with a metal finger nail file and then I just sanded it off with the tool.🥰. I even filed all my toenails down.

source_doc: Very sensitive. I did not know that you're not supposed to use this before your baby's umbilical cord falls off. We have been attaching it off to the side of the umbilical cord. So far I think it's fairly accurate but I also know of at least one or two but I believe to be false alarms. It's kind of hard to tell the things like this. Ultimately I know it's going to give me peace of mind and it's much better than the snooze of because I don't have to manually shut it off under the baby's clothes I can shut it off with my phone. The temperature feature will be useful if little one gets a cold. I definitely think this item is worth the purchase. However I kind of wish that we had an owlette too. Which ultimately I can totally see myself buying the owlette to compare Head to Head. If you're on the fence about this item I say go for it it's better than a lot of other ones on the market and the rollover feature is really nice. I would say just to go by the manufacturer rules and wait for the umbilical cord to fall off. That way you can line it up better and not worry about false alarms.

source_doc: Seems like a good collar. My cats needed new collars and I thought I'd give this one a try.  I ordered the cloud print and it's cute.  No issues with sizing the collar to what I needed and I did try pulling apart on it to ensure it would "break away" if need be and it did come apart with a fairly good tug.  My cats are indoor cats so I doubt it will be put to the test, but would want to make sure it would just in case.  I do have to say I don't care for the bell.  My cat's last collar had a bell and it really wasn't noisy unless he was really running.  This bell is very noisy.  It's a smaller sound, kind of a tinny sound.  But I could tell my cat did not like it.  At least for the first few days he was constantly messing around with his neck like he was trying to find the bell.  He never did that with his last collar.  I was actually getting ready to take it off but it's been about a week and he seems used to it now so I'll leave it be for a bit longer and see.  But I do wonder if it's still driving him nuts.  I may still remove it at some point.

source_doc: These are some Good lil' Buggers. I was surprised with how well these little buggers work. Unfortunately, one of them had a broken wire right there at the base of the housing so as not like I can fix it without tearing it open, and it's completely glued shut. However, all I needed was 2  of them.  I did not need them to squirt across the room. I don't know how long they'll last. But, all I need them for is 10 minutes at a time. So they should probably last a year or more. . I can't tell you what I use them for or you would laugh. So that's what I have as review. I just bought them, and now I needed off/on switch that plugs right into the USB, in-line with the power.

source_doc: Fun. I bought this in November, tomorrow it will be January and I have yet to finish the game as I’m having so much fun exploring and dinking around as I play. The graphics are great when they’re not glitching but glitches are momentary and I’ve only become stuck in game once and the game did self correct after a minute so it does have safety features that I’m grateful for. I wasn’t sure how I’d like the tera evolution deal but it’s not bad but I don’t really use the feature although I do enjoy the battles against the tera Pokémon too. I do wish I could customize more of what my character is wearing as the school uniform kinda sucks and I love customizations so much but I am glad I can change between seasonal wear. The new Pokémon are interesting and I’m enjoying learning about them too.

source_doc: Didn't know I needed one till I started using it. I've been stressed out quite a bit lately with work and my home so I've decided I need to take some time to relax through the day so when I saw this I figured I would give it a shot, and I was glad I did.  It came packaged well with no defects I could see.  In the box are the eye massager and a USB c cord.  It charges via USB C which I like and didn't take all that long to charge.  Putting it on I did have to adjust it a little bit but that wasn't too hard.  I kicked it on and let it run a preset on my eyes.  Let me tell you it feels wonderful.  It does have a bit of pressure but nothing uncomfortable.  I let it run its cycle and ran another one because it felt so good.  If you are looking for a way to relax and block out light this thing is amazing.

source_doc: Really liked them, but they would not charge. I really liked these lanterns. They flashlight option was extremely bright. The big downside is the charging. Upon receiving them, I plugged them both in. A blue light came on for about 5 seconds and then disappeared. I assumed this meant that they were fully charged. I took them camping and they started fading before the end of the first night. The next day I plugged them both in for about 3 hours apiece. The same thing happened when I plugged them in, a blue light for about 5 seconds then it disappeared. No indication if they were actively charging or fully charged. After 3 hours of charging apiece, I tried using them for my 2nd night of camping. As soon as I turned them, they died within a minute as if they hadn’t been charged at all. I returned them. These lanterns failed me on my camping trip. I can’t have an unreliable light source that doesn’t given any indication at all of charging or battery status. It’s a shame because I really liked the outside of the charging issues..

source_doc: Awful Taste, no noticeable positive results.... I bought these, despite the reviews on how bad they taste.  I thought I could hold my breath and chew it.  I was wrong.  These are the worst thing I have ever tasted (vanilla probably makes it worse) and they do clump up in your teeth.  I barely got one down and would not try a second.  I blended two more to a smoothy and drank it (in the evening).  I have to admit, I slept quite well that night, but no help after that.I then ended up crushing the rest with a meat tenderizer and put them into capsules myself.  I had to take quite a few at once, but I could swallow them.  I did not notice any improvement with sleep, anxiety or energy after taking it this way.  I will not buy again, as I am not convinced they help with any of the things I needed them for.I would like to add that my not liking this particular product would not prevent me from purchasing from Dr. Berg's shop in the future.  I trust his advise completely and get a lot of valuable information out of his videos.

source_doc: Back to basic, it’s what works! Who ever said newer and more technical is better was wrong. When I had my daughter 20 years ago we used the basic bulb sucker at home but this style in the hospital where I worked as a nursing student. I had my second child this year and saw that nasal aspirators had advanced, they’re electric with lights and sounds now. I of course got one immediately but when my baby got his first stuffy nose I came to realize they don’t offer very much suction and it was more work than it was worth. I tried a few others before going back to the basics. I remembered the one at the hospital working better than my bulb sucker so when I saw this I decided to try one more. This nasal aspirator works great! It has wonderful suction and I like that you control just how much. There aren’t a ton of parts that need cleaned afterward and nothing has to be done before using it in the middle of the night with a scared crying baby. You can tell it’s made with quality material and the little etching of the bunny is a cute addition. I’m very happy with this purchase and relieved I have a way of helping my baby breathe easier.

source_doc: Easy to install & just work! I had cages on my pedals, but I was primarily riding my bike on a trainer.  I used the cages because I figured my feet would slip, but I didn't want the clicky shoes since I wasn't convinced I was going to ride enough to spend the time finding something that fits...I unhooked my bike and now its going on the road for real.  The cages are just not going to work for me, so these are just right.  I wanted something durable and at least decent looking for my cyclocross bike.  Like I said, I'm not hardcore, so I just wanted something with regular pedals - these fit perfectly and work as I had hoped.  Look cool and have plenty of grip for when I'm casually riding around.  Very satisfied.

Odepjal/a jsem kolo a teď se chystá na silnici doopravdy. Klece pro mě prostě nebudou fungovat, takže tyto jsou přesně to pravé. source_doc: Skeptical at first, but I will not play without them again! I had just seen these grips on social media when a friend who had a set  recommended I give them a try. I was skeptical at first, but after my first three-hour gaming session, I will never play without them again.I play Fortnite almost every night, often for a few hours at a time. Usually my hands get sweaty after about an hour or so, but that did not happen with c2 Gripz, even after three hours. I bought the mediums, and my hands fit perfectly around the contoured grooves. This helped separate my fingers and naturally placed my hand over the controller. The ridge at the bottom gave my fingers support and being above the controller also gave me better control.I have also noticed less strain on my hands after long gaming sessions. I have carpal tunnel, so sometimes I get flare ups during longer sessions, but I have noticed a big improvement with less strain on my hands and forearms since using C2 Gripz.I have been using them for almost two months, and I will never play without C2 Gripz again. Oh yeah! As a bonus, I like how the controller can stand on its own because of the base of the gripz. This is a perfect added feature for people who like to use their controller as a tv remote. I highly recommend this product 10/10.

source_doc: Inexpensive, but with cheap construction. I got this shelf/rack for my basement exercise room. It was inexpensive which is good because it is also somewhat problematically constructed.The first one they sent me had a piece soldered upside down. So I wasn’t able to assemble it. The second one had all the pieces soldered correctly but when I hung them up, the one side was longer than the other. So I couldn’t make it level. I had to Jerry rig it to make the bottom racks be level. (Second picture) I also had trouble with the mollies they included—they were super weak so I wasn’t able to successfully hammer them into the wall even after I pre-drilled holes. I got them partially in and then the top would just cave in and I had to cut them off.I found the installation instructions difficult to follow and incomplete. Thankfully I’m handy enough to figure out how to do it. But it took a fair bit of time. So just prepare yourself for that.Because it’s attached with six screws, it feels pretty solid. I think it’s going to do the job well.

source_doc: Silky finish, covers decent. It was hard for me to get a clear picture, of the difference but this works just like mixing your foundation with lotion. It has a nice silky feel after, but it covers better, and without making the fine lines pop out worse. I only used one squirt and it was enough to do my whole face. It is a little on the pale side, but i honestly could mix this with a darker shade of foundation and I think I'd be just fine. I was pleasantly surprised at the coverage and the overall ease of application. I literally just rubbed it on like I would sunscreen and i did not need to do anything else. If I took the time to apply it, I think it would look even nicer and I would be even happier. This is definitely a brand I personally would be interested in seeing what other products they have, because I was immediately impressed with this, and I usually can not say that when trying new products. I am extremely happy with this, and definitely will be ordering more when this bottle is gone. Took a photo of the color it is, as that was a question I had  before ordering. Hope it helps.

source_doc: Great exercise wedge. I got these to do calf stretches as I was getting leg cramps. I like how sturdy they are and I will say I was surprised at how much they weigh ( approximately 10 pounds). I really like that when I am using them in my socks I don't feel like I am going to slip off. The wedges lock together if you need more of an incline, I have not tried that yet. I am very pleased with my decision to get these and I would purchase again.

source_doc: Easy to swallow vitamin E. I have tried in the past various Vitamin E products. I was looking for one where I only had to take 1 a day. source_doc: A solid and well-made gate. I have pretty much the same gate (different company) but without the cat door. I didn't know they even made gates with cat doors! I was thinking of all sorts of different things I could do to create a safety barrier but not lock the cats out. I didn't want to actually have to install a door and then cut a whole and install a cat door. I was excited when I ran across this product, and was hoping it was something of good quality (like my other gate). I was pleased when this arrived as it was quite heavy (a good thing) and is made with some sort of solid metal (can't be bent). I like that the cat door can be left open, or it can be locked. I admit when I installed my first gate it was a bit confusing as I wanted to get it right, but the manual that this came with is really helpful in it's detail and pictures. It helps I've already made an installation like this before, but even if I hadn't I appreciate the instructions. I will still use them. I don't remember how much I paid for the non-cat gate, but it was definitely more expensive than this. I'm glad they make a product like this!
