source_doc: Perfect For Our Dim Evening Light In Bedroom. I have a beautiful light which I love in our bedroom.  We have it attached to the switch so that when you walk into the room, you are not blinded by the bright lights in the room all on.  It takes chandelier bulbs and I was having trouble finding one for it that I liked.HOW THESE COMEThese come in a thick box with plenty of padding to protect the bulbs.DO THEY FIT?These fit my light perfectly.COLORThese are what I call warmer lighting.  I tend to like daylight for most of my lights when I want to see.  This is warmer for that glow that allows us to see, but it does not make it difficult to go to sleep when I want to.DIMMINGThis is not a dimming light so I do not have a way to test this for dimming yet.THE BOTTOM LINEThese bulbs are perfect for my low light light in the bedroom.  It is a warm light that shines through the shade, but still keeps the light lower for a more restful evening.MY RATINGSo far, this is a FIVE STAR for us.  I don't see me running out of these anytime soon as we only have the one light.  However, if I get a dimmer light uses them, I will update.
hypos: Perfektní pro naše tlumené večerní světlo v ložnici. Mám krásné světlo, které miluji v naší ložnici. Máme ho připojené k vypínači, aby vás při vstupu do místnosti neoslnila jasná světla, když jsou všechna rozsvícená. Používá lustry žárovky a měla jsem potíže najít takovou, která by se mi líbila. JAK SE TYTO PŘIJÍMAJÍ Tyto přicházejí v silné krabici s dostatečným polstrováním na ochranu žárovek. PASUJÍ? Tyto dokonale pasují k mému světlu. BARVA Říkám jim, že jsou to teplejší světla. Obvykle mám ráda denní světlo pro většinu svých světel, když chci vidět. Toto je teplejší pro ten nádech, který nám umožňuje vidět, ale neusnadňuje to usínání, když chci. STLUMENÍ Toto není stmívatelné světlo, takže nemám způsob, jak to zatím otestovat na stmívání. ZÁVĚR Tyto žárovky jsou perfektní pro moje tlumené světlo v ložnici. Je to teplé světlo, které se prosvítí stínem, ale stále udržuje světlo nižší pro klidnější večer. MOJE HODNOCENÍ Zatím je to pro nás PĚT HVĚZD. Nevidím, že bychom brzy došly, protože máme pouze jedno světlo. Pokud ale dostanu stmívatelné světlo, které je používá, podám aktualizaci.

source_doc: Good quality. At first I thought this mat was such a weird size; however it worked out perfectly for our 84 in x 84 in playpen. I had to buy 4 of them and they all fit. The product is consistent! I have purchased mats before and they weren’t consistent so each set of the mat was slightly different. I really like that there are no edge pieces but because of that I had to buy way more because I only needed a few extra middle pieces and I have bunch of corner/end pieces left. I wish it’s slightly thicker but overall the quality is really good. I ended up spending a similar amount that I would have spent for the house of hoa mats but this mat size fits perfectly for our playpen. I highly recommend this mat! Hope they eventually have different designs and color!

source_doc: EXCEEDS EXPECTATIONS. A friend suggested I purchase this pair of hand warmers before a ski trip I had planned with my family. In the past, I would typically buy disposable single-use "pouch" style hand warmers but wanted something that was reusable and would last longer. Boy was I impressed with these. As I was putting on all my ski equipment, I fired these up and put them in my boots. When I was ready to put my boots on, they were already nice and toasty so I moved the warmers to my jacket pockets and zipped them closed. Once I went outside the lodge into the cold, I put my hands in my pockets and they were nice and warm. I had the warmers on the lowest setting and they kept my pockets warm all day. It was great to take my gloves off on the chair lift, stick my hands in my pockets before each run, and it made the day a much better experience overall. I highly recommend these if you're a skiier, hiker, go to an outdoor sporting event, etc.!

source_doc: This made me extremely nauseous. I read the benefits of taking 400mcg of folic acid & decided to entail this in my daily vitamin regime. This may work well for some. For me I had a very bad reaction to it upon taking it the first day. Within 4 hours I became very nauseous. I had to leave work. I knew it was due to putting this new vitamin in my body. I’ve researched folic acid since & wanted to share that there can be side effects from taking it. In some cases one may experience nausea, black stool, constipation, loss of appetite, bloating or gas. I spoke to my Doctor about it. There was no type of adverse reaction with the other vitamins I was taking. It was simply my body didn’t like it. He did ask if I took it with a full glass of water & food, which I did. He said this was important. So a heads up if you’re considering to purchase for the first time. This may not be for you.  I do respect this brand of vitamin. Unfortunately I can’t receive the nice benefits gained by taking it.

source_doc: Really happy with these pump dispensers. I wanted some nice soap dispensers for my sinks because I got tired of the expense of buying the much more expensive individual soaps I have gotten for several years. I saw these and I really liked the simple look of them. I like that they are actually glass and not plastic. They came with a silicone funnel which I really didn't need since they have a large enough opening to easily fill with the large soap refill I got. The pump works really well and I am completely happy with this set of two. The labels that come with them are really pretty but I chose not to use them so I appreciate that you can use them or not. I wouldn't want ones that came with labels already attached. I can easily recommend these.

source_doc: Works!! I’m a diabetic and my fasting glucose was in the 200’s. I couldn’t get one single test under 200 even though I was eating a fairly low carb diet. I felt absolutely exhausted and could barely stay awake a couple of hours each day. I was pretty sure I would need to go on insulin very soon. Then I tried these capsules!What a change! In literally 10 days, my glucose has gone down. From the mid-200s to 120+/- is unbelievable to me but it’s true! I am also doing intermittent fasting 16:8 which I was doing on its own before with no real effect to my blood sugar. I’m convinced doing 16:8 plus taking the capsules is what makes the difference for me. I now have a ton of energy from the B vitamins in the capsules, I don’t take daytime naps and blood sugar is getting better by the day. It is a night and day difference in just 10 days!My advice - stick to it for at least a week or two before giving up on it. I had no noticeable change until day 3. That’s when the capsules seemed to “kick in” and start working. I will try to update this in a month or two on my progress.

source_doc: Good fit but ear loops break through mask. Be sure you are carrying another mask! First impression: Great fit, love the chance to be able to tighten or loosen the ear loops. I was impressed enough to recommend this mask to several friends. Now I have to tell them about how the area where the loops go through needs to be reinforced by the company.  I really love this mask but now I have to carry others because the first one I used only 3 times failed.  I wasn't being forceful with tightening the loops. I saw it was somewhat iffy so I was careful. Put it on the 4th time and it immediately fell apart at the right ear loop. Luckily, I had another different kind in my purse so I wasn't left in the lurch. If they would reinforce the area where the loop goes through, this would be a 5 star mask for me. I was planning to take these on a cruise next month but will need to take the old kind also. I can't be without a mask. I usually will wear a mask 4 to 5 times depending on where I have been or the circumstances.
hypos: Dobře sedí, ale uši se protrhnou skrze masku. Ujistěte se, že máte s sebou další masku! První dojem: Skvěle sedí, mám rád/a možnost utáhnout nebo uvolnit ušní smyčky. Byl/a jsem dost ohromený/á, abych tuto masku doporučil/a několika přátelům. Teď jim musím říct, že oblast, kde procházejí smyčky, musí být posílena firmou. Opravdu miluji tuto masku, ale nyní musím mít s sebou i jiné, protože ta první, kterou jsem použil/a, selhala po třech použitích. Nebyl/a jsem příliš silný/á při utahování smyček. Viděl/a jsem, že to je trochu riskantní, tak jsem byl/a opatrný/á. Nasadil/a jsem ji potřetí a okamžitě se rozpadla na pravé ušní smyčce. Naštěstí jsem měl/a v kabelce jiný typ, takže jsem nezůstal/a ve štychu. Kdyby posílili oblast, kde smyčka prochází, byla by to pro mě pětihvězdičková maska. Plánoval/a jsem si tuto masku vzít na plavbu příští měsíc, ale také budu muset vzít starý typ. Nemohu být bez masky. Obvykle nosím masku 4 až 5krát, v závislosti na tom, kde jsem byl/a nebo na okolnostech.

source_doc: Great item for the money fixed up my oil leak! I purchased this and was concerned about the low price.  I cleaned it out thoroughly looking for debri before proceeding with install and found none.From reading other "cheap" replacement oil filter housing reviews most folks advocated for replacing the oil and temp sending unit.  The last thing I want to do is strip the engine down as far as I did for one of those.  I went ahead and bought auto part store senders and replaced what was on here.  It may have worked fine I just didnt want to dig back in to the engine for them.You have to take off the upper and lower initakes to get to this.  I found over a quart of oil sitting on top of the engine that I had to clean out.  Once replaced and everything re-installed I am happy to report that I have used my inspecting camera and a simple "dip stick" to try to find oil under the intake and it has come back clean.  I put this in before Christmas so as of this review over a month and so far so good.Very happy that my oil leak is finally solved!

source_doc: My preferred pick, I like both the nylon and ceramic. I have been using these picks for a little over 30 years.  Picks are a personal preference so I can't say these are perfect for everyone.  i am always trying out other picks, but I still haven't found anything that i like better.  For me I find these to be the easiest to hold onto, they don't slip around in my fingers as much as other picks.  I like the points on these too they work best with my picking style.  I play a lot of rhythm metal on guitar, and metal and rock on bass.  I like the .7mm for guitar and the 1.0mm for bass.  I jump between the nylon and the ceramic depending on how I am feeling.  They hold up well too I find they show less wear than most other picks too.  I would say they last about 2 or 3 times longer than other picks, especially on bass which can really chew up a pick.

Enter this cable:Less than 15 bucks, arrives the next day (for me,) and works great. The price and availability are unbeatable. How does the cable perform? I haven't been able to to detect any noise on the video or the audio. If there's audio hum, I geneuinly haven't noticed it. These are cheap so I'm sure they're hit or miss and I doubt the wires are individually shielded. But the one I received murders the composite cable I was using. I would even say it surpasses perfect s-video quality. It's sharp colorful rgb video.The cable feels and looks cheap, but it IS cheap. And you're definitely rolling the dice on the build quality here, but I can at least vouch that you'll potentially receive a solid cable that looks a million times better than composite.I might come back later and compare it to a high quality scart cable to note the differences, but I would say go ahead and give this one a try if you want to save some time and money. Bottom line: the cable I got looks great.

source_doc: Buyer- Read description. So I ordered these Omega 3 Fish Oil for Dogs and Cats, Dog & Cat Fish Oil Pet Supplement, Skin and Coat Supplements for my pup who suffers from dry skin and itching. I read the product description at the time of ordering and just re-checked it before writing a review. Now, unless I am missing something nowhere in the decription does it mention that it is made in China and I feel like that is important information. Maybe it is might fault for not doing more in depth research but I personally feel that anything that is being ingested should clearly state where it is made. This product has also only been available since October of 2022 which also does not make me feel overly confident in it. I do not ingest nor do I allow my dogs to ingest anything that is not made and approved in the US. Had I known it was not a US product I would not have ordered. Unfortunately I cannot speak on how well it works, but I will say that the value for the amount that you get is decent.

source_doc: Best Travel Acoustic. Great Sound. I am planning a trip and I have my guitar, as I will be playing for a family gathering outside.  So, I need to travel on an airplane with it.  I need portability to the outside venue and I need a good sound.  After reading so many reviews, and looking at options for several hours, I finally decided on the Mark III.  I received it yesterday.  I have been playing it for several hours and I have to say, I love this guitar.  If you plug into a decent amp, the sound is great.  It does not have the full sound of my Fender.  It's a solid body, and it's better than I expected.  Also, it feels the same. With headphones, it is very quiet. I highly recommend the Mark III.  I am also using the Donner Mini Guitar Amp for portability.

source_doc: Too Much Fun! When I first ordered this drum I didn't know what to expect, I mean I saw people playing it and it looked cool but now I know.  I LOVE sitting on this box and just banging away! I think it's therapeutic.  You learn how to play it as you experiment with it. There are different ways that you that you can hit it the drum, or cup your hands differently that gives you different types of sounds.  To let you know how solid this box is, I weigh 250 pounds and this drum holds me up with no problems. I don't feel like it's going to break underneath me. I would say it's commercial grade, and the fit and finish is wonderful.  It really is fun to play, and even my adult kids want to play on Dad's drum.  When I'm not using it I use it as a small table for a one of my speakers. It is well worth the money and something that I could see lasting forever if not abused. I highly recommend!

source_doc: I WANT TO WEAR THIS LIKE A BURRITO IT IS SO BRILLIANT GET IT GET IT!!!! Okay, I can't believe I am reviewing a blanket - but this one deserves it.  A bit of history - I love blankets and the supersoft thin ones made out of recycled coke bottles or whatever are all over my house.  But my favorite blanket has always been a BERKSHIRE one I got years ago and I went on Amazon looking to see if they had similar by that brand and found this.  I cannot believe I lived without this blanket for so long it is sheer perfection!  Both lightweight and super warm - I have been wrapping myself like a burrito at night while I read and I am perfectly warm and content.  I may never leave my house again.  Just brilliant - love it!! Mine hasn't been shedding which I see others say - but that may be because of the color?  I don't know.  I am buying more.  I will spend this winter as a happy warm burrito.  You should too!

source_doc: I wonder about the quality. The connector should work ok for lighter duty applications.  I dont think I would use it on a car or truck.  The contact surface at the base of the black knob is nowhere near the contact surface of the battery post connector, although it is about the same as where you would connect the cable.  the connector is two parts with just a plastic bushing/insulator between the two parts.  I was able to move the two parts some, but did not try and seperate them, but I think I could if i used more pressure.  The square headed bolt is too small to self hold as it is designed to, or the ridge designed to hold the flat side of the bolt is to far away.  The square head will spin and not hold against the flat side as you can see in the pictures.  The unit does appear to be brass or at least a brass alloy.  I did file a small amout off one edge and got the same color underneath.  The cable connector end has a short area with threads but I tried the clamp bolt in there and it fit but was a really sloppy fit.  When I install the switch I will most likely drill out those threads and just clamp the battery cable eyelet with a bolt and nut.

Kontaktní plocha na základně černého knoflíku není ani zdaleka stejná jako kontaktní plocha konektoru bateriového pólu, i když je přibližně stejná jako místo, kde byste připojili kabel. Konektor je rozdělen na dvě části, mezi kterými je pouze plastová pouzdro/izolátor. Dokázal/a jsem pohnout oběma částmi, ale nepokoušel/a jsem se je oddělit, myslím, že bych mohl/a, kdybych použil/a větší tlak. Čtvercová hlava šroubu je příliš malá na to, aby se sama udržela, jak byla navržena, nebo hrana určená k udržení ploché strany šroubu je příliš daleko. Čtvercová hlava se točí a nedrží proti ploché straně, jak můžete vidět na obrázcích. Zdá se, že jednotka je z mosazi nebo alespoň z mosazné slitiny. Odloupl/a jsem malou část z jednoho okraje a dostal/a jsem stejnou barvu pod tím. Konektor kabelu má krátkou oblast se závity, ale vyzkoušel/a jsem tam šroub pro svorku a pasoval/a tam, ale byl/a to opravdu volná pasáž. Když budu instalovat spínač, pravděpodobně ty závity vyvrtám a jednoduše upevním oko bateriového kabelu šroubem a maticí.

source_doc: GREAT PRODUCT. This is a great product. I couldn't be happier with my purchase. I only gave it 4 stars for sturdiness because even though there is a metal support under each wooded step... the wood itself feels a bit vulnerable. source_doc: A very nice inexpensive Irish whistle! I have some experience with Native American flute but am new to the pennywhistle. The first thing I looked at was craftsmanship; this whistle was flawless from what I could see; solid paint job on the brass tube, no little scratches, etc; holes were drilled cleanly; mouthpiece well-formed.  The first time I played it there was a lot of screeching; I was trying to overlay how I play NA flute onto this new little whistle. The second time I played it I tried to let go of my NA flute experience (except the basics like making sure all the holes are well-covered) and let nature find it's own way re breathing, ... ; here came the solid and clear notes! Since I do have a few other Irish whistles to compare to, I can say that this Feadog Pro D definitely has it's own voice, and it's a very pleasant one. I'm glad I added it to my instruments; it's fun to play.
hypos: Velmi hezká cenově dostupná irská píšťalka! Mám nějaké zkušenosti s národní americkou flétnou, ale s pennywhistle jsem nová/ý. První věc, na kterou jsem se podíval/a, byla řemeslná práce; tato píšťalka byla bezchybně/ý, co jsem viděl/a; solidní nátěr na mosazné trubce, žádné malé škrábance atd.; otvory byly vyvrtány čistě; náústek dobře tvarovaný. Když jsem na ni poprvé hrál/a, bylo tam hodně skřípění; snažil/a jsem se překrýt, jak hraji na NA flétnu, na tuto novou malou píšťalku. Při druhém hraní jsem se snažil/a pustit mé zkušenosti s NA flétnou (kromě základů jako zajistit, že všechny dírky jsou dobře zakryté) a nechat přírodu najít svůj vlastní způsob, co se týče dýchání, ...; zde přišly solidní a jasné tóny! Protože mám několik dalších irských píšťalek k porovnání, mohu říct, že tato Feadog Pro D rozhodně má svůj vlastní hlas a je to velmi příjemný hlas. Jsem rád/a, že jsem ji přidal/a do svých nástrojů; je to zábava hrát.

source_doc: Spendy in my opinion, even though I love them. I am 5*3" 170lbs. I was worried that these shorts would sacrifice comfort for absorbency, but I was wrong. These shorts are comfy that I would definitely wear them even when not on my period.They arrived at the end of my period so I can't yet talk about functionality... But from what I can tell I really think these will be better than all the other methods I've tried. Each method has their own setback. hypos: Podle mého názoru jsou drahé, i když je miluji. Měřím 5'3" a vážím 170 liber. Obávala jsem se, že tyto šortky obětují pohodlí ve prospěch savosti, ale mýlila jsem se. Tyto šortky jsou pohodlné, že bych je určitě nosila i mimo menstruaci. Dorazily na konci mé menstruace, takže zatím nemohu mluvit o funkčnosti... Ale podle toho, co mohu říct, si opravdu myslím, že budou lepší než všechny ostatní metody, které jsem vyzkoušela. Každá metoda má své vlastní nedostatky. I se vším, co jsem zkusila, jsem nikdy za svých 29 let nebyla během menstruace bez úniku. Některé produkty fungují lépe než jiné, jako například kalíšek... Méně úniků, ale stále uniká. A je to nepohodlné. Doufám, že to vyřeší tento problém. Jedna věc, kterou musím říct, je, že miluji, že mají kapsy, ale jedna z kapes má v sobě velký otvor. Jsou tam nitě, kde by to mohlo být sešito. Jen si myslím, že to nebyli schopni ušít dohromady. To bylo zklamání, ale dá se to opravit. Jen musím zmínit, že to je drahé... Nejsem spokojená s cenou. Miluji pohodlí a kvalitu látky. I bez špatného šití by to nemělo být tak drahé!

source_doc: “High density” does Not mean that it is hard enough. I attached a photo that some might find helpful about ways to use this block. I’m a yoga teacher.  Speaking from a place of experience and a certain kind of conditioning I prefer hard blocks. I have felt three inch (as opposed to four) lightweight hard foam blocks that are amazing. Such a block is great for a high amount of pressure that is therapeutic. Still trying to find a brand other than Manduka. So here I learn that “high density” doesn’t necessarily mean that it’s hard enough. I tried this block and i will return it. It is flimsy when using it on high height in something like the supported shoulder bridge which you can see in the attached image. I think I remember as a beginner I liked soft blocks because it felt more comfortable. Then I learned. So I hope that is helpful. Maybe everyone reading this is the type of beginner that doesn’t want a hard block. I have gotten off-brand cork blocks here which cost a bit more but have perfect density and hardness.

source_doc: Didn't think I needed it until I got it ... I have an organization problem.  No matter what I try, I always seem to lose track of things, only to discover them weeks/months later.  This happens with small things mostly -- things that have a tendency to disappear behind other things.I use processed American cheese for grilled cheese sandwiches mostly -- it melts better than anything else and tastes great (I grew up on it, so ... ).  I especially like the individually wrapped variety as it stays fresher longer.  That is, until I lose track of the last few slices in a package and find it months later as part of an unintended science project in the back of the fridge.Enter this little box.  And that's all it is, really -- a cute box made to fit exactly the individually-wrapped slices of cheese.  I simply put the slices in the box, the box in the door of the fridge, and I know exactly where it is.  No more errant slices hiding in the far corners of the fridge.It's sturdy, well made, nice hinge, and a slight "snap" to the lid so it doesn't come open until I want it to.Just about perfect, really.  Glad I purchased it!  Solid 5 stars: it does what it's supposed to do, does it well, and has proven to be of benefit in helping me stay organized.

source_doc: Giving it a try. I just started using this. It arrived unsealed and the box damaged in transit, but I was confident by the look and feel of the pump that it hadn't been used. I'm using this as a toothpaste, but I may share it with others who have appliances. I think it is meant to replace toothpaste. It doesn't include fluoride though. One pump generously covers the toothbrush. Although it's mostly air, it does feel like enough product to do the job. The foam has an unpleasant alcohol-menthol taste. I didn't find it that intolerable though, and it dies down over the two minutes. I also think it helps give that clean feeling afterwards. Instructions are to use this 1-2x daily, expecting results in 1-2 weeks. I'm surprised that I think I feel slight achiness after one use, so I'm going to see if I can do once a day for a few days. I'll report if I see whitening. To be fair though, I've been using a lot of whitening products lately and am not sure if I can expect more progress from products. This claims to be up to a 4 month supply which seems improbable, but then again, it does dispense a lot of air. If it lasts nearly that long and works, it's certainly worth $12.99.

source_doc: I have owned 7 house bunnies in a row!!! In about thirty years I have owned 7 bunnies, all who have lived inside and been treated very special.  Sometimes I have owned two at once, but in those thirty years never gone without at least one.  Obviously I am doing something right since several of mine have lived to be about 12-13 years old.  So in say that, I highly recommend this grass mat that I use inside their huge open door cage where I also have pet fur mats on the floor along with one of these mats where I sit there bowl of TIMOTHY pellets.  I notice that the bunny I have now will ignore it for awhile and then one day just start shredding it to pieces, so I make sure to keep buying them for her since she really doesn't play with any rabbit toys I buy her.  Except for loving empty toilet paper rolls this is her fav fun project!  I always make sure anything I give my bunnies is safe and healthy (note, always use timothy pellets, give them just the tiniest bit of fruit, no other carbs and tons of green vegies daily).  Rabbits love to eat but anything sugar or sweet will mess up their stomachs real easily...but back to this product, it is a big yes and I will continue buying them when needed.
hypos: Měl/a jsem 7 domácích králíčků za sebou!!! Za přibližně třicet let jsem měl/a 7 králíčků, všichni žili uvnitř a byli velmi speciálně opečovávaní. Někdy jsem měl/a dva najednou, ale během těch třiceti let jsem nikdy neměl/a méně než jednoho. Očividně dělám něco správně, protože několik z mých králíčků se dožilo asi 12-13 let. Takže to říkám, velmi doporučuji tuto travní podložku, kterou používám uvnitř jejich obrovské otevřené klece, kde mám také zvířecí kožešinové podložky na podlaze spolu s jednou z těchto podložek, na které mám misku s TIMOTHY granulemi. Všímám si, že králíček, kterého mám teď, ji chvíli ignoruje a pak jednoho dne začne trhat na kusy, tak se snažím ji neustále kupovat, protože se opravdu nehraje s žádnými hračkami, které jí kupuji. Kromě toho, že miluje prázdné role toaletního papíru, je toto její oblíbený projekt! Vždy se ujistím, že cokoli, co dávám svým králíčkům, je bezpečné a zdravé (poznámka: vždy používejte timothy granule, dávejte jim jen ten nejmenší kousek ovoce, žádné další sacharidy a spoustu zelené zeleniny každý den). Králíci milují jíst, ale jakýkoli cukr nebo sladké snadno naruší jejich žaludky... ale zpět k tomuto produktu, je to velké ano a budu pokračovat v jejich nákupu, když bude potřeba.

source_doc: These are great! I ordered these when the time changed (we live in an area that does Daylight Saving Time) and it started getting dark by 5:00pm. I didn’t like pulling up at home after work and getting out in the dark, so I got these bulbs to put in the fixtures on the front of our detached garage. They work like a charm!! I was so pleased the next day when I came home and had lights on! We’ve had these all winter now, and I purposely waited to write this review so I could be sure of how well they work. They come on at dusk and go off at dawn - just as advertised! I actually like that they stay on all night because then they function as security lights. I have absolutely no complaints about these bulbs, their brightness, their dependability, nothing. They are fantastic and I wish I’d bought them years ago. I would certainly recommend these to anyone.

source_doc: Good value. I bought this in January, 2023 and have been playing it for 3 months now. I am a beginner so I didn’t want to invest too much in something if I didn’t stick with it. The threads aren’t rounded off but don’t stick out too much on the sides. The strings were a bit rusty from the warehouse but I didn’t change them out in case I wanted to return. I finally changed them out the other day after 3 months averaging 8-9 hours a week of playing.  Sounds much brighter and louder now with fresh strings. The tuning pegs turn smoothly and after the strings stretched they hold tuning fairly consistently. I decided it was time to get it a case and today received this case today. A perfect fit. Crossrock Hardshell Arch Top Wood case fits OM, Martin 000 Guitars-Vinyl Tweed(CRW600OMTW)If you’re a beginner, I think this is a good one to go with. I really like the tone of it compared to others I have heard. My music interests are Dixieland and music from the 30’s so the tone fits that era well.

source_doc: Pretty good lemon flavor, better when mixed with water. I've been trying to live a bit healthier lifestyle and have been trying drops like this as I see them so when I saw this I thought ok ill give it a shot.  The package came just fine without any leaks or cracks in the bottle.  Opening the bottle it doesn't really smell like anything and I was a bit worried but I shouldn't have been.  I took the dropper and put a couple of drips on my tongue and it was a sweet lemon flavor, kinda reminds me of lemon drops but didn't linger.  I tried this mixed with water also and with 2 drops per 8 oz I couldn't even notice the flavor at all so keep that in mind if you aren't 100% sold on the flavor.  As I have just started trying it I have not seen any results but I have not seen any negatives and that works for me. source_doc: everything is just wrong. I went to install it and took all the parts I needed off and out of the way then  I put one of the brackets on with ease thanks to a friend. but shortly afterward noticed an issue with the second bracket. the one that attaches to the transfer case bolts wasn't fitting right. I went and read that some needed to cut their brackets to get it to fit, instead of cutting the bracket I cut the bit off that was in the way with a Dremel and it fits perfectly afterward. then I went on to try to put the shifter in and attach it to the 4WD lever and I tried for nearly an hour and it wouldn't work. I went to look up if I was doing something wrong but I found out I was given the wrong bracket altogether. so I spent half my afternoon taking my car apart and now I need to go to B&M for customer support and hope they can help fix the mistake.

source_doc: i think it is great and fits my needs really well. for this price i was surprised that this sounds as good as it does. here is my use case: i live in a townhome so i had the idea for my band to plug into a mixer (e-drums used) and everyone wears headphones. that way we can crank it up and not anger the neighbors. lots of headsets, wires, headphone amp... i put some time into planning it out. what i did not account for was the guitars sounding like hell - i am running a line out from the headphone out of the amps directly into the mixer. so i started researching cab simulators, IR loaders, etc. to try and replicate the sound of a mic'd amp. the sonicake does this really well - it sounds authentic. i wasn't expecting a lot for the price, but i was happily surprised. if you have similar needs to me, i would highly recommend that you use the XLR out on the sonicake. i noticed a large difference in sound quality between that and the 1/4 inch out.

source_doc: Feels SO wonderful on my scalp! I have kinky/coily 4b/c hair. I have routinely oiled and massaged my dry scalp with my fingertips 2-3 times per week. I just received my massagers and washed my hair yesterday. Because my kinky/coily hair is VERY difficult to detangle when wet, I did not use while shampooing (YET! I plan to try that later). I wanted to try it 1st with my regular routine - oiling and massaging my dry hair. I began massaging 1st with my fingertips (as usual), then immediately switched to my new silicone massager. The feeling on my scalp was instantly different and wonderful. The massager felt so much better than my fingertips!  I finished at 5:10pm, it is currently 6:10pm and my scalp is still tingling from the excellent blood circulation results of the massager. NEVER felt this when used only fingertips. Also, I saw that one person gave a low rating, stating that the massager hurt scalp and tangled hair. I massaged my scalp gently and it felt SO GOOD! I also noted that, as with fingertips, I always have to detangle with my fingers after massaging. After using massager, my detangle process was about the same and actually seemd a little easier. I love the massager! I will send an updated review if/when I try on my wet kinky/coily hair.

source_doc: I was skeptical. I needed a carrier for 2 kitties I got from our daughter. So I had to reconsider. I was looking at a carrier that was over $50. I didn't want to spend that much on an item that will be used maybe a few times a year.My daughter suggested that I get the used one because it is less expensive.Well, I thought if I didn't like it, I would send it back.I am pleasantly surprised at how new this carrier looks.Not a scratch on it and it's really attractive for a carrier.So I am happy that I purchased this used item, it was absolutely worth it.It was packaged very securely so that everything was delivered intact.Thanks again Amazon.

source_doc: Love it! Very sturdy little stool. I hate to say it but I am 420lbs and getting one of these I was worried I would break it when I sat on it but this little handy dandy stool is pretty darn sturdy. I work as a after care teacher in early education, I have a bad knee and plantar fasciitis in for feet so standing for to long sometimes is kinda difficult. I have to sit with my leg extended out so holding any of my weight up off the stool isn't something that happens. Also my kiddos at school are always wanting to sit on it and of course they try playing with it and it's held up very well! As for comfort, I mean it doesn't have a cushion so it's not like super comfortable but it gives me a place to sit and it holds me up so yeah its good enough. Another good thing is is that i am a tall girl and this isn't so short like other stools like this one where I snap crackle and pop when I go to sit down so that's definitely a plus. It's most definitely worth the money if you need a portable stool.

source_doc: Works great, no problem pairing but your camera App might not allow external microphones. If your video App allows you to select an external microphone, this will work very well. Any problems I had with this were the result of my smartphone, and the included Camera App and, not the fault of the product. When I first plugged this in and powered up the microphone, the two immediately paired. However, try as I might, I could not get my phone to use the microphone. Yes, my Motorola G7 has OTG and has worked with other products like endoscopes, Wallabot and other products. However, when recording video, the phone always used my internal microphone.Today I found out that the problem lays with my Camera APP that came with the phone. So, I downloaded an App called "Open Camera" from the play Store and, there is a selection to use internal or external (if plugged in). Once I selected "external" this wireless microphone has worked flawlessly.  I walked to the edge of my property (about 110 ft) and it clearly picks up me whispering and, the sound quality is as good, or better than my internal microphone. The nice thing about this particular app is that there are no adds at all so far.It took a bit to figure out but, I am now totally pleased. I just wish I did not have to use a different App to video something.

source_doc: Measurements all wrong. I don't know where to begin. I was so excited when I found this item. I paid a good amount for it, it had good reviews. Everything was wrong with it when I recieved it. It said it was 41" wide and 25" deep.... this thing is tiny. I have a large breed I was very excited to have fit on the bottom bunk. That is not how it ended up working. I had to leave the bottom bunk off to have it fit at all. I made it work because I needed it for a specific reason. I measured six times to make sure it would all fit. I waited days for it to arrive, only to be very disappointed. The stairs are an ironworkers nightmare. They are complete trash, straight to the garbage. Wasted my money on such a poorly designed product with a completely inaccurate description.

hypos: Dětské ubrousky. Opravu jsem byl/a spokojený/á s cenou, když jsem je koupil/a před týdnem, stály mě asi 12 $ a něco navíc, ale po zakoupení a obdržení zboží jsem byl/a rád/a za své nákupy, dostal/a jsem všech 9 balení za skvělou cenu! Takže jsem zvažoval/a opakované objednávky, ale cena vzrostla o 8 $, teď stojí 9 balení 20 $... Vybral/a jsem si to kvůli skvělé nabídce a výrobek byl kvalitní pro jeho použití! Ale teď, když ceny vzrostly, prostě najdu jinou alternativu, kterou vyzkouším. To je důvod, proč dávám 4 hvězdičky, protože došlo ke změně ceny! Ale kvalita výrobku je skvělá! source_doc: It just looked too big - but fit perfect after I got the collar attached and on dog. Jack, my 16-pound female Corgi will have her Spay surgery in a couple of weeks.  Wanting to avoid the horror of a traditional cone, I chose this product to prevent her from bothering the stitches.  When I first opened the package, I really thought it was going to be too big.  I measured her and ordered according to the chart.  I tried to inflate using the included pump, but it wouldn't insert far enough to really work.  I did force it in and it did start to work, but it was taking FOREVER, so I hose to blow it up manually.  Just a few breaths and it was done.  (NOTE - the pump has a tip on it that WILL BE wonderful to deflate this item.)After getting it pumped up, I threaded her collar through the attached loops and after properly allowing her time to get used to it, I placed this on her.  She didn't like it, of course, but did tolerate it.  I do think this will be a better option than the cone after her surgery.

source_doc: Buy The Bundle - You Will LOVE These!! I ended up buying the elderflower one just to try them after finding out about these existing. I have pretty bad anxiety and need something to fidget around with/concentrate on and mints were too sugary for me. These are so pleasant to have in your mouth and really do make you feel calmer! I just wish they lasted a little longer since I do like them a lot haha. I wish I bought the bundle first to save money but I never thought I would like them this much!I have one container in my purse, one on my desk, and one for backup! Absolutely lovely having this bundle.Also I love playing with the lid sometimes because it has such a unique way to open! Just make sure to read the directions and not try to pry it open like I did at first haha.EDIT: Lemon actually ended up being my favorite flavor and I eat that flavor after meals since it makes me feel better! Also I am a huge lemon fan fyi, so this might not be your favorite if lemons aren't your thing.

source_doc: Most likely much louder than my ears would appreciate. Before I read the other reviews, I took 2 of these whistles to a park to test them out and I was not impressed, I could not get a good loud sound out of them, no matter how I blew them. After I read some of the reviews I realized it must be me and not them, but even so I couldn't make them whistle loud or even soft really. But after some time went by I went back to park with one and changed my blowing technique and it worked, they are loud, so loud in fact that I was annoying people at the park and my ears were not happy either. They do require some practice apparently to get a good loud sound out of them or just determination. I hope I can make them whistle loud if I'm ever in an emergency situation.

source_doc: Can’t get enough of this stuff. I’m not a BBW customer until NOW. I picked up some other scents on a whim without even smelling them. I fell in love with them until I found Fairytale! I still like the others a lot and will use all the products I bought, but I took another leap of faith and ordered some of this discontinued scent from the description and adorable packaging. I LOVE this stuff and stocked up like a maniac because I know when it’s gone, it’s gone. The scent is fruity without being childish, floral without being cloying. The vanilla and amber make it perfect. I swear I could eat it. I love these products and they came on time and packed well.

source_doc: These are perfect for me. I am a guitar hobbyist. I like to play for a couple hours at a time and know only a few songs. I love to experiment and just goof around. Since the 80s, the biggest irritation has been guitar cables.. Whether I am tripping over them, snagging them, or the connections get loose and the awful static sound ruins whatever I am trying to play. I hate cables.This is my first set of wireless connectors and I have to saw that I think they are Awesome! No more cables and I can walk around while I play. On top of that, when the wife wants some quiet time, I plug in my headphones straight in to the transmitter and can keep playing. The sound is pretty good and I like the distortion effect the most as it has a slight delay effect. The other effects are good too, but I really like the distortion. I do wish that the sound were a bit louder like my old headphone amps were, but for this price, I am happy with the connectors, just the way they are.

source_doc: Nice, small rack.  Screw holes are not 16" apart and thus cannot be attached to studs. This is a review of "touekeng Garage Storage Tool Organizer,Garage Organization Wall Mount Rack Hanger,Super Heavy Duty Steel Garden Tool Organizer (3 Hooks, 1 Rails 16 in).”I hung this organizer today.  It’s not quite 16 inches long.  The furthest apart screw holes were not 16” apart - more like 15”.  I was close enough to the studs that I hope the screws caught some of the wood, but I couldn’t tell.  I may have to rehang it using the drywall anchors.  The padded hooks are nice, heavy-duty and versatile.  I like that I could configure them however I liked.  I couldn’t figure out what the rubber gasket was for, so I didn’t install it with it.  It was loose in my packaging.  I’ve tried to reinsert the gasket, but it's too hard to get it in now.  I don’t really think it makes much difference.It’s a nice small organizational piece for my garage.  I’m happy to have all the organizational help I can get!  I reduced the rating by one star because the screw holes weren’t 16” apart.

source_doc: Can I give this 3.5 stars? I wish I could. I really wanted my cat to like these. They came well packaged, in individual pouches. The ingredients list is impressive. My cat is getting on in years and the bone/joint support sounded promising. My cat is finicky about her food - she loves her greens, her Fancy Feast Medleys and her Temptations treats. But she also LOVES her Churus, especially the Chicken and cheese flavor. I thought this would be a great substitute for Churus and so I tried to entice my cat 2 ways: I placed a pouch of this (like I would her Churus) in a bowl and placed it where I put her treats. She tried it… and quickly dismissed it. I thought maybe I should have mixed it? But I tried again and was still unable to grab her attention. I then tried this as what the brand indicates- as a topper for her food…and my baby didn’t even touch her plate… and it was her FAVORITE canned wet food flavor. So although I wanted to like this, kitty didn’t like it and so I’m stuck with several pouches of a topper my cat will not eat… Serving size is 1 pouch for up to 8lbs cat weight. Price at the time of this review is 47 USD, which is inline with the quality of the ingredients but for my cat not in line on flavor.

Seznam ingrediencí je působivý. Moje kočka stárne a podpora kostí/a kloubů zněla slibně. Pak jsem to zkusil/a tak, jak značka udává - jako posypku na její jídlo... a moje kočka ani nesáhla na svůj talíř... a to byla její NEJOBLÍBENĚJŠÍ příchuť mokrého konzervovaného jídla. source_doc: Good inexpensive Shower Bench. This is not exactly what I wanted, but I needed a shower seat for the roommate immediately due to his recent leg surgery.  The roommate reported that it’s the perfect height for him, and that he likes it better than the adjustable bar stool he used previously.  (The stool began to rust.)  The shower bench is very sturdy with two bolts in major stress points, is easy to assemble and comes with an extra parts— an extra of everything except the hex wrench.  It even has an extra plastic no-slip cap for the leg bottom.  I was truly impressed by this foresight since one of the grommets didn’t allow the machine screw to go all the way in; I swapped it with the spare and presto— assembled.  The bench doesn’t wobble or shake; it’s a steal for the price I paid.  I have no idea about longevity, but I plan to replace with a stone bench if/when I find one since I was looking for a stone bench that would allow me to use a steamer ia the shower prior to this immediate need.  I almost purchased a bench 2-3x the price; I’m glad that I chose this one.  I will update this review in the future if my opinion changes over time due to longevity issues, but keep in mind it’s low price.  See the pictures for size and the box it arrives in.

Sprchový stolička je velmi robustní s dvěma šrouby na hlavních stresových bodech, snadno se montuje a přichází s extra díly - jedna náhradní součást všeho kromě hexového klíče. Dokonce má i extra plastovou neklouzavou krytku na spodku nohy. Opravdu mě ohromil/a tento předvídavost, protože jeden z grometů nedovolil/a strojnímu šroubu, aby se dostal dovnitř úplně; vyměnil/a jsem ho za náhradní a hotovo - smontováno. Stolička se nekymácí ani netřese; je to krádež za cenu, kterou jsem zaplatil/a. Sprchová stolička je velmi stabilní, má dva šrouby na hlavních stresových bodech, snadno se montuje a obsahuje náhradní součásti – k dispozici je jedno navíc ke každé součástce kromě hexového klíče. Dokonce má i dodatečnou plastovou neklouzavou krytku na spodku nohy. Opravil/a jsem jeden z grometů, který neumožnil/a strojnímu šroubu, aby se dostal/a úplně dovnitř; vyměnil/a jsem ho za náhradní a voilà – smontováno. Stolička se nekymácí ani netřese; za cenu, kterou jsem zaplatil/a, je to skvělá koupě. Nemám představu o její trvanlivosti, ale plánuji ji vyměnit za kamennou stoličku, pokud/ a až najdu nějakou, protože jsem hledal/a kamennou stoličku, která by mi umožnila využít parník ve sprše ještě před touto okamžitou potřebou. Téměř jsem koupil/a stoličku 2-3x dražší; jsem rád/a, že jsem zvolil/a tuto. source_doc: Perfect for portioning out my slabs of salmon. I buy a big $40 slab of salmon at a club warehouse every time I go, then use a nice set of heavy duty kitchen scissors  to portion it out, so I can freeze what I won't use right away. Recently the selection has not been what it was, and getting it skinless isn't always possible. I needed a knife that would slice through that salmon like butter, not only to portion but also to remove the thin skin (I think it makes the fish taste fishier).This knife feels good in my hand and yes, slice through and gets the skin off like it's going through butter. I didn't know I needed this knife, but now that I have it, I can't imagine working in my kitchen without it.  I also see that there's a Mama's Great bread knife and oh my, I think I might need it too.
hypos: Perfektní na porcionování mých plátků lososa. Každýkrát, když jdu do klubu, koupím velký plátek lososa za 40 dolarů, pak použiji hezké silné kuchyňské nůžky na porcionování, abych mohl zamrazit to, co ihned nepoužiji. Nedávno výběr nebyl takový, jaký býval, a získat lososa bez kůže není vždy možné. Potřeboval/a jsem nůž, který by krájel lososa jako máslo, nejen na porcionování, ale také na odstranění tenké kůže (myslím, že to dává rybě výraznější rybí chuť). Tento nůž se mi dobře drží v ruce a ano, krájí a odstraňuje kůži, jako by procházel máslem. Nevěděl/a jsem, že tento nůž potřebuji, ale teď, když ho mám, si nedokážu představit pracovat v mé kuchyni bez něj. Také vidím, že existuje výborný chlebový nůž Maminky a ach jo, myslím, že bych ho také mohla potřebovat.

source_doc: Cute. Ok, I don’t think I completely “get” ice rollers. Why not just use an ice cube or a cold stone? Why put fruit and things in your ice if the rest of the ice cube is just plain water? I don’t get it.None of this confusion was helped by the lack of instructions. The two molds came nested and I was trying to figure out - do you fill the inside one or the outside one? Do you fill the outside so the inside is like an ice-covered hollow mold?  I had to find the listing to figure out what to do.I like them, as far as I understand them. I still don’t get why this is different from just grabbing an ice cube. But whatever. They’re easy to fill and use. The chick one is really cute and I don’t know why I enjoy that as much as I do. The bigger one seems like overkill and I stilll haven’t figured out if I’m supposed to scrub my face with the ice inside, or use the cover as a scrubbie and then use the ice. Idk. In any case, they seem to do exactly as advertised.
hypos: Roztomilé. Dobře, myslím, že úplně “chápu” ledové válce. Proč prostě nepoužít kostku ledu nebo studený kámen? Proč dávat ovoce a podobné věci do ledu, když zbytek kostky ledu je jen obyčejná voda? Nerozumím tomu. Žádná z této zmatečnosti nebyla usnadněna nedostatkem pokynů. Dvě formy přišly naskládané a snažil/a jsem se zjistit - naplníte tu vnitřní nebo vnější? Naplníte vnější, aby byla ta vnitřní jako ledem pokrytá dutá forma? Musel/a jsem najít inzerát, abych zjistil/a, co mám dělat. Líbí se mi, jak je chápu. Pořád nechápu, proč je to jiné než prostě vzít kostku ledu. Ale co. Snadno se plní a používají. Ta slepičí je opravdu roztomilá a nevím, proč mi to tak moc líbí. Ta větší se zdá být zbytečná a pořád jsem nezjistil/a, jestli si mám obličej drhnout s ledem uvnitř, nebo použít kryt jako škrabku a pak použít led. Nevim. V každém případě se zdají fungovat přesně tak, jak bylo inzerováno.

source_doc: Nice Scent. I love my fur babies but I do not want my house to smell like a litter box.  I got these OdorTrap refills to use with my Litter Robot because they are much less expensive than what I was using.  I like that the scent is not overpowering because I have found that if I use anything that smells too strong, the cats avoid the litter box…definitely not something you want happening lol.  These refills are made to go in the pod that goes in the drawer of the Litter Robot but I think they could even be used without that near any type of litter box.  I have another litter box that is in an enclosure.  I put one of these packs behind it and it is helping to remove the odor quite well.  I definitely will be stocking up on these.  Great product.  Great price.

source_doc: The flies sure seem to like it. Wow. I mixed up a small batch of this stuff and dumped in a maybe half a dozen fruit flies from a store bought culture. I've got loads of flies now. I'm going to need more spiders.I put maybe a quarter cup of powder in a clean quart size plastic container that previously contained soup from Costco. I added boiling water and stirred, adding more water a little at a time until I had a mixture that would generally keep it's shape but would flatten out if I banged the container on the counter. While it cooled, I cut a roughly 1.5 inch square in the lid of the container. When the mixture was cool, I added the flies and put a coffee filter on top of the container, followed by the lid. Then I just set it aside and waited. It took maybe a week and a half before I saw new signs of life. Now I have a very active colony (swarm?) of flightless fruit flies. I've added new members from another store bought culture to perhaps improve genetic diversity. I don't know if it'll do anything. All I know is I had a few flies and now I have a zillion.

source_doc: The diaper bag I never knew I needed. I wanted to try this diaper bag for the mere fact that it looked roomy and easy to carry. I was right, it was roomy. I was also right that it was easy to carry. What I didn’t know, though, is that it expands into a mini crib!Why would I like that, you ask? I mean you didn’t ask, but I’m going to tell you. I live in FL, and this is genius to take to the beach. I didn’t realize I needed this, until I used it. Great feature!

source_doc: FINALLY - no more tangled hair or itchy scalp. Name a shampoo and I have probably tried it over the years.  My hair is thin and wavy, so it tangles very easily.  I HATED shampooing because once I dried my hair, I had so many tangles, I was brushing out handfuls of hair.  I am not sure what is magic about Viori but my hair is MUCH more manageable AND I have way less tangles. This is my first experience with a bar shampoo.  After 2 months of use, my hair is now thicker!  I used to have to wash my hair much more frequently but again, the magic of Viori, once a week is perfectly fine.  My hair styles easier and so far, after 8 uses, the bar is barely used, will probably get at least 20 washings from one bar, if not more.  I have below the shoulder length hair.  I can travel with this bar shampoo as it can be carried onto airlines AND is much easier than having at bottles of shampoo at home and camping.  Also better for our planet!  I want to try the Viori conditioner next!

source_doc: Perfect. I will absolutely buy more of these hinges when the time comes for me to replace the other hinges I need to replace.  For now though, I bought this set in order to replace a cabinet door that was previously there but had since been removed for I don't know reason, but I had to put a cabinet door back on this small opening because our cats decided that being able to go in there to hide was going to be their favorite hiding place and normally I would not have had an issue with this had it not been for the fact that I have a lot of things I put down there and use on a regular basis and having to remove cat hair from my trays and stuff constantly is not my idea of a good time.  These nickel hinges are super easy to install and it might be a personal preference thing, but I really love how smooth these things open and close.  The material is solid and I really like the looks of the brushed nickel.  If you are looking for a solid constructed, smooth hinge, these are a great start.  I hope you find this review helpful!

source_doc: Had to return controller but ordered another because I love the controller layout. So I love the controller and the buttons on the back are in the best spot on any controller I’ve used. Unfortunately, I had to return the first one I ordered. When I plugged my headset into the controller and talked to teammates in any game I played, my teammates would say that my voice was coming through awful and I sounded muffled. I tried to find any solution by playing around with game settings, system settings, and troubleshooting the controller but to no avail the issues with voice communication remained. When I plugged my headset into other controllers, my headset and voice were perfectly normal so I knew it had something to do with the powerA controller. I returned the first one I ordered and have ordered a new one hoping it was just a lemon. I love what the controller has to offer just need the mic problems not to happen! Fingers crossed with the next one I’m waiting to be delivered.

source_doc: Only includes 1 round banister piece. I bought this for the top of my stairs where there are 2 round banisters. When I started installing I noticed there was only 1 round spindle piece. It came with a note saying if we want a second round spindle piece we need to contact them. So I tried emailing them using the email from their customer service website but that email address doesn't work. So now I have to find time during business hours to call them cause their customer service line has limited hours. Very annoying. On top of that, I went ahead to put it together as much as I could (to make sure it is worth contacting them) and found that the one spindle piece included is WAY to big. In order to get it to stay at the right spot I had to wrap my banister spindle in a ton of cloth. Oh and one of the mounting straps broke when I was tightening it (it wasn't super tight either). So overall, not a good experience. I think I will return it, but will call them just to see if they can fix these issues.

source_doc: Not Worth Purchasing. I am a 52 year old hobby drummer and am not a rough player. I figured these would be cheap but thought that with my easy playing they would be good enough to last a year and save the $20-$25 for Vic Firth Rute's or Promark Hot Rods. I sent these back after playing with them 3x. The first time I used them I noticed after about 10 minutes that the rods started coming out. I would push them back down but then they were uneven. Play a little more and push them down. It only became worse with each time playing so I sent them back.The rods themselves seemed just as durable as the more expensive ones but I will never know for sure since I returned them. All they have to do is put some glue in the end piece before putting it on and the rods would stay in place. I have had a pair of VF Rute 606's for over a year and they are still going strong. The rods have never moved and they show only a little wear. The ends are spreading out some but it just makes them quieter. I guess there is a reason they cost more and I will not mess with the cheap one's in the future. Save your time and money, unless you want to mess around fixing these yourself.

source_doc: Not a favorite. This is my second dock charger. I got it because it is designed for the headset to lay horizontal so there is no chance of the lenses getting damaged by light or scratched. Overall, I do not like this dock very much. I have a few aftermarket headset accessories that the dock doesn’t work well with. The controllers setting in the middle which means I have to adjust my strap piece to get my controllers in the charger.The biggest issue I had is my controllers don’t even charge. I thought there wasn’t an indicator light for the controllers, but it ends up they weren’t charging at all. I left my headset and controllers on the dock for a couple days thinking everything was charging but when I powered up the controllers were at 40% battery life. I even heard my controllers click into place. I never did get them to charge but the headset charges fine so I think my product may have been defective.

source_doc: THE MEASUREMENTS/SIZE GIVEN ARE NOT CORRECT but a nice cover for the price. I purchase alot of car covers.  I usually purchase Budge because they are economical for what I need them for.  This review is not against the seller but the mfg.  I followed directions and measure this car from front to back, I also went online to confirm the length....204" or 17'.  I ordered 2 covers that the mfg states are 228' or 19" for extra caveats to the car itself.  Mind you I know this is a universal fit, the fit overall for a sedan is fine, however, this cover is not 19' long so I am very disappointed.  I cannot return because it was such a tight fit a small corner ripped.  I also used this cover on another car of same dimensions, it did not fit.  This is a lightweight cover which I knew that is fine.  Not happy spending $64+ dollars for something that didn't cover 100%.  Again, not made at the seller, just the mfg and to let people know that Budge misrepresents the measurements.  This is the first time this has happened to me on their covers.

source_doc: Stay away unless you are short. I loved the way the windshield looked on my 2020 rebel 500 but, when I went above 50 mph the wind hitting my helmet made it vibrate so bad that it blurred my vision and gave me a headache. I tried different riding positions but nothing worked unless I stayed ducked down. I am only 5’8” so I’m not that tall to begin with. I tried to return the windshield and they declined the return stating that since I used the windshield they wouldn’t accept it back. I only had the windshield attached for one week So buyer Beware. If I was only riding in town and never over 50 mph then I would recommend it but since I am more of a daily driver going 40 miles one way and the average speed is 60 mph there is no way I would recommend this windshield to anyone. Plus I would not recommend this seller for any purchase since it looks like they will find any excuse to not refund. This is my two cents on this product so take it or leave it.

source_doc: I used these to protect my chicken runs. These are great!  I actually bought several after the first one impressed us.  Last year, my first year with chickens, I got expensive, opaque, heavy plastic and put around the runs (I have 4).  It did the trick, no issues there, but I had to staple it on.  Taking it off was tedious since I wanted to save it, given the price.  I saw these and ordered one to see how we liked it.  The rivets meant we could screw it into the wood (or use cable ties on the wire runs), making removal and reuse next year much easier.  The little "block" design allows more light inside the runs, which is great because the chickens do need light to stay healthy.  It's a toss up - light vs. keeping wind and elements down so they don't freeze.  I feel like this does a good job at both.  The tricky part came when I had to use them side by side because, while the screws were fine, the cable ties left a gap. I fixed that by using Gorilla tape, which sticks well in inclement weather.  Overall, very happy to have found these and I got them at a good price, which is awesome since my pet chickens cost more than any other animal I've ever had in my life!  They're spoiled, but I wouldn't have it any other way.

source_doc: Absolute Garbage. These things are absolute garbage. I have had two now, one which I just threw in the trash last night, was a black HZ model. I bought two roughly same time frame about 5 years ago. The black one cracked one of the ball support tabs, so I wrapped string around it and glued the string in place to make a kind of splint. That got me about another 8 months then yesterday I see the snark on the floor all discontorted, I picked it up and saw it cracked at the jaw, so I threw it in the trash.Today I remembered when I bought them, I bought two at the same time, so I should have another new one essentially since I haven't used it. Well this picture is the second one, it's 5 years old yes but never even been taken out of the box til now and one of those tabs is cracked. Unbelievable. It's going in the trash and I'll never buy snark anything again. Done.On a side note, not sure what the material they make these out of but this blue one, which has never had hands on it, is sticky. I keep it in a box with guitar strings, plus it was in it's original box, and the little bag. My guess the material over time, off gasses, and the material just becomes weak and cracks or something.

source_doc: Fluffier than expected. It is hard to order something online and know if you will like it or not, even if you base your decision on the reviews. I must have spent a week almost daily searching for a comforter. So, I took a chance on this one because my old comforter was flat and faded. And hello, I like being spoiled by two day shipping with Prime!The comforter arrived in a vacuum sealed tight bag and looked pretty thin. No weird smells, either. It was late and I wanted to use it that night, so I overlooked the instructions and tossed it into the washing machine. (The instructions state to air it out over a 24 hour period outside, but it is winter here and I have nowhere to safely hang it or leave it.) I washed it on "warm" on the delicate cycle and the tag said to "line dry" but seriously, who does that anymore? Being the rebel that I am, I forego the instructions and shove it into my regular sized dryer on "medium" and waited. Well, it took about 2 hours to dry. When it was done, it smelled great and was very fluffy! I put it on the bed and loved the look and feel of it. I slept great that night snuggled up with this wonderful, and did I mention fluffy? new comforter. I'm very happy with my purchase.

source_doc: Check the comb for metal shards! One safety issue that I found concerning was that I found metal shards in-between the combs.  I found 3, removed them, and rinsed and soaked the removable comb piece in soapy hot water before even using it to be safe.This is an extremely cheap alternative to the popular FURminator descending comb, so I wanted to try it out.First thing difference I noticed was that this comb doesn't have the button to push out the hair like the FURminator.  That button you see on top is only to remove the metal de-shedding comb.For $3, this de-shedding comb is a fantastic deal, and does the job of de-shedding your pup like it's supposed to.  I do find it annoying that I have to grab the hair out after a few brushes instead of being able to use a single button to do it, but again for $3 bucks, I can deal.  I follow up with a brush down with my regular brush to catch all of the loose hairs that this tool doesn't pick up.It's a cheap tool, and I'm happy I have it.  I probably will purchase the FURminator again down the line, because I really do miss that button.

source_doc: Best on the market. I am ridiculously happy with these under-mount rechargeable lights! I recently updated my master closet and installed two of these lights. They are perfect for what I need. The motion sensor is very sensitive. They turn on immediately as I walk in, remain on as long as I am there and shut off about 30 seconds after I leave.  The brightness is adjustable. There is a switch to turn it on, off, or automatic. The little metal discs that the light magnetizes to are simple to adhere to a myriad of surfaces. I applied them to a melamine shelf so I’m not worried about removal should I want to move them. I would be cautious of applying to painted surfaces unless you plan on it being permanent.These have been perfect in my closet for low light for nighttime or early morning when I don’t want the brightness of over head lighting. source_doc: It works fast!! Awesome product. My dog had these raw dark splotches in the creases by her legs. She was constantly licking. It was driving me crazy, plus making her miserable! I already had her on allergy supplements,  so I tried mixing organic coconut oil in her dry food. And putting pure aloe gel on those areas. All she did was want to lick it off(aloe is non-toxic but still). I also started bathing her weekly myself with an antifungal shampoo. But I think it's because of having the heat on, and blankets and the creases are where she sweats(I assume). Or air doesn't get to that area enough. I ordered this stuff as a last resort before a costly vet bill, and I was floored. Not only does it smell great, immediately after spraying those areas, I could tell she felt immediate relief!! She has never once even tried to lick the area. She doesnt like me fussing over her, but when I go to spray her, she pulls her leg back so I can get to it better!! lol which tells me she knows it is helping. I've only used it for 3 days. One side has cleared about 70%, the other about 50%. She is no longer miserable, she's back to playing. And I'm only on day 3 twice a day. Pretty amazing. I'm so thankful that I found this, I immediately just ordered more. Game changer!!!
hypos: Funguje to rychle!! Úžasný produkt. Moje fenka měla tyto syrové tmavé skvrny v záhybech u nohou. Neustále si je olizovala. Šílelo mě to, navíc ji to činilo nešťastnou! Už jsem ji měla na doplňcích proti alergiím, takže jsem se pokusila smíchat organický kokosový olej do jejího suchého krmiva. A nanášela jsem čistý gel z aloe na tato místa. Všechno, co chtěla, bylo si to olizovat (aloe je netoxický, ale i tak). Také jsem začala ji sama koupat jednou týdně s antifungálním šamponem. Ale myslím, že to je kvůli zapnutému topení, a dečkám a záhyby jsou místem, kde se potí (předpokládám). Nebo se vzduch k tomu místu nedostane dostatečně. Tohle jsem si objednala jako poslední možnost před nákladným veterinářským účtem, a byla jsem ohromena. Nejen že to skvěle voní, okamžitě po nastříkání těchto míst jsem poznala, že cítila okamžitou úlevu!! Ani jednou se nepokusila si to místo olizovat. Nelíbí se jí, když se o ni starám, ale když jdu jí to nastříkat, stahuje nohu zpět, abych se k tomu mohla lépe dostat!! haha což mi říká, že ví, že to pomáhá. Použila jsem to pouze 3 dny. Jedna strana se vyčistila asi o 70 %, druhá asi o 50 %. Už není nešťastná, zase si hraje. A jsem teprve na třetím dni dvakrát denně. Docela úžasné. Jsem tak vděčná, že jsem to našla, okamžitě jsem objednala víc. Změna hry!!!

source_doc: Exactly what I wanted. I am not a big fan of water. I can’t explain it, I just never really like it unless I’m severely dehydrated. Since I don’t drink sodas or sugary drinks, that means I usually just drink coffee or tea all day. Not exactly the best choice as that’s a lot of caffeine. So I determined that I’m going to drink more water. I swear the water tastes funky to me if it comes out of stainless steel containers. I can only tolerate drinking water from glass or ceramic vessels. Plastic is out of the question to touch my food or drinks.  I know- I’m picky. I couldn’t find any large volume glass water bottles locally, so I turned to Amazon. I completely love this water bottle. I’ve been throwing some frozen fruit & chopped cucumber in there & filling it with filtered water to infuse. It has been a game changer. It’s also easy to use, easy to clean, no leaks, and you can use the straw or not depending on your preference. Yeah, you have to be careful not to throw it around since it’s glass, but the carry handle is very sturdy. I love everything about it!

Protože nepiji limonády ani sladké nápoje, znamená to, že obvykle piji pouze kávu nebo čaj celý den. Není to přesně nejlepší volba, protože to je hodně kofeinu. Tak jsem se rozhodl/a, že budu pít více vody. Přísahám, že mi voda chutná divně, pokud vychází z nerezových nádob. Můžu akorát tolerovat pití vody ze skleněných nebo keramických nádob. Plast je naprosto vyloučený pro dotyk s mým jídlem nebo nápoji. Vím - jsem vybíravý/á. Nemohl/a jsem najít žádné velké skleněné lahve na vodu v okolí, tak jsem se obrátil/a na Amazon. Tuhle lahev na vodu úplně miluji. Házel/a jsem tam nějaké mražené ovoce a nakrájenou okurku a plnil/a ji filtrovanou vodou na infuzi. Bylo to revoluční. Také se snadno používá, snadno se čistí, neteče a můžeš používat brčko, nebo ne, podle své preference. Ano, musíš být opatrný/á, abys ji neházel/a, protože je skleněná, ale úchytka je velmi pevná. source_doc: I just wanted it to tell time with a red display. The first one I got was defective. It would not power on when plugged in. I returned it without issue and was sent a replacement. Second one was just fine. Simple to set time, I like that it has a red display. It isn’t too large but still able to see it from across the room. I purchased it so I could tell what the time was in the middle of the night without having to turn on a light or expose myself to blue light. I have a very difficult time sleeping and any other color display would be too stimulating and keep me from sleeping. I have to take medication at particular times during the night. I don’t use the alarm function but I do like that if I needed to, it has the ability to have a softer or louder alarm option. It also has a battery backup option. Simple, effective at telling time without being too bright or stimulating in the middle of the night. Bonus, my husband can see the time without looking at his phone and lighting up our bedroom. So nice not to have that happening anymore. Hopefully it lasts a long time.

source_doc: Beautiful flute, but… This is a very beautiful flute and I was so excited to get it. I hadn’t played in about 30 years and wasn’t sure if I could still play. I was pretty good way back when and really wanted to start playing again.When I started playing, I thought some notes seemed sharp. Well, as I said, it had been a while and I thought it was me. I continued to practice and did not see an improvement in the sharpness. In fact, the flute just got more out of tune as time went on. No amount of adjustment would correct this. Sadly, I was unable to continue to play this flute. It was too hard on my ears. I have returned it and will look at an intermediate flute to purchase. I am glad I tried it however because it sparked that part of me that always loved to play.

source_doc: I’m very happy with these hammocks. The only reason I’m giving four stars is because we’re I live at it’s so cold that our windows are very cold so the suction won’t stay on the windows. That to me that would not be a product issue. It’s just where I live at. It’s very very cold! It does indeed hold two cats each on each hammock. I have three indoor cats but right now I’m babysitting my best friends cat so I’m up to four cats so I can say it does hold two cats a piece.Every time I try to take a picture of any of the cats on the hammock they see the camera and then they jump off! They were very easy to put together, and they are very sturdy because two of my cats are pretty big and pretty sturdy! If I get any of the cats to stay on the hammock, when I have my phone out, then I will indeed take a picture and add the picture at a later date! I’m very happy with this product and I do believe my three cats plus the one that I’m babysitting is very happy with these hammocks! I was very surprised when I open the box and seen that there was two hammocks. I just assumed that was only one. They’re fantastic and again I’m very pleased with them. Thank you for letting me review these hammocks.

source_doc: Cheap upgrade. I am fairly new to the sax and I bought one of the cheap Eastar $200 altos. I won't knock my Eastar, I LOVE that in 2023 there's such a thing as a $200 saxophone (didn't exist when I was a kid), but I COULD NOT hit those altissimo notes! Obviously I assumed it was because I was a beginner and I needed to practice my embouchure, and I could hit a very squeaky high F# maybe 30% of the time (the lowest altissimo note). It's been a couple months now and I was starting to get the feeling that the problem wasn't me, it was the hardware. I just got this Yamaha 4C in the mail today, plugged it onto my cheap sax, and hit a perfect high F# first try! I swapped back and forth between the mouthpieces and the Yamaha notes sound noticeably smoother and clearer.TLDR: If you've got a cheap sax then this is a cheap way to instantly improve your playing.

Nechci kritizovat svůj Eastar, MILUJI, že v roce 2023 existuje něco jako saxofon za 200 dolarů (to neexistovalo, když jsem byl/a dítě), ale NEMOHL/A jsem zahrát ty altissimo tóny! Očividně jsem si myslel/a, že to je proto, že jsem začátečník/ce a potřeboval/a jsem cvičit svou embouchure, a dokázal/a jsem zahrát velmi skřípavé vysoké F# asi 30 % času (nejnižší altissimo tón). Teď to jsou už dva měsíce a začínal/a jsem mít pocit, že problém není ve mně, ale v nástrojích. Dnes mi přišlo toto Yamaha 4C poštou, připojil/a jsem ho k mému levnému saxu a na první pokus jsem zahrál/a dokonalé vysoké F#! source_doc: Falls apart nearly immediately. I was excited to get  table for my bed and laptop and that excitement lasted about 25 minutes after I set it up.  I noticed it swaying, the bridge support on the left side had popped out, either not glued well or should have had deeper holes to slide into.  I thought "fine i'll pop it back in" well it kept happening no matter howc careful I was and its practically useless now because every small nudge could send it, and whatever I have on it crashing to the floor.Ontop of this I noticed a screw from no where on my bed, and it wans't until I stepped on and cut my foot upen on a second one I realized they were loosely drilled in and had fall out with ease.  Well now i have a bloody bottom of my foot and I'm not sure if  I need  tetanus shot.This i remind you was within 48 hours of use.  Who knows what would have fallen to the floor or hurt me next..Poor or defective unit or the whole design is cheap.

source_doc: Careful... I bought the 64oz which has a seam in the mouth (the 40oz doesn't) and I looked in there today, not even a week after it arrived, to find rust so just be sure to check every once in awhile that everything is kosure. I'm used to working with cast iron so I know I can scrub it out but it's not really something I want to have to worry about constantly.Other than that I feel like I haven't really been able to give this a fair shot but as mentioned, I bought a 40 oz as well which I'm hoping will be better.Also, I'm rating this as "not easy to drink from" (next section of review asks for a star rating on this feature) because I very much want a super fast, super smooth flow so I can chug like my embrava (not insulated) water bottles but I don't think that I will ever get that from any hot drink lid. Still a pita to have the lids be so... Gluggy and slow pour just because I prefer warm water.

Koupil/a jsem 64oz, která má šev u úst (40oz ho nemá) a dnes jsem se tam podíval/a, ani ne týden po jejím doručení, a našel/a jsem rez, takže se ujistěte, že občas zkontrolujete, že je všechno v pořádku. source_doc: Love these so much!! Let me start off that I haven't used the decals. My walls are textured, so I already know they probably wouldn't stick. The shelves look great even without the decals though so I'm not worried about it. I know they were for a nursery, but I didn't need them in my son's room. So I put them in my bathroom behind my sink area to hold my lotions and perfumes. I love that they have the bar infront to hold things in, easy to clean, the perfect size for what I needed them for, and SOMEWHAT easy to put together. The only reason I gave it a 4 instead of a 5, is the reason why I said somewhat easy to put together. I had one end piece that the holes were not done correctly for the bar piece. So could only use one dowel to hold it in place instead of two. Which shouldn't effect it at all, but you expect something to come in with no defects at all. With that being said, I would get these again in a heartbeat and highly recommend them.
