source_doc: Great option for small spaces! I got this because I don't have enough under counter space to install those typical paper towel holders, and I didn't want a tabletop one.  I was worried that it wouldn't fit in the space that I was intending for it, but it fits!The quality of the holder is great, nice and sturdy.  And the most important part: the magnet is strong!  It slapped down onto the side of my fridge and it doesn't budge without putting a good amount of force into it. It's absolutely worth it's value, I honestly feel like it's a steal because of the quality and versatility in placement compared to the typical paper towel holders that you have to screw down.I would like to note that I prefer this one over another magnetic holder I have because the rod that holds the paper towel roll isn't screw-on, it's one whole piece.  The other one I have had a tendency to unscrew itself over time, so I had to gorilla glue it, because I found it annoying.  Get this one!

source_doc: Great value for a cheap starter kit! This is the first time I've tried to pull dents out of anything but I have seen it done several times. So that being said, I think this is a very cheaply made kit, it's not meant for professionals at all. It is a good beginner-starter kit though. I used it on my clothes dryer where "someone" stepped on the lid and left a large dent. I used up an entire stick of black glue. I had better luck applying glue to the dryer lid first. When I applied it to the puller tab first it would stay stuck on the dryer which made the whole process much harder.  There's no replacement for experience though. The puller contraption itself is easy to use but made of very cheap metal so I'm not sure how long it will last. The glue gun works, but it heats up pretty slow. Cleaning up the glue that didn't come off the metal was a huge pain. Like I said before that can be prevented some by applying the glue to the metal surface first instead of the pull tabs. I did not get the dent completely pulled out but it does look a lot better. I just wanted to try it out on something besides a car first. I didn't need the little pry tools for anything yet, but I do a lot of car projects so I'm sure they will come in handy eventually.

source_doc: Better than I thought. I got this microphone for my phone to cut down background noise mainly for zoom meetings but also for a bird identification app called Merlin as traffic is very loud. I am usually a stickler about apps but this said it didn't require one. Much to my surprise it actually does not require an app or anything. I have a galaxy S22 ultra and I plugged it in and it just worked. I didn't have to change any settings or anything. It worked for every app even ok google. While playing with it i did open a decibel meter and took notice of how much of the background noise was being cut out. I live full time in a Class A RV so the noise level can be pretty high inside. I put 2 screenshots in to show it does decrease the background noise a bit. I think the actual bonus comes from the microphone being much closer to you though. I only used it on my phone so not sure about the other things.

source_doc: About 2/3 shades lighter than picture so order wisely. This hairpiece is very beautiful. It’s long wavy and light. It wraps around your bun really well and cascades down your back very beautifully. The only problem is that the color between what you see in the picture and what you get when it arrives is way off about 2 to 3 shades lighter than expected. I ordered the blonde color and I thought based on the picture that it would be a dusky darker blonde and it ended up being a lighter blonde, lightening towards the tips into an almost platinum blonde, so I can’t use this hairpiece, but that doesn’t mean I didn’t like it. It’s a really well-made piece. I wish that the colors were more true to what you would expect when you order so please keep in mind the difference in color I’m attaching two pictures one is with flash and one is without, and then you can see the difference between what I ordered and what I got. I did order another piece that I hope is closer to my hair color so that I can use it because I really did like this. Took a star off for color variation, and kept the 4 stars for the quality, fit, and price.

source_doc: What is going on with these keyboards? My daughter got one of these keyboards for Christmas. The 1st keyboard we had types randomly into text boxes on the screen. Just random characters. It was freaking them out so I contacted the mfgr. They said that I should update the software. I downloaded the tool to do so, but it's all in Chinese (I assume)? I don't know which button is update and which button is identify but I poke around and figure it out. The SUCCESS/FAIL text box is also not in English so I don't know the status and the window doesn't close. Either way, nothing fixes it. The company sends out a new keyboard and this one turns off randomly while in use. Since this is a gaming keyboard, you KNOW that can't happen, or GAME OVER. They suggested I update the software, but we had already plugged in the old keyboard in the meantime. I finally get the chance to do that and now the thing is dead. Like dead dead. I plug it into another computer, still won't light up. Uninstall/Reinstall/Repair/Update software, hardware (in DevMgr), restart over and over and over...and nothing. Now it's just a brick. Guess we're stuck with the ghost keyboard. Side note: Customer service was responsive in their attempt to help, but they couldn't solve the problem. Ended up offering a $20 credit, but I didn't purchase it, so that didn't make sense. I just want something that works!

source_doc: SHORT style great for people 5’9” or taller DID NOT SWIVEL & WOBBLY. Preface: I am female…weigh more than I care to say…(229lbs)…and I am 5’7”. I purchased this for guitar practice as I have read many, many people have. So let’s cut to the chase……Maybe I received a dud…who knows. I do know that 1) it was wobbly with no means of adjusting it. Well…I guess I could put a matchbook under one of the legs to level it out…you know, like in the old days! 2) Maybe my definition of “swivel” is different than most…seat barely even moved when I wasn’t even sitting on it and had to strong arm it. 3) I researched like crazy to find the “perfect” stool. I read several reviews that stated it’s good for people 5’7”….. um…nope. I couldn’t put a foot on the floor without sitting so close to the front that it was quite uncomfortable on my woman parts. Again…I might have received a defective item. I have learned through all my research that roc-n-soc is extremely well made and very popular. I just purchased the r-n-s nitro drum throne so I’ll let ya’ll know how that one is. I’m super stoked!

source_doc: I absolutely love this backpack! It's super light but extremely well-made, sturdy and looks great. I was so excited when this arrived and while I was unpacking it. I think I finally found the perfect backpack. Good backpacks often are pretty large and take up space, but not this one. It is large unpacked but folded up it's about the size of a small hat. I took a million photos so I would be sure to know how to fold it up into it's tiny little sack again. It's unbelievable how compact this backpack can be when you see it all filled up and expanded. I put 2 large winter coats and a sweatshirt in it for the photos. There are straps in all the right places to distribute the weight evenly. I won't even consider buying a backpack if it doesn't have straps on the sides, but his backpack has side straps, two front straps and straps on the bottom for a bedroll or something. There are even straps on the straps! Can you tell that I love this backpack? I really do!
hypos: Tento batoh naprosto miluji/a! Je super lehký/á, ale extrémně kvalitní/á, pevný/á a vypadá skvěle. Byl/a jsem tak nadšený/á, když dorazil/a, a když jsem ho/ji vybaloval/a. Myslím, že jsem konečně našel/a dokonalý/á batoh. Dobré batohy bývají často docela velké a zabírají místo, ale tento ne. Je velký/á, když je rozbalený/á, ale složený/á má velikost malého/é klobouku. Udělal/a jsem milion fotografií, abych si byl/a jistý/á, jak ho/ji zase složit do jeho/její malé taštičky. Je neuvěřitelné, jak kompaktní/á tento batoh může být, když ho/ji vidíte úplně naplněný/á a roztažený/á. Dal/a jsem do něj/ně dva velké zimní kabáty a mikinu na fotky. Na všech správných místech jsou popruhy, které rovnoměrně rozdělují váhu. source_doc: I Love This Shampoo! I am always hesitant about purchasing beauty products online. I stumbled across this Biotin because I was looking for something with a nutritional value instead of just stripping my hair of oils. I had been using Suave for years and noticed my hair was breaking much more. My hairdresser recommended that I get away from shampoos with sulfates. I switched the following week and I noticed a HUGE different in my hair feel, texture and VOLUME! I have received so many compliments on how healthy my hair looks. The only thing I changed was the shampoo. The video shows a guy squeezing a lot of shampoo on his head. My hair length is below my shoulders and I only use about the size of dimer amount. A little goes a long way.I have been convinced that this is the only shampoo for me. I will be adding the conditioner to the hair care lineup.

source_doc: I hesitate to say how much I love this guitar but…. I sent mine back. It was said to have a blemish on the body. It did not. It was gorgeous and beautiful and I love the feel and pickups. It had a warped neck. It needed a fret job and a nut job. I can do fret jobs but I can’t fix a warped neck. I almost cried sending it back. It had a wonderful vintage feel and tone. I plan to get another. I love this guitar and I have a lot of guitars. I can’t recommend this to anyone other than luthiers who appreciate the 70’s.To new players get a new guitar with perfect action and half price. Eart. There’s so many.

source_doc: AMAZING! It literally melts my press on nails! I’ve never been able to get professional acrylic nails because all that filing of the nail bed to prep, would traumatize my nails to the point of creating pockets of fungus. Then I discovered press on nails and with some trepidation I tried it. I took them off after three days to make sure that my nails were clean and to my relief there was no sign of trauma. A whole new world of beautiful nails  just opened up to me! I came across this little gadget and I thought I tried it. I had nothing to lose because if it didn’t work as expected, I could always return it. I followed instructions and then soaked my nails for 5 minutes. When I took my hand out I couldn’t believe my eyes! They fake nails had just disappeared! I didn’t even have to use the scrapper. I used a cotton with acetone to finish taking what little was left. Then I soaked them again for an additional 3 minutes and I was done. I rubbed tea tree oil on my nails to help with the dryness and prevent fungus. This little thing is worth every penny. Healthy nails  have no price. Now I can safely become addicted to beautiful press on nails.

source_doc: A remake that feels more like two steps backward than a step forward. I grew up playing the original Diamond and Pearl, and besides the notoriously slow engine run, I had really enjoyed those games and looked forward to the remakes. I found BDSP faithful to a fault, while not introducing enough new spins to qualify as a breath of fresh air. The Grand Underground held my interest for only a brief amount of time. Everything else feels stale, rigid, and uninspired. I’m not a fan of the chibi aesthetic, which I’m especially disappointed about since I liked the direction the new games were going with more detailed and realistic models. I have played Pokemon since I was in preschool, over 20 years, and this is the only Pokemon game I have not finished. I stopped playing after getting the eighth badge and couldn’t feel bothered to continue any further. (I did, however, help my sister beat Cynthia on Brilliant Diamond, and I appreciate that they’ve made the notoriously difficult Champion even more difficult. From the remastered music to the competent AI, hands down the best battle in BDSP.) When Pokemon Legends Arceus came out, I dropped Shining Pearl like a hotcake and didn’t look back. Arceus was the breath of fresh air I was craving.

source_doc: Love this play mat. I got this play mat for the kids playroom and was pleasantly surprised. This was a perfect addition to our playroom since we have hard wood floors. Sitting on the ground was not comfy for me when I was playing with the kids but it was also a safety concern for me not having padding on the ground for my daughter who was doing tummy time, rolling and crawling. The mat is very sturdy / durable which is 100% necessary when you’re working with toddlers. I wasn’t sure if would last long but for the price I was willing to give it a shot. I was not disappointed. I wish I had it when I had my first child. I love the material because I would let the baby just lay freely so if she went potty it was an easy clean up. Even in general I was able to clean / sanitize the mat when necessary! Great buy.

source_doc: I don’t know. I wish I could give it a review. I saw this on the feed in the summer and was notified during a flash sale. I bought and when I had time off work to take to pool, I got someone’s return. Now mine was an impulse buy based on what it looks like it can do. But the one I received didn’t have a power source. I received the device and the top wing (fin) whatever it is. I returned. I noticed upon return that the serial numbers did not even match up from the inner to the outter box. I’m bummed, but I guess it worked out since it was an impulse buy for myself. I’ll continue to watch and if it drops to where I don’t feel guilty I’ll repurchase. Oh, the motor had a hair wrapped up in it. Blonde I think and mines black!

source_doc: Great for smaller mums but. So after almost a month trying this product, I have a love hate relationship with this item. It runs on USB-C which is great since i bought a power bank to charge these on the go after I used them.  It's easy to clean.  I use odorless baby bottle soap to clean it so it's not masked with heavy soap oder.Now like others have mentioned, its not very quiet. I mean I really don't mind, but if a baby is sleeping and baby is sensitive to noise then it's an issue. Also I'm a 36FF. After trial and error 6 bras, ace bandage and even trying a corset I couldn't accommodate the product to stay on my chest. I feel this product is more accommodating to small/med chested women. I even tried to micky mouse and place a different suction funnel to it to accommodate my large chest but to no avail.So I had a friend use it for her new baby and it helps her. She's a 36B and it works perfectly for her which is why I'm fine and love the product because it's helping a another mum. To avoid milk spillage we had to get a big bowl and then funneled the bottles which was just too much.Overall I give the product a 3/5
hypos: Skvělé pro menší maminky, ale. Po téměř měsíci zkoušení tohoto produktu mám k němu vztah lásky a nenávisti. Používám bezodorousní mýdlo na dětské lahve, aby nebylo zamaskováno těžkým zápachem mýdla. Jak už zmínili i jiní, není to příliš tiché. Mě to opravdu nevadí, ale pokud dítě spí a je citlivé na hluk, pak je to problém. Také mám velikost 36FF. Po zkoušení a omylu 6 podprsenek, bandáže a dokonce i zkúšení korzetu jsem nemohl/a přizpůsobit produkt, aby zůstal na mé hrudi. Mám pocit, že tento produkt je více přizpůsoben pro ženy s malými/středními prsy. Dokonce jsem se pokusil/a použít Mickey Mouse a připevnit k němu jinou sací trychtýř, abych vyhověl/a své velké hrudi, ale marně. Takže jsem měl/a kamarádku, která to použila pro své nové dítě a jí to pomáhá. Ona má 36B a perfektně jí to funguje, což je důvod, proč jsem v pohodě a mám produkt rád/a, protože pomáhá jiné mamince. source_doc: Best Wipers I Ever Owned. My 2004 Toyota Avalon XLS had squeaky wiper since the day I bought it. Car is in excellent condition and I replaced the wipers originally with something like Bosch. They still dragged and squeaked horribly. I thought perhaps the motor was bad so I replaced the wiper motor, still squeaked. I bought another "Silicone" type wiper blade and they squeaked. I though maybe my wiper linkage was bad so I replaced the entire mechanical arms. Still squeaked. I lived with this for about 2 years and driving to work in the rain one morning, my wipers were squeaking when I noticed that about 8 inches of the passenger wiper blade peeled off from the frame. The wipers instantly stopped squeaking. Crazy.I ordered the "Rain-X 830124 Silicone Endura Wiper Blades", which is a bit misleading because it is only one blade. I assumed there were two since the cost was enough for two, but it was only one. I ordered the other blade as well and these things are buttery smooth, no squeaking at last!Highly recommended.

source_doc: I would describe the fram brand as barely adequate, if that. The build quality feels just really cheap. Everything about it is cut rate. That's probably why it's priced right around $4 right now. I don't know about all the people that say it's destroyed their engines and whatnot. I guess that would happen if pieces came off at and it came apart in some way and started to clog up the oil passages. But from what I've seen no one's ever been able to prove that that has happened. Now that's not to say it hasn't happened I just don't have the time to do extensive research. But everything about these is just cheap. I have no idea how well they filter. For a few dollars more you can get something that feels really good quality. So I decided not to use cheap oil filters anymore and so I find these unacceptable. Like I say I'm not going to make claims that they ruin engines because I have no idea. I know the nickname for these is orange can of death. It's pretty funny but I haven't seen that to be really true at all like I said above I haven't seen proof about it. Anyway yeah I'm just not going to use filters this cheap and low quality.
hypos: Fram značku bych popsal/a jako sotva přijatelnou, pokud vůbec. Kvalita zpracování se cítí opravdu velmi levně. Všechno kolem toho je podřadné. To je pravděpodobně důvod, proč je cena nyní kolem 4 dolarů. Nevím o všech těch lidech, kteří říkají, že to zničilo jejich motory a podobně. source_doc: Finally, I found the right ones! I was asked to find and order wind screens for the microphones in the drive-up window at the bank I work at.  I never thought it would be so difficult to find the right ones.  The mics we have are very old, so I wasn't like I could go to the manufacturers website and order replacements.  They don't make the model.  I Googled over and over and tried many different sites and searched on here.  Just measuring didn't do any good.  For one thing, the ones we had were missing the tops (did someone chew them off?) and they were stretched out, and it was hard to tell what size they really were.  I tried measuring the size of the mic and trying to figure out what would fit.  I looked at pictures, descriptions, measurements, all of it.  And I ended up with several purchases that didn't even come close. It seemed that most of what was out there was designed for lapel mics, which I guess would be very small, and gaming headsets, and most of those looked too big or two small. Finally I ordered these.  And they fit!  They seem nice, I mean they're just little pieces of foam-not much to screw up there.  Now I can quit looking and move on to the next odd thing they ask me to order.

source_doc: Pickleball is tough but fun.  This set is great for beginners learning how to play. I used to play tennis in high school, and I loved it.  Over the years I've not played tennis nearly as much as I wanted to given work and life schedules.  Pickleball is something that I had heard of a couple of years ago but never really looked into it.  Now, it's the newest sports fad, and this set from Deerfamy is one that I ordered to get me back into something that is like tennis.  This set comes with two lightweight pickleball rackets, two indoor court (orange) and two outdoor court (yellow) balls.  There's also a carrying case that everything fits into.After my first attempt at playing pickleball, I have to say it's a tougher sport than I thought.  If you're familiar with tennis, there's a LOT of fast-paced volleying.  That was the part of tennis that I hated and the main reason I stayed back on the baseline.  I'm not a net player, but pickleball sort of forces you into that.  The equipment from Deerfamy was good at helping me practice.  It's lightweight and had a nice grip on the handle.  I had control of the racket when swinging, so I can't blame the racket.  I'm just not good at pickleball.... yet! :)

source_doc: Water tastes great! I love this filter! I’m new to RVing and I noticed all the neighbors have this on their water supply so I researched it and I knew I needed one! I immediately noticed the chlorine smell was gone. I use bottled water but I occasionally run out and I hated using tap water because of the toxins it contains. I also worried about giving it to my dogs to drink. The installation was a breeze but there were no instructions that mentioned the black water that comes out at first. I was alarmed but I found their website and read that it’s carbon from the filter and it isn’t harmful. I made my first pot of coffee this morning (without my regular dread) and it was far better than regular tap water! The only thing that I don’t like is that it leaked from the water source. It comes with a rubber ring but it didn’t work for me. Luckily I had others on hand and now it doesn’t leak. Best purchase I’ve made in a very long time!

source_doc: Blender, frother or shaker bottle works best with this. In adding 3 scoops to my 12 oz coffee, I found it didn't mix thoroughly. Next try, I added 1 scoop to my coffee and it mixed up a little better using just one scoop. I then added an another scoop to a 1/3 cup half & half (yes, I like a little coffee with my creamer lol). I used my cordless frother and it mixed up fine. I am not sure 2 scoops in the creamer would have worked as well. I'm ok with only using 2 scoops a day; it's better than nothing.  The flavor was nice, but I also add flavored syrup to my coffees as well.  Next day, I put 3 scoops in a blender bottle (with wire wisk ball) along with 12 oz of milk and half a packet of chocolate breakfast drink mix. Then, shook and shook and shook. It mixed up great and tasted awesome.  I removed a star only because I didn't feel this worked as well as I thought it should in hot coffee. It's better than some, but still not awesome.

I never use it during breastfeeding and I don’t think it’s a good idea to have vibration with the baby attached to you.I wish the battery life were longer. I also think it would have been better that the inlet for the charger had a hole to begin with. I kinda created a slit while trying to pierce through the hole (see picture). source_doc: ---Buyers BEWARE they don't stand behind WARRANTY-- Very rarely have I had issue's with sellers warranty.After 2 months the temperature light stopped working. It did work atill I put another Thermometer in the tank and adjusted the correct temperature. A couple month's later I had to adjust again. I had to keep changing it  to bring up the 70 to 78 degrees temp. At 4 months I contacted the company about there 1 year warranty.  They did repond and I told them i appreciate that they responded.  First off they offered 50% coupon.They raised there price. Even at 50% I said I could find one cheaper last longer.  Now there respone send it in to repair.Wait what??It's winter and my tank would be without a heater. That just funny. I've already lost a snail. I live in the high desert so our temperature changes 115 to below 0. My house stays 62 to 80. Yes this heater needed to function for the changes.I bought a higher power for the size of the tank thinking this heater would be the best for my tank for the area.When I purchased this heater it had 5 stars.I hope I helped someone to stay away,because company 12 month warranty only works if you send it in.What a joke. Buyer BEWAREI paid for this heater with my own monies no one paid me.

source_doc: Pretty Good. The first time I started looking for something like this, I just gave up due to too many options.  Since I had the chance to try this, and I figured it met my first requirement of not being plastic, I was happy to give it a try.It fits the bill pretty nicely.  It saves a bit of room by getting some of the tiny stuff off the cabinet floor under my half bath sink, and then gets some of the larger bottles cleaned up and in one place as well.As I suspected, for every bit of space you gain, you also gain some complications - and I'm sure this is true for almost every device like this unless it was engineered specifically for your EXACT cabinet.For example, I like that it pulls out, but then I have to leave some space in front of it so it can do so.  And then I can't put anything too tall on the top because those things could hit the top of the door and stop it from pulling out all the way.  So it helps, but it's not making an astronomical difference under there.  I still like it.  I wouldn't bother with almost any of the plastic models.  At least this does NOT seem cheap or flimsy at all (anything cheap and flimsy trying to help you save space always makes more problems than they solve).

source_doc: great for walking, a bad back makes it harder to move. I use this daily while watching TV.  My other half uses it to keep moving on rainy or otherwise lazy days.  I love it.  The remote came with a cheap and possibly old battery - it died quick.  Replaced it with a new and expensive one and it is happy as a clam.  Invest in a good battery if you want it to work with only one button push. I have a bad back and I was hoping I could move it easily, but that was to much to expect of my back I think.  But, I can get it out of the way if I have to just not daily.  It folds easily though. When not in use, it stays in the living room, folded up and covered with a towel to discourage interested cats.  They think I purchased a very expensive cat bed, so that didn't work but the towel keeps the cat hair off it.  Someday I will make a cover that fits it and matches the rug.  I have not paired it with my phone and downloaded the app, I just bring it slowly up to my speed and walk as long as I can.
hypos: Skvělé na chození, špatná záda to ztěžují. Používám to každý den při sledování TV. Moje polovička to používá, aby se udržela v pohybu na deštivé nebo jinak lenivé dny. Miluji to. Dálkové ovládání přišlo s levnou a pravděpodobně starou baterií - rychle se vyčerpala. Vyměnil/a jsem ji za novou a drahou a je šťastné/šťastná jako blecha. Investujte do dobré baterie, pokud chcete, aby to fungovalo pouze jedním stisknutím tlačítka. Mám špatná záda a doufal/a jsem, že to budu moci snadno pohnout, ale to bylo příliš velké očekávání od mých zad, myslím. Ale mohu to dostat z cesty, pokud musím, jen ne každý den. Skládá se to ale snadno. Když se nepoužívá, zůstává to v obývacím pokoji, složené a zakryté ručníkem, aby to odradilo zvídavé kočky. Myslí si, že jsem koupil/a velmi drahý kočičí pelíšek, takže to nefungovalo, ale ručník udržuje kočičí chlupy daleko. Jednoho dne udělám povlak, který na to pasuje a ladí s kobercem. Ještě jsem to nespojil/a se svým telefonem a nestáhl/a aplikaci, prostě to pomalu přidávám ke své rychlosti a chodím, jak dlouho mohu.

source_doc: It’s awesome however.. The mic itself is awesome I use it for gaming and I have no issues with anyone hearing me or it sounding like I’m 100 miles away. It pics up every background noise there is even my washing machine four rooms away that I normally can’t hear. However it’s the best mic I have owned for gaming. The lights are amazing I love that you can change them and even turn them off, you can mute with ease everything about the mic is awesome. However idk what the hell was in the cord box and I honestly don’t even want to know what happened there I just used some alcohol wipes to get the cord out and clean it off before touching. I included pics and that was terrifying. Other then that the product is great and I have had no issues at all. I would buy it again but I would for sure open the cord box a little slower next time.
hypos: Je to úžasné, ale... Mikrofón sám o sobě je úžasný/á, používám ho na hraní her a nemám žádné problémy s tím, že by mě někdo neslyšel/a nebo to znělo, jako bych byl/a 100 mil daleko. source_doc: You need your own adhesive to use these. I knew these did not come with adhesive when ordering.  They are priced as such coming in roughly half the cost of self sticking versions.  Very fairly priced.  I figured the next time I go to Home Depot I’d pick up some adhesive.  I ordered these Jan 1.  It’s now Mar 1 and they are still on the floor in the corner of my drum room.  I’ve been to Home Depot five times (house project) since then and have forgotten every single time.  The two times remembered and planned on buying, by the time i was done shopping, i had been there so long I’d forgotten again.  I know i can order adhesive but i kind of wanted to see what my options were as first time buying such a product.Although I’d normally wait to write a review until I actually used the product, i thought I’d share my status with these for the guys out there that are forgetful like me, or procrastinators or whoever;  it might better to spend the money and get the self sticking kind just so you can get them hung and be done.  I’m hoping to get there, Hung and Done, soon.  Good luck

source_doc: very moisturizing, non greasy, little goes a long way. If it seems greasy, then you used too much. Comes down to preference. I find this lotion to be very hydrating yet not greasy. Feels good on dry parched winter skin. I massaged it into my hands and I liked how it seemed to absorb well. Dont need much to do the job. If it seems too greasy or heavy, then you used too much. Scale back. This is very rich, and takes very little to cover the hands.The scent is a tad off putting to me. I normally like both essential oils, but this is just "OK" to me. I think it is because it reminds more of a mans body wash. I dont need it to smell "female", I just prefer something else scent wise. It IS pleasant enough, and really comes down to personal preference.Salt and Stone has quality products at premium prices. I dont rate on price. I have no issue with the quality. source_doc: Excellent so far. The box came in good condition. There were not a whole lot of pieces to assemble. I put this together myself in about 30 minutes and only because I did not look at the directions as carefully as I should have. I always look at the pieces in the box compared to the directions of what is to be be sent in the box. What I didn’t notice was the fine print that said some of those pieces came pre-assembled. I scratched my head at some of the other directions, but if you think it through, it will make sense.This machine is smaller than a magnetic rower and the arm motions are like rowing on water as opposed to just pulling back and forth. I used it the first time last night after putting it together. I could only take the number 1 setting in the tension as I have gotten out of shape except for indoor biking. I ended up using my VR headset to play Holofit and lost track of the time. It ended up being about 40 minutes. Today, I am sore all over, but a good sore. This machine really works the arms, back, and legs. After a few months, if this machine is as good as it is now, I will give it 5 stars.

source_doc: They've screwed up! They changed the design and have ruined the cups! I have ordered MULTIPLE sets of these cups over the last 4 years for my grandbabies. I LOVED them!! They were well made,came in fun colors, and are made from recycled material here in the USA. What's not to love?! I recommended them to a dozen people. They loved them too. Well, fast forward to a month ago when my niece bought some from Target. She took them home and tried them out. She told my sister I was crazy for thinking they were so great. Hers leaked. Well, she had bought me 3 the same day...and they leaked too!! Some from the spout, some from the edge of the lid. I took an older one from the cabinet and compared them. Well, the continuous thread has been replaced with these weird tabs which apparently keep the cup from sealing properly. I am so sad such a great product has been ruined. I even tried ordering another set from Amazon in hopes it would be the old style. No such luck. Every single one of them leaked as well. I guess I will just have to guard my old ones with my life and never allow them to leave the house. I once would have told you to buy buy buy...now I say skip them. So disappointing.

source_doc: Works great, and exceptional customer service! I order a lot of things on Amazon, but I think that this is the best customer service that I have ever received. The package was missing some things, an easy accident. I contacted the seller. They responded very quickly, corrected the issue immediately, and were as nice and as generous as they could possibly be. Today I got the chance to put the unit to the test. I wanted to use it to sanitize bottles I use to store water I distill to use with some breathing devices. I had some waiting here to be cleaned, and I sanitized them and some other items according to the very easy directions. It is working like a champ! I totally recommend this sanitizer and this seller as highly as I possibly can!

source_doc: Don’t hold their shape. These diaper inserts are very nice when you take them out of the package. The material is soft and a really nice off-white color. I was thrilled to receive these because I took a chance buying them without reviews. I really thought these were going to be amazing, especially as my first hemp inserts (the rest of mine are bamboo). However, after the first wash these inserts just shriveled up and I cannot straighten them back out. Feels like they’re just going to rip if I tug on the sides. I attached a photo, from left to right - Nora’s Nursery (bamboo), these inserts (hemp, and super wrinkly), then Thirsties (hemp). I actually bought another pack of these right when I first received them because they seemed thick and amazing, but now I’ll be returning them. I can still use the ones I’ve already washed, but I double them with a bamboo insert to make sure the wavy edges don’t bother baby. The wavy edges are also pretty rigid and not ideal. I’m a little disappointed, I really thought these were a hidden gem.

source_doc: A Most Excellent Mouse. The M913 is an excellent office and gaming mouse.  I have been a Razer user for years.  I was having problems gripping my mouse due to injuries to both hands and wrist so I went on Amazon to find a new mouse that wasn't over $100.  I came across the M913 and found the features perfect for me and I bought it and the gaming pad.A week after I had been using it I was misusing the software (I forgot to turn the mouse on) and was trying to turn it on thru the software.  Strictly a user error.  I contacted the company thru their website by filling out the form.  Since it was late Sunday night and it was one of those fill out the form and hope for the best I did not expect an answer for several days.  I was surprised and very happy when a tech support person sent me an e-mail with the easy fix.  My mouse was fixed in less than 10 minutes!  I am now a dye hard fan of Red Dragon perifels.  Thank you Red Dragon for a superior product.

source_doc: Keyboard is too tall? Never thought I would have this complaint about a keyboard, but this thing is way too tall. I have had a Corsair K70 for the past 10 years and I am at a point of needing to replace it. Thought I would give this one a try and see if I liked the optical linear switches which I do really like.The problem is the actual height of the keyboard itself. It sits at least twice the height of my old mechanical keyboard. I tried adjusting my chair but found that it was a big enough difference between my mouse and keyboard that my armrests had to sit at two separate heights. Doing this hurts my shoulder and ruins my posture, but if I keep my armrests even like I would normally my wrist is bent just enough to cause pain.If you really cannot live without this keyboard for whatever reason, I would recommend raising your mousepad to match the height of the keyboard. I am tempted to do that just to keep this keyboard, but this is just dumb design in my opinion.

source_doc: This is my second purchase of these. I originally purchased this belt when I had an iphone 8+ back in 2018.  I used it every other day when I ran.  I constantly pulled my iphone out of the belt 2 - 3 times a run (for pictures).  When I purchased an iphone 13 pro max I was happily surprised that it still fit in my old belt.  The belt fit me fine (I wear size 8 women's pants) and never "bounced" during the time I used it (although from time to time I did have to tighten it a bit as it sometimes came loose).Finally after many years of service, the zipper broke in December 2022.  I purchased a replacement and the quality is still as good as the original.  Not planning to upgrade my iphone any time soon, but I hope this still works in future.I highly recommend this product for those who don't like to carry their phones in their pockets when running.

source_doc: Tire marks..avoid this sealer! I purchased with high hopes based on excellent reviews...sadly I've had nothing but issues since I sprayed it on my paver driveway. I applied the product as per the instructional video and after waiting 48 hours, I parked on the driveway. Over the past several weeks I've accumulated over 20 tire marks on my once clean driveway. I tried to scrub off with soap and water, but it made little difference. I contacted the manufacturer and they told me that the tire marks must have been on the driveway before sealing (definitely not the case) and after submitting several photos they sent me a .pdf explaining how black tire marks will happen with this time of "film forming sealer." Their recommendation was to soap/scrub and then pressure wash the marks off. I sealed my driveway so I wouldn't have to scrub it and pressure wash it frequently...but this low rate sealer all but guarantees I will have to repeatedly power wash on a regular basis to get rid of the tire marks that keep appearing. If I had a time machine I would go back and warn myself not to put this sealer on my driveway no matter how good the reviews were. Avoid this product for your driveway unless you enjoy frequent cleaning and the depressing feeling that you just paid nearly $300 for a product that will make your driveway more of a headache to keep clean. Zero stars if I could!

source_doc: What a relief! I didn’t know that such a device existed, however, I will now share my new discovery with friends! For many years I found myself constantly readjusting my seatbelt while driving. I added a pad to the belt hoping it would project my neck from the rubbing seatbelt. It only reduced my discomfort slightly.This product appeared as I was looking for something to help me install a dog booster seat in my car. It was a spontaneous purchase. While I’ve only used the device for two days, I am pleasantly surprised by the comfort it provides. The seatbelt now feels like a good, personalized fit for me and my atypical body.I marked down the “ease of use” because I am still trying to figure out how to keep the device on the seatbelt when I leave the car. The belt doesn’t fully retract when I leave the device on the belt. My hunch is that I need to develop a new habit of consciously tucking the belt beside the seat as I’m leaving the car so I don’t shut the door on the belt.My biggest regret is that I didn’t discover this device years ago when I was doing more cross-country road trips!

source_doc: I love the storage! I have a little chiweenie so these are very necessary for him to be able to get on and off the bed by himself. I have tried another style of these type of stairs and this style is a lot better. The other style wasn't as sturdy and they weren't all connected to each other. I like this design how they completely detach from each other. It makes traveling with them or storing them a lot easier. I like the soft material on these. It seems better for my dog too, that way he doesn't slip as easily. What's really nice about these too is the storage you get. I like to put his treats, shampoos or any other supplies I use for my dog in here. The reason I only gave it four stars is because of the velcro design that is used for the lid. One of the stairs has the velcro coming off already. Also, I have to make sure to push on the velcro to secure it and even then it seems like one side isn't secured. It's held up though for now but I'm not sure how long it will last. I'm sure at that point I can figure out a way to fix it though. Other than that these are great and I would definitely recommend them to anyone with small dogs. They have made my life a lot easier.

source_doc: Serious Stomach/Gas Issues. I purchased my bulk unflavored canister directly from the Armra website about 4 weeks ago. I took it once a day for a week and then twice a day (morning and night). The main positive effect I had was that I slept more soundly through the night and my Fitbit recorded more deep sleep and REM sleep.  I agree with the commenters who find the taste of the unflavored product similar to powdered milk - I thought it was fine.  I was pleased enough with the sleep improvements to want to continue using the product, but I developed serious stomach pain and gas issues on my left side in the area of the pancreas. The pain was severe enough across several days to consider going to the doctor but I finally remembered I had started this new product and I stopped taking it during week 3. Fortunately the pain and gas eased within 24 hours and was gone in 3 days. I rarely react to foods and supplements so this was unexpected. I checked the ratings here and see a small but notable group of users reporting similar gastrointestinal issues. I don’t know why some of us have such a significant reaction but it is something to be aware of.
hypos: Závažné problémy se žaludkem/plyny. Koupil/a jsem si svůj bulk neochucený prášek přímo z webových stránek Armra asi před 4 týdny. Bral/a jsem ho jednou denně po dobu jednoho týdne a poté dvakrát denně (ráno a večer). Hlavní pozitivní efekt, který jsem měl/a, byl, že jsem lépe spal/a celou noc a můj Fitbit zaznamenal/a více hlubokého spánku a REM spánku. Souhlasím s komentujícími, kteří považují chuť neochuceného produktu za podobnou práškovému mléku - myslím, že to bylo v pořádku. Byl/a jsem dost spokojen/á se zlepšením spánku, abych chtěl/a pokračovat v používání produktu, ale vyvinuly se mi vážné bolesti žaludku a plynatost na levé straně v oblasti slinivky. Bolest byla tak silná, že jsem několik dní zvažoval/a, že půjdu k lékaři, ale nakonec jsem si vzpomněl/a, že jsem začal/a používat tento nový produkt, a přestal/a jsem ho brát během třetího týdne. Naštěstí bolest a plynatost ustoupily do 24 hodin a během 3 dnů pominuly. Zřídka reaguji na potraviny a doplňky, takže to bylo nečekané. Zkontroloval/a jsem hodnocení tady a vidím malou, ale významnou skupinu uživatelů hlásících podobné gastrointestinální problémy. Nevím, proč někteří z nás mají tak významnou reakci, ale je to něco, na co je dobré si dávat pozor.

source_doc: Works very well. Works very well to track steps, calories, distance and work outs. Data is accurate and battery life is excellent. I wear it 24 hours and the sleep data has been very helpful. I also use the smart wake feature so an alarm doesn't wake my partner since I get up a couple hours before him. The smart wake sends vibrations which buzz the arm. It works surprisingly well. Even though there is a water lock to allow user to wear in shower or swimming, I have not tried it yet, but plan to. The sensors on the sides are easy to use for the EDA scan and heart rhythm scan. I would prefer to have the apps in a different order but that is just a personal thing. The only other issue I have had is the phone app occasionally acts up and won't allow me to sync data. It self resolves but can be annoying. I chalk it up to consequence of having so much tech these days.  I am glad I chose the 5 over the 4 version for the built in GPS & water lock capabilities. I also recommend getting the fitbit premium account if you are serious about getting your health better. It has additional insights and data analyses that you won't have access to without it. Overall extremely happy with the Fitbit 5 and I do recommend it.

source_doc: Great mic. I'm kind of new to the podcasthing thing and at first I was disappointed with the sound quality. It was only as good as the $5 desktop mic I replaced. Then I figured out that I had to speak directly into the mic rather than just having it to the side of me on my desk. If I speak directly into the mic the sound quality is amazing. I was really hoping not to have to move the mic directly in front of me each time I recorded, so I started looking for some type of arm that I could connect above me so I could just bring it in when I needed it but I can't seem to find any clamp that fits the mic since it's so wide. Even the ones that say they work with "blue yet" are too small. I've tried two already; neither fits. Other than that, I love the mic.

source_doc: Great pillow for neck pain. I wasn't sure about buying this pillow mostly because I am not a back sleeper. And while I don't think it has made any difference with my snoring, I do love this pillow. I always thought I loved feather pillows, but after getting this I realized it was because I could bunch them up to be high or low where I wanted. But they don't stay that way... I like this pillow because it is firm but not overly firm and there are various heights. So while I'm on my side, I sleep on one section but if I roll more to my stomach, I can move my head to a different section. And, surprisingly, I do actually enjoy relaxing on my back with my head cradled before I go to sleep. I still don't sleep that way but it's very comfortable to initially wind down

source_doc: Cover about 28 vents, and about its efficiency I will tell more when I know. I recently moved into an apartment complex that was supposed to be pest free and smoke free… Couple of days after moving in we started smelling a lot of cigarettes smoke and weed as well. We first thought it was coming from the door or windows, since people would go to the balconies to smoke, but nope… we learned that our next door neighbor smokes inside and the smoke smell comes from all the ac vents and the bathroom vent when the AC is not running. I got this “filter” to cover the AC vents. I sprayed the filter with odor ban to see if it helps. I will let you guys know more about its efficiency after couple of days.I decided to cover the vents from the inside, so I could still redirect the vent from the outside, and because of that I used a lot of the fabric. I live in a 1 bedroom apartment, so I only have 3 ac vents to cover. source_doc: Thin and lightweight. I first started sleeping on a memory foam pillow some 20+ years ago. It radically changed the way I sleep. Though I fell asleep on my side, I always woke on my back. It was so much more comfortable for me that I won't use anything else. I got this pillow so I would have a spare. I was a bit taken aback by how small, thin, and lightweight it is compared to standard bed pillows. Even so, it is pristine, with a very nice quilted zippered case that can be removed for cleaning. It is firmer than the pillow I am used t, and I had my doubts that I would like it. But I slept on it last night and it was great! It will take a few more nights to determine if this is my new pillow of choice, but at the very least it will be a close second and will certainly be the one I take along when traveling!

source_doc: Not just for toys! I saw this over the door hanger for kids toys, and I immediately thought that it would be great for my craft room! source_doc: Won't connect to Razer Synapse. I bought this to upgrade from my old Diamondback.I have never had any issue connecting peripherals from any other company other than Razer and this mouse is no different. I went through the processes outlined on their website to have Synapse recognize this mouse but it didn't find it. Take note, I also have an old Diamondback and Firefly already installed. During the 'repair' process, it prompted me to search for the synapse.msi file but couldn't find it saying the file doesn't exist. The folder it was pointing to exists but that msi file is no where on my system so even though I updated my synapse application a week or two ago, I tried it again but no updates were available.This isn't rocket science. This shouldn't be that difficult. I have 'gaming' peripherals from numerous other companies and never, not once did I ever have an issue connecting one of their devices. They are recognized immediately upon connection but not with Razer. Razer forces me to jump through all these hoops and it still doesn't work. So, I no longer spend hours upon hours trying to get their products to work. If they don't within five or ten minutes of troubleshooting it's being sent back. I should have remembered when I tried to connect one of their headphones and had the same issue. I remember even uninstalling the application back then and reinstalling it and it still didn't connect.

source_doc: Love the ladder hardware, screws are horrid. Love the hardware, the screws are worthless.  I used oak sides and rockler steps.  (Saved enough on the rolling hardware I decided to splurge on the steps).Be careful planning the alignment of the top rail as the wheels only clear the mounts at the operational angle.I read how bad the screws were bug figured I could be careful.  They're horrible.  I predrilled, new bit, gently installed, and the heads still stripped.  I complained and was sent smaller screws.  I ended up replacing them with others from Amazon.  Pain in the neck because I had to use an easy out on 3.The wheels and rail are fairly straightforward to install.  I built my ladder, then put it up to figure out where to screw the top in.  The hardware seems fairly well made.  I did have trouble putting the caps on the rails and between the rails, the o-rings wanted to tear themselves up the fit was so tight.  That was annoying and I replaced one, but I ended up deciding they weren't that important and didn't worry if the others tore.Would have preferred that the bottom locks, but the ladder rolls smoothly and I'm really happy with it.I replaced the screws with:https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B00GI8BVKG/ref=ppx_yo_dt_b_asin_title_o03_s00

source_doc: Easy to use, feels professional. I must admit I was skeptical about buying this because of it's price! I wanted this model because cortado is one of the presets, and I had red good reviews about the milk recipes.My previous machine is a Nespresso latissima plus, which I still think it makes decent coffee, and maybe more coffee crema that I have been able to get with this Gaggia.Can I go back to nesspreso... No way!I like how this machine looks professional, my guests enjoy selecting a coffee from the display, so it has become an entertaining device.Coffee quality is good, but I'm learning that very dependent on the coffee beans I get. So many options to try now.. I like that!A more manual espresso machine may give you better taste or more crema...... Maybe.. I do not know and I do not plan to find out, manual is just too much work! I think this is a great combination of quality and ease of use.I'm saying goodbye to nesspreso.
hypos: Snadno se používá, vypadá profesionálně. Musím přiznat, že jsem byl/a skeptický/á ohledně koupě tohoto výrobku kvůli jeho ceně! Chtěl/a jsem tento model, protože cortado je jedním z přednastavení a měl/a jsem dobré recenze na recepty s mlékem. Moje předchozí káva je Nespresso Latissima Plus, která podle mě stále dělá slušnou kávu, a možná více kávové cremy, než jsem dokázal/a získat s touto Gaggií. Můžu se vrátit k Nespresso... Ani náhodou! Líbí se mi, jak tento stroj vypadá profesionálně, moji hosté si rádi vybírají kávu z displeje, takže se stal zábavným zařízením. Kvalita kávy je dobrá, ale učím se, že je velmi závislá na kávových zrnech, která dostávám. Tolik možností vyzkoušet teď... To se mi líbí! Myslím, že je to skvělá kombinace kvality a snadnosti použití. Loučím se s Nespresso.

source_doc: FINALLY a diffuser I love. I've wanted this particular diffuser for years now, I'm so glad I finally got it. I love it. My only complaint is that once my wife sees it, she'll want it too.

source_doc: In anticipation of using, I'm going to say it's right up there with Hydroflask. My family owns too many water bottles and most of them are hydroflasks. We've got a few eco vessels and a few generic throw around ones. But I wanted to be different so that I would know it's mine... My wife might try and claim it as hers like she did with another hydroflask bottle I bought.I really like the size and the wide mouth opening and the chug cap. The wide mouth when you have the chug cap off makes it super easy to fill with ice and drink. It's wider than the hydroflask wide mouth bottles. The chug cap is really easy to take off. It has a grippy edge to it.Having had the handle cap for the hydroflasks, I think I can honestly say I like the yeti design better. A solid shape as opposed to having it swivel. I prefer the solid shape.Even though I haven't used it yet I have no doubt that it will perform as well with hot and cold as the hydroflask bottles. I plan on using this for travel and of course those hot summer days on the golf course.The picture doesn't do the color justice. It looks better than the picture. I'd definitely get another so I can have 2 in a rotation... Just a different color.

source_doc: Comfy, cushy seat! We just got a stationary bike and it came with one of those skinny bike seats you use on cycling bicycles. It was so uncomfortable that I decided we needed a different seat so I came on Amazon, like I always do, and searched for one. When I came across this one I loved how it looked so I clicked it and read all about it. Even the reviews were mostly positive, and I see why. When we got the seat we put it on our stationary bike, as soon as I got on the bike I knew we made the right choice! It’s so soft and very cushy, it’s such a huge difference from the original seat! I can’t say anything about the durability quite yet since we just got it, but it feels very sturdy to me and seems to be very well made. I’m very happy with it and I definitely recommend this seat to anyone who needs a comfy bike seat.

source_doc: Advantage 2 For some reason my indoor cats keep getting plagued with fleas (my BFF thinks it's from the vet). I ordered Advantage 2 for my socialized cats and for my ferals I ordered an oral medication. Once I put the Advantage 2 on my adults, shortly afterwards I started noticing that one of my cats started scratching alot less. He seemed to be the one most plagued anyway. I read from another reviewer that it will take a while to break the cycle. In the meanwhile make sure all laundry is done, floors are cleaned, etc. I don't have rugs, so that's a plus. I use blue Dawn to mop my floors (it kills the fleas on contact). I just recently bought RAID for fleas too. Seems that it kills fleas on contact according to another reviewer (I agree. No sooner I sprayed the RAID I noticed that the fleas stopped biting.) Will be spraying all surfaces that I can't wash. It surely pays to read other reviews!! You learn alot from it. I don't buy anything unless it's a 4.5 stars review or better.UPDATE: 2 weeks later and I see my cats scratching again. I'm disappointed 😞.

source_doc: Works well on my very fine, thin, and fragile hair. Not a mist... I love TRESemmé products, and this TRESemmé One Step 5-in-1 Volumizing Hair Styling Mist it's no different, other than one thing. It is definitely not a mist, and cannot be sprayed directly on the hair evenly. I spray it into one hand, rub my hands together, and then apply it to my hair, starting at the root area. I don't have a lot of hair, so it works well for my fine, thin, fragile, and rather curly hair.Whenever I go out, I wear wigs, but I still want my natural hair to look halfway decent at home. Not only does it work well on my natural hair it also helps to keep my wigs in place. For what little natural hair I have, it doesn't take much to do the job. If I blow dry it, it gives it quite a bit of volume, but most of the time I let it air dry. It starts out a little crunchy, but once I finger comb it out, it has more volume and looks much thicker.I wish the product sprayed out in a mist as its name suggests, but I still like it for my natural hair, and for my wigs, as well. For those reasons, I would definitely recommend it!
hypos: Skvěle funguje na mé velmi jemné, tenké a křehké vlasy. Není to sprej... Miluji produkty TRESemmé a tento TRESemmé One Step 5-in-1 Volumizing Hair Styling Mist není výjimkou, kromě jedné věci. Určitě to není sprej a nemůže být rovnoměrně nastříkán přímo na vlasy. Nastříkám si to do jedné ruky, třu ruce k sobě a pak to aplikuji na své vlasy, začínám u kořínků. Nemám moc vlasů, takže to skvěle funguje na mé jemné, tenké, křehké a poněkud kudrnaté vlasy. Když jdu ven, nosím paruky, ale i tak chci, aby moje přirozené vlasy vypadaly doma alespoň trochu slušně. Nejen, že to skvěle funguje na mé přirozené vlasy, ale také to pomáhá udržet mé paruky na místě. Na to, kolik přirozených vlasů mám, to na práci tolik není potřeba. Když si je fénuji, dodá to docela dost objemu, ale většinou je nechávám schnout na vzduchu. Na začátku jsou trochu křupavé, ale jakmile je pročešu prsty, mají více objemu a vypadají mnohem hustší. Přeji si, aby se produkt stříkal jako jemná mlha, jak jeho název naznačuje, ale i tak se mi líbí na mých přirozených vlasech a také na mých parukách. Z těchto důvodů bych to určitě doporučil/a!

source_doc: I wish I had gotten the larger one. I'm a bigger girl and this smaller one...well, I was able to get into it, but it wasn't exactly the most comfortable fit for me.  Also, I had to make sure that I could get up out of this little soaking bath.  I used a telescoping seat so that my feet, knees and hips could lift me up without me feeling like I might slip or fall on the water-slick bottom.  I got this as a possible camping bath and it may work.  I'll have to try it out in the field - use it like a stand up shower.  My feet stay clean as I have a rubber mat that I can put down next to this shower tub.  Camping is fun except when you have to go to bed all sweaty from hiking or just being out on the lake on a hot day.  Having a shower available makes my camping experience more enjoyable and I'm hoping this tub will work well - I think it will!

Použil/a jsem teleskopické sedátko, abych se mohla zvednout, aniž bych měla pocit, že sklouznu nebo spadnu na kluzké dno. Dostal/a jsem to jako možnou kempovací vanu a snad to bude fungovat. Musím to vyzkoušet venku - použít to jako sprchu ve stoje. Moje nohy zůstávají čisté, protože mám gumovou podložku, kterou si mohu položit vedle této sprchové vany. Kempování je zábavné, pokud se nemusíte cítit zpoceně z túry nebo když jste na jezeře v horkém dni. Mít k dispozici sprchu činí můj kempovací zážitek mnohem příjemnější a doufám, že tato vana bude fungovat skvěle - myslím, že ano!

source_doc: Good for kids (and very good for adults ears) These are very, very light weight. I was desperately looking for foam mallets because they just sound nicer on steel tongue drums and mid class vibraphones. I bought these, not caring that they looked like a lollypop( probably not a good thing because it may entice little ones to chew on it) So I gave them a try and even though the foam was the density that I was hoping for, the handles are so light that I can’t get the sound I want, without whacking really hard,,,,and then all you hear is the thudding and no music. I thought the handle might be hollow and I that I could somehow add some weight but the ends are sealed ( I may chop it off & see if I can add weight and then sand the ends, so they’re smooth. Hmmm….may have to update later.Pros: For parents, whose so called friends, have gotten the kiddies a xylophone, this may save your sanity…Even though the munchkins may bang away, at that thing,,,the sound will not pierce a hole in your eardrum & make you long for their 18th birthday..lol

source_doc: Use force and don’t touch with skin when applying adhesive pads. I applied mine to wood paneling and some kind of dropped ceiling material as well as drywall. These were all freshly pained with an eggshell finish.The part that may help you- Given other reviews I was aware of adhesion problems so I made sure not to touch them with my skin AT ALL. I removed the pad from the sheet with tweezers (leaving the backing on the one side) and placed it on the fattest part of the butterfly body where the magnet is. I then pressed it on hard using my fingers, thumb on the pad and the rest on the other side of the body. And I do mean hard. After doing them all my fingers really hurt. After this I then removed the paper backing and applied them to the surface and pressed HARD repeatedly. A few of them I heard a crack because I pressed so hard but not sure where I cracked as it wasn’t visible.I have had 3 fall. One after 2 days, another after a week, and then another 3 weeks later. I put each of these back up using superglue.Other than that, haven’t had any problems. I believe that using force and avoiding getting skin oils on them was helpful.

Věřím, že použití síly a vyhnutí se kontaktu s oleji z pleti bylo užitečné.

source_doc: Love it! My old knob had been slipping on my genuine leather Wheel Skins cover, even though I used the optional rubber strips. I replaced this cover with a wonderfully plush, inexpensive leather-like cover. The ad for the XL spinner urged me to measure before I ordered. Out of laziness, I did not, and I had to return the regular-size knob for an XL. Installation was a bit of a hassle because the supplied small L-shaped Allen wrench had to be used upside down and out of sight. I wished I had a tool like a screwdriver handle with an Allen wrench attached. I think I did the final tightening by attaching the Allen wrench to a vice grip. I am male, but I have never been as strong as some. I love the XL knob! It operates so smoothly, like a precision instrument with ball bearings. The large, flat head provides secure, excellent control. It does NOT slip, and I wouldn't hesitate to bet it never will. This product is the cat's pajamas!

source_doc: Surprisingly discouraged. I am disappointed. Ohora has the most incredible selection of colors… So I am bummed to discover such poor quality. I have tried many semi cured gel strip brands. I’ve been wearing them for a year consistently. I change my sets every two weeks, usually because I just want to change my manicure, very rarely do I have any shipping or peeling. With this brand I find they crack and ship far more quickly than any other. This set has already had two nails that chipped so I took them off & replaced. Now I have three more chipped nails.  I think I’m just going to give up and take them completely off.  I have other Ohora sets in my drawer that I won’t let go to waste but unless I’m pleasantly surprised by the others I try in the future, I would not recommend this brand again.  So sad bc the color options are for sure the best I’ve found.

source_doc: Just what I need. I have just gotten it all set up in our bedroom, so haven’t had a chance to really see how it is in the long run, but I am hopeful. Use special water (not just distilled), and fill this other hole with whatever-the-hell (more special c**p) and be sure to run this, flip that, push this and dance around it in goatskin chaps in hopes of getting humidity.I have very high hopes for my dry, scratchy eyes, mouth so dry my tongue has to be peeled from the roof of my mouth, cracked lips, dry skin, and itchy face and hands. source_doc: Genuinely Emotional. I can't even begin to describe the wonderful feeling I got when I first used this serum &... Zero Contact Dermatitis!!! None, not even a single red mark. I almost cried! I was SO nervous...I spent months in hell before I figured out I was allergic to synthetic ascorbic acid... I was exhausted, my life was a mess & I had no idea what was causing it or how many products I owned that contained it (topical AND consumable) or were cross contaminated with it (Curology, my Electrolyte Powder, my Vitamins... I was heartbroken)! Ever since discovering my allergy, I've felt like I was on the same exact skincare odyssey I went through in my mid 20's only worse. It's been stressful & filled with a lot of disappointment plus wasted money.But to find THIS product.... Who was the BEAUTIFUL human that thought of this? Bless you!!! There aren't ENOUGH hypoallergenic options in general, but let me tell you... There are almost NO hypoallergenic Vitamin C products!!! They are RARE... & This is one of them. If you're allergic to synthetic ascorbic acid like I am, buy this. Your skin will thank you & you'll feel the deep sense of gratitude that SOMEONE out there cared enough about us.

source_doc: Teachers, this is a game changer for your students. I am a professional cellist and teacher. I had the mother of my 6 year old student order this for our little cellist. I have not been impressed with other products in the past, but this looked like it was worth a shot. It's much easier to assemble and lighter than a similar animal themed product- hint, hint. Despite the bulk, it was comfortable in my hand and in her tiny hand. You can pop it on and off with ease. I will never use the beginner thumb on the ferrule bow hold again. I will forever start my students with this gadget. In her 30 minute lesson she graduated to a "real" bow hold with and without the grip aid. I could see the instant change from her fingers to her elbow and shoulder positioning. Hallelujah!! I am ordering one or two for my studio. I think it will be a wonderful aid for my experienced students struggling with bad habits they developed before getting into private lessons. If I was still teaching orchestra in the public schools I would purchase a classroom set. I will definitely be recommending this to my Youth Orchestra cellists.
hypos: Učitelé/učitelky, tohle je průlomové pro vaše studenty/studentky. Jsem profesionální violoncellista/violoncellistka a učitel/učitelka. Mama mého 6letého/6leté studenta/studentky si to objednala pro našeho/náš malého/malou violoncellistu/violoncellistku. Nebyl/a jsem v minulosti ohromen/a jinými produkty, ale tohle vypadalo jako něco, co stojí za zkoušku. Je to mnohem snadněji sestavitelné a lehčí než podobný produkt s tematikou zvířat - nápověda, nápověda. I přes objem to bylo pohodlné v mé ruce a v její drobné ruce. Můžete to snadno nasadit a sundat. Nikdy znovu nebudu používat začátečnický palec na držení luku s ferrulem. Navždy začnu své studenty/studentky tímto gadgetem. Během její 30minutové lekce přešla na "skutečné" držení luku s a bez pomůcky na úchop. Mohl/a jsem vidět okamžitou změnu od jejích/jeho prstů k jejímu/jeho lokti a ramenu. Haleluja!! Objednávám jeden nebo dva pro svou školu. Myslím, že to bude skvělá pomůcka pro mé zkušené studenty/studentky, kteří/ které bojují se špatnými návyky, které vyvinuli/y před začátkem soukromých lekcí. source_doc: You get what you pay 4 I'm just getting back into playing the cello after many years, so when I committed to lessons at the beginning of the year I had to move quickly to find an instrument. I found what appeared to be a good beginner cello for a great price. The instrument arrived the next day and was packaged immaculately. However the good stoped there. On first inspection everything seemed normal as I set up the bridge. However, as I started to tune the cello I noticed the tuning pegs would very easily slip out of place. Then I noticed the fine tuners for the D string on the tail piece was bent. I disassemble the bridge and strings to correct it and it just popped backed into the wrong place again. When I took my cello to my first lesson my instructor immediately noticed several things off about the instrument. The nut and bridge were too high, making the strings sit up too far away from the finger board. These physical issues made it very difficult and next to impossible to play. Save your money and go to a licensed string instrument seller. It might me a little more pricey but at least you'll get a quality instrument. I know I did.

source_doc: Do not waste your money. I had high hopes for these pads & was impressed by looking at them when they arrived. They are a great size & cover a lot of area. They are nice & thick & seem to be of a much better quality over thin pads I’ve gotten previously. Unfortunately that’s where the good part ends. They work horribly. I have a senior dog who is incontinent so I use these where she lays. She wears diapers but has leaks. I was hoping to have an added layer of protection by using these pads. I tested them by pouring a small glass of water on them & waiting a few minutes. The floor under the pad was wet. Not damp, but wet. I felt the top where the pad would have contact with the person or pet’s skin & it was also sopping wet. I double checked to make sure I had the correct side up and it was laid down properly. These pads are no different than laying down a towel. Very disappointing. I’m wondering if all these great reviews were done prior to actually using them. If I had rated on initial looks alone without testing; I would have given this an excellent review. Because of their thickness if you have to double them up for them to work, it is going to be uncomfortable to lay on. I wanted to love these but they were a complete disappointment.

source_doc: Okay cheap grinder. I've been getting into whole bean coffee here recently and I wanted something that I could fine-tune better than an electric grinder so I got this.  It came packaged just fine and I didn't see any defects or dings on the grinder.  It is basically 3 main pieces the handle which has a plastic knob, the grinder which has all the guts, and the collection bin which catches your grounds.  I got a whole bean that I hadn't tried before and loaded it up and got to grinding.  The grinding while okay didn't feel that great and I had to put a bit more muscle behind it than I had to for my other grinder.  Cleaning it was a breeze, it says not to get it wet so I took it most way apart (I left the grinder guts in) and took my electronic duster, and just blew it out.  For how cheap this is it does its job well I'll probably take this one with me when I go on trips because if it gets lost or broken eh no big deal, but if you want one for home I would spend a couple of bucks more.

source_doc: Neutral Lip Mask. I was kind of confused when I saw this product.  I am aware of and have been using facial masks. For lips, we have lip balms. Is this a facial mask or a lip balm? The product comes in plastic with two sets of lip masks. Each lip mask is on its separate small carton box. One of the things I noticed is that the product has no safety seal. Neither the box nor the tube is sealed. Please see the photo I posted.  The instructions provided are in Korean and English.I squeeze it and applied it to my lips. I did not notice any fragrance or after-taste. I did not feel any weird sensations. It is not oily nor greasy, unlike the two products I currently use. Please see the photo for comparison. I felt a little sealing effect almost similar to when you apply a mask on your face. I kept thinking that this maybe is sealing the lip moisture. So far so good. I need more time to see how this will improve my lips. I will update and report the result here. For now, I will apply this before bedtime and will keep using my current lip balm during the day.

source_doc: It worked! I wish I had taken pics for you. It is Feb 3, 2023. This Folex arrived an hour ago. I have brand new very light variegated beige, almost white carpet. I have a white Boxer, house broke and tidy but sheds so I vacuum constantly. After Christmas dinner, I found DARK brown spots where my 14 yr old grandson had sat to open presents. Everyone removes shoes at the door. I put my nose in the spots. No smell.  I cleaned with my Hoover steam carpet cleaner. Nada. I ordered the famous other pet stain remover and truthfully, pitched it!  I am a 68 yr old farm woman. I have dealt with all kinds of stains in my life! :)This Folex arrived, I took a microfiber cloth and attacked!  It worked famously enough to make me write this review!  Last Fall, I was hospitalized. While gone, my Boxer got left inside too long and had a urine accident back on new mint green bedroom carpet.  Folex removed the remaining shadow of that stain!I am totally pleased.  Cannot recommend strongly enough.  Take my years of ag experience with dirt, grease, grime, animals, & kids and waste your money elsewhere. :)
hypos: Fungovalo to! Přál/a bych si, abych vám udělal/a fotografie. Je 3. února 2023. Tento Folex dorazil před hodinou. Mám zbrusu nový velmi světlý mramorovaný béžový, téměř bílý koberec. Mám bílého boxera, naučeného na domácnost a úhledného, ale línajícího, takže neustále vysávám. Po vánoční večeři jsem našel/a TMAVÉ hnědé skvrny, kde seděl můj 14letý vnuk, aby rozbalil dárky. Všichni si na dveřích sundavají boty. Dal/a jsem nos do těch skvrn. Žádný zápach. Čistil/a jsem s mým parním čističem koberců Hoover. Nic. Objednal/a jsem slavný jiný odstraňovač skvrn od zvířat a upřímně, vyhodil/a jsem ho! Jsem 68letá farmářka. V životě jsem se vypořádal/a se všemi druhy skvrn! :) Tento Folex dorazil, vzal/a jsem si mikrovláknovou utěrku a zaútočil/a! Fungovalo to skvěle, abych napsal/a tuto recenzi! Minulé podzim jsem byl/a hospitalizován/a. Když jsem byl/a pryč, můj boxer zůstal uvnitř příliš dlouho a měl močení na novém mátovém zeleném koberci v ložnici. Folex odstranil zbytkový stín té skvrny! Jsem naprosto spokojen/a. Nemohu jej doporučit dostatečně. vezměte si mé roky zkušeností s blátem, tukem, špínou, zvířaty a dětmi a nevyhazujte své peníze jinam. :)

source_doc: i waited a little while to see how they would stand up - good. I used these spikes a little differently than most as I wanted to use them to string power up into a light and get it high in the air so I could use my ride on lawn mover underneath.  They assembled very easily and are sturdy and weighty.  I'm 6ft tall and even with my hand in the air as high as it could go i was several inches down from the top so they really are very tall and kids wouldn't come anywhere near to the top.I put it in the ground and in the two months or so since I put them up they haven't moved an inch.  they still look great with no signs of rust or any defect.  I think these are a great item for stringing lights and cables and work really well.  I would say it obviously helps if you have solid ground to put them in and I also liked that it came with retention straps so you could secure it to a fence or post.  I didn't need then for my application and they are just freestanding.  but like I said, very good product and well made.
hypos: Čekal/a jsem chvilku, abych viděl/a, jak se postaví - dobře. Použil/a jsem tyto hroty trochu jinak než většina, protože jsem je chtěl/a použít k rozvěšení světel a dostat je vysoko do vzduchu, abych mohl/a použít svou sekačku na trávu pod nimi. source_doc: In love! I really love this bag! I needed something smaller, but still with a good amount of storage. I got the red, and it does unfortunately show oil/water stains very easily. I might be brave enough to try washing it eventually, if the staining becomes super obvious. But I love the four pockets around the sides. When I change and need to stash my phone or work badge, they come in so handy! The shoe pocket is perfect for my size 7-8 shoes. The strap is the perfect length and keeps the bag right where I need it, but still allows me to carry it in the crook of my arm too. Highly recommend! I got the medium because I don't need a ton of room. Just enough for a change of clothes. I will say I do have to cram my work clothes in there if I wear a bulky sweater. So if you need more room get the large!

source_doc: Good for quick cleaning. This electric spinning scrubber is really good for quick cleanings. I'm not a fan of cleaning the tub and this helps to move things along. It's a good quality handle with various types of brush heads. Right out of the box I could use it because it was charged which I like. I put the large brush head on to tackle the tub and turned it on...well hold on because I wasn't ready for the brush to take off once it made contact. It's spinning so it kind of spun right along on it's own, I had to get used to it to hold the brush down to clean the area I wanted. The main thing is you have to hold it at the right angle for the brush to make solid contact because the tip of the handle where you attach the heads is at an angle. With the attachment I have been using it's a little difficult to keep it in full contact so I feel like I am missing areas while I'm cleaning. That's why I say it's good for quick cleaning, not necessarily a thorough cleaning. The power also lasted awhile for me, I've used it about 4 times and it still has a charge. I like having this tool but at $75 the price is high in my opinion.

source_doc: A simple lamp that brings beauty! Since receiving & writing my original review of the defective lamp I received the seller contacted me & offered a replacement. This lamp fully functioned! My picture reflects its beauty! The lamp is easy to put together. Instructions come with it. First you put the lightbulb in & then you tighten the top on. The cord has a flip switch on it. The cord is of a generous length. I have a warm low voltage lightbulb in the lamp as you see. I’m happy I was given a chance to appreciate this lamp’s beauty. For the price it is of quality. I now do recommend!My original review: I was looking forward to using this lamp for the top of my desk. With excellent reviews I thought I found a gem. Unfortunately upon placing a lightbulb in it it wouldn’t turn on. I thought the lightbulb was dead but sure enough a new lightbulb didn’t work either. It was defective in some way. For as much as I loved it’s beauty I returned as defective. I didn’t trust purchasing another one. A disappointment. I don’t recommend.
