source_doc: Programmed fine but a bit concerned with other comments. This is a nice smoke alarm that I was able to program with no issues.  However, after reading some of the comments, I'm a bit concerned with where I planned to install it.There were a number of posts about false alarm posts.  There are so many positives that I still plan to use it, but it's not going where I wanted it, my living room ceiling.  I need a taller ladder to reach the ceiling and hearing about false alarms in the middle of the night is very discouraging for me to install where I intended.My thought at this time is to place it high enough in the room so that it's reachable with a step stool and, if I have no issues with false alarms, put it where I originally planned.  I burn a lot of firewood and the LR is right next to the garage so I wanted an alarm that would add some protection in those areas.I love the idea of getting an alarm wherever I may be but I certainly want a true signal.

source_doc: Poor Quality. On the positive side, the lock is easy to install. The directions are clear and the lock has a voice menu. After following the directions and installing the lock, I added batteries and set the administrative passcode. I then programmed the lock for a left hinge door - all very easy following the instructions. Beware, after making these settings, the door locked. I wasn't able to unlock it with the passcode. I had to retrieve a spare key and enter through another door. After deleting the default passcode, I set up my own passcode. So far so good. I then tried locking the door by pressing the # key for 2 seconds. I heard the motor whir and the voice stating that the door was locked. Unfortunately, door was not locked. The deadbolt hadn't moved. Whether I tried locking or unlocking the door, the motor would whir and the voice would announce door locked, BUT the deadbolt never moved or engaged. It would not lock or unlock. I was disappointed because the features of this lock were exactly what I was looking for. Quality is just not there.  I returned it.
hypos: Špatná kvalita. Na pozitivní straně je zámek snadno instalovatelný. Pokyny jsou jasné a zámek má hlasové menu. Po dodržení pokynů a instalaci zámku jsem přidal baterie a nastavil administrativní heslo. Poté jsem zámek naprogramoval pro dveře s levými panty - všechno velmi snadné podle pokynů. Pozor, po nastavení se dveře zamkly. Nebyl/a jsem schopen/a je odemknout pomocí hesla. Musel/a jsem si vzít náhradní klíč a vstoupit jinými dveřmi. Po smazání výchozího hesla jsem nastavil/a své vlastní heslo. Zatím dobré. Poté jsem zkusil/a zamknout dveře stisknutím klávesy # na 2 sekundy. Slyšel/a jsem motor hučet a hlas říkal, že dveře jsou zamčené. Bohužel, dveře nebyly zamčené. Západka se nepohnula. Ať už jsem se snažil/a dveře zamknout nebo odemknout, motor hučel a hlas oznámil, že dveře jsou zamčené, ALE západka se nikdy nepohnula ani nezapojila. Nezamkla se ani neodemkla. Byl/a jsem zklamaný/á, protože funkce tohoto zámku byly přesně to, co jsem hledal/a. Kvalita prostě chybí. Vrátil/a jsem to.

source_doc: 2012 RAM 2500 ST 6.7L  Transfer case switch perfect  replacement. I was stuck and put my truck 4low, and a service 4wd light came on. Once I was no longer stuck, I shifted it back to 2wd hi, and the dash said I was in 4 hi. So I wanted to see if it was in 4wd. I put my truck in my yard and stomped it, and of course, I was actually in 2wd. I placed it in 4wd and stomped it I was in 4w drive. My truck is a manual floor shift for the transfer case if that helps anybody, which means no electronic actuator to replace for 529.00, just a sensor (Dorman 600-555 ) for 83.00 at Autozone or 60.00 at amazon. I would purchase it again and I suggest going to Harbor freight tools for a 1-1/2-inch spanner wrench or the spanner wrench set for 65.00. the Spanner wrench would fit in the space much better than huge combo wrench. it took only 25 minutes to remove and install please use dielectric grease in the switch plug to keep water out.

source_doc: I chose DAY LIGHT so it's bright. I argued for years with hubby as he prefers the softer white bulbs and I find them too yellow and need the BRIGHT. I finally made a believer out of him. He's 85 so he's entitled to his opinion I just know when it's my space I need the white light. Don't consult just do it and he then is fine. Ask or try to discuss it with him oh best not. After 51 years together yeah I've got this part of relation side figured out. Usually...lol. All in the lights are BRIGHT. Should have bought a bigger pack or at least two. I would by more but they do not state if they can go inside enclosed lamp fixtures or sealed ones. So for that I didn't buy more. But happy with them and replaced some LED spot lights in sewing room fixtures we bought at hefty price a few years ago but Hubby snuck in 2 yellow lights in there...they look yellow when the 8 track plus 2 more lights most are bright white day light versions and two were the soft white. So these are so bright they are wonderful and I quickly used the remaining two about the house too. I do wish they all would come out ready to be stable in enclosed fixtures though. I can't deduct because I knew that when I bought them. And they weren't put in enclosed fixtures.

source_doc: So glad I found this!!! I have experienced shoulder and neck pain for over 20 years now. I blame it primarily on a lot of customer service work and years talking with customers on the phone prior to the advent of headsets (and I had to crook the phone between my neck and shoulder). I am always on the look out for a good heating pad and massager. I had been using a standard heating pad (rectangular) but I was super excited to try this. I love that it is custom made for shoulder pain. Once on, it hugs my back neck and shoulders and supplies wonderful heat. The heat is evenly distributed and has multiple settings to give me just what I need. I love that this heating pad covers the whole area that I need help with. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a great heating pad for your upper back, neck and shoulders!

source_doc: Absolutely Luxurious. I have been singing the praises of Andy Pandy diapers for six years and you could not have paid me to use anything else. Until the size large were out of stock for months. I had no choice but to find something similar and I did when I came across Eco Boom. Then for a reason I cannot recall I was on the hunt again. These diapers were on sale and oh how I wish I had been able to purchase more because they are the best diaper I have ever put my hands on. The feel absolutely divine, almost too good to be something a little human poops on. source_doc: These made for a great relaxing evening! I like to give my wife massages. She has lots of back pain and tension. I have a set of stones I bought prior, but no heating source. I would put them in a pot of water and heat them, then bring them into to room. This was kind of a pain. This lets me keep them right on my nightstand. Takes about  20-25 minutes I guess to heat them. Wasn't timing it. For me by the time I was ready to put the stones on, they were ready to go. Not too hot! They were very soothing. I actually put some of my other stones in to heat them as well but honestly, I didn't end up using them. The stones that come with it are enough to put them on the spots that needed them. I watched many YT videos on how to do massage, and where to place the stones. Getting pretty good at it now! :-) I have used products from SereneLife in the past and have been happy with them, so I chose these. Nice case/heater combo. Well thought out. Easy controls.

source_doc: Beautiful and super easy. Update: Removing these weren't bad. Most of them were ready to come off at about 1.6 weeks. Next time I plan on using a brush on glue as I think that may be a little easier but all in all, they went on easily. The length is great and not too long that they get in the way. I may try a longer one at some point just to try it but I have a feeling the "RS White Cream French Tip" will be my go to.I 100% recommend these especially because of the tabs. Its easy to pick out the size and then grab the matching nail for the other hand. The set that is a medium length doesn't have the tabs. I'm going to try them but I already know I love the tabs.These are great. I'm not sure how they will be when I want to remove them. Hopefully not too hard.I did accidentally pop my thumb nail off the first day but I'm guessing I may not have used enough glue. source_doc: So awesome probably for everyone. I just started to learn how to play. I bought this back in august and it has been amazing. I find it easier to learn to play a song if the guitar sounds like what I’m attempting to emulate. There is no sound this thing can not produce and with the preconfigured sets that users put out it’s an endless supply of sounds. From Hendrix to Freddy Fender. When I purchased it I thought it was the 100% cordless one. It was not so I just went ahead and bought that smaller one too. I hate cords, and with my wireless sender / receiver and the smaller spark it’s going to be so freeing to go anywhere. Now if you’re new like me you will love this I promise. I matter who you are. If you’re a pro I am not sure but I am sure you would probably enjoy this as well. Also for such a small amp it packs a hell of a sound. Must buy.

source_doc: Nothing special. I had never tried this scent before, but I read about it. I found the history aspect of it interesting. It was cheap enough, so I ordered it. Once I smelled it, I tossed it in the trash. I would say the scent is familiar, but not sure from where. The scent is not terrible, but I don't find it pleasant. I smelled my wrist a little while later to see if it would grow on me, and the smell wasn't even there. So not only doesn't it smell great, it doesn't last an hour. I would not recommend buying this unless you have smelled it in person. source_doc: Great. I haven't put together many things in my life and I did this so I would say it was fairly easy.  It was harder logistically to get it together than it was to figure it out (getting the screws in odd places and holding bars until I could get the screws on and tightened enough that things weren't falling).  I read some reviews about not tightening all screws until the end and that helped.One thing I found odd, when I went to tighten the screws, the metal frame bent from the force of the screws.  I'm not all that strong and didn't torque on them as hard as I could so I didn't expect that.  I was a little nervous that I had messed up (I still am), but I loaded it up with weights and it seems OK.  It's not super strong, like I can push on it and feel it move a little, but it's not wobbly so I'm hoping it's OK.

source_doc: Can I give these more than 5 stars?! I love the convenience of using a Swiffer for quick clean-ups.  I have four rescue dogs and foster frequently too so I definitely use my Swiffer a lot.  But let's face it, the Swiffer doesn't really do a great job of cleaning.  In one area of my house, I have tile that was put down years ago before it became more popular to use the larger tiles (my tiles are probably only 12" tiles so I have lots of grout).  The Swiffer doesn't seem to really get down in the grout to clean.  I bought these reusable pads mainly because I thought they would be cheaper in the long run.  An unexpected huge bonus was finding how much better they actually work than the disposable Swiffer pads!  These pads are thick and absorbent.  They make it a tad bit harder to push your Swiffer around but the results are so much better and worth the extra effort!  I haven't tried to wash them yet. I have only just rinsed them off and reused them but will wash them soon and update if I have any issues (but I don't anticipate any problem with them). They do come with instructions telling you not to use fabric softener on them - just an FYI. So glad I ordered these and I will definitely order more!
hypos: Můžu dát těmto více než 5 hvězdiček?! Miluji pohodlí při používání Swifferu na rychlé úklidy. Mám čtyři záchranné psy a také často pečuji, takže určitě hodně používám svůj Swiffer. Ale pojďme si říct, že Swiffer opravdu neodvádí skvělou práci při úklidu. V jedné části mého domu mám dlaždice, které byly položeny před lety, než se stalo populárnější používat větší dlaždice (moje dlaždice jsou pravděpodobně jen 12" dlaždice, takže mám hodně spárování). source_doc: Is not easy to assemble! I have had a pack and play in the past, easy to set up and take down.  I wish that I had that one back but I sold because I thought we were done with grandchildren.  To our surprise we have a new grandchild so I purchased the Dream On Me, because of the reviews.  The ease to set up and take down does not happen with this unit.  It took three of us to get it into a locked position so that we could lay the baby down.  I now am afraid to take down because I may not be able to get it set up again especially on my own.  I would look for another brand.I wish I could return however I didn't have a need to use until the child was 4 months old and I purchased right after her birth.  Not happy.

source_doc: Poor packaging. Are you kidding me ??? I was looking for ice packs that will last for hours without sweating too much. I Came across these and made the purchase. When they arrived the package was not at all what I expected.It was not completely sealed and therefore, parts were missing.there was only 4 ice packs included instead of the 5 as described. The funnel was missing as well as the cork-type pieces that are supposed to be used to fill the packs then seal the openings. In all fairness, I contacted Amazon and a replacement set will be sent to me. I do, however must return this set so I won’t be charged twice. Obviously I am quite disappointed with this product and company. I am looking forward to finding out if the new set will work as I originally anticipated.  As of right now, I do not recommend this product!UPDATE : well the second set was delivered and WHAT…the package was open and contents are missing. AGAIN !  How does this happen twice in one month ? Although this time I did get all 5 ice packs, but the funnel and 5 blue stoppers are missing. I’m done. This time I am returning and expecting my money back! At a price of $18.98 I truly expected better quality in the packing from manufacturer. Do not waste your time or money on this frustration !

source_doc: Just what I needed. incremental degrees of lighting is helpful. I needed a lamp for my desk, so I was pleased to try this gooseneck lamp. It clamps onto the desk securely via a spinning C-clamp (as opposed to one you pinch to open). Since it can be tightened and loosened it is quite stable. I tried this lamp in different positions so I clamped it and reclamped it with no issues until I found exactly where I wanted it.I REALLY like that I can increase the light output incrementally (10 levels) from quite dim to nice and bright. There are also 3 different light modes: warm light (2700K), warm white light (4500K), and cool light (6500K). Each of these modes also can be increased/decreased incrementally. Really nice for helping prevent eye fatigue.The neck/arm is 24" and the light strip is 11". I really didn't notice the power supply before I got it, and assumed that it was a normal plug, but it has a USB plug at the end instead. It seems that I'm finding this to be the case more and more. Not an issue except I have to grab some more USB adapter blocks.Made in China.

source_doc: I do love this water bottle. I found this water bottle at a great deal when I was looking to add a new one to my collection. I love the colors - and there were a ton to choose from. The motivational writing on the sides is cute and I know works for some people. I don't necessarily follow them strictly during the day, but they do help to keep you a bit on track for water consumption. The outside has a good grip, even if you have melting ice trying to form some condensation. The handle is also great for carrying it around. It fits into most cupholders in the car or even in a backpack side pocket. The lid has been great for keeping the water inside the bottle and not leaking. I love the ease of pressing the button and having the spout pop up. The only thing I'm not a huge fan of is it is a little difficult to clean the straw. I haven't tried to force it from the lid because I don't want to break it. But I don't think you can detach it from the lid. I'm just extra vigilant about regular rinsing and soaking in hot soapy water and hoping no mildew or mold ends up growing in there. Overall a great water bottle and probably one of my favorites from the many I have tried.

source_doc: Used for cabinets, WATER DOWN YOUR PAINT. I have never sprayed paint before and I bought this for a laundry room project to paint unfinished Home Depot cabinets.At first I hated this thing, it only has 1 PSI setting and it blows HARD. First pass with sanding sealer was a nightmare and resulted in large bubbles and all of my (quickly applied) masking tape and plastic getting blown off.Then I switched to paint and I kept getting speckles and not enough paint. I was about to give up and just roll the cabinets with paint, but after a huge mess and lot of trial an error I found that watering my paint down MUCH more than recommended worked great. You'll still see speckles or even globs of paint, but they dry fine and are not noticeable at all.I was using .5cup of water with the paint inside of the container (Sherwin Williams cabinet paint) of the gun and what I found to work perfectly was about 60% paint, 40% distilled water in the container. I had much better results and after 3 coats with sanding in between they looked awesome.I finished the cabinets with 2 coats of Minwax Polycrylic and they came out great. There are some remaining drips from my first coat of sanding sealer that I missed when sanding so I would just be careful to not apply too much and test a lot on cardboard.

source_doc: Versatile and the perfect size, I wish the keycaps were transparent. I really like this size in a portable keyboard. It's small enough that it'll fit easily in a backpack but big enough to have cursor and function keys. All it's missing is the number pad and I can always get a standalone one of those for the occasions that I need it.This keyboard connected very easily with the included cable, dongle and also over Bluetooth. I noticed no typing lag in any mode, but I wasn't using it to play games. The dongle slips into a little pocket underneath the keyboard to reduce the chance that it gets lost. The included instructions are brief but comprehensive.The keys feel great to type on. You can definitely tell you hit the key but it's not super loud like some other mechanical keyboards. The spacebar makes a different and louder sound, but I like that too.There are plenty of backlighting options, and the keyboard remembers the last one you set. My biggest complaint is that the keycaps are not transparent, so it's harder to identify the keys in the dark. A minor quibble is that I don't like the side-by-side notation for shifted keys, I prefer when the shifted key shows up over top of the non-shifted key.Overall, I think this is a great portable keyboard with a lot of versatility in connections. I only wish the keycaps were transparent.

Nepoznal/a jsem žádné zpoždění při psaní v žádném režimu, i když jsem ji nepoužíval/a pro hraní her. Dongle se skryje v malé kapsičce pod klávesnicí, aby se minimalizovala šance na jeho ztrátu. Přiložené instrukce jsou stručné, ale výstižné. Klávesy se skvěle píší a určitě pocítíte, že jste stiskli klávesu, ale není to tak hlasité jako u některých jiných mechanických klávesnic. Mezerník má jiný a hlasitější zvuk, ale to se mi také líbí. Existuje mnoho možností podsvícení a klávesnice si pamatuje poslední nastavení, které jste zvolili. Moje největší výhrada je, že klávesy nejsou průhledné, což ztěžuje jejich identifikaci ve tmě. Malou výhradu mám vůči vedlejšímu označení "shiftovaných" kláves; dávám přednost, když se "shiftovaná" klávesa zobrazuje nad "ne-shiftovanou." Celkově si myslím, že to je skvělá přenosná klávesnice s velkou variabilitou připojení. Jen bych si přál/a, aby klávesy byly průhledné.

source_doc: Seemed great until I realized how off it was. I thought this would be the best thermometer ever because it can quietly read a sleeping child’s temp or easily read another child’s temp without contact. We have had this thermometer for 6 months and I thought it was reading accurately the whole time (we have used it maybe 10-15 times) and battery is still great. But when I took my 6 month old’s temp it kept saying 98 or 99 and I just KNEW she felt hotter than that. So I got our the trusty rectal thermometer and sure enough it read 4° higher! I understand it being a decimal off but FOUR DEGREES? That’s unacceptable. I wish I would have done this test months ago so I could have returned it! I got this thermometer because it had thousands of great reviews!

source_doc: Perfect fit for SRX 2012 13582688...Why I remember this number? Because this was the BCM number in my SRX, and I had a hard time finding it new. That was also before I learned EEPROM...anyways. I saw this one, and it was reasonable, I tried to google to see if it will work, no clear answer. I finally contacted Cadillac and they told me yes it fits, then I purchased it. I did have hard time to get the car start even after programming the part, then I copied the EEPROM from my old BCM, wrote that in the chip, it showed "EEPROM PROGRAM INCORRECT". So what to do? I just ran SPS2 and reprogrammed the BCM again, then everything worked. Car started fine, most of the error message is gone on the dash. That was great! Then I purchased ALLDATA subscription, and under the BCM replacement, it showed this one as the only one fit for my car. So happy!

Nakonec jsem kontaktoval/a Cadillac a řekli mi, že ano, pasuje, tak jsem to zakoupil/a. Měl/a jsem těžký čas dostat auto nastartovat i po naprogramování dílu, pak jsem zkopíroval/a EEPROM z mého starého BCM, napsal/a to do čipu, ukázalo to "EEPROM PROGRAM INCORRECT". Tak co teď? Jen jsem spustil/a SPS2 a znovu naprogramoval/a BCM, pak vše fungovalo. Auto nastartovalo v pořádku, většina chybových hlášení na přístrojové desce zmizela. To bylo skvělé! Poté jsem zakoupil/a předplatné ALLDATA a pod výměnou BCM to ukázalo tento jako jediný, který se hodí pro moje auto. Tak šťastný/á!

source_doc: Batteries. So far I do like this wet vac. I've discovered that if I don't run a dust mop over the floors first, the "suction pipe needs cleaning" command is given. If I dust mop first, I totally avoid needing to stop, dump dirty water, flush out dirty water tank, and then resume. If I don't dust mop first, I need to rinse the "suction pipe" maybe 4-5 times. After self-cleaning, I do take a rag and hand dry the rollers, they're pretty wet! Also, I find every time that there's material that needs to be wiped out of the roller compartments, and where outlet where the dirty water is conduited into the suction pipe of the dirty water chamber. I have a question in to the seller as to how to change out the rechargeable batteries. I looked everywhere, called Amazon, and they gave me a link to do this. All that being said...it's STILL steps above my old mop and pail! I am not regretting the purchase, which was made a couple of months ago...

Pokud nejdříve nepoužiji prachový mop, musím "vysávací potrubí" propláchnout možná 4-5krát. Po samočistění vezmu hadr a ručně osuším válce, jsou docela mokré! source_doc: Very nice! source_doc: I bought a bunch of these and so far, so good. I bought an air purifier for each bedroom in my house and I have a big Winix downstairs to help combat our outrageous fur and dust issue. I like these little ones because they are really really quiet on low. The high setting is a little much sound-wise so I have to agree with other reviewers that there should be a medium setting to move more air but still be quiet. But I do keep them on low and they seem to collect plenty of stuff so I can't complain too much. The color is a little odd, but pleasant if you like blue. I can't comment on the sleep mode because I never use it. I just leave them on low at all times instead. I don't use the light up function either because I like my bedroom dark when I'm sleeping. Overall, I think that for the price, they are a good deal and every little bit helps in my house full of cats and dogs. I also like that you can get filters easily and it's made by a big name brand instead of a small company overseas that could stop offering filters at any time. I think this a good buy and I like them.

Nemohu posoudit režim spánku, protože ho nikdy nepoužívám; místo toho je nechávám neustále v nízkém režimu. Osvětlení také nepoužívám, protože preferuji tmu ve své ložnici, když spím. Celkově si myslím, že za tuto cenu představují dobrou investici a každý malý detail pomáhá v naší domácnosti plné koček a psů. Také se mi líbí, že filtry lze snadno sehnat a vyrábí je známá značka, nikoli malá společnost v zahraničí, která by mohla kdykoli přestat nabízet filtry. Myslím, že je to skvělý nákup a mám je rád/a.

source_doc: Least irritating shave I've had in a while. I didn't think there could be too much difference between these and the other razors I've purchased and have been using. While shaving, these seemed as good but no better than a new blade of the other brands I have. What surprised me, was afterwards when I was applying alum and expecting the burn I typically get there was none. I looked these up and the only thing I could tell that is different (from the details in the listing) is that the grind angle is different than other blades might use. This really does seem to make a difference as the next time I used them I experienced the same thing, and I know for a fact that burning is from the micro cuts you are getting when shaving. Alum on shaved skin exacerbates that burn, but with these so far there has been no burn. Hopefully I keep having the same luck, but I highly recommend these as a result!

source_doc: Stopped working after a the first time using.  I paid for shipping on the replacement. I got this as a present so that I can have radio with my partner whilst biking.  I received it for Christmas and live in a winter wonderland so I only tried this once and it worked fine.  Then the weather finally got bearable to bike and low and behold it did not work.  It was passed the time to return it to Amazon so I had to try to get a replacement from Senna.  After a few weeks of back and forth I finally received an RMA but I had to pay shipping.  Maybe this is standard but it is really disappointing that I have to pay out of pocket for a product that is defective.Sound quality is not good but I guess I should have expected it.  No base and only really good for the spoken word.  It tells you to download the app but the only thing the app is good for is the instructions.The helmet itself looks nice and fits comfortably.If I could do it all again I would choose a different company.

source_doc: Love the scent. First thing I do on any new shampoo or conditioner is smell it to see if it smells nice.  Both the conditioner and shampoo passed with flying colors.Shampoo first.  I like a squeeze bottle over a pump.  I just feel that I can utilize the entire bottle over a pump bottle.  Shampoo did lather nice.  Again, I liked the smell of it as I was washing my hair.Rinsed off and left my hair feeling clean.  Not the dry squeaky type of clean.  A nice soft clean.I then put on the conditioner before I washed up so it would sit in my hair for a few minutes before rinsing.  Like the shampoo, I loved the scent.Nice thicker conditioner.Rinsed off and towel dried my hair.  It didn't get every tangle out but I could tell I had less tangling.  I have very long hair so it's close to impossible to not have a few tangles.My hair felt soft and smelled so nice.  Even after blowing it a little dry, it felt soft.Once I straightened it, my hair feels like silk.  I love it.Price is a little on the higher end.  But ,the bottles are large and with not having to use as much as some other hair products this should last quite awhile.  So price can be comparable.

source_doc: A complete waste of time and money!! Do yourself a favor and look at other tankless rv units by OTHER manufacturers! The listing says that it will fit and opening but this is false! I originally purchased this to go in a travel trailer but it was entirely too small to fit in the opening. I never installed it but decided to hold on to it for my next RV. I recently purchased another RV and the existing water heater was shot so I got this unit out and placed it in the RV. The first time that I used it, it worked great!! I was pleased. The next morning when I tried to do dishes I kept getting an error code and the hot water would immediately shut down. When I very first turn the water on the sensor says that the water is 199 degrees so the unit thinks that the water is too hot. So, now I have to order and install a new temp sensor after using this unit 1 time! A ripoff. I can get no support or warranty repair because I purchased it 2 years ago even though it was kept in the box in new condition I have no support! A complete waste of time and $600.00.

source_doc: Good keyboard for the money. This keyboard feels really good for the price point. I like the somewhat stiff action and the quiet clicking sounds. I enjoy using this keyboard and I use it all day. I have not tried it for gaming yet but for the everyday tasks that I do while working. My son tried it out with some games and he said it was pretty good. The RGB lights are fun, but they do not add a lot for me personally. I may just be too old to enjoy that stuff. ;)  I have two things that I wish were different. First, the indicator lights that show Caps Lock, Num Lock, and Scroll Lock are not very bright. They are white labels with white lights, and I can barely tell if they are on or not due to the reflection of my overhead lights. With all the RGB on the keyboard, I wish these indicator lights were bolder. Also, I was excited about having a keyboard for my PC that had mute and audio controls on it. Unfortunately, I have not found any way to invert the function keys so that I can use the audio controls without also holding down the FN key. The FN Lock just locks the whole keyboard which isn’t all that helpful on a desktop compared to its usefulness on a laptop, if those two items were fixed, I would give this keyboard a five-star rating.

source_doc: Nice to be able to order the buttons without the entire assembly... I use Straploks on all my basses. I have three straps, and each one has the male portion of the Straplok system. On my main strap, I have four Straplok male connections so that I can achieve the correct playing position for different basses. Each time I purchase a bass, the first thing I do is to change the existing buttons to the Straplok buttons. Until recently, I thought it was necessary to buy the entire assembly, even though all I needed was the buttons. Now it is nice to be able to order just the buttons, but I believe they are priced too high. The entire assembly can be purchased for just $5 more than the buttons alone, which makes no sense, since the male portion of the assembly is much more complex to manufacture compared with the button portion. Still, I would rather pay $5 less and not have too many useless male portions just lying around. I think $5 or so would be a more fair price, not that Dunlop is listening to my advice. lol.

source_doc: Woks well for fine, straight hair. This is one of the better hair masks that I've found at this price point for my super fine, straight hair. While I wouldn't say it makes a hugely dramatic impact, it's noticeably stronger than regular conditioner. It adds a bit of shine, detangles, and makes my hair more manageable overall. I really struggle with volume, so the fact that this smoothes without flattening is a huge win for me. I also like that I can see its benefits while sticking to my extremely basic hair care routine. I use my normal shampoo and conditioner beforehand and simply comb and air dry afterwards.It does work a bit slower than similar treatments I've used, so I always make sure to thoroughly saturate my hair and leave it on for at least 7 minutes. If I rinse it much sooner, I don't notice the full effects. A little goes a long way though. I start with a small glob to avoid wasting it and usually add a little extra to my ends, as they tend to dry out. It doesn't magically fix split ends, but they do seem to occur less often when I use this mask a few times a week. One tub lasts me several months that way. I think it's a good value overall and will continue purchasing it!
hypos: To funguje dobře na jemné, rovné vlasy. Toto je jedna z lepších vlasových masek, které jsem našel/a za tuto cenu pro své super jemné, rovné vlasy. I když bych neřekl/a, že má obrovský dramatický dopad, je znatelně silnější než běžný kondicionér. Přidává trochu lesku, rozčesává a celkově dělá moje vlasy snadněji ovladatelné. Opravdu se potýkám s objemem, takže to, že to uhlazuje, aniž by to spláclo, je pro mě obrovské plus. Také se mi líbí, že mohu vidět jeho výhody, zatímco dodržuji svůj extrémně základní rutinní péče o vlasy. Než to použiji, použiji svůj běžný šampon a kondicionér a potom jen pročešu a nechám uschnout na vzduchu. Funguje to o něco pomaleji než podobné léčby, které jsem používal/a, takže se vždy ujistím, že důkladně nasytím své vlasy a nechám to na nich alespoň 7 minut. Pokud to opláchnu mnohem dříve, nevšimnu si úplných účinků. Ale kousek toho opravdu stačí. Začínám s malým množstvím, abych se vyhnul/a plýtvání, a obvykle přidám trochu navíc na konečky, protože mají tendenci se vysušovat. Magicky to neopravil/a rozštěpené konečky, ale zdá se, že se objevují méně často, když tuto masku používám několikrát týdně. Jeden kelímek mi takto vydrží několik měsíců. Myslím, že to má celkově dobrou hodnotu a budu pokračovat v jeho nákupu!

source_doc: Just what I wanted. I had a jump rope but I didn’t like the super light jump rope cord on it. I needed something a little heavier that I don’t have to spin at a thousand miles an hour to make it track straight. This kit is fantastic, I trimmed the medium cord (the black one) to the size in needed with the included tools and took off using it like I’ve owned it forever because it felt so natural. The medium is perfect for me but I will also trim the other two cords to the same length so I can mix it up now and again. I have nothing but good things to say about this set, the handles are comfortable and spin well, the quick release system works well, all three included cords seem high quality and the case is nice. The extra set screws and Allen wrench were a nice touch and the cable cutters are so nice they are going right in my tool box after I get my other two cords sized. In my opinion this jump rope set is a great value and I can recommend this without reservation.

source_doc: Lasted longer than I thought. I teach a sport that requires me to pack food for 14 hour days on the weekend. I try to pack as lightly as possible because everything has to be transported with my on a bus and then into schools, it's a whole thing. Since I'm on a special diet I bring all my food for the day but I try to fit it all in one lunch bag. That was not really possible with those hard plastic ice packs that I would typically use. However, with these, they don't take up as much space and they still lasted me at least 8-10 hours and still felt cold.Do I think these will work well for more than 8-10 hrs? I don't think so. But if you are using these for school lunches I think they would do the trick. Because of their size they don't take up a lot of room so I was able to use both of them to make sure I could be near more than one item in the bag.I'll keep trying these each weekend and see if I can narrow down exactly how long they last but if they're well frozen and in a decent lunch bag you should be good to go.Also, I love the color of these. :-)
hypos: Trvalo to déle, než jsem si myslel/a. Vyučuji sport, který vyžaduje, abych si na víkendové dny balil/a jídlo na 14 hodin. Snažím se balit co nejlehčeji, protože všechno musím převážet autobusem a pak do škol, je to celá věc. Protože jsem na speciální dietě, nosím si celé jídlo na den, ale snažím se to všechno vejít do jedné tašky na oběd. To nebylo opravdu možné s těmi tvrdými plastovými chladicími vložkami, které bych typicky používal/a. Nicméně, s těmito, nezabírají tolik místa a vydržely mi alespoň 8-10 hodin a stále byly studené. Myslím si, že tyto budou fungovat dobře déle než 8-10 hodin? Nemyslím si. Ale pokud je používáte na školní obědy, myslím, že by splnily svůj účel. Díky své velikosti nezabírají moc místa, takže jsem mohl/a použít oba, abych se ujistil/a, že mohu být blízko více než jednoho předmětu v tašce. Budu to zkoušet každý víkend a uvidím, jestli se mi podaří přesně zjistit, jak dlouho vydrží, ale pokud jsou dobře zmražené a v slušné tašce na oběd, měli byste být v pořádku. Také miluji barvu těchto. :-)

source_doc: Does not stay on well. I need to preface this review by saying that I am new to doing my nails at home. I have always been a nail biter and picker. So, before spending money on going to a salon and have my nails professionally done only to tear them up, I thought I would try it at home. I used this gel in particular to attach nail extensions to my natural nails. I then used a dip powder to polish them. During the entire process three nails came off very easily. I simply figured I had not used enough of the gel and replaced the nails using more gel. However, once all was said and done, and I was finished with the manicure, the nails still popped off quite easily. So in my very unexperienced opinion, this gel does not seem to stay on your natural nails very well. I still gave it three stars because it could entirely be user error on my part.

source_doc: Works so good but you'll never use this much. First of all my child had mild cradles cap, or so I thought. I used this in the bath and I thought I did it wrong cuz I saw no difference or I thought maybe it wasn't bad enough to work I have no idea. We continued the bath and when I took her out her head was covered in white softened cradles cap flakes! It did work, I just needed to wait I guess. We combed them out etc.  And we ended up doing this for 2 days in a row at bath time And she's never had it again. My only criticism is that I wish there was a smaller volume of this stuff that cost less. I'll never use it all even if I had 5 babies with cradles cap. Unless its like a chronic condition that keeps returning for some idk why someone would need this much. The product itself though it amazing and I highly suggest it.

Pokračovali jsme v koupání a když jsem ji vyndal/a, měla hlavu pokrytou bílými, změklými vločkami krusty! Opravdu to fungovalo, jen jsem asi musel/a počkat. Pročesali jsme je atd. Sám produkt je ale úžasný a vysoce ho doporučuji.

source_doc: BUY THIS AMAZING POWER!!!!! I'm not a "makeup kind of girl" anymore.Now,that I'm 42. But, I have blotchy skin, from getting so tan,when I was younger(I'm Italian). source_doc: Love them. I just purchased for a second time.Pros:I like these because they have a size 0 that is wide. These nails are durable and lasted me two weeks. (Of course that depends on how you apply your nails.)They come with a lot of nail sizes, which I like. I have wide width nail beds and their size 0 fits great. (Since I repetitively use the 4 & 5, I wish you could just order your sizes versus having extra sizes I cannot wear, but I get my money’s worth by using the extra nails to practice designs.)FYI, I use gel polish so it definitely makes them look professional. They are thin by the cuticle and thicker at the end so it makes it easier to file to fit your nails and look like acrylics.The price is great for how many nails you get and for the quality. I did crack a nail after I took them off, but this was me putting a heavy object on them. Please do not think these nails are unbreakable, because they can. They are still very strong (not fragile) and did excellent for the two weeks.Lastly, I did not have any issues where I had to contact customer service so I cannot speak to that, but the product is good. I will buy again.

source_doc: Definitely worth a play at a discounted price. Feels like a PS2 era game in regards to voice acting and hack and slash combat but, it’s actually pretty challenging to master the combat in this game. You can actually do some pretty neat things with the gum and katana strung together. You can also hit and then guard cancel into another attack to save animation frames, the game never explains this but once you get a hang of the combat it’s actually a lot of fun.The huge issue I have personally for the game is that it is somewhat too difficult. I have played the game about 7 hours and beaten a couple of bosses and I understand the gameplay loop and how to play, I just feel the checkpoint system makes the game too challenging. The game itself is difficult, but I genuinely enjoy the combat and the challenge to some extent, I just need more checkpoints after completing a challenging area. Often times I will play through a 5-10 min section of the game, just to die and have to replay it, over, and over again. I feel like I really do enjoy how tough the combat feels because overall it feels fair, but it’s hard to not make many mistakes through the long combat sections and overall I ended up losing interest in the game prior to finishing it. I don’t want the Combat to be easier, I just need more checkpoints.

source_doc: I keep coming back to this foundation. I’ve tried other foundations over the years but seem to always come back to this one. I have fair skin and use the L1 ivory color. My skin is also sensitive and I honestly find this somewhat soothing.No fragrance, not too thin (I do like some coverage for my uneven skin and some minor scarring) but not too thick. It actually glides on very smoothly with my make-up sponge. It easily smooths into the hair line and blends well over the chin-to-neck area. No obvious borders from skin color to make up, so I know it’s a good color match for me.I like the pump feature for ease of putting on my sponge (I never apply foundation with my fingers), but I do hate leaving product in the bottle when it gets low. I typically save a “low” bottle and then when my next bottle gets low, I stand one on top of the other to hopefully drip down into the bottom bottle. There is still some waste, but at least I’m getting the use of more product. I think there are even small make-up “spatulas” out there, so perhaps I will try that.I dislike spending money on high-end make-up, and I find this is a quality brand and good value. I highly recommend.

source_doc: Good for GI issues. I decided to try this food for my APT, who was having intermittent diarrhea.  I initially thought it was related to NSAIDs, as she needs them daily for arthritis.  At wits end, I tried stopping the NSAIDS as a last resort, as I also tried MANY supplements and changed her food, with still no signs of her loose stools resolving.  Chicken and rice helped the most, but I knew she couldn't stay on it forever.  My dog's only symptom was diarrhea.  Her appetite and energy were normal (both over the top) and she would have formed stools as often as diarrhea.  Her weight remained unchanged.At the time I switched to Dave's dry food, I was feeding our dog Blue Buffalo Basics Salmon dry food and white fish wet food.  I didn't realize these were grain free, as I was focused on the "basic" part of the food.  In chatting with a vet, I learned that sometimes grain free diets in dogs can lead to intermittent diarrhea.  After  much research of good quality and affordable dog food for sensitive systems, I came across Dave's Pet Food and decided to try it.  Within a month our dog was back to having consistent formed stools, even while taking her NSAIDS.  I would highly recommend this food for dogs with sensitive systems and GI issues.

source_doc: Hard to press keys. I bought the newer black widow on Dec 23rd 2021 and had it until I bought this one in October of 2022, due to the black widow having a sticky spacebar situation and whenever I hit keys around a and a itself, it would constantly add an a next to the other one to look like leaaving, laake, the like... you probably get the drift.Now only having had this one since October and the other one only lasting 10ish months before I went crazy enough to replace it, the keys on my Ornata are really hard to press down on at times. I can't just do a normal soft typing, I have to force it down with effort when trying to type and that's like half my keys on this keyboard... I didn't spill anything on this keyboard either. I don't know why it is like that. It is driving me crazy though.I am pretty disappointed in razor. I used to recommend them, but two keyboards in a row that aren't making it a whole year? One not even barely half a year? I can't recommend their keyboards anymore. For that I am sad.

source_doc: So perfect, except.. I love so many things about this bag, but I didn’t end up keeping it because while it is beautiful and functional, I don’t feel like it will stay beautiful for long haha. The inside is a white satin - so pretty - but I have a 3 yo and 1 yo and my diaper bag is regularly filled with crumbs and wrappers and other things they throw in there on occasion, but to keep it short, I don’t want to stress about my beauty diaper bag getting dirty when it is my messiest season of life.Here are some things I absolutely loves though:- so pretty, obviously- so functional. I LOVE the inside space and how easy it is to see everything. I wish so much I could duplicate it on a less luxury bag lol- the hidden magnetic closure on the side pockets to keep them minimal when you’re not using them- the little front pocket for easy access to my keys/phone, though the opening kind of tight and hard to get intoOverall I love it, so much. But I can’t justify the spending for something that will ultimately be more or less trashed by the season of life that I’m in, and I don’t want to be stressin about the appearance of the inside of my diaper bag lol. hopefully one day I can come back for it :)
hypos: Tak dokonalé, kromě.. Miluji tolik věcí na této tašce, ale nakonec jsem si ji nenechal/a, protože ačkoli je krásná a funkční, nemám pocit, že by zůstala krásná dlouho haha. Uvnitř je bílý satén - tak pěkný - ale mám 3leté a 1leté dítě a moje taška na plínky je pravidelně plná drobků a obalů a dalších věcí, které tam občas hodí, ale abych to zkrátil/a, nechci se stresovat, že moje krásná taška na plínky bude špinavá, když je to mé nejšpinavější období života. Tady jsou některé věci, které absolutně miluji:- tak pěkná, samozřejmě- tak funkční. MILUJI vnitřní prostor a jak snadné je vidět všechno. Tak moc bych přál/a, abych to mohl/a zdvojit na méně luxusní tašce lol- skryté magnetické zapínání na bočních kapsách, aby zůstaly minimalistické, když je nepoužíváte- malá přední kapsa pro snadný přístup k mým klíčům/telefonu, i když je otevírání trochu těsné a těžké na dostání. Doufám, že se pro ni jednou mohu vrátit :)

source_doc: Better than the Toyota factory links. My elderly Toyota had a rattle that I had a lot of trouble pinning down.  It would happen as I went over some bumps but not others.  It would act up so intermittently that I couldn't figure it out.  After a lot of driving around and head-scratching I finally narrowed it down to a worn out front sway bar link on the passenger side.The factory Toyota links are non-greasable.  Mine lasted almost 200k miles which is certainly a good track record, but when it came time to replace them one of the reasons I chose the Moog parts is because I can grease them.Yeah, I know suspension grease nipples have gone the way of vent windows and manual door locks.  Modern suspension components are Lubed For Life (yeah right) and last a long time.  Except when they don't.  Besides, I don't mind hitting a dozen fittings with the grease gun once every few months.So I bought the Moog links, installed them, and pumped them full of grease.  It's been a few years and almost 100k miles and the Moogs are still going strong.  I think I've lubed them twice in all that time (so much for those grease fittings) but they're as quiet and slop-free as they ever were.If I ever manage to wear out the links again, I'll buy another set of Moogs.
hypos: Lepší než tovární spojky Toyota. Moje starší Toyota měla zvýšený zvuk, který jsem měl/a hodně problémů identifikovat. Objevovalo se to, když jsem projížděl/a některými nerovnostmi, ale ne jinými. Chovalo se to tak příležitostně, že jsem na to nemohl/a přijít. Po hodně jízdě a přemýšlení jsem to nakonec zúžil/a na opotřebovanou přední spojku stabilizátoru na straně spolujezdce. Tovární spojky Toyota nejsou mazný. Moje vydržely téměř 200k mil, což je určitě dobrý výkon, ale když přišel čas je vyměnit, jedním z důvodů, proč jsem si vybral/a díly Moog, je, že je mohu mazat. Jo, vím, že mazací čepy zavěšení už jsou jako okna s větráním a ruční zámky dveří. Moderní komponenty zavěšení jsou navrženy na doživotní mazání (jistě) a vydrží dlouho. Kromě případů, kdy nevydrží. Navíc mi nevadí jednou za pár měsíců projet se mazací pistolí kolem deseti spojení. Takže jsem si koupil/a spojky Moog, nainstaloval/a je a naplnil/a je mazivem. Uběhlo několik let a téměř 100k mil a Moogy stále fungují skvěle. Myslím, že jsem je za tu dobu mazal/a dvakrát (tak much pro ty mazací spojení), ale jsou tak tiché a bez vůle, jaké byly kdy jindy. Pokud se mi někdy podaří opotřebovat spojky znovu, koupím si další sadu Moog.

source_doc: I love this thing! This product came and it was exactly how I expected it to come. Shipped perfectly! This thing works great, and has a mind of its own (in the best way). I usually like to run it when I am at home, just incase it gets stuck or anything, but it also runs while I’m at work! Which is awesome because it makes the house feel a little bit cleaner when I get home and takes the stress off a little bit. I like to use this in between vacuums too, and I can’t believe how much it picks up even right after I use my vacuum! I would recommend this to pretty much everybody, especially pet owners with a dog who sheds, like me! Great product! The app is so easy to use and I can start the cleaning or pause the cleaning right from my phone, from anywhere! I don’t have to be home to operate it which is another added bonus! Plus it alerts you if the vacuum is stuck or has low battery.

source_doc: I buy for convenience. I buy this strictly for the convenience factor. I do a lot of cooking from scratch and many recipes call for bell peppers. I have a smaller refrigerator and I’m tight on space. This can is huge, so I poured it into a 2.7 Quart Lock n Lock container. As you can see, there’s plenty of room leftover. I could probably fit it into an even smaller container. So while the can is huge, there is significantly less product than I expected. I realize it’s sold by weight, not volume.After the initial shock of a half empty can, I can say I am still happy with this purchase. I’ve always got peppers available now; no last minute shopping trips to the grocery store to finish making a meal. The smell is that of fresh peppers and the taste has been very good in every dish I’ve made with them. I’ve used in meatloaf, soup, poultry dishes, and even omelets. For omelets, I let them sit in the egg mixture for 5 minutes or so with an additional tablespoon of water before adding to a hot pan. Peppers are pretty expensive these days, so I think this is a good value and I’ll definitely buy them again, especially when they’re on sale.

Tato plechovka je obrovská, takže jsem ji přelil/a do nádoby Lock n Lock o objemu 2,7 litru. Jak vidíte, zůstává spousta místa. Pravděpodobně bych to mohl/a vměstnat do ještě menší nádoby. Takže i když je plechovka obrovská, je tu výrazně méně produktu, než jsem očekával/a. Uvědomuji si, že se prodává podle hmotnosti, ne objemu. Po počátečním šoku z poloprázdné plechovky mohu říct, že jsem s tímto nákupem stále spokojen/a. Vůně je jako čerstvé papriky a chuť byla velmi dobrá ve všech pokrmech, které jsem s nimi připravil/a. Použil/a jsem je do sekané, polévky, pokrmů z drůbeže a dokonce i do omelet. source_doc: Does as advertised, well designed, well built. I have a 26” wallyworld special that I converted to an electric hub several years ago.  I love my bike, but it is big, meaning it takes up a lot of room.  I wasn’t sure if this tire holder would work, as the bike has reasonable sized tires and is heavy.  It does work and it works well.  I rotate the bike up, the wheel pops into the holder, all is right with the world and I have reclaimed space in my 1 car garage.This is well designed and well built.  5 stars all the way!Note: I have been an Amazon customer for almost 20 years. I write all of my reviews to reflect my personal observations and opinions on a product. It matters not if I have purchased the item myself or if it was provided to me for review. My goal is to provide other potential customers as much real-world knowledge as possible to make an informed decision. In most cases I will return to my review in 6 months or less to see if I should alter my original observations. In no case will the cost of a product influence my opinions at all. In addition, I will try to include multiple images and or videos on each product, if practical.
hypos: Dělá to, co je inzerováno, dobře navrženo, dobře postaveno. Mám 26” speciál z wallyworldu, který jsem před několika lety převedl/a na elektrický náboj. Mám rád/a svůj bicykl, ale je velký/á, což znamená, že zabírá hodně místa. Nebyl/a jsem si jistý/á, zda bude tento držák na kola fungovat, protože bicykl má přiměřeně velké pneumatiky a je těžký/á. Funguje to a funguje to dobře. Bicykl zvednu, kolo se zacvakne do držáku, všechno je v pořádku a znovu jsem získal/a prostor ve své jednomístné garáži. Je to dobře navrženo a dobře postaveno. 5 hvězdiček bezesporu! Poznámka: Jsem zákazník/ce Amazonu už téměř 20 let. Píšu všechny své recenze tak, aby odrážely mé osobní pozorování a názory na produkt. source_doc: So far, so good. I received this yesterday, so I cannot speak to its long-term reliability.  However, I would like to make a few points.  It is smaller than described. About 4 inches wide instead of the 6.3 inches in the description, which fits nicely on my dash.  I chose the "warm light" color.  Gold really, and this fits well with my other dash lights.  The more popular green would have looked much more like an added, non-factory accessory.  It started working right out of the box; however, I did charge it further before installing.  It took about two hours.  Yes, the instructions are poorly translated  from the Chinese.  As with many other consumers, I wish that the Chinese manufacturers would simply find a native English speaker to write their instruction manuals.  Too proud, I suspect.  In any event, If you have trouble with the directions find a 14 year-old to do it for you.  I'm 72 and I managed.  I set it so that only the time shows.  I would have included the temperature, but it will only show that in Celsius.  I don't need the date and year, so I passed on that, too.  My car does have a factory clock, but it is small and poorly placed.  This does the job.  I'll post a follow up in a year or so if I have any further comments or problems.  If you don't see a follow-up then so far, so good.

source_doc: So far this bed is awesome! At 5'9" with a model like frame, I had to get help with the box b/c it's weighs more than I do.After that, opening it and placing it on the platform was easy.  As soon as I removed the plastic, the bed started to inflation. It took 24hrs to get to its full size. However, I opted to follow directions and let it sit for more than 48 hours without touching it at all.The corners of the bed are sturdy and did not collapses as shown in some pictures.There was a smell but it was not strong. The smell dissipated once the bed fully inflated.It took my body about three weeks to adjust to it.  I thought it was too firm at first but it turned out to be just right.I have a metal platform frame and it sits well without sliding even though I have additional space on the frame.  Pics will come soon.  I had the bed for about 6-8 weeks and I love it.  I also noticed that I don't have back pain or feel stiff when I wake up.The price was exceptional.This is a great buy if you follow directions to the T.  Check back for an update in April 2023.

Nicméně jsem se rozhodl/a dodržet pokyny a nechat ji stát více než 48 hodin bez toho, abych se jí dotkl/a. Rožky postele jsou pevné a nezhroutily se, jak je vidět na některých fotografiích. source_doc: Perfect for my needs!! I am preparing for a Uromastyx. I am getting the enclosure, lights, and decor just right before I get my new guy or girl. I want to add some wood pieces in and these work for me. I couldn't really picture the sizes when I ordered them, so I just went with this size as it was a little larger. If you have a big enclosure, you may want to get even larger. I have a 4x2x2 (120 gallon) enclosure from dubia.com. My enclosure is huge!! I think I will end up buy a few more pieces of wood that are at least 14 inches and up. I have rocks, bricks, tile, and these wood pieces. There is still lots of room for more. I am happy with the look and feel of this wood. It shipped very fast. I have no issue with it. It is perfect for a smaller tank or enclosure. It is fine for a larger one also, just understand you may need bigger ones as well. I don't regret my purchase and would buy again. I think it adds layers and lots of areas to climb on.

source_doc: Well ... if it's all you've got, it's better than nothing i guess. I really wish I'd taken photos of this after i used it the second time. I was hacking at a relatively small branch of a tree for my pet squirrel's habitat. It was the second time i used it and up until this use, i felt it was pretty sturdy and durable. I aimed and struck about 4 times and the ax head just broke right off the handle. I definitely wasn't expecting the head to just fall off. I'm hoping it was just an issue with this one ax and not the entirety of them. Like, maybe i just got a defective or a bad one ? Not going to pay more money to find out though. I hope you have a better experience with yours than i did mine if you do purchase one.

source_doc: dont be fooled. update to the lower comments:if you ever plan on taking the child seat off like we did, the lid is almost useless for sitting, the lid slides around ALLOT, the child seat was helping make it all stronger, once that off not good. of course if you dont ever sit on a closed lid then its a non-issueseat is good enough, only reason I marked down a star is for the advertised (removable) child seat. I wouldn't consider something yo need to sue a pryer on to be "removable" unless they are just talking about the fact it can be removed after the kid no longer needs. I assumed it was to be able to take off and clean, not the case, I thought I was going to break it when I did. so much so I thought maybe I miss read the advertising and came back to read again to make sure. I wouldn't have even attempted it if I was just cleaning as I was that sure it would break. we just didn't need it so I didn't care if it broke.

Aktualizace k níže uvedeným komentářům: pokud někdy plánujete sundat dětskou sedačku jako my, víko je téměř k ničemu na sezení, víko se hodně pohybuje, dětská sedačka pomáhala všechno zpevnit, jakmile je pryč, není to dobré. Samozřejmě, pokud nikdy nesedíte na zavřeném víku, pak to není problém, sedačka je dostatečně dobrá, jediný důvod, proč jsem udělil/a jednu hvězdu méně, je za inzerovanou (odnímatelnou) dětskou sedačku. Nepovažoval/a bych něco, co potřebujete poškodit kvůli tomu, abyste to nazvali „odnímatelným“, ledaže by mluvili pouze o tom, že to může být odstraněno, když dítě už nepotřebuje. Předpokládal/a jsem, že je to proto, abyste to mohli sundat a vyčistit, ale to tak není, myslel/a jsem, že to rozbiju, když jsem to udělal/a. Tak moc, že jsem si myslel/a, že jsem si možná špatně přečetl/a reklamu a vrátil/a se, abych to přečetl/a znovu, abych se ujistil/a. My jsme to prostě nepotřebovali, takže mi nezáleželo na tom, jestli to praskne.

source_doc: I am impressed. I have never purchased anything that has impressed me more than this.  I have a 130 lb yellow lab that sheds a pound of hair a day.  I am constantly chasing hair bunnies and sweep my floor daily.  He has very thick hair but this works great, I filled the bin the first use.  I have brushed him everyday and no longer have hair everywhere.  The best part is that he loves it.  I pick up the hose and he comes running.  The only down side is that my arms get tired before he does.  The best purchase I have made in a really long time.  I even used it on our cat, she was not as happy as he was but did let me brush her for about 10 minutes before she flipped her tail and left.  I could never brush them in the house because hair would fly everywhere I spent more time cleaning up after brushing than I did brushing. This brushes and vacuums at the same time which is wonderful, no mess to clean up.  It is amazing how much hair is in the bin.  My only regret is that I didn’t buy it sooner.  I am happy and the dog is thrilled that he gets brushed everyday.  The noise is low so it doesn’t bother him.  I highly recommend this product

source_doc: Holy smokes! (Or holy flame?!) Geeze very few times have I actually bought something especially on Amazon and I’m blown away with the quality and price. (I’m not getting paid for this review but I should). This little thing packs a hell of a punch!!I have a Kamado joe grill and also a solo stove so I figured a propane torch would help speed things up. I tried the welding torch I have but it has a check valve and it’s a super small flame. I bought a cheap one off Amazon for 30 bucks and it failed on arrival. I waited a while and saw grillblazer. I really wanted that long one they got but no way I was shelling out 200 bucks and still need a kickstand for it to stand on its own.So glad I saw this and watch’s several YouTube reviews on it. Figured I’d give it a try and so glad I did. Now I can use my charcoal grilled just as fast if not faster than my propane grill on weekdays/nights :)

source_doc: BEST PAIN RELIEF PRODUCT I’VE EVER TRIED!!! I have lived with multiple pain sites in my body for 60 years: Severe neck and lumbar pain as well as shoulder and leg pain. I have tried dozens of topical products including creams, lotions, sprays and CBD preparations. I have never found one that I was even marginally happy with. I will admit that I am quite often unhappy with these products because of their odor; I simply cannot stand anything that smells like BenGay or Mentholatum. These odors are so pervasive and make my pajamas, my sheets and my pillowcase reek—one use and the odors refuse to dissipate until I shower and wash all my bedding! The other thing is that I dislike anything that causes sensations to my skin—burning, cooling or otherwise.Now let me tell you about my experience with Theraworx: NO odor whatsoever; NO burning, cooling, prickling sensations; and NO sticky, unpleasant residue on my hands. I can use it at my bedside without having to get up and wash my hands before going to sleep. But, of course, that is not the best part. The best part is that IT ACTUALLY WORKS—every time, at least for me! I highly recommend that you give this product a try. I am so glad I did!

source_doc: Works great for me! I have found that nothing alleviates my arthritis pain better than a hemp product. Until I tried this soft gel, I had only used a tincture. Using a tincture is fine, it’s just hard to carry around. I fear that it might leak inside my purse or that I might drop and break the bottle. The soft gels have solved those problems. The soft gels are small and are easy to put inside a pill box. I can now take them with me wherever I go. I have found that the arthritis pain in my hands and feet is reduced much better than an OTC arthritis drug, and hemp is a natural product, The recommended usage is 1 to 2 soft gels and I find that I get great results with just 1. source_doc: So convenient! My old pill organizer broke so I needed a new one. After comparing so many, this was my choice and I have been very happy with it. I don't actually take meds 3x daily, but in the morning I take vitamin C and biotin that are both chewables. So I put those in the center compartment. I love that the containers can be removed for travel when I might not need to pack the entire week's worth. I have had to come up with a way to easily fill these with my pills which is a little less convenient with the individual containers, but still worth it. I actually purchased 2 of these so that when I am filling them, I do both at the same time and don't have to deal with it as often.

source_doc: Very impressed with the quality of this microphone. I have to say I was pretty blown away by the sound and quality of this microphone. Out of the box, I saw that it was modeled after the Sennheiser series which I own. This allowed me to do a side by side comparison. Now it does come with it's own cord, but I tossed it aside as for using this mic you will in fact to get the best results want to use a full XLR cable. To be honest, I could not tell the difference. The WEYMIC has just as much warmth and presence as my mic. Weight, construction, looks exactly like my own mic, so needless to say, I was very impressed. Since I was at band practice, I let the other guys listen while I tried both and they also could not tell the difference. Just so you know, the WEYMIC microphone is now on my stand and my previous mic is with my guitar player who also shares vocal duties. This works out great since both mics match in sound and quality. I couldn't be happier with this and have hopes that in the future I'll be able to try out some of WEYMIC's other products. This mic well earns 5 stars. Thank you.

source_doc: A little smaller than expected. I wear a size XL glove and they fit perfectly so I went with the XL size slide but it's a little tight. The first time I put it on I actually had a moment where I thought I was in trouble and really had to yank to get it off my finger. I thought maybe I just put it on too deep but after looking at the video they have that's not the case, it's just a little too snug to wear like that.Otherwise I like the idea and if I had gone a size up I think I would really like it. I like the one I got enough and am able to use it and get a sense of the "ergonomic design" which is actually pretty nice. I was ripping No More Tears earlier and it sounded much better with a slide as intended rather than faking it.

source_doc: Great versatile lamp that gives off plenty of light. I mostly got this lamp because I wanted something we could use when the power goes out. We have high winds where I live and usually a few times a year they end up making the power lines where I live go down. Amazingly enough two days after this light arrived our power went out for about 3 hours. I was so happy I had charged this little lamp and had it to use. It gave off all the light we needed. I even put it at lower light to make it last longer since we had no idea how long the power would be out. The only thing the least bit negative is that it takes a long time for it to fully charge. I set it to charge as soon as I opened it and probably 4 hours later it was still glowing with the red light so I ended up leaving it on for the night. It was fully charged when I got up the next morning but I really don't know just how long it took. So far we have used it for maybe 5 hours all together and it's still going strong. I'm really happy with this light and I'm even thinking of getting another one to keep on hand for the next time we lose power. Definitely recommend this light.

source_doc: I love it. I did significant research before pulling the trigger on the Honbay modular sectional. I’m so glad I did. My family and I absolutely love it. As other reviews mentioned, 5 out of 7 boxes arrived earlier than expected. The 2 remaining boxes arrived the next day. Once I had an idea of what I was working with in my space, I ordered two additional ottoman pieces to create the sectional I had envisioned. I have a weird space in my living area so many traditional sectionals would be too large. It was super easy to assemble, I did it myself over the course of the two arrival days. I love the storage in each piece, which really helped to declutter my living area and eliminated the need for two storage baskets, freeing up floor space in the process. I love the firmness of the seats. I would agree with other reviews that the back cushions could be fluffier but I added a lot of my own pillows which solves that problem for me. My kids and my dog have bounced around on it and I haven’t noticed any instability. With the layout I chose, I love the little cutout which makes it easy for kids or dog to climb in. I’m so thrilled with my new sectional. If you are on the fence, do it!!

source_doc: Good keyboard for Mac. I have an apple wireless extended keyboard and I like the simplicity but was never happy typing on it for long periods of time.  I bought this one because I was hoping for the feel I had with the older Apple keyboards.  I miss those.  This one is a pretty good replacement.  The key feel is good for touch typing and the angle doesn't make my hands as tired after a long time banging away at the keys.The light effects I do not find necessary but I do like the setting that illuminates the key that was just typed.  I just wish there was a way to lock that selection in as if I accidentally hit the key that switches the light setting I have to toggle all the way back to where is was.

source_doc: Two pieces! Can use both at same time or just lumbar, just seat. I took a 4587 mile road trip a few months ago for ministry. Oh how I wish I had this then! The one I had slipped and slid every time I got in and out of the car and—  lost it’s cushioning. Sore bottom!  I love the fact that I can choose to use just the seat or just the lumbar or both at the same time. Very comfortable. VERY comfortable!  I have a lumbar seat in my CRV but this gives even more solid support. My biggest problem has been my seat after several hours of long distance driving. This seat is WONDERFUL!  It doesn’t slide around when you get in and out of the car due to several details. The raised pimples on the bottom with a material that doesn’t slide. Also the space separation for each leg. Each one has an elastic strap that can be clipped around the seat. I took a 3 hour, (6 hours round trip)  the day I received this. No pain. No fatigue. No slipping and sliding. I absolutely feel much less fatigued with this support. I love this!!!  Needed it years ago!  Glad to finally have it now. Highly recommend.

source_doc: Good seat for floor play. I bought this seat for my 5 month old to help her sit up even though I was hesitant. We are doing as much of the Montessori method as possible, so I do my best to minimize her time spent in ‘containers’. There are still times where I want/need her to sit by herself for independent play while I complete a task and this fits the bill.The seat is lightweight, which makes it easy to move from room to room or travel with. The tray is very easy to install. Right now I put her in it and place on or two of the toys in our current rotation for her to play with on it. She seems to focus on them more in this upright position than she does in tummy time. I only use the seat after she has had some tummy time and I don’t keep her in it for more than 15-20 minutes.For what it is, I think the price is high. I don’t really need it as a booster seat, as we have a tripp trapp high chair and a Montessori table we’ll use when she starts solids next month. I can see how it would be helpful to people who don’t have or don’t want to buy those things.

Děláme co nejvíce podle Montessori metody, takže se snažím minimalizovat její čas strávený v 'kontejnerových' věcech. Přesto jsou chvíle, kdy chci/potřebuji, aby seděla sama na nezávislé hry, zatímco dokončuji nějaký úkol, a toto sedadlo to splňuje. Sedadlo je lehké, což usnadňuje jeho přemísťování z pokoje do pokoje nebo cestování s ním. Tácek se velmi snadno instaluje. Teď ji do něj dávám a umístím na něj jednu nebo dvě hračky z aktuálního výběru, aby si s nimi mohla hrát. Zdá se, že se na ně více soustředí v této vzpřímené pozici než při 'tummy time'. Používám sedadlo jen po tom, co měla nějaký 'tummy time', a nenechávám ji v něm déle než 15-20 minut. Za to, co to je, si myslím, že je cena vysoká. Opravdu to nepotřebuji jako zvýšené sedadlo, protože máme tripp trapp vysokou židli a Montessori stůl, který budeme používat, když začne s pevnou stravou příští měsíc. Vidím, jak by to mohlo být užitečné pro lidi, kteří tyto věci nemají nebo nechtějí kupovat.

source_doc: Works for me and helps improve my sleep. I was a little unsure about this because I've tried a wide variety of supplements for sleep and not a lot has been effective.I bought these during a bout of stress induced insomnia causing me to wake up around 4-6 am, unable to fall back asleep. Or I would try to sleep early and would struggle for hours to fall asleep. I was exhausted and desperate.These tablets have seemingly helped to stabilize my sleep enough to where even if it's interrupted, I can get back to sleep quickly. I don't wake up feeling groggy like I do if I were to take something like zzzquil.I'm so happy to have these and will definitely always keep them stocked for those stretches of time where my sleep just won't cooperate.Edit: one caveat is these contain lactose. I do not recommend if you are severely intolerant. I have a sensitivity to lactose myself and sometimes I do get a little extra gassy/bloated from taking these, but not enough to where it disrupts my sleep. These are not effective for all situations but months later I still find them helpful most of the time.
hypos: Pro mě to funguje a pomáhá mi to zlepšit spánek. Byl/a jsem trochu nejistý/á, protože jsem vyzkoušel/a širokou škálu doplňků na spánek a ne moc jich bylo efektivních. Koupil/a jsem si je během období stresu způsobeného nespavostí, kdy jsem se probouzel/a kolem 4-6 ráno a nebyl/a jsem schopen/a znovu usnout. Nebo jsem se snažil/a usnout brzy a hodiny jsem bojoval/a s usínáním. Byl/a jsem vyčerpaný/á a zoufalý/á. Tyto tablety mi zdánlivě pomohly stabilizovat můj spánek natolik, že i když je přerušený, dokážu rychle znovu usnout. Neprobudím se s pocitem otupělosti, jako když užiji něco jako zzzquil. Jsem tak rád/a, že je mám, a rozhodně si je budu vždy uchovávat na ty období, kdy můj spánek zkrátka nespolupracuje. Edit: jedna výhrada je, že obsahují laktózu. Nedoporučuji, pokud máte těžkou intoleranci. Sám/sama mám citlivost na laktózu a občas se cítím trochu více nadmutý/á po užití těchto, ale ne natolik, aby to narušilo můj spánek. source_doc: I love everything about this, except for the price. I'm 32, acne prone, with combination skin (oily tzone, but dry around my chin). I don't use social media at all, but I am in Korea and my family gifted me some of this. I've been here a month and just finished a stick of it (well there's a bit more, but it's at the bottom and I can no longer glide it over my face). I did not apply it sparingly, used it most days and most evenings as I had forgotten my normal moisturizer. I found that sometimes I'd feel a pimple coming on and I think it actually helped it heal much faster. I haven't noticed wrinkle reduction, but my skin feels healthier and brighter. I tried slugging over it with CeraVe healing ointment, but that's too heavy together, unnecessary. I really like the scent and the packaging, I think I will repurchase, but if you're looking for wrinkle reduction - microneedling and/or retinol products will be more affective. This would be a nice product to alternate when not using retinol.
hypos: Miluji na tom všechno, kromě ceny. Je mi 32 let, mám aknózní pleť a kombinovanou pleť (mastná T-zóna, ale suchá kolem brady). Nepoužívám vůbec sociální média, ale jsem v Koreji a moje rodina mi nějaké z toho darovala. Jsem tu měsíc a právě jsem došla k tužce (no, je tam ještě trochu, ale je na dně a už ji nemohu klouzat po obličeji). Nanášela jsem to štědře, používala jsem to většinu dní a večerů, protože jsem zapomněla na svůj obvyklý krém. Zjistila jsem, že někdy jsem cítila, jak se blíží pupínek, a myslím, že mi to opravdu pomohlo se rychleji uzdravit. Nepozorovala jsem žádné snížení vrásek, ale moje pleť se cítí zdravěji a jasněji. Zkoušela jsem to zakrýt s CeraVe hojivou mastí, ale to je příliš těžké dohromady, zbytečné. Opravdu se mi líbí vůně a balení, myslím, že si to znovu koupím, ale pokud hledáte snížení vrásek - mikroneedling a/nebo produkty s retinolem budou účinnější. To by byl hezký produkt na občasné střídání, když nepoužívám retinol.
